articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: GEICO Donates $100,000 to Expand Collision Repair Tech Pipeline
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Engineering Career Alliance announced a $100,000 grant from the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation, GEICO’s charitable arm, that will give partner colleges standardized tools to attract students, engage employers and strengthen the pipeline of skilled collision repair technicians nationwide.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics projects 14,600 annual openings for collision repair technicians through 2034. Training programs supply only 42% of that demand, according to the TechForce Foundation 2026 Technician Supply, Demand & Opportunity Report.

Through a two-year associate degree and paid, hands-on apprenticeships, Collision Engineering helps students turn an interest in vehicle repair into a career. The grant will help partner colleges share that opportunity with more students.

“By donating to Collision Engineering, we’re opening doors for the next generation of technicians and helping address a workforce shortage that affects drivers, repair shops and insurers alike,” said Alan Durand, board member of the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation and head of associate experience at GEICO. “We’re proud to stand with Collision Engineering, educators and our industry partners to build a stronger workforce for the future.”
Grant to Support Recruitment and Employer Engagement
The contribution will support national infrastructure for student recruitment and employer engagement, including:
- A standardized recruitment framework and training for college recruiters, college staff and high school counselors
- Quarterly webinars and ongoing education
- A repeatable approach to student recruitment, employer engagement and placement
Together, these resources will help partner colleges reach more students, connect them with employers and expand the Collision Engineering model across the country.

“This donation gives Collision Engineering the national backbone every partner college needs to recruit more effectively, engage more employers and grow with confidence,” said Mary Mahoney, president of the Collision Engineering Career Alliance. “When industry, education and employers come together like this, we can offer more students in more communities hands-on training, paid apprenticeships and meaningful careers.”

Collision Engineering unites employers, colleges, industry partners and workforce leaders to build a stronger, more connected talent pipeline. The program combines a two-year associate degree with paid, hands-on apprenticeships at qualified collision repair facilities, and it is recognized by the U.S. Department of Labor as the standard for training collision engineering technicians. Students gain real-world experience, and employers gain access to a stronger pipeline of skilled talent.

“The collision repair industry talks a lot about the technician shortage, but solving it requires more than recognition,” said Laura Lozano, professor of collision repair technology and chair of the Automotive Department at Contra Costa College. “We need to introduce more young people to these careers and, just as importantly, connect them with employers willing to train and mentor them. GPF’s donation will help build those connections and give schools like ours the resources to reach more students and industry partners.”

paras.en: The Collision Engineering program is active at partner schools across the country, including College of Lake County in Grayslake, Ill.; Contra Costa College in San Pablo, Calif.; Parkland College in Champaign, Ill.; Metropolitan Community College in Omaha, Neb.; Sandhills Community College in Pinehurst, N.C.; North Dakota State College of Science in Wahpeton, N.D.; and El Camino College in Torrance, Calif.

“Through Collision Engineering, I graduated with a degree, real experience and a clear path forward,” said Karina Badillo, Collision Engineering graduate from the College of Lake County. “This industry is moving fast, and Collision Engineering prepared me to move with it. Donations like the one made possible by the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation will help more people get that same start.”
Employers, educators and others interested in helping students explore collision repair careers can learn about the program and ways to get involved at beacollisionengineer.com.

articles.title: Ohio Mutual Insurance Group launches ‘Trusted Repair Program’ DRP with CrashBay
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: CrashBay is now powering a direct repair program for Ohio Mutual Insurance Group.
According to CrashBay, Ohio Mutual announced the “Trusted Repair Program” earlier this year. CrashBay says Ohio Mutual was looking to streamline claims handling and improve shop relationships.
“Through its partnership with CrashBay, it now has one coordinated repair workflow that improves consistency, communication, and visibility across the entire process,” a CrashBay blog post states.
CrashBay says the workflow manages estimates, supplements, re-inspections, and communication between the carrier and its repair shops.

The post adds that the program “connects parties involved in automobile claims involving Ohio Mutual members with a trusted network of repair facilities and provides coordinated support throughout the repair process, from first notice of loss through completed repairs.”
CrashBay notes that it is the intelligence layer for collision coordination, and doesn’t own repair facilities nor perform repairs.

“Regional carriers like Ohio Mutual know their policyholders and their markets, and they want a repair program that reflects that without building the machinery to run one,” said John Harvey, founder and CEO of CrashBay, in the post. “We give them a coordinated, consistent repair process that fits how their claims team already works, so they get the benefits of a direct repair program without the administrative weight.”
The post adds that the program launch reflects a broader shift in how some regional carriers approach direct repair.
“Managing a shop network, keeping the workflow consistent, and coordinating communication no longer has to rest solely on internal resources,” the post states.

Clare Krumlauf, Ohio Mutual Insurance Group claims AVP, adds: “While insureds and claimants always retain the ultimate choice of which repair facility to use, the partnership with CrashBay adds another way for us to deliver on the trust our members place in Ohio Mutual. The program expands access to quality repair options while providing greater visibility and coordination throughout the repair process, helping those involved in a claim to navigate a challenging time with confidence.”

articles.title: CFA urges appointment of consumer-focused insurance commissioner in Texas
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: The Consumer Federation of America (CFA) urges Texas Governor-Elect Gina Hinojosa, in a letter sent to her this week, to appoint a new insurance commissioner who focuses on consumers.

“With escalating auto and homeowners insurance rates and harmful pricing practices that leave many consumers paying higher prices, the appointment of a pro-consumer Insurance Commissioner is essential to lowering the cost burden of insurance for millions of Texans,” states the letter signed by Douglas Heller, CFA director of insurance, and Michael DeLong, CFA research and advocacy associate.

According to the letter, the Texas Department of Insurance (TDI) is one of the best-resourced departments in the nation. However, over the last several years, the department has focused on protecting insurer interests and profits at the expense of consumers, the letter adds.
A consumer-focused leader at TDI could bring financial relief across the state, the letter states. Bob Hunter, a former TDI commissioner and CFA director of insurance, is pointed to as an example.
“Texas’s insurance market is one of the largest in the nation, worth about $294 billion and with more than $106 billion in direct written property and casualty premiums in 2025,” the letter states.
It adds that TDI is tasked with ensuring insurance rates are not excessive, inadequate, or unfairly discriminatory and that companies pay claims fairly and expeditiously.
TDI requires auto insurance, but the market is unaffordable for many Texans, the letter states. It adds that an estimated 14.5% of motorists in the state are uninsured.

“High prices disproportionately harm low-income consumers and communities of color because insurers include socioeconomic and personal characteristics of customers in their pricing models,” the letter states.

It adds that credit history pushes up auto insurance premiums for Texas drivers with perfect driving records. Texans with “poor” credit pay 126% more for basic coverage required by state law, it states.
CFA states that drivers with perfect driving records but “poor” or even “good” credit pay more for coverage than drivers with “excellent” credit who have been convicted of drunk driving.

“Legal and regulatory actions around the country are revealing insurers’ aggressive strategies to unfairly delay, low-ball, and deny claim payments to consumers,” CFA says. “Recently, the state of Oklahoma filed lawsuits against Allstate and State Farm for allegedly maintaining secret standards (reportedly also deployed in Texas, according to the State Farm lawsuit) where they attempted to close as many homeowners claims as possible without paying the customer anything and to reduce payments as much as possible, in spite of their massive advertising campaigns promising otherwise.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The letter also warns of increasing AI use by insurers in all aspects of the insurance product cycle with insufficient regulatory guidance or constraints.

“We expect that this will not only further disempower consumers when they buy insurance and file claims, but it will reinforce long-standing racial and ethnic biases that have harmed communities of color for decades,” the letter states.

The new commissioner must advocate for legislative reforms, including bans on socioeconomic factors insurers use to surcharge consumers higher premiums, and the creation of a low-cost auto insurance program for low-income drivers, the letter states.

“The commissioner must also provide guidance to insurers and consumers on how to reduce risk and hold insurers accountable for any mistreatment of consumers, including delays, denials, and minimizations of claims,” the letter adds.

articles.title: CIC committee tackles suggestions for AI use in claims handling
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: AI is involved in the auto claims handling process, but regulations have yet to catch up, Jill Tuggle, Auto Body Association of Texas executive director, said during the Collision Industry Conference’s most recent meeting held in Las Vegas.
The National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) approved a model bulletin in 2023 on insurer AI use that 25 states and Washington, D.C., have adopted, she said.
None of the states that have adopted the model require a human to make the final call on claim denials, she added.
An NAIC survey also found 88% of auto insurers are using or exploring AI, she said.
“We still have a long way to go,” Tuggle said.
AI now touches vehicle intake, photo review, estimating, valuation, and claim closure, she added.
Currently, a vehicle is often inspected by a shop and a field adjuster who agree on the required repairs, Tuggle explained. The estimate then goes to a central review team.

“We’re not really sure who is behind that right now,” Tuggle said. “AI is scrubbing the files in many cases, and these algorithms are built by the companies who are reviewing them. We’re not totally sure what the parameters are that are being set and how they’re writing the algorithms to take a look at these files.”
There are examples of automatic overrides for estimates that include more than eight hours of repair, Tuggle said.
A shop will reach out to a field adjuster to discuss the changes to the estimate, she adds. The shop is told the adjuster is no longer on the claim and the shop must call customer service.

“That’s when we start hitting brick walls,” Tuggle said. “So who actually made the final decision? So the issue here is the attribution gap. Who observed the car, the field adjuster? Who modified the estimate? The central team and their AI scrubbers? Who knows? That’s often very unclear. But the field adjuster is still named at the bottom.”
The CIC Governmental Committee found an example of an AI-handled claim where the shop estimate was about $2,500, Tuggle said. It came back from the central review team at $438.
The claim was closed because it was lower than the deductible, Tuggle said. She added there was no recourse for the customer on the claim decision.
“What consumers should be able to count on is knowing when AI material has shaped their claim and know who made the decision and how to reach out to them,” Tuggle said.
When asked, 67% of the CIC audience also believed consumers should know when AI is used in the claim handling process.

NAIC’s AI model is built on the existing Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act, she explains. It covers claims and fraud detection; states controls should scale with potential harm to consumers; and states that decisions cannot be inaccurate, arbitrary, or unfairly discriminatory.
It also requires insurance companies to set clear decision authority and escalation paths, test data and models, monitor for drifts, keep records, notify consumers of AI use, and oversee vendors.

Tuggle said the bulletin doesn’t require claim-level notice that AI shaped the estimate. It also doesn’t require a change log or final author on the estimate, a named accountable reviewer, or duties for shops or vendors.
There should be more oversight depending on the consequence, Tuggle said.
For example, disclosure isn’t necessary for administrative work such as scheduling, transcription, and document searching.
Perhaps there should be AI disclosure for AI drafts with review by a qualified person and the ability to change the draft, she said.
In a third scenario, insurance companies should provide a disclosure with a named approver and a reason when AI removes repairs, totals a vehicle, or flags fraud, Tuggle said.
A meaningful human review needs to meet five criteria, she said.
- “Competence: Can spot the technical error;
- “Evidence: Sees the photos, not just AI summary;
- “Time: Not racing a productivity quota;
- “Authority: Can override without layers of approval; and
- “Permission: Can disagree without penalty.”
Tuggle asked, “At the end of the day, when you’ve got an estimate where so many different entities and people have influenced it, who owns it?”

”That’s kind of one of the major issues,” she continued. “You have your data provider who supplies the inputs and your AI vendor; they’re building the models, the algorithms for the scrubbing software that they’re using at the central review areas. And then we’ve got our estimating platform, which embeds it into the workflow. Insurers approve or deny the claim, and the repair facilities perform the repair.”
Tuggle asked whether there could be shared responsibility that is also symmetrical in the process.
The committee also suggests duties for consequential AI. This includes AI disclosing material and preserving every estimate version.

It should also attribute credit to who inspected the estimate, which system was used, changes made, and who made the changes, Tuggle said. She added that insurance companies should explain the basis for each change and provide an escalation option to a human who can reverse it.
The name also must mean something, she said.
“The field adjuster’s name at the bottom of the file is not enough, and it’s not really getting us anywhere right now,” she said. “So, proposed again, a human decides the safety and critical items.”

The committee also proposes that a qualified human must approve any cuts to procedures such as structural repairs, airbags, seatbelts, restraints, scans, ADAS calibration, fraud flags, and other safety-critical items.
“AI can advise it, but it can’t be the only reason for denial,” Tuggle said.
James Spears, Tractable head of automotive AI, said during a panel discussion that it would be difficult to imagine all the ways that AI touches insurance claims.

“AI begins at policy acquisition,” Spears said. “AI begins before they even have a customer, right? AI is used in the way that you market. AI is used once you close a policy. AI is used in underwriting. AI is used all throughout in a number of ways.”
Many assume AI has evil intent, but it can increase claim speed and accuracy, Spears said.
He explained that the AI models the general public uses aren’t as advanced as the models insurance companies use. However, he said AI will advance significantly in the coming years.
Jerry McNee of Ultimate Collision agreed that AI benefits the user.
Before AI, a shop manually went through everything and took time pulling the repair processes. It took additional time to verify, he added.
Humans also have errors and miss procedures, he said.

“We have to get ahead of it, and we have to understand it, and we have to put it to work,” McNee said. “There still has to be some human interaction and touch on it, in order to proof it and make sure.”

“The best way to employ AI is to only use it as a tool that takes some mundane task off of your team,” Spears said. “Then push that team towards the customer. That’s where you really make a difference.”
He added that he disagrees with “straight-through” processing where a human never touches a claim.
The insurance and repair industries should work together to create rules AI can work within, he said.

“Ninety-five percent of AI will get you to yes with shared rules very quickly,” Spears said. “The other 5%, that’s going to be your escalation, and that’s when you get humans talking about it. That’s the way I would play the game. If I was sitting in a carrier’s chair right now, I would have shared rules with every one of my DRPs.”
AI can help speed up parts and rental car deliveries, Spears added.
When Tuggle asked whether consumers should be notified of AI use, Spears said they should.
“But here’s the deal: It’s not going to shock a consumer,” Spears said. “Because everything in their life has AI.”
“Absolutely, consumers should be informed, especially on the decision-making when it comes to their vehicle or their policy or returning the car back to its previous condition,” McNee said.
Jill Tuggle, Auto Body Association of Texas executive director, James Spears, Tractable head of automotive AI, Jerry McNee of Ultimate Collision during CIC in Las Vegas.

articles.title: Brake Job: 2020–2026 Buick Encore GX
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: I was recently working on an ASE A5 test-prep article, and we reached the section on parking brakes. Most parking brakes act on the rear wheels, so the test is structured around that arrangement. But some vehicles have parking brakes on the front wheels. I knew that some older Saabs and Datsuns used front-wheel parking brakes. One modern example is the Buick Encore GX.

On these models, pulling the park-brake switch sends a signal to the Electronic Brake Control Module. The module supplies 12 volts to the apply-control circuits and ground to the release-control circuits, activating the left and right park-brake actuators and applying the brakes.

Pressing the switch sends a signal to the module to release the brakes. The module supplies 12 volts to the release-control circuits and ground to the apply-control circuits, activating the actuators and releasing the brakes. Depending on the vehicle, the switch may be a push-button style. Pressing it commands the parking brakes to apply or release based on their current position.

The parking brake will release automatically if the engine is running, the vehicle is shifted into gear, and the driver attempts to move off. Avoid rapid acceleration while the parking brake is applied to help preserve the parking-brake lining.
The Electronic Brake Control Module, also called the Brake System Control Module, controls the park-brake motor circuits and runs diagnostics to verify that they are operating properly.

To replace the brake pads, the park-brake caliper pistons must be fully retracted. There are two ways to put the parking brake into service mode. The preferred method is to use a scan tool with a service-mode function. If you do not have a compatible scan tool, use this procedure:
- Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
- Press the accelerator pedal halfway down.
- Move the park-brake switch to the release position and hold it for 10 seconds. Release the switch.
- Within five seconds, move the switch to the release position again.

The actuator bolts to the back of the caliper and is not included with a replacement caliper. If you remove the actuator, GM recommends replacing the caliper’s O-ring. Front-wheel parking brakes may be a novelty, but they make an interesting piece of trivia to test your technician friends on.

articles.title: What Tire Wear Reveals About Suspension and Alignments
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: A driver rolls into the shop complaining that their tires are wearing out faster than expected. The vehicle drives reasonably well, and there are no obvious suspension noises. But a closer look at the tread tells a different story.
paras.zh: 一名司机冲进商店，抱怨他们的轮胎磨损得比预期的要快。车辆行驶起来还算不错，没有明显的悬挂异响。但仔细观察胎面却发现了不同的情况。

paras.en: Uneven tire wear can reveal problems with alignment, suspension components, tire inflation and ride control. Learning how to recognize these patterns gives technicians a valuable diagnostic advantage.
paras.zh: 轮胎磨损不均匀会揭示定位、悬架部件、轮胎充气和行驶控制方面的问题。学习如何识别这些模式为技术人员提供了宝贵的诊断优势。

paras.en: The key is understanding what each wear pattern means and knowing which components to inspect next.
paras.zh: 关键是了解每种磨损模式的含义并知道接下来要检查哪些部件。

paras.en: Start With Tire Pressure and Tread Depth
paras.zh: 从轮胎压力和胎面深度开始

paras.en: Before recommending an alignment or replacing suspension components, check the basics.
paras.zh: 在建议对准或更换悬架部件之前，请先检查基础知识。

paras.en: Inspect all four tires. Measure and record tread depth across the inner, center and outer portions of each tire. Compare the readings to identify differences in wear.
paras.zh: 检查所有四个轮胎。测量并记录每个轮胎的内部、中心和外部部分的胎面深度。比较读数以识别磨损差异。

paras.en: Next, check inflation pressure against the vehicle manufacturer’s specifications. Underinflation often increases wear along both shoulders, while sustained overinflation can increase center tread wear.
paras.zh: 接下来，根据车辆制造商的规格检查充气压力。充气不足通常会增加两侧胎肩的磨损，而持续的充气过多会增加胎面中央的磨损。

paras.en: Don’t overlook the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS). A warning light, damaged sensor or incorrect pressure setting may contribute to a problem that has gone unnoticed.
paras.zh: 不要忽视轮胎压力监测系统（TPMS）。警告灯、损坏的传感器或不正确的压力设置可能会导致未被注意到的问题。

paras.en: Also look for mismatched tires, damaged wheels and evidence of missed tire rotations.
paras.zh: 还要查找不匹配的轮胎、损坏的车轮以及错过轮胎换位的证据。

paras.en: These initial checks help determine whether the cause is tire maintenance, vehicle geometry or a mechanical problem.
paras.zh: 这些初步检查有助于确定原因是否是轮胎维护、车辆几何形状或机械问题。

paras.en: Inner-Edge Wear: Check Camber, Toe and Ride Height
paras.zh: 内缘磨损：检查外倾角、前束角和行驶高度

paras.en: When the inside shoulder wears faster than the rest of the tread, alignment geometry should be one of the first areas to investigate.
paras.zh: 当内侧胎肩比胎面其余部分磨损得更快时，对齐几何形状应该是首先要研究的区域之一。

paras.en: Negative camber means the top of the wheel tilts inward relative to the vehicle. Excessive negative camber can place additional load on the inner shoulder.
paras.zh: 负外倾角意味着车轮顶部相对于车辆向内倾斜。过大的负外倾角会给内肩带来额外的负载。

paras.en: Toe settings also matter. When wheels point too far inward or outward relative to the vehicle’s direction of travel, the tires scrub against the road instead of rolling cleanly.
paras.zh: 脚趾设置也很重要。当车轮相对于车辆行驶方向过于向内或向外时，轮胎会摩擦路面，而不是干净地滚动。

paras.en: - Problems with an air suspension system
paras.zh: - 空气悬架系统问题

paras.en: Independent rear suspensions deserve particular attention. Worn bushings can change wheel geometry during acceleration, braking and cornering.
paras.zh: 独立后悬架值得特别关注。磨损的衬套会在加速、制动和转弯过程中改变车轮的几何形状。

paras.en: Shop tip: Measure ride height before performing an alignment. If the suspension is sitting below specification, adjusting alignment angles alone may not solve the problem.
paras.zh: 商店提示：在进行对准之前测量行驶高度。如果悬架低于规格，仅调整对准角度可能无法解决问题。

paras.en: Outer-Edge Wear: Inspect Alignment and Body Control
paras.zh: 外缘磨损：检查对准和车身控制

paras.en: Excessive wear on the outside shoulder may indicate an alignment problem or excessive loading during cornering.
paras.zh: 外侧肩部过度磨损可能表明存在对准问题或转弯时负载过大。

paras.en: Positive camber, incorrect toe settings and worn suspension components can contribute to outer-edge wear.
paras.zh: 正外倾角、不正确的前束设置和磨损的悬架部件都会导致外缘磨损。

paras.en: Consider how the vehicle is driven. Crossovers and SUVs have relatively high centers of gravity, which can increase weight transfer during turns.
paras.zh: 考虑车辆的驾驶方式。跨界车和 SUV 的重心相对较高，这可以增加转弯时的重量转移。

paras.en: When springs, shocks or struts no longer control suspension movement effectively, the tire may experience additional loading and irregular wear.
paras.zh: 当弹簧、减震器或支柱不再有效控制悬架运动时，轮胎可能会承受额外的负载和不规则磨损。

paras.en: Diagnostic reminder: Outer-edge wear does not automatically mean the shocks are bad. Verify alignment and mechanical condition before recommending replacement parts.
paras.zh: 诊断提醒：外缘磨损并不自动意味着冲击不良。在建议更换零件之前，请验证对准和机械状况。

paras.en: Feathering occurs when the tread blocks develop a sharp edge on one side and a smoother, rounded edge on the other.
paras.zh: 当胎面花纹块的一侧形成尖锐边缘而另一侧形成更光滑的圆形边缘时，就会出现羽化现象。

paras.en: You may not notice feathering immediately during a visual inspection. Carefully running your hand across the tread in opposite directions can help identify the pattern.
paras.zh: 在目视检查期间您可能不会立即注意到羽化。小心地将手以相反的方向抚过胎面有助于识别花纹。

paras.en: Feathering commonly indicates an incorrect toe setting.
paras.zh: 羽化通常表明脚趾位置不正确。

paras.en: However, toe can change when worn steering or suspension components move under load. That means the alignment readings may not tell the entire story.
paras.zh: 然而，当磨损的转向或悬架部件在负载下移动时，前束可能会发生变化。这意味着对齐读数可能无法说明全部情况。

paras.en: Check for looseness in tie rods, control arm bushings and other steering components before making adjustments.
Remember that changing camber or caster can affect toe. That’s why toe is normally adjusted after other applicable alignment angles.
paras.zh: 请记住，改变外倾角或后倾角会影响前束。这就是为什么通常在其他适用的对准角度之后调整前束的原因。

paras.en: Cupping and Scalloping: Look Beyond Alignment
Cupping creates irregular high and low spots around the tire’s circumference. The pattern may resemble a series of shallow dips in the tread.
paras.zh: 拔罐会在轮胎圆周上产生不规则的高点和低点。该图案可能类似于胎面中的一系列浅凹陷。

paras.en: - Loose or damaged suspension components
paras.zh: - 悬挂部件松动或损坏

paras.en: Shocks and struts help control wheel movement as the vehicle travels over bumps. If they lose damping ability, the tire may move excessively and develop irregular wear.
paras.zh: 当车辆行驶在颠簸路面时，后减震器和前减震器有助于控制车轮的运动。如果它们失去阻尼能力，轮胎可能会过度移动并出现不规则磨损。

paras.en: However, wheel imbalance can create similar symptoms.
Shop example: A driver complains of a humming noise that increases with road speed. The rear tires show scalloped wear, but there is no obvious wheel-bearing play.
Before replacing a bearing, inspect the tire surfaces, check wheel balance and evaluate suspension condition. Tire noise can sometimes resemble a failing wheel bearing.
A vehicle’s suspension geometry is designed around a specified operating height.
paras.zh: 车辆的悬架几何形状是围绕指定的操作高度设计的。

paras.en: When springs weaken or suspension components wear, ride height can change. That affects camber, toe and the position of suspension control arms.
paras.zh: 当弹簧减弱或悬架部件磨损时，行驶高度可能会发生变化。这会影响外倾角、前束和悬架控制臂的位置。

paras.en: A small height difference may have a meaningful impact on tire wear.
paras.zh: 微小的高度差可能会对轮胎磨损产生有意义的影响。

paras.en: Measure ride height using the manufacturer’s procedure and compare the results against specification. Don’t assume that springs are healthy simply because the vehicle appears level.
On vehicles with electronic air suspension, check for leaks and verify that ride-height sensors and calibration are operating correctly.
paras.zh: 对于配备电子空气悬架的车辆，检查是否有泄漏并验证行驶高度传感器和校准是否正常运行。

paras.en: Don’t Forget Rear Alignment and Thrust Angle
paras.zh: 不要忘记后部对准和推力角

paras.en: Tire wear problems aren’t always limited to the front axle.
paras.zh: 轮胎磨损问题​​并不总是局限于前轴。

paras.en: The thrust angle describes the direction the rear wheels point relative to the vehicle’s centerline. If the rear wheels are not aligned correctly, the driver may need to compensate with the steering wheel to keep the vehicle moving straight.
paras.zh: 推力角描述了后轮相对于车辆中心线的方向。如果后轮未正确对准，驾驶员可能需要用方向盘进行补偿以保持车辆直线行驶。

paras.en: That condition can contribute to unusual tire wear and a steering wheel that appears off-center.
paras.zh: 这种情况可能会导致轮胎异常磨损和方向盘出现偏心。

paras.en: A four-wheel alignment can help identify these problems, particularly on vehicles with independent rear suspension.
paras.zh: 四轮定位可以帮助识别这些问题，特别是对于具有独立后悬架的车辆。

paras.en: When uneven tire wear enters the shop, use a consistent inspection process.
paras.zh: 当轮胎磨损不均匀进入车间时，请使用一致的检查流程。

paras.en: - Verify the complaint. Ask when the wear started and whether the vehicle pulls, vibrates or makes noise.
- Inspect the tires. Record tread depths, tire sizes, inflation pressures and visible wear patterns.
- Check the suspension. Inspect steering components, bushings, springs, shocks and struts.
- Measure ride height. Compare measurements with factory specifications.
paras.zh: - 测量行驶高度。将测量值与工厂规格进行比较。

paras.en: - Check alignment. Review camber, caster, toe and thrust angle where applicable.
paras.zh: - 检查对齐情况。如果适用，检查外倾角、主销后倾角、前束角和推力角。

paras.en: - Verify the repair. Correct the cause, evaluate tire safety and explain the findings to the customer.
The Takeaway: Let the Tires Guide Your Diagnosis
Tires are more than replaceable wear items. They provide clues about how the vehicle’s steering, suspension and alignment systems are working together.
Recognizing those clues helps technicians diagnose problems earlier, protect customers’ tire investments and avoid unnecessary repairs.
paras.zh: 识别这些线索有助于技术人员更早地诊断问题、保护客户的轮胎投资并避免不必要的维修。

articles.title: Think Twice Before Erasing Trouble Codes
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Counter pros should avoid erasing diagnostic trouble codes when customers request it. Clearing codes without fixing the underlying problem will only temporarily turn off the check engine light.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员应避免在客户要求时删除诊断故障代码。清除代码而不解决根本问题只会暂时关闭检查引擎灯。

paras.en: Erasing codes also deletes valuable freeze-frame data that technicians need for accurate diagnosis. Additionally, clearing codes resets emissions readiness monitors, potentially affecting vehicle emissions testing.
paras.zh: 擦除代码还会删除技术人员进行准确诊断所需的宝贵冻结帧数据。此外，清除代码会重置排放准备监视器，可能会影响车辆排放测试。

paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: NMG Gives UAC, Precision Vendor of the Year Awards
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。

paras.en: According to NMG, honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on “availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.”
paras.zh: 据 NMG 称，获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据“可用性、质量和响应能力，以及更严格的测试：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功服务”而选出的。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, president of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion Group 总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

articles.title: NTN Volunteer Event Supports Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corp. of America held its Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, on Tuesday, October 27. A team of twelve NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司于 10 月 27 日星期二在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。由 12 名 NTN 员工组成的团队自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并为当地家庭提供支持。

paras.en: Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags that will be distributed to families throughout the community. Designed as a “trick-or-treat” style shopping experience, team members worked together at various food stations, collecting and packing items including cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix, and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，这些食品袋将分发给整个社区的家庭。设计为“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物体验，团队成员在各个食品站一起工作，收集和包装物品，包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees assisted pantry staff with organizing and storing five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the work completed by the NTN team in a few hours would have taken the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers up to a month to accomplish.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工协助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，NTN 团队在几个小时内完成的工作需要储藏室的正式员工和志愿者长达一个月的时间才能完成。

paras.en: NTN’s Community Spirit & Engagement Program, launched in January 2023, includes contributing time and resources to charitable organizations, encouraging employees to take an active role in the local community, and building partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: NTN 的社区精神和参与计划于 2023 年 1 月启动，包括向慈善组织贡献时间和资源、鼓励员工在当地社区发挥积极作用，以及与其他团体和组织建立合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity, serving approximately 1,100 families each month through a client-choice model that allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a dignified and convenient manner. Through partnerships with community organizations, donors, and volunteers, the pantry helps ensure local families have access to the resources they need throughout the year and is expected to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags assembled during the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: Elk Grove Township Food Pantry 为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务，每月通过客户选择模式为约 1,100 个家庭提供服务，使家庭能够以有尊严和便捷的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室帮助确保当地家庭能够获得全年所需的资源，并预计在这个节日期间将活动期间收集的感恩节食品袋分发给近 900 个家庭。

articles.title: AACF Golf Tournament Raises Record $700,000
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) celebrated the success of its 34th annual Bob Schoeberl Memorial Charity Golf Tournament. The event took place Nov. 1-2 at Spanish Trail Country Club in Las Vegas. The sold-out event brought together 216 golfers and other automotive aftermarket industry supporters for two days of networking and competition.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 庆祝其第 34 届年度鲍勃·舍伯尔纪念慈善高尔夫锦标赛取得成功。该活动于 11 月 1 日至 2 日在拉斯维加斯西班牙小径乡村俱乐部举行。此次活动门票全部售完，共有 216 名高尔夫球手和其他汽车售后市场行业支持者齐聚一堂，进行为期两天的交流和比赛。

paras.en: Fundraising activities included the tournament, live auction, prize drawings and golf pro experiences. These activities raised nearly $700,000, marking the highest total in the event’s history. The funds will help AACF provide financial assistance to aftermarket families facing unexpected hardships.
paras.zh: 筹款活动包括锦标赛、现场拍卖、抽奖和高尔夫职业体验。这些活动筹集了近 70 万美元，创下了该活动历史上的最高总额。这些资金将帮助 AACF 为面临意外困难的售后家庭提供经济援助。

paras.en: AACF Tournament Supports Aftermarket Families
paras.zh: AACF 锦标赛支持售后家庭

paras.en: “When a member of the automotive aftermarket community faces an unexpected hardship, the support of this industry can make all the difference,” said John Kairys, executive director of AACF. “The generosity of everyone who participated in this year’s tournament will help ensure that individuals and families facing some of life’s most difficult moments know they aren’t alone. We’re thankful and appreciative that this community comes together year after year for such an important cause.”
paras.zh: AACF 执行董事 John Kairys 表示：“当汽车售后市场社区的成员面临意想不到的困难时，该行业的支持可以发挥重要作用。” “参加今年比赛的每个人的慷慨将有助于确保面临生活中最困难时刻的个人和家庭知道他们并不孤单。我们感谢和赞赏这个社区年复一年地为了如此重要的事业聚集在一起。”

paras.en: Historic Hole-in-One Highlights Tournament
paras.zh: 历史性一杆进洞精彩赛事

paras.en: Among this year’s tournament highlights, Sean McLoraine became the first participant in the event’s 34-year history to win the hole-in-one contest. Interstate Batteries sponsored the contest, which featured a new 2026 Toyota Tundra as its grand prize.
paras.zh: 在今年赛事的亮点中，肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 成为该赛事 34 年历史上第一位赢得一杆进洞比赛的参赛者。 Interstate Batteries 赞助了此次竞赛，其大奖为一辆全新 2026 款丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)。

paras.en: “I look forward to this tournament every year because I love seeing our industry come together to give back to the people who make it what it is,” said Jeff Helfrich, AACF golf committee chairman. “To raise a record amount for aftermarket families and have Sean McLoraine make the first hole-in-one for a vehicle in our 34 years of playing this event made this a year I’ll always remember. Congratulations to Sean on his new Toyota Tundra and thank you to Interstate Batteries for sponsoring the contest.”
paras.zh: AACF 高尔夫委员会主席杰夫·赫尔弗里奇 (Jeff Helfrich) 表示：“我每年都期待着这项赛事，因为我喜欢看到我们的行业齐心协力，回馈那些做出今天的贡献的人们。” “为售后家庭筹集了创纪录的金额，并让肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 在我们参加这项赛事 34 年来首次打进一杆进洞，这让我永远铭记这一年。祝贺肖恩 (Sean) 拥有他的新丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)，并感谢 Interstate Batteries 对本次比赛的赞助。”

paras.en: AACF thanked the participants, sponsors, donors, volunteers and industry partners who supported this year’s tournament. Those interested in participating in or sponsoring the 2027 Bob Schoeberl Memorial Golf Tournament can click here for updates and additional information.
paras.zh: AACF 感谢支持今年比赛的参赛者、赞助商、捐助者、志愿者和行业合作伙伴。有兴趣参加或赞助 2027 年 Bob Schoeberl 纪念高尔夫锦标赛的人士可以点击此处获取更新和其他信息。

articles.title: Gates to Acquire Nitta’s Stakes in Five Asian Markets
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Gates Industrial Corporation Ltd. announced an agreement to acquire Nitta Corporation’s interests in five Asia-Pacific joint ventures. The transaction will give Gates full ownership of its power transmission businesses in China, India, Thailand, Korea and Singapore. Gates also will sell its interest in the Japan joint venture to Nitta.
paras.zh: 盖茨工业有限公司宣布达成协议，收购新田公司在五家亚太合资企业中的权益。此次交易将使盖茨完全拥有其在中国、印度、泰国、韩国和新加坡的输电业务。盖茨还将把其在日本合资企业的权益出售给新田。

paras.en: The joint venture helped broaden Gates’ reach into emerging economies in the Asia-Pacific region. Since 1986, Gates has held a 51% ownership stake in each joint venture entity. Gates has consolidated the entities’ financial results into its own reporting.
paras.zh: 该合资企业帮助盖茨扩大了在亚太地区新兴经济体的影响力。自1986年以来，盖茨在每个合资实体中持有51%的股权。盖茨已将这些实体的财务业绩合并到自己的报告中。

paras.en: The transaction will allow Gates to operate in Asia-Pacific through a wholly owned platform. It also reinforces the company’s long-term commitment to the region.
paras.zh: 此次交易将使盖茨能够通过全资平台在亚太地区开展业务。它还加强了公司对该地区的长期承诺。

paras.en: Gates anticipates several benefits from the transaction, including:
paras.zh: 盖茨预计此次交易将带来诸多好处，包括：

paras.en: - Increasing reported earnings per share by eliminating the noncontrolling interest associated with the joint venture. Gates estimates the transaction will increase annual adjusted earnings per share (EPS) by $0.02 on a pro forma basis.
paras.zh: - 通过消除与合资企业相关的非控股权益来增加每股报告收益。盖茨预计，此次交易将使年度调整后每股收益 (EPS) 预计增加 0.02 美元。

paras.en: - Expanding Gates’ strategic flexibility to independently pursue growth initiatives in the Asia-Pacific region.
paras.zh: - 扩大盖茨的战略灵活性，以独立追求亚太地区的增长计划。

paras.en: - Providing Gates with greater access to foreign cash reserves.
paras.zh: - 为盖茨提供更多获得外汇现金储备的机会。

paras.en: - Mitigating future restructuring investments.
paras.zh: - 减少未来的重组投资。

paras.en: - Simplifying Gates’ financial reporting.
paras.zh: - 简化盖茨的财务报告。

paras.en: Gates will pay Nitta approximately $40.2 million in dividends and a net $112 million for equity interests. The equity payment remains subject to certain post-closing adjustments.
paras.zh: 盖茨将向 Nitta 支付约 4020 万美元的股息和净额 1.12 亿美元的股权。股权支付仍需进行某些交割后调整。

paras.en: Gates has historically consolidated the joint venture for accounting purposes. As a result, a portion of the joint venture’s revenue and profitability will transfer to Nitta.
paras.zh: 盖茨历来出于会计目的合并了该合资企业。因此，合资企业的部分收入和盈利能力将转移给新田。

paras.en: Gates estimates the transaction will reduce its annualized 2027 consolidated sales by approximately $88 million to $108 million. The company also expects a reduction of approximately $26 million to $32 million in annualized 2027 adjusted EBITDA.
paras.zh: 盖茨估计，此次交易将使其 2027 年综合销售额减少约 8800 万美元至 1.08 亿美元。该公司还预计 2027 年年度调整后 EBITDA 将减少约 2600 万至 3200 万美元。

paras.en: “We have built a profitable, growing business under Gates’ leadership across Asia-Pacific through a longstanding, collaborative relationship with Nitta. Taking full ownership in these markets gives Gates greater flexibility to pursue our growth strategy in the region,” said Ivo Jurek, Chief Executive Officer of Gates Industrial Corporation. “In conjunction with Nitta, we will work closely with employees, customers, suppliers and relevant regulatory bodies to ensure continuity.”
paras.zh: 盖茨工业公司首席执行官伊沃·尤雷克 (Ivo Jurek) 表示：“通过与 Nitta 的长期合作关系，在盖茨的领导下，我们在亚太地区建立了盈利且不断增长的业务。完全掌控这些市场使盖茨能够更灵活地实施我们在该地区的增长战略。” “我们将与 Nitta 合作，与员工、客户、供应商和相关监管机构密切合作，以确保连续性。”

paras.en: The transaction will conclude the longstanding partnership. Gates expects to close the transaction in the first quarter of 2027. The closing remains subject to customary conditions, including required regulatory approvals.
paras.zh: 此次交易将结束双方的长期合作关系。盖茨预计将在 2027 年第一季度完成交易。该交易仍需满足惯例条件，包括所需的监管批准。

articles.title: VIVE Collision Appoints Charlie Drake Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: VIVE Collision announced that it appointed Charlie Drake chief operating officer (COO) earlier this year. Drake brings nearly 40 years of industry experience and a people-first leadership approach that supports VIVE’s commitment to its teammates, customers and communities.
paras.zh: VIVE Collision 在今年早些时候宣布任命 Charlie Drake 为首席运营官 (COO)。 Drake 拥有近 40 年的行业经验和以人为本的领导方法，支持 VIVE 对团队成员、客户和社区的承诺。

paras.en: With two decades in operations leadership at national collision repair organizations, Drake combines experience managing multi-location businesses with a practical understanding of the work happening in each repair facility. He is known for building strong teams, linking culture to performance and creating systems that support accountability and a consistent customer experience.
paras.zh: 德雷克（Drake）在国家碰撞修复组织担任运营领导职务已有二十年，他将管理多地点业务的经验与对每个维修设施中发生的工作的实际了解结合起来。他以建立强大的团队、将文化与绩效联系起来以及创建支持责任和一致的客户体验的系统而闻名。

paras.en: “Growing VIVE means making sure our people have the leadership and support to do their best work,” said Vartan Jerian, Jr., CEO and founder of VIVE Collision. “Charlie understands what it takes to run a successful collision repair organization and how much of that success comes down to the people in each location. His experience and approach will help us strengthen our operations while keeping our teammates and customers at the center of every decision.”
paras.zh: VIVE Collision 首席执行官兼创始人 Vartan Jerian, Jr. 表示：“发展 VIVE 意味着确保我们的员工获得领导力和支持，以尽其所能。” “查理了解成功运营一个碰撞修复组织需要什么，以及这种成功在多大程度上取决于每个地点的员工。他的经验和方法将帮助我们加强运营，同时让我们的队友和客户成为每个决策的中心。”

paras.en: As COO, Drake will lead VIVE’s operations, working with its leadership teams to support performance across the organization. His appointment reinforces VIVE’s focus on “People, Process and Passion,” pairing investment in its people with the operational discipline needed to deliver high-quality repairs and earn customer trust.
paras.zh: 作为首席运营官，Drake 将领导 VIVE 的运营，与其领导团队合作以支持整个组织的绩效。他的任命强化了 VIVE 对“人员、流程和热情”的关注，将对人员的投资与提供高质量维修和赢得客户信任所需的运营纪律相结合。

paras.en: Read the full article on bodyshopbusiness.com.
paras.zh: 请在 bodyshopbusiness.com 上阅读全文。

articles.title: The 45-Day Rule: How Parts Stores Stop Financing Their Customers
articles.author: Bob Morgan

paras.en: Every parts store has an account like this. The shop buys a lot. The owner is a good guy. He pays — eventually. Meanwhile he’s 50 to 90 days out and asking for another special order “by Thursday.”
paras.zh: 每个配件店都有一个这样的帐户。店里买的很多。店主是个好人。他最终付出了代价。与此同时，他有 50 到 90 天的时间，并要求“在周四之前”再下一份特别订单。

paras.en: Here’s the hard truth I learned after about 15 years running stores on Long Island: volume you don’t collect isn’t volume. It’s a loan you never approved. Most stores aren’t short on sales. They’re short on cash because they’re quietly running a bank for their customers, with the special-order desk as the loan window.
paras.zh: 这是我在长岛经营商店大约 15 年之后学到的残酷事实：你不收集的数量就不是数量。这是一笔您从未批准过的贷款。大多数商店都不缺销售。他们缺乏现金，因为他们悄悄地为客户经营一家银行，以特殊订单柜台作为贷款窗口。

paras.en: The fix isn’t a collections agency or a nasty letter. It’s one rule, written down and used every single time.
paras.zh: 解决办法不是催收机构或令人讨厌的信件。这是一条规则，写下来并每次都使用。

paras.en: If an account is 45 or more days past due and they want a special order, the special waits until the money is in the building.
paras.zh: 如果账户逾期 45 天或以上，并且他们想要特殊订单，则特殊订单会等到钱到达大楼后才进行。

paras.en: That’s it. Shelf stock can still go out for cash. The relationship stays intact. But you stop ordering non-returnable, hard-to-restock parts for an account that hasn’t paid for the last batch.
paras.zh: 就是这样。货架库存仍然可以换取现金。关系保持完好。但您会停止为上一批尚未付款的帐户订购不可退货、难以补货的零件。

paras.en: Why special orders? A stocked part sold on account is a receivable. A special order for a slow-paying account is a receivable plus freight, a restocking fee and a part you may end up owning if the job falls through. That’s where slow accounts do the most damage, so that’s where the line goes.
paras.zh: 为什么要特殊订单？赊销的库存零件是应收账款。慢付款帐户的特殊订单是应收账款加上运费、补货费以及如果工作失败您最终可能拥有的部分。这就是缓慢的帐户造成最大损害的地方，所以这就是线路的所在。

paras.en: Before the rule works, everyone at the counter has to agree on what “45 days” means. I count days past the due date, not days since the invoice. A Net 30 invoice dated June 12 is due July 12. On September 2, it’s 52 days past due — over the line.
paras.zh: 在规则生效之前，柜台上的每个人都必须就“45 天”的含义达成一致。我计算的是到期日之后的天数，而不是发票后的天数。日期为 6 月 12 日的 Net 30 发票应于 7 月 12 日到期。到 9 月 2 日，已逾期 52 天。

paras.en: If you’d rather age from the invoice date, fine. Pick one method, write it on the rule and never switch mid-argument. If your company already has a hold policy, use its number. The discipline matters more than the exact day.
paras.zh: 如果您希望从发票日期算起，没问题。选择一种方法，将其写在规则上，并且永远不要在争论中途改变。如果您的公司已有保留政策，请使用其号码。纪律比具体的日子更重要。

paras.en: The 45-day rule works because nobody gets surprised by it. The steps before it do the heavy lifting:
paras.zh: 45 天的规则之所以有效，是因为没有人对此感到惊讶。完成繁重工作之前的步骤：

paras.en: - Day 30 — a reminder, not a threat. “Invoice 1844 is at 30. Card or check on the next stop?”
paras.zh: - 第 30 天——提醒，而不是威胁。 “发票 1844 是 30。下一站刷卡还是支票？”

paras.en: - Day 35–40 — a human call. Not another statement they’re already ignoring. A person, by name, on the phone.
paras.zh: - 第 35-40 天 — 人工召唤。这不是他们已经忽视的另一个声明。一个人，叫出名字，正在打电话。

paras.en: - Day 45 — credit hold for new specials. Shelf can still be cash. Specials wait.
paras.zh: - 第 45 天 — 新特价商品的积分保留。货架上还是可以现金的。特价等。

paras.en: - Day 60 — hard hold. No “just this once” unless a manager puts the amount and the date in writing.
paras.zh: - 第 60 天 — 坚守。除非经理以书面形式注明金额和日期，否则不能“仅此一次”。

paras.en: Most accounts never reach day 45 once the day-30 and day-35 touches actually happen. The rule is the backstop, not the first move.
paras.zh: 一旦第 30 天和第 35 天的接触实际发生，大多数帐户永远不会到达第 45 天。规则是后盾，而不是第一步。

paras.en: Give your counter people the exact words. Nobody should improvise a credit conversation with a regular at the register. At day 45:
paras.zh: 向柜台人员提供准确的词语。任何人都不应该在收银台与常客即兴进行信用对话。第 45 天：

paras.en: “I can keep selling you what’s here if we’re cash. I can’t put another special in motion until 1844 is clear. I need you current so I can keep saying yes.”
paras.zh: “如果我们有现金，我可以继续向你出售这里的商品。在 1844 年明确之前，我无法推出另一个特价商品。我需要你提供最新信息，这样我才能继续答应。”

paras.en: “I like working with you. I can’t keep shipping on a 60-day balance. Let’s pick an amount for this week and a date for the rest. Until that starts, we’re cash.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢和你一起工作。我无法在 60 天的余额中继续发货。让我们选择本周的金额和其余的日期。在那之前，我们都是现金。”

paras.en: Those lines don’t threaten and don’t apologize. They state the rule and offer a path back. “I need you current so I can keep saying yes” puts you and the customer on the same side.
paras.zh: 这些台词既不构成威胁，也不构成道歉。他们陈述规则并提供返回路径。 “我需要你保持最新状态，这样我才能一直说“是””让你和客户站在同一边。

paras.en: The most common way the rule breaks: “I’m not paying until you fix that core credit.” Freeze the one disputed line and research it. The rest of the balance is still due. Don’t let a $40 question hold up a $4,000 balance.
paras.zh: 最常见的违反规则的方式是：“在你修复核心信用之前，我不会付款。”冻结一条有争议的线路并进行研究。其余余额仍需支付。不要让 40 美元的问题占用 4,000 美元的余额。

paras.en: And if yelling breaks the rule, you’ve just taught every shop in town that yelling works. The rule has to hold for your biggest account, too.
paras.zh: 如果大喊大叫违反了规则，那么你就已经告诉镇上的每一家商店大喊大叫是有效的。该规则也必须适用于您最大的帐户。

paras.en: A rule nobody checks turns into a suggestion. Once a week — I do it in a short Monday meeting — pull your aging and look at three things:
paras.zh: 无人检查的规则变成了建议。每周一次——我在周一的一次简短会议上进行——拉动你的衰老，看看三件事：

paras.en: - Total dollars 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的总金额。

paras.en: - A name and a next-call date next to every one of those accounts.
paras.zh: - 每个帐户旁边都有姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Any special order that went out to a 45+ account, and who approved it.
paras.zh: - 发送至 45+ 帐户的任何特殊订单以及批准者。

paras.en: A simple example (invented numbers): a store has $6,940 at 45+ days past due across two accounts. A fleet account on that list calls for a special. The counter person checks the list and uses the day-45 line. The special gets placed the afternoon the check clears. No fight, no exception, and the store isn’t fronting more parts to a customer who already owes $4,200.
paras.zh: 一个简单的例子（虚构的数字）：一家商店的两个帐户逾期 45 天以上，有 6,940 美元。该名单上的车队帐户需要特殊服务。柜台人员检查清单并使用第 45 天的线路。特价商品将在支票兑现的下午进行。没有打架，没有例外，商店也不会向已经欠下 4,200 美元的顾客提供更多零件。

paras.en: - Export or write down your current aging.
paras.zh: - 导出或写下您当前的年龄。

paras.en: - Highlight everything 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 突出显示逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的所有内容。

paras.en: - Put a name and a next-call date on every one.
paras.zh: - 在每个人身上写上姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Write the special-order rule on a sticky note at the counter where everyone can see it.
paras.zh: - 将特殊订单规则写在柜台的便利贴上，让每个人都能看到。

paras.en: You can like the shop. You can need the volume. You still collect. The 45-day rule is how a parts store stops financing its customers and gets back to selling them parts.
paras.zh: 你可以喜欢这家商店。您可能需要音量。你还是收藏吧。 45 天规则规定了零部件商店如何停止向客户提供融资并重新向他们销售零部件。

articles.title: AACF Golf Tournament Raises Record $700,000
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) celebrated the success of its 34th annual Bob Schoeberl Memorial Charity Golf Tournament. The event took place Nov. 1-2 at Spanish Trail Country Club in Las Vegas. The sold-out event brought together 216 golfers and other automotive aftermarket industry supporters for two days of networking and competition.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 庆祝其第 34 届年度鲍勃·舍伯尔纪念慈善高尔夫锦标赛取得成功。该活动于 11 月 1 日至 2 日在拉斯维加斯西班牙小径乡村俱乐部举行。此次活动门票全部售完，共有 216 名高尔夫球手和其他汽车售后市场行业支持者齐聚一堂，进行为期两天的交流和比赛。

paras.en: Fundraising activities included the tournament, live auction, prize drawings and golf pro experiences. These activities raised nearly $700,000, marking the highest total in the event’s history. The funds will help AACF provide financial assistance to aftermarket families facing unexpected hardships.
paras.zh: 筹款活动包括锦标赛、现场拍卖、抽奖和高尔夫职业体验。这些活动筹集了近 70 万美元，创下了该活动历史上的最高总额。这些资金将帮助 AACF 为面临意外困难的售后家庭提供经济援助。

paras.en: AACF Tournament Supports Aftermarket Families
paras.zh: AACF 锦标赛支持售后家庭

paras.en: “When a member of the automotive aftermarket community faces an unexpected hardship, the support of this industry can make all the difference,” said John Kairys, executive director of AACF. “The generosity of everyone who participated in this year’s tournament will help ensure that individuals and families facing some of life’s most difficult moments know they aren’t alone. We’re thankful and appreciative that this community comes together year after year for such an important cause.”
paras.zh: AACF 执行董事 John Kairys 表示：“当汽车售后市场社区的成员面临意想不到的困难时，该行业的支持可以发挥重要作用。” “参加今年比赛的每个人的慷慨将有助于确保面临生活中最困难时刻的个人和家庭知道他们并不孤单。我们感谢和赞赏这个社区年复一年地为了如此重要的事业聚集在一起。”

paras.en: Historic Hole-in-One Highlights Tournament
paras.zh: 历史性一杆进洞精彩赛事

paras.en: Among this year’s tournament highlights, Sean McLoraine became the first participant in the event’s 34-year history to win the hole-in-one contest. Interstate Batteries sponsored the contest, which featured a new 2026 Toyota Tundra as its grand prize.
paras.zh: 在今年赛事的亮点中，肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 成为该赛事 34 年历史上第一位赢得一杆进洞比赛的参赛者。 Interstate Batteries 赞助了此次竞赛，其大奖为一辆全新 2026 款丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)。

paras.en: “I look forward to this tournament every year because I love seeing our industry come together to give back to the people who make it what it is,” said Jeff Helfrich, AACF golf committee chairman. “To raise a record amount for aftermarket families and have Sean McLoraine make the first hole-in-one for a vehicle in our 34 years of playing this event made this a year I’ll always remember. Congratulations to Sean on his new Toyota Tundra and thank you to Interstate Batteries for sponsoring the contest.”
paras.zh: AACF 高尔夫委员会主席杰夫·赫尔弗里奇 (Jeff Helfrich) 表示：“我每年都期待着这项赛事，因为我喜欢看到我们的行业齐心协力，回馈那些做出今天的贡献的人们。” “为售后家庭筹集了创纪录的金额，并让肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 在我们参加这项赛事 34 年来首次打进一杆进洞，这让我永远铭记这一年。祝贺肖恩 (Sean) 拥有他的新丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)，并感谢 Interstate Batteries 对本次比赛的赞助。”

paras.en: AACF thanked the participants, sponsors, donors, volunteers and industry partners who supported this year’s tournament. Those interested in participating in or sponsoring the 2027 Bob Schoeberl Memorial Golf Tournament can click here for updates and additional information.
paras.zh: AACF 感谢支持今年比赛的参赛者、赞助商、捐助者、志愿者和行业合作伙伴。有兴趣参加或赞助 2027 年 Bob Schoeberl 纪念高尔夫锦标赛的人士可以点击此处获取更新和其他信息。

articles.title: Why do wolves howl?
articles.author: Charles Q. Choi

paras.en: Wolves can bark, whimper, yip, squeak and growl, but they are most known for their iconic howl.
paras.zh: 狼可以吠叫、呜咽、吠叫、吱吱声和咆哮，但它们最出名的是它们标志性的嚎叫。

paras.en: The eerie sound can travel vast distances and, if heard by other wolves, get them to join in with the chorus. But why do wolves howl in the first place?
paras.zh: 这种怪异的声音可以传播很远的距离，如果被其他狼听到，它们就会加入合唱。但狼为什么要嚎叫呢？

paras.en: Experts told Live Science that the behavior is triggered not by the sight of the moon, as is commonly believed, but by the need to maintain a complex social network.
paras.zh: 专家告诉《生活科学》杂志，这种行为并不是像人们普遍认为的那样是由看到月亮引发的，而是由维持复杂的社交网络的需要引起的。

paras.en: Wolves can howl by themselves and in groups. "If a lone wolf howls, it's probably because they're separated from their pack and want to regain contact," Arik Kershenbaum, a zoologist at the University of Cambridge, told Live Science. "Members of a pack can become quite dispersed, and when they need to hunt together, or to care for pups, or when their territory is being threatened by other wolves, they need a way of returning to each other."
paras.zh: 狼可以单独嚎叫，也可以成群嚎叫。剑桥大学动物学家阿里克·克申鲍姆 (Arik Kershenbaum) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“如果一只独狼嚎叫，很可能是因为它们与狼群分开了，想要重新获得联系。” “狼群中的成员可能会变得相当分散，当它们需要一起狩猎、照顾幼崽、或者当它们的领地受到其他狼的威胁时，它们需要一种回到彼此身边的方式。”

paras.en: However, lone wolves that leave their packs may howl as well. This could be "a way of finding a new pack or mate to join," Kershenbaum said.
paras.zh: 然而，离开狼群的独狼也可能会嚎叫。克申鲍姆说，这可能是“寻找新狼群或伙伴加入的一种方式”。

paras.en: When a wolf pack howls together, they are sometimes advertising their territory to deter other packs. "Data shows that packs howl more in the center of their territory; they howl more when there are pups around and also when they have a carcass from a hunt," Tamás Faragó, an ethologist and bioacoustician at Eötvös Loránd University in Budapest, Hungary, told Live Science. "So group howling can have a repellent effect on neighboring packs."
paras.zh: 当狼群一起嚎叫时，它们有时是在宣传自己的领地，以威慑其他狼群。匈牙利布达佩斯罗兰大学的动物行为学家和生物声学学家塔马斯·法拉戈 (Tamás Faragó) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“数据显示，狼群在领地的中心嚎叫得更多；当周围有幼崽时，或者在狩猎中获得尸体时，狼群会嚎叫得更多。” “因此群体嚎叫会对邻近的狼群产生排斥作用。”

paras.en: However, "most chorus howling is social — that is, they howl together to build what is technically called social cohesion," Kershenbaum said, "because it makes them feel good to be safe and surrounded by their pack mates. Faragó noted that this kind of group howling gets a pack in the same mood, "and is quite common before going out on a hunt."
paras.zh: 然而，“大多数合唱嚎叫都是社交性的——也就是说，它们一起嚎叫是为了建立技术上所谓的社会凝聚力，”克申鲍姆说，“因为这让它们感觉很安全，并被同伴包围着。法拉戈指出，这种集体嚎叫会得到一群心情相同的狼群，“这在外出狩猎之前很常见。”

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Howling can trigger more howling. "When an individual wolf hears a howl, it has a very strong tendency to reply back," Faragó said. However, "if a lone wolf is accidentally wandering into the territory of its neighbors, and they hear the pack there howling, they won't respond. That would make it obvious that it's an intruder there."
paras.zh: 嚎叫可以引发更多的嚎叫。 “当一只狼听到嚎叫时，它有一种非常强烈的反应倾向，”法拉戈说。然而，“如果一只独狼不小心走进了邻居的领地，而它们听到狼群的嚎叫声，它们就不会做出反应。这会很明显表明它是那里的入侵者。”

paras.en: A wolf's howl can be heard up to 10 miles (16 kilometers) away in open terrain, according to the Wolf Conservation Center in South Salem, New York. The combination of low- and high-frequency sounds that make up howls ensures that "even if some of the lower-frequency sounds are attenuated by vegetation, the higher-frequency components can remain intact and carry a lot of information about the individuals that made the howls," Faragó said.
paras.zh: 据纽约州南塞勒姆狼保护中心称，在开阔地带，最远 10 英里（16 公里）外都可以听到狼的嚎叫声。构成嚎叫的低频和高频声音的组合确保了“即使一些低频声音被植被减弱，高频成分也可以保持完整，并携带有关发出嚎叫的个体的大量信息，”法拉戈说。

paras.en: Wolf howls differ among species and subspecies. A 2016 study of 13 species and subspecies of wolves, jackals, coyotes and dogs by Kershenbaum and his colleagues found that each has a kind of howling dialect that features different types of howls with varying regularity depending on the species or subspecies. For example, the howling repertoire of the timber wolf (Canis lycaon) is dominated by low, flat howls, while red wolves (Canis rufus) most frequently use high, looping howls.
paras.zh: 狼的嚎叫声因物种和亚种而异。 Kershenbaum 和他的同事在 2016 年对狼、豺狼、郊狼和狗的 13 个物种和亚种进行的一项研究发现，每种动物都有一种嚎叫方言，其特点是根据物种或亚种的不同，发出不同类型的嚎叫，其规律也不同。例如，木狼 (Canis lycaon) 的嚎叫方式主要是低沉、平缓的嚎叫，而红狼 (Canis rufus) 最常使用高亢、循环的嚎叫。

paras.en: The howling of dogs, which are descended from gray wolves (Canis lupus), can differ from wolf howling, but this depends very much on the breed. A 2023 study from Kershenbaum, Faragó and their colleagues found that more ancient dog breeds that are more closely related to wolves howl more often. In contrast, more modern dog breeds bark more often.
paras.zh: 狗的嚎叫是灰狼（Canis lupus）的后代，它的嚎叫可能与狼的嚎叫不同，但这在很大程度上取决于品种。 Kershenbaum、Faragó 及其同事在 2023 年进行的一项研究发现，与狼关系更密切的古老犬种会更频繁地嚎叫。相比之下，更现代的狗品种叫得更频繁。

paras.en: A question "that we all want to answer" is whether howling sounds might differ depending on their purpose, Kershenbaum said. "The problem is that most of the time when wolves howl, we don't know what they're doing at that time — they're either too far away, or it's nighttime."
paras.zh: 克申鲍姆说，“我们都想回答”的一个问题是，嚎叫声是否会根据其目的而有所不同。 “问题是，大多数时候，当狼嚎叫时，我们不知道它们当时在做什么——它们要么离得太远，要么是在夜间。”

paras.en: Generally, "we believe that howls made in different emotional states probably sound different," Kershenbaum said. "For example, perhaps when a wolf is feeling threatened in a territorial conflict, the howl goes up and down in pitch in a different way than when the wolf is relaxed. But this is a field of active research."
paras.zh: 一般来说，“我们认为不同情绪状态下发出的嚎叫听起来可能不同，”克申鲍姆说。 “例如，当狼在领土冲突中感到受到威胁时，嚎叫的音调升降方式可能与狼放松时不同。但这是一个活跃的研究领域。”

paras.en: A common belief is that wolves howl at the moon. "A myth, I'm afraid," Kershenbaum said. "There doesn't seem to be any correlation at all between them." He suggested that perhaps before electric lights, people were outdoors more often when there was a bright moon, "and that's when they heard the wolves."
paras.zh: 人们普遍相信狼对着月亮嚎叫。 “这恐怕是一个神话，”克申鲍姆说。 “它们之间似乎根本没有任何关联。”他认为，也许在电灯出现之前，当月亮明亮时，人们会更频繁地呆在户外，“那时他们就会听到狼的叫声。”

articles.title: 'A future where EVs charge simply by parking': New positioning system could make wireless EV charging much more efficient
articles.author: Owen Hughes

paras.en: Researchers in Japan have developed a new technology that could enable electric vehicles (EVs) to charge "simply by parking".
paras.zh: 日本研究人员开发出一种新技术，可以让电动汽车（EV）“只需停车”即可充电。

paras.en: Wireless charging is still relatively nascent in the EV market, but scientists hope that integrating more wireless charging devices into roads and parking spaces will move the EV industry away from bulky plug-in infrastructure. It uses the same wireless power transfer technology found in modern smartphones and consumer electronics: a transmitter coil inside in a ground pad generates an oscillating magnetic field, which induces an electric current in a receiver coil underneath the vehicle. This current recharges the EV's battery cells.
paras.zh: 无线充电在电动汽车市场中仍相对较新，但科学家希望将更多无线充电设备集成到道路和停车位中将使电动汽车行业摆脱笨重的插入式基础设施。它使用与现代智能手机和消费电子产品相同的无线功率传输技术：接地垫内部的发射器线圈产生振荡磁场，从而在车辆下方的接收器线圈中感应出电流。该电流为电动汽车的电池充电。

paras.en: However, small misalignments between the two coils can affect how quickly and efficiently the battery recharges. This new system uses short-range radio signals to determine the position of the vehicle's magnetic charging coil relative to the charging device in the ground, including its distance and angle. This helps the EV and its driver get into the optimal position for efficient charging.
paras.zh: 然而，两个线圈之间的微小偏差会影响电池充电的速度和效率。这个新系统使用短程无线电信号来确定车辆磁性充电线圈相对于地面充电设备的位置，包括其距离和角度。这有助于电动汽车及其驾驶员进入高效充电的最佳位置。

paras.en: The technology could be particularly useful for driverless "robotaxis" and other autonomous vehicles that need to be able to recharge quickly and efficiently without human assistance, the researchers said. They detailed their findings in a study published Aug. 26 in the IEEE Open Journal of Vehicular Technology.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，该技术对于无人驾驶“机器人出租车”和其他需要能够在没有人工帮助的情况下快速有效充电的自动驾驶车辆特别有用。他们在 8 月 26 日发表在《IEEE 车辆技术开放期刊》上的一项研究中详细介绍了他们的发现。

paras.en: "We hope this research will lead to a future where EVs charge simply by parking, much like smartphones placed on wireless chargers," Ryotaro Hada, first author of the study and a master's student at the University of Osaka's Graduate School of Information Science and Technology, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、大阪大学信息科学与技术研究生院的硕士生 Ryotaro Hada 在一份声明中表示：“我们希望这项研究将带来这样一个未来：电动汽车只需停车即可充电，就像智能​​手机放在无线充电器上一样。”

paras.en: Existing methods for aligning an EV's charging coil with a wireless charging pad use magnetic sensors or cameras. Magnetic systems work best when the coil is close to the pad, while cameras can struggle in rain, poor lighting or when dirt obscures the pad, the researchers explained.
paras.zh: 将电动汽车充电线圈与无线充电板对齐的现有方法使用磁性传感器或摄像头。研究人员解释说，当线圈靠近垫子时，磁性系统效果最佳，而在下雨、光线不足或灰尘遮挡垫子时，相机可能会表现不佳。

paras.en: This new system uses four ultra-wideband radio devices mounted around the vehicle's charging coil to communicate with four antennas around the charging pad.
paras.zh: 这个新系统使用安装在车辆充电线圈周围的四个超宽带无线电设备，与充电板周围的四个天线进行通信。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: By measuring how long radio waves take to travel between the ultra-wideband devices and the antennas, as well as detecting tiny differences in how the signals arrive at each of the vehicle's sensors, the system can pinpoint the position and angle of the EV's charging coil relative to the ground pad.
paras.zh: 通过测量无线电波在超宽带设备和天线之间传播的时间，以及检测信号到达每个车辆传感器的微小差异，该系统可以精确定位电动汽车充电线圈相对于接地垫的位置和角度。

paras.en: The same technology is used in some digital car keys. They use short radio pulses to detect when the driver is close by, allowing the driver to unlock their vehicle without requiring a physical key.
paras.zh: 一些数字汽车钥匙也使用了相同的技术。它们使用短无线电脉冲来检测驾驶员何时在附近，从而使驾驶员无需物理钥匙即可解锁车辆。

paras.en: In laboratory experiments using a scaled-down vehicle model, the system worked out where the vehicle's charging coil was to within 0.09 inches (2.32 millimeters) of its actual position and which direction it was facing to within 0.25 degrees. Correcting for distortions in the radio signals reduced the positioning error by around fivefold, the team said.
paras.zh: 在使用按比例缩小的车辆模型进行的实验室实验中，系统计算出车辆的充电线圈与实际位置的误差在 0.09 英寸（2.32 毫米）以内，并且其面向的方向误差在 0.25 度以内。研究小组表示，纠正无线电信号的失真可将定位误差减少约五倍。

paras.en: The researchers noted that the system still needs to be tested outdoors, on full-size EVs and under real charging conditions.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，该系统仍需要在户外、全尺寸电动汽车上和真实充电条件下进行测试。

paras.en: Owen Hughes is a freelance writer and editor specializing in data and digital technologies. Previously a senior editor at ZDNET, Owen has been writing about tech for more than a decade, during which time he has covered everything from AI, cybersecurity and supercomputers to programming languages and public sector IT. Owen is particularly interested in the intersection of technology, life and work – in his previous roles at ZDNET and TechRepublic, he wrote extensively about business leadership, digital transformation and the evolving dynamics of remote work.
paras.zh: 欧文·休斯 (Owen Hughes) 是一位自由撰稿人和编辑，专门从事数据和数字技术。 Owen 曾担任 ZDNET 的高级编辑，十多年来一直在撰写有关技术的文章，在此期间，他涵盖了从人工智能、网络安全和超级计算机到编程语言和公共部门 IT 的所有内容。 Owen 对技术、生活和工作的交叉点特别感兴趣 - 在他之前在 ZDNET 和 TechRepublic 任职期间，他撰写了大量有关商业领导力、数字化转型和远程工作不断发展的动态的文章。
