articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 21, 1676: Danish astronomer discovers speed of light — by accident — while observing Jupiter's moon Io
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 21, 1676, the Danish astronomer Ole Rømer discovered the speed of light. Before Rømer figured it out, scientists thought that light travels instantaneously, or infinitely fast.
paras.zh: 1676 年 11 月 21 日，丹麦天文学家 Ole Rømer 发现了光速。在罗默弄清楚这一点之前，科学家们认为光的传播速度是瞬时的，或者说是无限快的。

paras.en: Rømer disproved this almost by accident when he was studying Jupiter's moon Io. He was trying to figure out how long it takes Io to orbit Jupiter in hopes of using it as a cosmic clock. He watched Io disappear behind Jupiter and reappear on the other side. He did this over and over every 42 hours for years.
paras.zh: 罗默在研究木星的卫星木卫一时几乎偶然地反驳了这一点。他试图计算木卫一绕木星运行需要多长时间，希望将其用作宇宙钟。他看着艾欧消失在木星后面，又重新出现在木星的另一边。多年来，他每 42 小时就会一遍又一遍地重复此操作。

paras.en: To his surprise, the timing of the eclipses was not consistent. When Earth was closest to Jupiter, the eclipses happened 11 minutes early. Likewise, when the two planets were farthest away, the eclipses were 11 minutes behind schedule.
paras.zh: 令他惊讶的是，日食发生的时间并不一致。当地球距离木星最近时，日食提前 11 分钟发生。同样，当两颗行星距离最远时，日食比预定时间晚了 11 分钟。

paras.en: Rømer figured out the pattern and made an accurate prediction for Io's eclipse on Nov. 9, 1676. Then on Nov. 21, he took his findings to the Royal Academy of Sciences and explained that a finite speed of light must be responsible.
paras.zh: 罗默找出了这一规律，并对 1676 年 11 月 9 日艾奥的日食做出了准确的预测。然后在 11 月 21 日，他将自己的发现带到了皇家科学院，并解释说一定是有限的光速造成的。

paras.en: Understanding that the speed of light is a constant is the key that opened our ability to gauge the scale of the universe, as well as was central to developing modern physics.
paras.zh: 理解光速是一个常数是开启我们测量宇宙规模能力的关键，也是发展现代物理学的核心。

paras.en: "The speed of light becomes a sort of ultimate speed limit," Live Science explained in an article about why the speed of light matters. "In fact, objects with mass, be they cars or neutrinos, can't reach the speed of light because they would need infinite energy to do so."
paras.zh: 《生命科学》在一篇关于光速为何重要的文章中解释道：“光速成为一种极限速度限制。” “事实上，有质量的物体，无论是汽车还是中微子，都无法达到光速，因为它们需要无限的能量才能达到。”

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com.作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: NASA Science Data Powers New Method to Discover Hard-to-Find Pulsars

paras.en: An international team of scientists has developed a method that can find pulsars in publicly available NASA data about a million times faster than before. This opens the door to discovering many more of these rapidly spinning objects. A paper describing the results published Thursday in the Physical Review Letters.
paras.zh: 一个国际科学家团队开发了一种方法，可以在 NASA 公开数据中找到脉冲星，速度比以前快一百万倍。这为发现更多这些快速旋转的物体打开了大门。周四发表在《物理评论快报》上的一篇描述结果的论文。

paras.en: Using 15 years of data from NASA's Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope and a cryptography-based method developed by study co-authors Dotan Gazith and Barak Zackay from the Weizmann Institute of Science in Israel, the team found PSR J1622−7204, an isolated pulsar spinning 261 times per second, using the equivalent of 10 hours of computing time on a standard computer processor.
paras.zh: 利用来自 NASA 费米伽马射线太空望远镜 15 年的数据以及以色列魏茨曼科学研究所的研究合著者 Dotan Gazith 和 Barak Zackay 开发的基于密码学的方法，研究小组发现了 PSR J1622−7204，一颗每秒旋转 261 次的孤立脉冲星，相当于标准计算机处理器上 10 小时的计算时间。

paras.en: By comparison, the previous best method failed to find the pulsar, despite using enough computing power that a standard processor would take 600 years to perform the calculation.
paras.zh: 相比之下，以前的最佳方法未能找到脉冲星，尽管使用了足够的计算能力，标准处理器需要 600 年才能执行计算。

paras.en: A pulsar is a rapidly spinning neutron star that sweeps beams of radiation toward Earth, much like a lighthouse. Finding pulsars in gamma-ray data is extraordinarily difficult because Fermi detects only a tiny number of photons from a given pulsar, mixed in with background noise from other gamma-ray-emitting sources and the broader universe. To find the signal, researchers must accurately guess several unknowns at once: how fast the star spins, how quickly the spin is slowing down, and precisely where it sits in the sky. Searching every possible combination would require an impossible number of computations.
paras.zh: 脉冲星是一颗快速旋转的中子星，它向地球发射辐射束，就像灯塔一样。在伽马射线数据中寻找脉冲星非常困难，因为费米只能检测到来自给定脉冲星的极少量光子，这些光子与其他伽马射线发射源和更广阔的宇宙的背景噪声混合在一起。为了找到信号，研究人员必须同时准确猜测几个未知数：恒星自转的速度有多快，自转减速的速度有多快，以及它在天空中的精确位置。搜索每种可能的组合将需要大量的计算。

paras.en: "We don't see every rotation from the pulsar, and we can't just count the rotations to work out where the photon came from," said lead author Daniel Pook-Kolb, a scientist at the Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics (Albert Einstein Institute) in Germany. “We have a four-dimensional grid, and we must search each direction with millions of trials in it. There’s just not enough computing power on Earth to do it.”
paras.zh: 德国马克斯·普朗克引力物理研究所（阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦研究所）的科学家、主要作者丹尼尔·普克-科尔布（Daniel Pook-Kolb）说：“我们看不到脉冲星的每次旋转，我们不能仅通过计算旋转来确定光子的来源。” “我们有一个四维网格，我们必须在其中进行数百万次试验来搜索每个方向。地球上没有足够的计算能力来做到这一点。”

paras.en: Traditionally, scientists have searched for these pulsars by breaking Fermi data into smaller chunks and analyzing them by crowdsourcing computing power from volunteers around the world. Even with these volunteers contributing their computers’ unused processing power to run searches, it typically took the equivalent of hundreds of computer-years to identify a single pulsar.
paras.zh: 传统上，科学家通过将费米数据分解成更小的块并通过世界各地志愿者的众包计算能力来分析它们来寻找这些脉冲星。即使这些志愿者贡献了计算机未使用的处理能力来进行搜索，通常也需要相当于数百计算机年的时间才能识别出一颗脉冲星。

paras.en: Gazith and Zackay realized that the search could be transformed into a geometry problem: finding the shortest vector in a high-dimensional lattice, or a regularly spaced array of points. This lattice technique draws on algorithms developed by cryptographers trying to break encryption systems designed to resist code-breaking by future quantum computers. The method has also been used to help make satellite navigation systems more efficient.
paras.zh: Gazith 和 Zackay 意识到搜索可以转化为几何问题：在高维晶格或规则间隔的点数组中找到最短向量。这种晶格技术利用了密码学家开发的算法，试图破解旨在抵抗未来量子计算机破解密码的加密系统。该方法还被用来帮助提高卫星导航系统的效率。

paras.en: "We have nothing to do with cryptography in our analysis here, but those algorithms can help us solve the problem of searching for pulsars in our data," Gazith said.
paras.zh: 加齐斯说：“我们的分析与密码学无关，但这些算法可以帮助我们解决在数据中搜索脉冲星的问题。”

paras.en: Each trial run of the algorithm took about five minutes on a single computer core — easily doable on a standard laptop, which usually has between two and eight cores. Once the lattice method identified a pulsar candidate, the researchers confirmed it by feeding in the full Fermi data set, revealing a signal so strong it could not be a chance occurrence.
paras.zh: 该算法的每次试运行在单个计算机核心上大约需要五分钟——在通常有两到八个核心的标准笔记本电脑上很容易完成。一旦晶格方法识别出一颗脉冲星候选者，研究人员就通过输入完整的费米数据集来确认它，揭示了一个如此强烈的信号，不可能是偶然发生的。

paras.en: The team’s next goal is even more ambitious: finding pulsars in binary systems, where a pulsar orbits a star. These discoveries have long been considered out of reach because a companion star’s gravity distorts the signal in ways that have made these pulsars essentially impossible to discover with traditional methods.
paras.zh: 该团队的下一个目标更加雄心勃勃：在双星系统中寻找脉冲星，其中脉冲星绕恒星运行。这些发现长期以来被认为是遥不可及的，因为伴星的引力会扭曲信号，使得这些脉冲星基本上不可能用传统方法发现。

paras.en: "We know that there are probably tens or maybe even hundreds of these pulsars in the data set that we just couldn't find," said Colin Clark, an astrophysicist at the Max Planck Institute who co-authored the study. "The next goal is to extend the searches and use the combination of the new algorithm and the crowdsourced computing power from volunteers in our Einstein@Home program to hopefully find many new pulsars that we think should be there.”
paras.zh: 该研究的共同作者、马克斯·普朗克研究所的天体物理学家科林·克拉克说：“我们知道，数据集中可能有数十个甚至数百个我们无法找到的脉冲星。” “下一个目标是扩大搜索范围，并结合使用新算法和 Einstein@Home 项目志愿者的众包计算能力，希望能找到许多我们认为应该存在的新脉冲星。”

paras.en: The discovery would not have happened without NASA's longstanding, Gold Standard Science policy of making its science data, including data from Fermi, freely available to anyone. Launched in 2008, Fermi surveys the entire sky every three hours, observing the universe in gamma rays — the highest-energy form of light. After an initial one-year calibration period, all Fermi data became fully public and continues to be released as soon as it is processed.
paras.zh: 如果没有美国宇航局长期以来的黄金标准科学政策，即向任何人免费提供其科学数据（包括来自费米的数据），这一发现就不会发生。费米于 2008 年发射，每三个小时巡视一次整个天空，以伽马射线（光的最高能量形式）观察宇宙。经过最初一年的校准期后，所有费米数据都完全公开，并在处理后立即继续发布。

paras.en: "The nice thing about NASA data is it's all open," Clark said. "All 18 years of Fermi data have been made public, and the data just keeps growing."
paras.zh: “美国宇航局数据的好处在于它是完全开放的，”克拉克说。 “所有 18 年的费米数据都已经公开，而且数据还在不断增长。”

paras.en: That openness allowed researchers from outside the Fermi mission, including the cryptography-inspired team, to apply a completely new approach to the dataset. NASA’s support for the science community, through open software and tools such as NASA's Fermitools, enabled the team to prepare their dataset before beginning their analysis.
paras.zh: 这种开放性使得费米任务之外的研究人员（包括受密码学启发的团队）能够对数据集应用一种全新的方法。 NASA 通过开放软件和工具（例如 NASA 的费米工具）对科学界的支持，使团队能够在开始分析之前准备好数据集。

paras.en: The Fermi mission has grown its catalog from a few hundred gamma ray sources to thousands, with new findings emerging as scientists apply fresh ideas to the same data.
paras.zh: 费米任务的伽马射线源目录已从几百个增加到数千个，随着科学家将新的想法应用于相同的数据，新的发现不断出现。

paras.en: "Any search that one team is doing, another team can just go and do that and check the search," said Elizabeth Hays, Fermi project scientist at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. "It's made all of the science better."
paras.zh: “一个团队正在进行的任何搜索，另一个团队都可以去做并检查搜索结果，”位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的费米项目科学家伊丽莎白·海斯说。 “它让所有的科学变得更好。”

paras.en: For more information about NASA's Fermi mission, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 费米任务的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: Battle to control GPS and radio signals raises civilian safety concerns

paras.en: Battle to control GPS and radio signals raises civilian safety concerns
paras.zh: GPS 和无线电信号控制权之争引发平民安全担忧

paras.en: From aid convoys in conflict zones to passenger jets and cargo ships far out at sea, safe journeys depend on GPS, satellite navigation and old-fashioned radio transmissions. But these signals are increasingly being blocked or faked – and civilians are paying the price.
paras.zh: 从冲突地区的援助车队到远在海上的客机和货船，安全旅程都依赖于 GPS、卫星导航和老式无线电传输。但这些信号越来越多地被屏蔽或伪造——而平民正在为此付出代价。

paras.en: Those signals travel through the electromagnetic spectrum, which also underpins modern military operations and has become a battleground in its own right.
paras.zh: 这些信号穿过电磁频谱，这也是现代军事行动的基础，并且本身已成为战场。

paras.en: The more we rely on these technologies, the more exposed we are to interference, manipulation and disruption, Federico Mantellassi, a researcher in the Security and Technology Programme at the UN Institute for Disarmament Research (UNIDIR) has told UN News.
paras.zh: 联合国裁军研究所（UNIDIR）安全与技术项目研究员费德里科·曼特拉西（Federico Mantellassi）告诉《联合国新闻》，我们越依赖这些技术，我们就越容易受到干扰、操纵和破坏。

paras.en: The two main threats are jamming, which blocks signals, and spoofing, which feeds systems false ones.
paras.zh: 两个主要威胁是干扰（阻止信号）和欺骗（向系统提供错误信号）。

paras.en: UNIDIR estimates suggest GPS spoofing in civil aviation rose by 500 per cent between January and August 2024, affecting hundreds of flights.
paras.zh: UNIDIR 估计，2024 年 1 月至 8 月期间，民航中的 GPS 欺骗行为增加了 500%，影响了数百架航班。

paras.en: In early 2026, the crisis in the Middle East saw the highest concentration of maritime jamming on record.
paras.zh: 2026 年初，中东危机出现了有记录以来最集中的海上干扰。

paras.en: Mr. Mantellassi recently moderated a session on these disruptions and what they mean for peace and security at UNIDIR’s 2026 Innovations Dialogue in Geneva.
paras.zh: 曼特拉西先生最近在裁研所于日内瓦举行的 2026 年创新对话中主持了一场会议，讨论这些干扰及其对和平与安全的意义。

paras.en: The spectrum covers the full range of electromagnetic waves, from radio waves and microwaves to infrared, visible light, X-rays and gamma rays.
paras.zh: 频谱涵盖了整个电磁波范围，从无线电波和微波到红外线、可见光、X射线和伽马射线。

paras.en: Armies and other branches of the military increasingly depend on the spectrum to connect their systems for surveillance, data transmission, weapons guidance and battlefield networks.
paras.zh: 军队和其他军事部门越来越依赖频谱来连接其监视、数据传输、武器制导和战场网络系统。

paras.en: The UNIDIR expert noted that “the military use of the electromagnetic spectrum dates back to the early 20th century, coming of age in the Second World War. What has changed is the exponential growth in the number of devices and systems that emit and receive signals and depend on continued access to the spectrum.”
paras.zh: 裁研所专家指出，“电磁频谱的军事用途可以追溯到 20 世纪初，在第二次世界大战中成熟。发生变化的是发射和接收信号并依赖于持续访问频谱的设备和系统数量呈指数级增长。”

paras.en: Electronic warfare on the front line may not always affect civilians directly. But when conflict comes closer to everyday life and commerce, Mr. Mantellassi warned, the knock-on effects can be widespread.
paras.zh: 前线的电子战可能并不总是直接影响平民。但曼特拉西警告说，当冲突越来越接近日常生活和商业时，连锁反应可能会广泛蔓延。

paras.en: Earlier this year, during the war sparked by US-Israeli attacks on Iran, media reports showed a rise in spoofing and jamming in the Gulf of Aden and the Strait of Hormuz, increasing the risk of collisions at sea.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，在美以袭击伊朗引发的战争期间，媒体报道显示，亚丁湾和霍尔木兹海峡的欺骗和干扰活动有所增加，增加了海上碰撞的风险。

paras.en: Disruption can also leave aid workers, peacekeepers and emergency services unable to rely on navigation and communications. It can hit mobile and internet services, rescue efforts, public transport and financial systems.
paras.zh: 干扰还可能导致援助人员、维和人员和紧急服务人员无法依赖导航和通信。它可以打击移动和互联网服务、救援工作、公共交通和金融系统。

paras.en: “Those types of services and humanitarians are really suffering and visibly seeing the cascading effects of increased disruption,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这些类型的服务和人道主义人员确实正在遭受痛苦，并且明显看到了破坏加剧所带来的连锁反应。”

paras.en: “The same effects can be felt in aviation operations where it’s already a very complex operational environment,” he explained, with aircraft positioning systems giving the wrong location and pilots forced to fall back on other instruments.
paras.zh: 他解释说：“在航空运营中也能感受到同样的影响，因为航空运营环境已经非常复杂，飞机定位系统给出了错误的位置，飞行员被迫求助于其他仪器。”

paras.en: “We just had a conference and one of the speakers from the international civil aviation agency (ICAO) said that if you have ever taken a flight, it’s very likely that you have been on a flight that has been jammed or spoofed,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们刚刚召开了一次会议，国际民航组织（ICAO）的一位发言人表示，如果你曾经乘坐过航班，那么你很可能乘坐过被堵塞或被欺骗的航班，”他补充道。

paras.en: The UN has long warned of the risks of artificial intelligence (AI), and the Security Council will discuss threats from emerging technologies at a high-level meeting later this month.
paras.zh: 联合国长期以来一直警告人工智能（AI）的风险，安理会将在本月晚些时候的高级别会议上讨论新兴技术的威胁​​。

paras.en: An arms race in AI-powered weapons is now emerging in the spectrum too. This is particularly worrying where machines are left to identify and select targets and carry out attacks without any human oversight.
paras.zh: 人工智能武器的军备竞赛现在也在该领域出现。当机器在没有任何人为监督的情况下识别和选择目标并进行攻击时，这一点尤其令人担忧。

paras.en: As jamming and spoofing spread, Mr. Mantellassi said, militaries are adapting, fuelling a cycle of measures and countermeasures.
paras.zh: 曼特拉西表示，随着干扰和欺骗的蔓延，军队正在适应，从而推动了一系列措施和反制措施。

paras.en: “One of the key justifications in adding artificial intelligence (AI) to weapons systems is that when the environment is denied through jamming and spoofing, and you cannot have a radio link to control a drone, then you are going to rely on AI for that drone to navigate, select and sometimes engage targets, and not have to rely on a connection,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在武器系统中加入人工智能（AI）的一个关键理由是，当环境因干扰和欺骗而被封锁时，你无法通过无线电链路来控制无人机，那么你将依靠人工智能来让无人机导航、选择目标，有时甚至与目标交战，而不必依赖连接。”

paras.en: The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) allocates radio frequencies to different services, manages interference between countries and sets binding international rules on their use.
paras.zh: 国际电信联盟 (ITU) 将无线电频率分配给不同的服务，管理国家之间的干扰，并就其使用制定具有约束力的国际规则。

paras.en: “When interference occurs, Member States can report incidents to the ITU, which provides mechanisms for coordination, dispute resolution, and escalating responses,” Mr. Mantellassi said.
paras.zh: “当发生干扰时，成员国可以向国际电联报告事件，国际电联提供协调、争议解决和升级响应的机制，”曼特拉西先生说。

paras.en: But the ITU’s rules exclude military uses of radio frequencies, so these frameworks largely stop where military activity begins.
paras.zh: 但国际电联的规则排除了无线电频率的军事用途，因此这些框架基本上停止在军事活动开始的地方。

paras.en: “Obviously, there is International Humanitarian Law, which governs armed conflicts, and different types of activities still have to abide by international humanitarian law.”
paras.zh: “显然，有管辖武装冲突的国际人道主义法，不同类型的活动仍然必须遵守国际人道主义法。”

paras.en: “So, there’s a framework that still applies. But it is clearly a little more complicated.”
paras.zh: “所以，有一个框架仍然适用。但它显然要复杂一些。”

paras.en: Mr. Mantellassi said the disruptions, and the responses they provoke, deserve the attention of the disarmament community.
paras.zh: 曼特拉西先生表示，这些干扰及其引发的反应值得裁军界关注。

paras.en: Through its Innovations Dialogue, UNIDIR has in recent years explored AI, quantum technologies and neurotechnologies. Disruption to the electromagnetic spectrum is its latest focus – an issue that matters not only for disarmament, but for public safety too.
paras.zh: 近年来，裁研所通过创新对话探索了人工智能、量子技术和神经技术。电磁频谱的破坏是其最新的焦点 — — 这个问题不仅关系到裁军，也关系到公共安全。

articles.title: Bridgetown AI summit to tackle safety as risks outpace capacity to respond

paras.en: Bridgetown AI summit to tackle safety as risks outpace capacity to respond
paras.zh: 布里奇敦人工智能峰会将解决安全问题，因为风险超出了应对能力

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres is heading to Barbados to co-host a special summit on artificial intelligence (AI) safety on Monday, aimed at closing the gap between accelerating risks and many countries’ capacity to deal with the pace of development.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯将于周一前往巴巴多斯共同主办人工智能安全特别峰会，旨在缩小不断加剧的风险与许多国家应对发展步伐的能力之间的差距。

paras.en: At this year’s high-level week of the UN General Assembly, 135 leaders brought up concerns over AI – up from just three in 2017 – Amandeep Singh Gill, the UN Special Envoy for Digital and Emerging Technologies, said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国数字和新兴技术特使阿曼迪普·辛格·吉尔 (Amandeep Singh Gill) 周五表示，在今年联合国大会高级别会议上，有 135 名领导人提出了对人工智能的担忧，而 2017 年只有 3 名领导人。

paras.en: “Monday’s summit capitalises on that momentum,” he said, pointing to a call by Norway and Finland for the control of frontier AI models, now signed by 32 States and the European Commission, and a call issued at a summit hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron, endorsed by 17 States and 10 AI developers.
paras.zh: 他说：“周一的峰会充分利用了这一势头。”他指出，挪威和芬兰呼吁控制前沿人工智能模型，目前已有 32 个国家和欧盟委员会签署，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 主持的峰会上也发出了这一呼吁，并得到了 17 个国家和 10 名人工智能开发商的支持。

paras.en: Co-hosted with Barbadian Prime Minister Mia Mottley, the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety will open discussion on the Secretary-General’s proposal for a multilateral AI risk management framework, backed by independent and credible oversight.
paras.zh: 布里奇敦人工智能安全特别峰会与巴巴多斯总理米娅·莫特利共同主办，将就秘书长提出的多边人工智能风险管理框架提案展开讨论，并以独立和可信的监督为后盾。

paras.en: “It’s not a treaty, it’s not regulation, but it is a framework which different countries can then use to build up their own national AI safety infrastructure,” Mr. Gill said.
paras.zh: “这不是一项条约，也不是法规，而是一个框架，不同国家可以利用它来建立自己的国家人工智能安全基础设施，”吉尔先生说。

paras.en: In his opening remarks, Mr. Guterres will underscore that AI’s potential benefits are enormous – from strengthening health systems and accelerating scientific discovery to transforming education and improving hurricane forecasting – but that its risks are growing just as rapidly, his Spokesperson said on Friday, briefing reporters in New York.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯的发言人周五在纽约向记者通报情况时表示，古特雷斯在开场白中将强调，人工智能的潜在好处是巨大的——从加强卫生系统、加速科学发现到改变教育和改善飓风预报——但其风险也在迅速增长。

paras.en: The summit can help strengthen national approaches to AI safety, he will stress, while recognising that no single model can fit every country.
paras.zh: 他强调，这次峰会可以帮助加强各国在人工智能安全方面的做法，同时认识到没有一种模式可以适合每个国家。

paras.en: The need for such infrastructure is often underappreciated, Mr. Gill stated. Many countries lack not only the computing power and talent to develop AI, but also the capacity to test models developed elsewhere and prepare for incidents such as cybersecurity breaches.
paras.zh: 吉尔先生表示，对此类基础设施的需求常常被低估。许多国家不仅缺乏开发人工智能的计算能力和人才，而且缺乏测试其他地方开发的模型并为网络安全漏洞等事件做好准备的能力。

paras.en: Citing the World Development Report 2026, he said high-income countries have 500 incident response teams, while low-income countries have only six.
paras.zh: 他援引《2026年世界发展报告》称，高收入国家有500个事件响应小组，而低收入国家只有6个。

paras.en: “These AI risks don’t recognize borders,” he said. Models may be developed in a couple of geographies, “but the risk can travel anywhere and the capacity is not there to deal with those risks.”
paras.zh: “这些人工智能风险不分国界，”他说。模型可能会在几个地区开发，“但风险可以传播到任何地方，而且那里没有能力应对这些风险。”

paras.en: Some 150 participants are expected at the hybrid meeting, including ministers from Norway and Finland, AI industry leaders, heads of AI safety institutes and members of the UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI. The United States will be represented by a senior diplomat, and Chinese experts are also expected.
paras.zh: 预计约有 150 名与会者参加混合会议，其中包括挪威和芬兰的部长、人工智能行业领袖、人工智能安全机构负责人以及联合国人工智能国际独立科学小组成员。美国将由一名高级外交官代表，中国专家也将出席。

paras.en: Discussions will not cover military uses of AI. A second roundtable will focus on access, inclusion and linguistic diversity, as developing countries fear missing out on AI’s benefits.
paras.zh: 讨论不会涉及人工智能的军事用途。第二次圆桌会议将重点讨论获取、包容和语言多样性，因为发展中国家担心错过人工智能的好处。

paras.en: No negotiated outcome is planned, but calls to action and pledges are expected.
paras.zh: 目前尚未计划达成任何谈判结果，但预计将呼吁采取行动并做出承诺。

paras.en: “We are in a good position, but action must catch up with the analysis,” Mr. Gill said.
paras.zh: “我们处于有利位置，但行动必须跟上分析，”吉尔先生说。

articles.title: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño

paras.en: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño
paras.zh: 家园被遗弃，收成歉收：海地农民在暴力、饥饿和厄尔尼诺现象中重建

paras.en: Years of insecurity, violence perpetrated by murderous armed gangs and economic instability, combined with displacement, poor agricultural performance and climate shocks, have left millions of Haitians struggling to meet their food needs.
paras.zh: 多年的不安全局势、凶残的武装团伙实施的暴力和经济不稳定，加上流离失所、农业生产不佳和气候冲击，导致数百万海地人难以满足粮食需求。

paras.en: It’s estimated that 6.35 million people, roughly half the population, will not get enough to eat between March and June 2027.
paras.zh: 据估计，2027 年 3 月至 6 月期间，将有 635 万人（约占总人口的一半）吃不饱。

paras.en: Almost two million of them will be at emergency levels, where families have little or nothing to eat and may have to sell the things they depend on for a living just to get food.
paras.zh: 其中近 200 万人将处于紧急状态，家庭几乎没有食物或根本没有食物，可能不得不出售他们赖以生存的东西才能获得食物。

paras.en: A series of overlapping crises are currently shaping food insecurity.
paras.zh: 目前，一系列重叠的危机正在造成粮食不安全。

paras.en: More than 1.5 million people have been forced to flee their homes due to the threat of gang violence, and many can no longer work or grow food.
paras.zh: 由于帮派暴力的威胁，超过 150 万人被迫逃离家园，许多人无法再工作或种植粮食。

paras.en: Insecurity is also disrupting farming communities and market supply chains.
paras.zh: 不安全局势也扰乱了农业社区和市场供应链。

paras.en: The El Niño weather phenomenon is now a third threat.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺天气现象现在是第三个威胁。

paras.en: It is bringing droughts and floods that are reducing harvests and affecting farmers' ability to prepare for the next planting season.
paras.zh: 它带来的干旱和洪水导致收成减少，影响农民为下一个种植季节做准备的能力。

paras.en: The number of people affected by drought conditions is projected to reach four million by December 2026.
paras.zh: 预计到 2026 年 12 月，受干旱影响的人数将达到 400 万人。

paras.en: “Rain isn’t falling,” said Dieula Célestin. “You work the soil, but there is no rain. You plant your crops, and you end up with nothing to harvest.”
paras.zh: “没有下雨，”迪乌拉·塞莱斯廷说。 “你耕种土壤，却没有下雨。你种庄稼，最终却一无所获。”

paras.en: Délivrance Dovily lost her animals: “Because of the country’s crisis, we struggle just to eat. We used to raise livestock to help pay for school, the animals used to support us. But because of the crisis and diseases that came through, we lost them.”
paras.zh: Délivrance Dovily 失去了她的动物：“由于国家的危机，我们只是为了吃饭而挣扎。我们过去饲养牲畜来支付学费，动物用来养活我们。但由于危机和疾病的发生，我们失去了它们。”

paras.en: Less food is being grown in Haiti, and ongoing insecurity means it cannot easily be transported to the people who need it most.
paras.zh: 海地种植的粮食越来越少，而且持续的不安全局势意味着粮食无法轻易运送到最需要的人手中。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) provides emergency food and cash to vulnerable families, including those displaced by violence.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）向弱势家庭，包括因暴力而流离失所的家庭提供紧急粮食和现金。

paras.en: This year, working alongside the Haitian authorities, it has supported 2.6 million people.
paras.zh: 今年，它与海地当局合作，为 260 万人提供了支持。

paras.en: Its programmes also include school meals for more than 620,000 students and malnutrition prevention for young children and support to the government for the establishment of a social safety net system.
paras.zh: 其计划还包括为超过 620,000 名学生提供校餐、预防幼儿营养不良以及支持政府建立社会安全网体系。

paras.en: In the case of extreme weather, such as Hurricane Melissa which struck the south of the country one year ago, pre-positioned stocks can provide rice, beans and cooking oil to up to 300,000 people for one month.
paras.zh: 在极端天气的情况下，例如一年前袭击该国南部的飓风梅丽莎，预先储备的库存可以为多达30万人提供一个月的大米、豆类和食用油。

paras.en: The UN Humanitarian Air Service (UNHAS) flies aid workers in and out of the capital Port-au-Prince, and to remote locations across the country, enabling humanitarians to reach the most vulnerable Haitians, wherever they are.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义空运服务队（UNHAS）负责运送援助人员进出首都太子港以及全国各地的偏远地区，使人道主义人员能够接触到最脆弱的海地人，无论他们身在何处。

paras.en: The UN’s Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) works alongside WFP during emergencies and has provided support including livestock, such as poultry but also goats in order to help farmers immediately generate cash and food to sustain their own family.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 在紧急情况下与粮食计划署合作，提供包括家禽等牲畜在内的支持，也包括山羊，以帮助农民立即赚取现金和食物来维持自己的家庭。

paras.en: “The animals are interesting because we can distribute them at any time. So, we do not have to wait for the planting season and farmers can immediately use them,” said FAO country chief, Pierre Vauthier.
paras.zh: “这些动物很有趣，因为我们可以随时分发它们。因此，我们不必等到种植季节，农民就可以立即使用它们，”粮农组织国家负责人皮埃尔·沃蒂尔说。

paras.en: Délivrance Dovily agrees: “Receiving these goats helps boost our activities and strengthen our capacity, giving us more resources to support our children with school and meet their needs.”
paras.zh: Délivrance Dovily 表示同意：“接收这些山羊有助于促进我们的活动并增强我们的能力，为我们提供更多资源来支持孩子们上学并满足他们的需求。”

paras.en: In partnership with national authorities, WFP, FAO and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), another UN agency working on rural poverty, are investing in programmes that help vulnerable communities to withstand shocks and protect livelihoods.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署、粮农组织和国际农业发展基金（农发基金）（另一个致力于农村贫困问题的联合国机构）与国家当局合作，正在投资于帮助脆弱社区抵御冲击和保护生计的项目。

paras.en: If people are more self-sufficient, they will depend less on humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 如果人们更加自给自足，他们就会减少对人道主义援助的依赖。

paras.en: WFP is rehabilitating water-management infrastructure and rural roads. It also provides insurance against crop losses from drought or excessive rain. Some 74 per cent of its school meals use food sourced directly from local farmers.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署正在修复水管理基础设施和农村道路。它还为干旱或过多降雨造成的农作物损失提供保险。大约 74% 的学校膳食使用直接来自当地农民的食物。

paras.en: WFP and FAO seek to connect immediate life-saving interventions with responding to the root causes of hunger, such as support for smallholder farmers and resilience.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署和粮农组织力求将立即采取的拯救生命干预措施与应对饥饿的根源联系起来，例如对小农的支持和抵御能力。

paras.en: “As Haiti faces a complex and multifaceted crisis, it’s more important than ever for UN agencies to work together with the government, not only to provide life-saving emergency food assistance, but also to scale up long-term investments that help communities build hope and resilience, withstand shocks and protect livelihoods from events like El Niño,” said Erwan Rumen, WFP Acting Country Director.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署代理国家主任埃尔万·鲁门表示：“由于海地面临复杂多方面的危机，联合国机构与政府合作比以往任何时候都更加重要，不仅要提供救生紧急粮食援助，还要扩大长期投资，帮助社区建立希望和恢复力，抵御冲击并保护生计免受厄尔尼诺等事件的影响。”

paras.en: Food aid keeps people alive today. Seeds, animals, roads and insurance make families less dependent on it tomorrow.
paras.zh: 粮食援助让人们今天得以生存。种子、动物、道路和保险使家庭明天对它的依赖减少。

paras.en: - WFP: Delivers emergency food and cash, school meals and shared logistics for the entire humanitarian community, while working to build resilient communities.
paras.zh: - 粮食计划署：为整个人道主义社区提供紧急粮食和现金、学校膳食和共享后勤服务，同时努力建设有复原力的社区。

paras.en: - FAO: Supports families with seeds, inputs and livestock to quickly produce their own food locally, for their own consumption or to generate income.
paras.zh: - 粮农组织：支持拥有种子、投入品和牲畜的家庭在当地快速生产自己的食物，供自己消费或创收。

paras.en: - IFAD: Funds programmes that raise smallholder farmers’ productivity and incomes.
paras.zh: - 农发基金：资助提高小农生产力和收入的计划。

paras.en: The latest data on food insecurity known as the IPC (a Government-led analysis supported by FAO and WFP) is available here.
paras.zh: 有关粮食不安全的最新数据，即 IPC（由粮农组织和粮食计划署支持的政府主导的分析）可在此处获取。

articles.title: Bolton hit back to hold Portsmouth

paras.en: Bolton Wanderers vs Portsmouth; Sky Bet Championship
paras.zh: 博尔顿 vs 朴茨茅斯；天空投注锦标赛

paras.en: Bolton Wanderers vs Portsmouth. Sky Bet Championship.
paras.zh: 博尔顿队对阵朴茨茅斯队。天空投注锦标赛。

paras.en: Bolton 1-1 Portsmouth: Sam Dalby earns point for Trotters
paras.zh: 博尔顿 1-1 朴茨茅斯：萨姆·达尔比为 Trotters 赢得积分

paras.en: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Bolton Wanderers and Portsmouth at the Toughsheet Community Stadium on Saturday; Josh Murphy nets early for Pompey before Sam Dalby hits back for Trotters as spoils are shared.
paras.zh: 报道周六在 Toughsheet 社区体育场举行的 Sky Bet 冠军赛博尔顿队与朴茨茅斯队之间的比赛并免费观看精彩比赛；乔什·墨菲 (Josh Murphy) 早早为庞培 (Pompey) 进球，随后萨姆·达尔比 (Sam Dalby) 为特罗特斯 (Trotters) 反击，战利品被分享。

paras.en: Bolton nemesis Josh Murphy helped Portsmouth secure a 1-1 Championship draw at the Toughsheet Community Stadium.
paras.zh: 博尔顿的宿敌乔什·墨菲帮助朴茨茅斯在 Toughsheet 社区体育场以 1-1 战平英冠。

paras.en: Murphy's first goal of the season put Pompey in front but Sam Dalby ensured Wanderers avoided a fourth successive home defeat with his seventh goal of the season and third in four games.
paras.zh: 墨菲本赛季的第一个进球让庞培领先，但萨姆·达尔比凭借本赛季的第七个进球和四场比赛中的第三个进球，确保流浪者队避免了主场四连败。

paras.en: Despite this frenetic opening 12 minutes neither side could celebrate a first game back after the international break with three points.
paras.zh: 尽管开场 12 分钟，双方都无法以三分庆祝国际比赛日后的第一场比赛。

paras.en: Murphy ensured the worst case of deja vu for Wanderers, now unbeaten in 15 second-tier games against Pompey but still adjusting to life after leaving League One last term.
paras.zh: 墨菲为流浪者队带来了最糟糕的似曾相识的感觉，现在他们在对阵庞培的二线比赛中保持了15场不败，但仍在适应上赛季离开甲级联赛后的生活。

paras.en: He scored the two first-half goals that saw Oxford stun the Trotters in the 2024 League One play-off final at Wembley.
paras.zh: 他在上半场打进两粒进球，帮助牛津队在温布利举行的 2024 年英甲附加赛决赛中击败了快跑队。

paras.en: This time it took him seven minutes to register his opening goal of the campaign and first since March 2025, heading in a deep right-wing cross from Northern Ireland international Terry Devlin.
paras.zh: 这次，他用了 7 分钟的时间就完成了本赛季的首个进球，这是自 2025 年 3 月以来的第一次，他接到北爱尔兰国脚特里·德夫林 (Terry Devlin) 的右翼传中头球攻门。

paras.en: But Steven Schumacher's side crucially levelled five minutes later. Max Conway, atoning for giving possession away for the game's first goal, crossed from the left and Dalby side footed home inside the six-yard box.
paras.zh: 但史蒂文·舒马赫的球队在五分钟后关键性地扳平了比分。马克斯·康威（Max Conway）为比赛第一个进球而失去控球权而赎罪，从左侧传中，多尔比（Dalby）在六码禁区内侧脚射门。

paras.en: Goalkeeper Nicolas Schmid, however, should have done better as he allowed the striker's shot to go through his legs in front of his own supporters.
paras.zh: 然而，门将尼古拉斯·施密德本应该做得更好，因为他让前锋的射门在自己的支持者面前穿过了他的腿。

paras.en: Top scorer Dalby should then have put Bolton in front in first half stoppage time.
paras.zh: 头号得分手达尔比本应在上半场补时阶段帮助博尔顿取得领先。

paras.en: Excellent work by Sam Iling-Junior fashioned the chance but Dalby could not convert the winger's cross on the slide from four yards.
paras.zh: 小萨姆·伊林的出色表现创造了这个机会，但多尔比未能将边锋从四码处滑出的传中转换成球。

paras.en: Portsmouth, beaten only once now in seven outings, started the second half positively with Murphy seeing a shot deflected for a corner.
paras.zh: 朴茨茅斯在七场比赛中只被击败过一次，下半场开局积极，墨菲看到射门偏出角球。

paras.en: Bolton though were more than a match for their visitors as they looked to improve this season's dismal home form.
paras.zh: 不过，博尔顿对于他们的客队来说不仅仅是一场比赛，因为他们希望改善本赛季惨淡的主场表现。

paras.en: Schmid saved from midfielder Xavier Simons' shot as both sides rang the changes in an attempt to make the breakthrough.
paras.zh: 施密德扑出了中场球员泽维尔·西蒙斯的射门，双方都试图取得突破。

paras.en: Portsmouth's hopes of a second goal though were repeatedly dashed by a succession of offsides while Wanderers
paras.zh: 然而，朴茨茅斯第二个进球的希望却因流浪者队的一系列越位而一再破灭。

paras.en: Teenager Max Lott headed wide shortly after entering the fray while defender Chris Forino tested Schmid in the final stages of normal time with a close-range header.
paras.zh: 少年马克斯·洛特在进入比赛后不久头球偏出，后卫克里斯·福里诺在正常时间的最后阶段用近距离头球考验施密德。

paras.en: Forino was the focal point for Bolton's late raids but again Schmid comfortably dealt with his latest attempt via a Lewis Brunt cross.
paras.zh: 福里诺是博尔顿后期突袭的焦点，但施密德再次通过刘易斯·布伦特的传中轻松应对了他的最新尝试。

paras.en: - Watch FREE Championship highlights | Latest EFL news and rumours
paras.zh: - 免费观看锦标赛精彩集锦|最新的 EFL 新闻和谣言

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream EFL games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 EFL 比赛📺

paras.en: "It was a decent performance apart from the first 10 minutes when they got in front.
paras.zh: “除了他们领先的前10分钟之外，这是一场不错的表现。

paras.en: "We looked a bit edgy and made a few unforced errors. But I thought after that we settled down really nicely, we played well for the rest of the first half, deserved to be level and should have been ahead before half time.
paras.zh: “我们看起来有点急躁，犯了一些非受迫性失误。但我认为在那之后我们的状态非常好，我们在上半场剩下的时间里踢得很好，理应扳平，应该在半场结束前就领先。”

paras.en: "And I think it would have been a deserved lead. He (Iling-Junior) had to hit the pass hard to get it past the keeper but the ball just bobbled up and Sam couldn't get his right boot on it.
paras.zh: “我认为这将是当之无愧的领先。他（小伊林）必须用力传球才能越过守门员，但球只是弹了起来，萨姆无法用右脚踢球。

paras.en: "There were more positives than negatives," added Schumacher of a display that nudged his side upto 17th, eight points above the relegation zone.
paras.zh: 舒马赫在谈到球队的表现时补充道：“积极因素多于消极因素。”这使得他的球队排名上升到第 17 位，比降级区高出 8 分。

paras.en: "Defensively, we improved and limited Portsmouth to only one shot on target. That takes a whole team effort.
paras.zh: “在防守方面，我们改进了朴茨茅斯，将其限制为只有一脚射正。这需要整个团队的努力。

paras.en: "And we have a setback but the lads always try and respond. We try and stay calm, don't lose our minds and start pointing fingers and screaming at each other.
paras.zh: “我们遇到了挫折，但小伙子们总是试图做出回应。我们努力保持冷静，不要失去理智，开始互相指责和尖叫。

paras.en: "It just looked like there was one team wanting to win the game."
paras.zh: “看起来好像有一支球队想要赢得比赛。”

paras.en: "We came away with a point having not played particularly well in the first half. So, there is much more to come from the group.
paras.zh: “我们在上半场踢得不是特别好，但最终还是拿到了一分。所以，这支球队还有很多事情要做。”

paras.en: "We were inconsistent. There were some good bits, some poor bits and everything in between.
paras.zh: “我们的表现不一致。有一些好的地方，有一些不好的地方，以及介于两者之间的一切。

paras.en: "The overall message to the group is 'well done' because we have come away to a tough place against a good side and taken a point.
paras.zh: “向球队传达的总体信息是‘干得好’，因为我们在客场对阵一支优秀的球队，并取得了一分。

paras.en: "I put out a side I thought could win us the game. But when you strip it back because of what we are contending with the squad, I think it is a decent achievement.
paras.zh: “我派出了一支我认为可以为我们赢得比赛的球队。但是当你因为我们正在与球队竞争而将其剥离时，我认为这是一个不错的成就。

paras.en: "But I still think we can be better both as individuals and as a team unit."
paras.zh: “但我仍然认为我们作为个人和团队单位都可以做得更好。”

articles.title: Wrexham earn narrow late win at Lincoln

paras.en: Lincoln City vs Wrexham; Sky Bet Championship
paras.zh: 林肯城 vs 雷克瑟姆；天空投注锦标赛

paras.en: Lincoln City vs Wrexham. Sky Bet Championship.
paras.zh: 林肯城 vs 雷克瑟姆。天空投注锦标赛。

paras.en: Lincoln 0-1 Wrexham: George Thomason nets winner for Red Dragons
paras.zh: 林肯 0-1 雷克斯汉姆：乔治·托马森为红龙队赢得胜利

paras.en: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Lincoln City and Wrexham at the ProAmpac Stadium on Saturday; George Thomason scores the only goal as Red Dragons claim a narrow late victory.
paras.zh: 报道周六在 ProAmpac 体育场举行的 Sky Bet 冠军赛林肯城 (Lincoln City) 和雷克瑟姆 (Wrexham) 之间的免费比赛集锦；乔治·托马森打进唯一进球，红龙队在最后时刻险胜。

paras.en: George Thomason grabbed a late winner as Wrexham secured a welcome 1-0 victory away at Lincoln.
paras.zh: 乔治·托马森 (George Thomason) 在最后时刻攻入制胜球，雷克瑟姆 (Wrexham) 客场 1-0 战胜林肯 (Lincoln)。

paras.en: It was a game lacking real quality in the final third at Sincil Bank.
paras.zh: 这是一场在 Sincil Bank 的最后三区缺乏真正质量的比赛。

paras.en: But Thomason kept his cool when the moment arose to fire Wrexham to victory with his 82nd-minute strike.
paras.zh: 但托马森在第 82 分钟的进球帮助雷克瑟姆取得胜利的时刻保持了冷静。

paras.en: It was a first away league victory for Phil Parkinson's charges since the start of September when they beat Millwall 2-0.
paras.zh: 这是菲尔·帕金森的球队自九月初以2-0击败米尔沃尔以来首次在客场联赛中获胜。

paras.en: The Red Dragons have now gone three games without defeat and will be hoping to use their recent upturn in form as a catalyst towards their play-off push.
paras.zh: 红龙队目前已经三场比赛保持不败，他们希望利用最近状态的好转作为他们晋级附加赛的催化剂。

paras.en: For Lincoln, it was the latest bump in the road as the reality of being minnows in the Championship is really beginning to hit home.
paras.zh: 对于林肯来说，这是道路上的最新障碍，因为在锦标赛中成为小鱼的现实确实开始击中要害。

paras.en: Any hopes the international break would bring about a change in fortunes were dashed with a fourth loss on the spin, whilst it is their seventh defeat in nine.
paras.zh: 任何希望国际比赛日能够改变命运的希望都因旋转中的第四场失利而破灭，而这是他们九场比赛中的第七场失利。

paras.en: Their only victory in that time was the 4-1 hammering of relegation rivals Burnley, which led to Nicky Hayen's sacking.
paras.zh: 他们当时唯一的胜利是4-1击败降级对手伯恩利，导致尼基·海恩被解雇。

paras.en: The first real chance of the contest fell to the visitors as Callum Doyle nodded wide of the mark from Thomason's delivery into the box.
paras.zh: 这场比赛的第一个真正的机会落在了客队身上，卡勒姆·多伊尔在托马森将球送入禁区后头球攻门偏出。

paras.en: Down the other end, Rob Street saw his own header well kept out by stopper Anthony Patterson.
paras.zh: 在另一端，罗布·斯特里特看到自己的头球被门将安东尼·帕特森挡出。

paras.en: Defender Demi Elerewe produced a great double block when he prevented Ollie Rathbone from breaking the deadlock.
paras.zh: 后卫德米·埃莱雷威（Demi Elerewe）在阻止奥利·拉思伯恩（Ollie Rathbone）打破僵局时完成了精彩的双重拦网。

paras.en: Patterson was then called into action once more to deny Adam Reach's effort on the half hour mark after good link up play between Reach and Dan Oyegoke.
paras.zh: 在里奇和丹·奥耶戈克之间的良好配合后，帕特森在半小时内再次被要求采取行动，以阻止亚当·里奇的射门。

paras.en: Street came close to changing the complexion of the respective half-time team talks when he agonisingly fired wide on the stroke of the break.
paras.zh: 斯特里特在中场休息时痛苦地射门偏出，差点改变了半场双方球队的气氛。

paras.en: The second half was a poorer showing than the first with meaningful chances at a premium after the restart.
paras.zh: 下半场的表现比上半场差，但重新开始后却有机会获得宝贵的机会。

paras.en: George Wickens got down low to keep out Rathbone's tame strike from outside the box in a routine bit of keeping.
paras.zh: 乔治·威肯斯（George Wickens）低位防守，以例行的防守方式挡住了拉思伯恩（Rathbone）在禁区外温和的射门。

paras.en: Patterson barely had to move to stop Andrei Coubis' effort down the middle of his goal.
paras.zh: 帕特森几乎不需要移动就能阻止安德烈·库比斯的射门。

paras.en: Dom Jefferies' free-kick did not threaten the visitors, whilst Oyegoke was kept out by another routine Patterson stop heading into the final quarter of an hour.
paras.zh: 多姆·杰弗里斯的任意球并没有对客队构成威胁，而奥耶戈克则在最后一刻钟的时候被帕特森的另一次例行拦截挡出。

paras.en: But the door was eventually unlocked when Thomason snatched the winner with eight minutes to go.
paras.zh: 但当托马森在比赛还剩八分钟时取得制胜球时，大门最终被打开。

paras.en: The 25-year-old pounced on a poor back pass and easily slotted home a left-footed effort beyond the on-rushing Wickens for his second goal of the campaign and most importantly to secure the points for the Welsh outfit.
paras.zh: 这位25岁的球员接住了一次糟糕的回传，轻松地在冲上来的威肯斯身后用左脚射门，这是他本赛季的第二个进球，最重要的是，他为威尔士队锁定了积分。

paras.en: Lincoln chucked on reinforcements to try and salvage something from the game.
paras.zh: 林肯派遣增援部队试图从比赛中挽救一些东西。

paras.en: Bailey Cadamarteri was denied Wrexham's second, with Patterson keeping out Jefferies right at the end.
paras.zh: 贝利·卡达马特里 (Bailey Cadamarteri) 未能获得雷克瑟姆的第二个进球，而帕特森则在最后时刻将杰弗里斯挡出。

paras.en: - Watch FREE Championship highlights | Latest EFL news and rumours
paras.zh: - 免费观看锦标赛精彩集锦|最新的 EFL 新闻和谣言

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream EFL games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 EFL 比赛📺

paras.en: "It's a very disappointing outcome. I thought we went toe-to-toe with Wrexham on the whole.
paras.zh: “这是一个非常令人失望的结果。我认为我们总体上与雷克瑟姆是正面交锋的。

paras.en: "The result has been decided by an error. It will be big learning for us as a group. We were trying to force the game, try to find a way to win it and unfortunately we've come away with zero points.
paras.zh: “结果是由一个错误决定的。这对我们作为一个团队来说将是一个很大的学习。我们试图迫使比赛，试图找到一种方法来赢得比赛，但不幸的是我们得到了零分。

paras.en: "The feel leading up to the goal, we got a bit too comfortable with the ball. A few passes went a little bit off script. We were perhaps irresponsible at times.
paras.zh: “在进球之前，我们对球的感觉有点太舒服了。有一些传球有点偏离剧本。我们有时可能是不负责任的。”

paras.en: "But the people, the players, the group involved will learn really quickly that you can't indulge at any moment at this level and we got punished.
paras.zh: “但是人们、球员、相关团体很快就会明白，在这个级别上你不能在任何时候沉迷，我们会受到惩罚。

paras.en: "Our performance as a whole was competitive enough. We were just starting to tip a nothing game, but unfortunately it's a really tough lesson for us all to learn.
paras.zh: “我们的整体表现足够有竞争力。我们刚刚开始在一场没有任何比赛的比赛中获胜，但不幸的是，这对我们所有人来说都是一个非常艰难的教训。

paras.en: "We looked physically good, but we just didn't quite connect around the penalty area.
paras.zh: “我们看起来身体状况不错，但我们在禁区周围的联系不够紧密。

paras.en: "The game was there for us if we really wanted, but when we got that flow we made a big mistake and that sums it up."
paras.zh: “如果我们真的想要的话，这款游戏就在我们身边，但当我们得到这样的流程时，我们犯了一个大错误，这就是总结。”

paras.en: "As any win, it's a huge one. We stood strong as a team. There was a group understanding of what was required.
paras.zh: “对于任何一场胜利来说，这都是一场巨大的胜利。我们作为一个团队坚强地站着。我们对需要什么有一个团队的理解。

paras.en: "I spoke to the lads on Monday about the importance about getting our away form back on track.
paras.zh: “周一我和小伙子们谈到了让我们的客场状态回到正轨的重要性。

paras.en: "You can never guarantee a result, but the performance and the determination of the group…the supporters could see that.
paras.zh: “你永远无法保证结果，但球队的表现和决心......支持者可以看到这一点。

paras.en: "When the moment came, Thommo took it brilliant. But the defending is as important as that goal.
paras.zh: “当那一刻到来时，托莫表现得非常出色。但防守和进球一样重要。

paras.en: "I think we're targeting performances on a weekly basis. Each game is different and you need different qualities every game.
paras.zh: “我认为我们的目标是每周的表现。每场比赛都是不同的，每场比赛你都需要不同的品质。

paras.en: "Each win is so hard. It was great to celebrate with our supporters at the end. The players are pleased with that one.
paras.zh: “每一场胜利都如此艰难。最后与我们的支持者一起庆祝真是太好了。球员们对此感到满意。

paras.en: "The lads who have got the shirts at the moment are putting in a great shift. We've had injury problems before, we've pieced teams together at a lot of levels. It's about being in a good position when those players come back.
paras.zh: “现在穿上球衣的小伙子们正在做出巨大的转变。我们之前也遇到过伤病问题，我们已经在很多层面上将球队整合在一起。当这些球员回归时，我们需要处于一个良好的位置。”

paras.en: "We've got good heart and good leadership in this team."
paras.zh: “我们这个团队有善良的心和良好的领导力。”

articles.title: Palestinians flee as Israeli tanks cross Gaza ceasefire’s ‘yellow line’
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: Israel’s ground operation across the yellow ceasefire line in Gaza, which forced Palestinians to flee their makeshift shelters, marks a fresh escalation in the conflict and risks undermining an already floundering truce with Hamas, analysts said Thursday.
paras.zh: 分析人士周四表示，以色列跨越加沙黄色停火线的地面行动迫使巴勒斯坦人逃离临时避难所，这标志着冲突再次升级，并有可能破坏与哈马斯本已岌岌可危的休战协议。

paras.en: As tanks rolled into central Gaza on Wednesday, residents could be seen carrying blankets and other belongings away from their tents in pictures and video taken shortly after the Israeli military began what it said was an operation targeting a “terror tunnel.”
paras.zh: 周三，当坦克开进加沙中部时，在以色列军方开始所谓的针对“恐怖隧道”的行动后不久拍摄的照片和视频中，可以看到居民从帐篷里搬出毯子和其他物品。

paras.en: Others could be seen rolling away mattresses on carts and pushing loved ones in wheelchairs away from the scene near the Nuseirat camp in central Gaza. At least one person was reported to have been killed in an Israeli airstrike near the raid, Palestinian medics said, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 可以看到其他人将床垫推到推车上，并将坐轮椅的亲人推离加沙中部努塞拉特营地附近的现场。据路透社报道，巴勒斯坦医务人员称，据报道，至少一人在袭击附近的以色列空袭中丧生。

paras.en: “Bullets were fired at us,” Amna al-Gasar, 49, told NBC News after she fled the scene with her young children, her baby in a pink fluffy sweater strapped to her chest. She said her family had received “evacuation orders” from the Israeli military and that tanks had advanced on the area.
paras.zh: “子弹向我们射击，”49 岁的阿姆娜·加萨尔 (Amna al-Gasar) 带着年幼的孩子逃离现场后告诉 NBC 新闻，她的孩子穿着一件粉色毛衣，绑在胸前。她说，她的家人收到了以色列军方的“疏散命令”，坦克已经向该地区推进。

paras.en: “This is the 14th time that we’re getting displaced,” al-Gasar said, who added that she is from Gaza City in the north of the enclave which is now on the side of the “yellow line” occupied by Israeli forces. “Where should we go? We are exhausted. This is not a life,” she said.
paras.zh: 加萨尔说：“这是我们第 14 次流离失所。”她补充说，她来自飞地北部的加沙城，该飞地现在位于以色列军队占领的“黄线”一侧。 “我们该去哪里？我们已经筋疲力尽了。这不是生活，”她说。

paras.en: Muna Abu Shehadeh, 37, said in a separate interview that along with some of her relatives, she left “with nothing but our children — no bedding, no food, and no water.” She added that she had a daughter who was ill, as well as a baby, and that they had to leave behind what few supplies they had.
paras.zh: 37 岁的穆纳·阿布·谢哈德 (Muna Abu Shehadeh) 在另一次采访中表示，她和她的一些亲戚“除了孩子们什么也没带走——没有被褥、没有食物、没有水。”她补充说，她有一个生病的女儿和一个婴儿，他们不得不留下仅有的少量物资。

paras.en: The Israeli military told NBC News the ground operation was the first to be executed beyond the yellow line — the boundary marking the roughly 60% of Gaza that remains occupied by Israeli forces — since the U.S.-brokered ceasefire with Hamas came into effect in October 2025.
paras.zh: 以色列军方告诉 NBC 新闻，自美国斡旋与哈马斯停火于 2025 年 10 月生效以来，这次地面行动是在黄线之外执行的第一次地面行动。黄线标志着仍被以色列军队占领的加沙约 60% 的地区。

paras.en: Separately, in a joint statement with the Israel Security Agency, or Shin Bet, the Israel Defense Forces said the operation was a “targeted” assault aimed at dismantling a tunnel that “posed an immediate and direct threat” to troops.
paras.zh: 另外，以色列国防军在与以色列安全局（Shin Bet）的联合声明中表示，这次行动是一次“有针对性的”攻击，旨在拆除一条对部队“构成直接威胁”的隧道。

paras.en: They said a warning had been issued to civilians in the area prior to the operation, though they did not expand on how exactly warnings were issued and whether they expanded beyond an announcement published online, when asked by NBC News.
paras.zh: 他们表示，在行动之前已向该地区的平民发出了警告，但当 NBC 新闻询问时，他们没有详细说明警告的具体发出方式以及警告是否超出了在网上发布的公告范围。

paras.en: Israeli forces would continue to operate to “remove any immediate threat and thwart attempts” by Hamas to harm Israeli civilians or troops, the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说，以色列军队将继续采取行动，“消除任何直接威胁并挫败哈马斯伤害以色列平民或军队的企图”。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Israeli military said Thursday that the operation west of the yellow line had “ended,” though they could not confirm when exactly the offensive came to a close. Hamas condemned the ground operation, calling it a violation of the ceasefire agreement.
paras.zh: 以色列军方发言人周四表示，黄线以西的行动已经“结束”，但他们无法确认进攻何时结束。哈马斯谴责地面行动，称其违反停火协议。

paras.en: Andreas Krieg, a senior lecturer at King’s College London’s School of Security Studies, said he also believed the incursion was a “clear violation of the fundamental premise of the ceasefire.”
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院安全研究学院高级讲师安德烈亚斯·克里格表示，他还认为这次入侵“明显违反了停火的基本前提”。

paras.en: “Israel agreed to withdraw to the ‘yellow line,’ which was supposed to establish a mutually understood boundary until further withdrawals could be negotiated,” he said Thursday. Sending ground forces a few hundred feet beyond that line and “forcing civilians to flee undermines the agreement,” he added.
paras.zh: 他周四表示：“以色列同意撤退到‘黄线’，这条线本应建立一条相互理解的边界，直到就进一步撤军进行谈判。”他补充说，将地面部队派遣到该线之外数百英尺并“迫使平民逃离破坏了协议”。

paras.en: “Israel cannot simply invoke security concerns whenever it wants to cross a boundary it agreed to respect,” he said, adding that its assertion of a threat had “not been independently substantiated.” The operation risked undermining “any meaning” the yellow line has held as a boundary under the ceasefire agreement, he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“每当以色列想要跨越其同意尊重的边界时，就不能简单地援引安全问题。”他补充说，其威胁的说法“尚未得到独立证实”。他说，这次行动可能会破坏黄线作为停火协议规定的边界的“任何意义”。

paras.en: The Israeli government and military did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the accusation that the ceasefire agreement had been violated.
paras.zh: 以色列政府和军方没有立即回应有关违反停火协议指控的置评请求。

paras.en: The truce has already been marked by regular Israeli strikes, with more than 1,600 people killed in the enclave since the truce began, according to the Palestinian Health Ministry in the territory. Israel says at least five soldiers have been killed within the same amount of time, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据该地区巴勒斯坦卫生部称，自停战开始以来，以色列定期发动袭击，导致该飞地内有 1,600 多人死亡。据路透社报道，以色列称在同一时间内至少有五名士兵被杀。

paras.en: Both Israel and Hamas have repeatedly traded accusations of ceasefire violations.
paras.zh: 以色列和哈马斯都多次相互指责违反停火协议。

paras.en: “Israel has been violating the ceasefire pretty periodically since it came into place, so it’s nothing new on that front,” Rob Geist Pinfold, a lecturer in defense studies at King’s College London, said Thursday of the Israeli military’s ground operation.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院国防研究讲师罗布·盖斯特·平福德(Rob Geist Pinfold)周四在谈到以色列军方的地面行动时表示：“自停火协议生效以来，以色列经常违反停火协议，因此这方面并不是什么新鲜事。”

paras.en: “It’s the scale of the violation,” he said, adding the ground assault and use of tanks signifying an “escalation” from Israel.
paras.zh: 他说：“这就是侵犯行为的规模。”他补充说，地面袭击和使用坦克标志着以色列的“升级”。

paras.en: Both Pinfold and Krieg noted that the ground operation comes at a time of great political uncertainty for Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces losing his prime ministership after elections last month.
paras.zh: 平福德和克里格都指出，此次地面行动是在本雅明·内塔尼亚胡面临巨大政治不确定性之际进行的，他在上个月的选举后面临失去总理职位的风险。

paras.en: While Netanyahu’s Likud party gained the most votes, President Isaac Herzog tasked his main rival, Gadi Eiskenot, with forming a coalition government based on the premise that he was most likely to succeed in doing so.
paras.zh: 虽然内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团获得最多选票，但总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格责成他的主要竞争对手加迪·艾斯克诺特组建联合政府，前提是他最有可能成功组建联合政府。

paras.en: Netanyahu has railed against the possibility of Israel’s Arab-led parties joining a coalition and both Pinfold and Krieg suggested that he might be seeking to ramp up pressure around security concerns.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡反对以色列阿拉伯领导的政党加入联盟的可能性，平福德和克里格都表示，他可能会寻求围绕安全问题加大压力。

paras.en: Pinfold said Netanyahu was also likely “trying to see how far he can go on the Gaza front,” particularly as the U.S. continues to sideline Israeli involvement in the war with Iran.
paras.zh: 平福德表示，内塔尼亚胡也可能“试图看看他能在加沙前线走多远”，特别是在美国继续回避以色列参与与伊朗的战争的情况下。

paras.en: “I suspect Israel is testing how far it can push the Americans without provoking a serious response,” Krieg said. Israel could also be seeking to “establish a precedent for what amounts to a permanent right of hot pursuit” in Gaza, even beyond its current “yellow line” and even into the future as efforts to advance the peace continue to stall, he added.
paras.zh: 克里格说：“我怀疑以色列正在测试它能在不引起严重反应的情况下将美国人逼到什么程度。”他补充说，以色列还可能寻求在加沙“建立相当于永久紧追权的先例”，甚至超越目前的“黄线”，甚至在推进和平的努力继续陷入停滞的未来。

paras.en: Elsewhere, President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, the body that is overseeing the execution of the U.S.-brokered ceasefire, delivered a bleak report Tuesday on its progress to the United Nations Security Council, warning that the fragile deal was in danger of collapse, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，唐纳德·特朗普总统的和平委员会周二向联合国安理会提交了一份黯淡的进展报告，警告说这项脆弱的协议有破裂的危险。

paras.en: The board said both Israel and Hamas should uphold the commitments made in the agreement, according to Reuters, which obtained a copy of the report. But Hamas’ disarmament and the militant group’s calls for the Israeli military’s withdrawal from Gaza have proven major sticking points in efforts to propel the deal forward.
paras.zh: 据获得该报告副本的路透社报道，该委员会表示，以色列和哈马斯都应恪守协议中的承诺。但哈马斯的解除武装以及该激进组织要求以色列军队从加沙撤军的呼吁已被证明是推动协议进展的主要症结所在。

paras.en: Fleeing from the area of Israel’s ground operation Wednesday, al-Gasar said Palestinians “need a solution.”
paras.zh: 周三逃离以色列地面行动地区的加萨尔表示，巴勒斯坦人“需要一个解决方案”。

paras.en: “All we ask for is safety and security. We’re not asking for a lot,” she said. “All of this talk in the media about advancement in negotiations, but instead we find advancement of tanks.”
paras.zh: “我们所要求的只是安全和保障。我们要求的并不太多，”她说。 “媒体上所有这些都在谈论谈判的进展，但我们却发现了坦克的进步。”

articles.title: Deadly Russian strikes hit 3 Kyiv bridges after Putin vows revenge for Crimea attacks
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — Three bridges in Kyiv were hit Friday in a massive Russian ballistic missile attack, officials in the Ukrainian capital said, hours after President Vladimir Putin vowed “painful” revenge for strikes on his prized bridge linking Crimea to Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——周五，乌克兰首都基辅的三座桥梁在一次大规模的俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击中被击中，几小时前，总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)发誓要对连接克里米亚和俄罗斯的珍贵桥梁遭受的袭击进行“痛苦”的报复。

paras.en: The attacks, which started in the early hours of the morning and continued well into the day, damaged the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges connecting the left and right banks of the Dnipro River, which flows through the city, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said in a post on Telegram.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里钦科在 Telegram 上发帖称，袭击从凌晨开始，一直持续到当天，损坏了连接流经该市的第聂伯河左岸和右岸的 Podilsko-Voskresenskyi、Darnytskyi 和南部桥梁。

paras.en: At least six people were killed and 15 injured in those strikes, Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said in a separate post. Two others were killed in separate attacks across the country, which saw nine regions hit overnight, he said.
paras.zh: 总理谢尔希·科列茨基在另一篇帖子中表示，这些袭击造成至少 6 人死亡、15 人受伤。他说，全国各地的袭击事件造成另外两人死亡，一夜之间袭击了九个地区。

paras.en: The strikes on Kyiv forced authorities to restrict traffic on the bridges, impacting the movement across the capital. Klitschko asked residents not to drive private cars into the city “unless absolutely necessary” and suggested employers let staff work remotely.
paras.zh: 对基辅的袭击迫使当局限制桥梁上的交通，影响了首都的交通。克里琴科要求居民“除非绝对必要”，不要驾驶私家车进入城市，并建议雇主让员工远程工作。

paras.en: Russia has been hitting Kyiv’s Southern and Northern bridges since early October, causing multiple closures, disrupting metro services and causing traffic jams.
paras.zh: 自十月初以来，俄罗斯一直在袭击基辅的南部和北部桥梁，导致多处桥梁关闭、地铁服务中断并造成交通拥堵。

paras.en: But it is the first time that Russia hit three different bridges in a single night, and it has left most of the main road crossings over the Dnipro simultaneously damaged or restricted.
paras.zh: 但这是俄罗斯第一次在一个晚上撞上三座不同的桥梁，并且导致第聂伯河上的大部分主要公路交叉口同时受损或受到限制。

paras.en: An NBC News team in Kyiv heard air raid sirens going off every few minutes overnight, accompanied by loud explosions.
paras.zh: 基辅的 NBC 新闻团队夜间每隔几分钟就听到空袭警报，并伴随着巨大的爆炸声。

paras.en: After dawn broke on the rainy and foggy Friday morning, firefighters were seen putting out the flames from a strike on an industrial area in the capital.
paras.zh: 周五早上，多雨多雾的黎明破晓后，人们看到消防队员正在扑灭首都一个工业区的大火。

paras.en: It’s part of the daily reality for Kyiv’s residents after Russia escalated both the number of ballistic missiles it was firing at the capital and the frequency of attacks.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯增加了向首都发射的弹道导弹数量和袭击频率后，这已成为基辅居民日常生活的一部分。

paras.en: The latest strikes came hours after Putin said that Moscow would retaliate after Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia and Crimea for a third time this week.
paras.zh: 就在最近的袭击发生几个小时前，普京表示，乌克兰本周第三次袭击连接俄罗斯和克里米亚的刻赤大桥，莫斯科将进行报复。

paras.en: Speaking in the Chinese city of Shenzhen after his much-touted trilateral meeting with President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, Putin said Moscow would hit back hard for the attacks on his flagship project. The Kerch Bridge was meant to solidify Russian dominance over Crimea, the peninsula he illegally annexed in 2014.
paras.zh: 普京在亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会上与唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平举行备受瞩目的三方会晤后，在中国深圳发表讲话称，莫斯科将对其旗舰项目的攻击进行严厉回击。刻赤大桥旨在巩固俄罗斯对克里米亚的统治地位，克里米亚是俄罗斯于 2014 年非法吞并的半岛。

paras.en: “We will respond to these strikes. I want everyone to know that,” Putin told reporters, adding that Russia’s response will be “far more painful” than what Kyiv did to the Kerch Bridge, which cost billions of dollars to build.
paras.zh: 普京对记者说：“我们将对这些袭击做出回应。我希望每个人都知道这一点。”他补充说，俄罗斯的反应将比基辅对刻赤大桥所做的“痛苦得多”，该大桥耗资数十亿美元建造。

paras.en: Putin personally opened the road and rail bridge, which is the longest in Europe, in 2018. Beyond its symbolic value, the bridge has served as a vital supply route for the Russian military and civilians in Crimea.
paras.zh: 普京于2018年亲自开通了这座欧洲最长的公路和铁路大桥。除了其象征意义之外，这座大桥还是克里米亚俄罗斯军队和平民的重要补给路线。

paras.en: Putin insisted Thursday that the bridge was “an exclusively civilian facility,” but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called it “the main military crossing from Russian territory into our Ukrainian Crimea.”
paras.zh: 普京周四坚称这座桥是“完全民用设施”，但乌克兰总统泽连斯基称其为“从俄罗斯领土进入乌克兰克里米亚的主要军事过境点”。

paras.en: On Friday, Ukraine’s Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said that Russia’s attempts to justify its attacks as “responses” to any of his country’s own attacks should be unacceptable.
paras.zh: 周五，乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈 (Andrii Sybiha) 表示，俄罗斯试图将其袭击辩解为对乌克兰自身袭击的“回应”，这是不可接受的。

paras.en: “Putting Russia and Ukraine on an equal footing is fundamentally wrong,” he said, adding: “This week, Putin posed for photographs with world leaders. But the photograph he deserves is one of him in the dock, where he stands trial for crimes against Ukrainians and Ukraine.”
paras.zh: “将俄罗斯和乌克兰置于平等地位从根本上来说是错误的，”他说，并补充说：“本周，普京与世界领导人合影留念。但他应得的照片是他在被告席上的一张照片，他因针对乌克兰人和乌克兰的罪行而接受审判。”

paras.en: Acknowledging Friday’s strikes on Kyiv’s bridges, Russia said they were used for military purposes — the line of reasoning Moscow has used in the past to justify bridge attacks in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯承认周五对基辅桥梁的袭击，并表示这些袭击是用于军事目的——这是莫斯科过去用来为基辅桥梁袭击辩护的理由。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ukraine’s air force said Friday that Russia used ballistic and cruise missiles, as well as more than 400 drones, in the massive attack against 23 locations across the country.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰空军周五表示，俄罗斯在针对该国 23 个地点的大规模袭击中使用了弹道导弹和巡航导弹以及 400 多架无人机。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said 27 of over 110 missiles launched at Ukraine overnight were ballistic. Nearly 80 cruise missiles were shot down, he said. “Ballistic missiles are, unfortunately, much more difficult to deal with, and that depends not on our capabilities but on the supply of missiles by our partners,” he added.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，夜间向乌克兰发射的 110 多枚导弹中，有 27 枚是弹道导弹。他说，近 80 枚巡航导弹被击落。他补充说：“不幸的是，弹道导弹更难对付，这不取决于我们的能力，而取决于我们合作伙伴的导弹供应。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy told NBC News in an interview on Wednesday that Ukraine was experiencing a “deficit” of American-made Patriot interceptor missiles that can stop Russian ballistic strikes, with U.S. deliveries falling this year. This was posing “a huge problem and challenge” for Kyiv, he said.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周三在接受美国全国广播公司新闻采访时表示，乌克兰正在经历美国制造的爱国者拦截导弹的“短缺”，这种导弹可以阻止俄罗斯的弹道袭击，美国今年的交付量有所下降。他说，这给基辅带来了“巨大的问题和挑战”。

paras.en: The country’s energy authorities also said Russian strikes on power plants and substations, which have been ongoing since early fall, left people in Kyiv and 10 other regions without power.
paras.zh: 该国能源当局还表示，俄罗斯自初秋以来一直对发电厂和变电站进行袭击，导致基辅和其他 10 个地区的人们断电。

paras.en: Richard Engel and Michael Fiorentino reported from Kyiv. Yuliya Talmazan reported from London.
paras.zh: 理查德·恩格尔和迈克尔·费奥伦蒂诺从基辅报道。尤利娅·塔尔马赞从伦敦报道。

articles.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to kill Ukrainian American rapper on its soil
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: COPENHAGEN, Denmark — Authorities thwarted the attempted killing of a Ukrainian American citizen on Danish soil in a plot allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services, the Danish prime minister’s office said Friday.
paras.zh: 丹麦哥本哈根——丹麦首相办公室周五表示，当局挫败了在丹麦领土上企图杀害一名乌克兰裔美国公民的事件，这起事件据称是由俄罗斯情报部门策划的。

paras.en: The Russian defense attaché has been expelled from Denmark in response, Danish Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen told a news conference. Two alleged members of the outlawed Danish gang “Loyal to Familia” have been arrested in connection with the attempted killing, police said.
paras.zh: 丹麦外交部长拉斯·洛克·拉斯穆森在新闻发布会上表示，作为回应，俄罗斯武官已被驱逐出丹麦。警方称，丹麦非法帮派“忠诚家族”的两名涉嫌成员因涉嫌谋杀未遂而被捕。

paras.en: Danish broadcaster DR, citing a court hearing, reported the men are suspected of having been recruited to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper ahead of a planned performance.
paras.zh: 丹麦广播公司 DR 援引法庭听证会报道称，这些人涉嫌被招募在计划演出前暗杀一名乌克兰说唱歌手。

paras.en: Police thwarted the alleged plot when they arrested the two men shortly before the rapper Kyivstoner’s Sept. 25 concert, which was later canceled.
paras.zh: 警方在说唱歌手 Kyivstoner 9 月 25 日的演唱会前不久逮捕了这两人，挫败了这一阴谋，演唱会后来被取消。

paras.en: It was unclear how police identified the two men, who were stopped in a vehicle carrying several weapons, or how the investigation expanded to include two other men who are not accused of participating in the alleged assassination plot targeting Kyivstoner.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚警方如何识别这两名男子，他们被拦在一辆携带多件武器的车辆中，也不清楚调查范围如何扩大到另外两名未被指控参与针对基辅斯通纳的暗杀阴谋的男子。

paras.en: However, all four men have been held in custody since September, according to the broadcaster.
paras.zh: 然而，据该广播公司报道，自 9 月以来，所有四名男子均已被拘留。

paras.en: It was also unclear how the Russian intelligence services allegedly recruited the two Danish suspects.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚俄罗斯情报部门是如何招募这两名丹麦嫌疑人的。

paras.en: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said: “It is a clear illustration of the grave security situation Denmark and Europe find ourselves in. We are facing a Russia under pressure which is acting more aggressively and is more willing to take risks.”
paras.zh: 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷泽里克森表示：“这清楚地说明了丹麦和欧洲所处的严峻安全局势。我们面临着压力之下的俄罗斯，它的行动更加激进，更愿意承担风险。”

paras.en: The Danes’ announcement came as tensions between Europe and Russia heightened again Friday. Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland in what its prime minister said was likely a provocation timed to coincide with European military exercises in his country for a possible postwar mission in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 丹麦人宣布这一消息之际，欧洲和俄罗斯之间的紧张局势周五再次加剧。两枚俄罗斯导弹和一架疑似无人机在波兰坠落，波兰总理表示，这可能是一次挑衅，恰逢欧洲在波兰进行军事演习，以执行可能在乌克兰执行的战后任务。

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Saturday the E.U. stands in full solidarity with Denmark.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩周六表示，欧盟完全声援丹麦。

paras.en: “This was an attack on E.U. soil. And it is unacceptable. We stand in full solidarity with Denmark. And with all Member States targeted by Russian hybrid attacks,” she said in an X post.
paras.zh: “这是对欧盟领土的攻击。这是不可接受的。我们完全声援丹麦。以及所有遭受俄罗斯混合攻击的成员国，”她在 X 帖子中表示。

paras.en: European Council President António Costa said: “We will not be intimidated. Russia’s tactics and threats will not weaken the European Union’s resolve to continue supporting Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔表示：“我们不会被吓倒。俄罗斯的策略和威胁不会削弱欧盟继续支持乌克兰的决心。”

paras.en: The Russian Embassy in Copenhagen said on Friday the accusations were not backed with proof.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯驻哥本哈根大使馆周五表示，这些指控没有证据支持。

articles.title: Why Pond ditched psych rock for new 'Goths at the pub' style
articles.author: Al Newstead

paras.en: Emerging in 2008 from the same Perth scene that birthed Tame Impala (the same suburban share house, in fact), Pond have long been at the vanguard of modern psychedelic rock and pop.
paras.zh: Pond 诞生于 2008 年，源自 Tame Impala 的诞生地（事实上，是同一个郊区合租屋），Pond 长期以来一直是现代迷幻摇滚和流行音乐的先锋。

paras.en: On their 11th album, however, the West Australian five-piece laid down some ground rules.
paras.zh: 然而，在他们的第 11 张专辑中，这支西澳大利亚五人乐队制定了一些基本规则。

paras.en: "No fuzz pedal, no ballads, and no Pink Floyd sh*t."
paras.zh: “没有法兹踏板，没有民谣，也没有平克·弗洛伊德的狗屎。”

paras.en: Denying themselves their lysergic signifiers came out of a simple desire for change and "have something to think about and reach for," frontman Nick Allbrook tells Double J's Michael Hing.
paras.zh: 主唱尼克·奥尔布鲁克 (Nick Allbrook) 告诉 Double J 的迈克尔·兴 (Michael Hing)，否认自己的迷幻符号是出于对改变的简单渴望，并且“有一些值得思考和追求的东西”。

paras.en: "Instead of 'should we do another Pond album?' Because that's a mind-numbingly boring idea."
paras.zh: “而不是‘我们应该再做一张 Pond 专辑吗？’因为这是一个令人头脑麻木的无聊想法。”

paras.en: Instead, the group "hatched this plan of making a short, sharp, angular" album and devised a new style guide — "Goths at the pub."
paras.zh: 相反，该乐队“制定了制作一张简短、尖锐、有棱角的专辑的计划”，并设计了一个新的风格指南——“酒吧里的哥特人”。

paras.en: The resulting album, Terrestrials, bridges distinctive 1980s aesthetics: sunburnt, acid-washed Oz rock and moody, largely British post-punk.
paras.zh: 最终的专辑《Terrescials》融合了 20 世纪 80 年代独特的美学：晒黑、酸洗的 Oz 摇滚和喜怒无常、主要是英国后朋克。

paras.en: Think Icehouse, The Church and Sisters of Mercy sharing a bill in the back room.
paras.zh: 想想冰屋、教会和慈悲修女会在后面的房间里分摊账单吧。

paras.en: Compared to Pond's last album, 2024's sprawling, career-overview Stung!, Terrestrials is leaner and more cohesive.
paras.zh: 与 Pond 的上一张专辑、2024 年的庞大职业生涯概览《Stung!》相比，《Terrescials》更精简、更有凝聚力。

paras.en: The riffs and rhythms are more urgent; the pounding drums avoid cymbals while synths dispense spaciness for taut clarity.
paras.zh: 即兴重复段和节奏更加急迫；敲击的鼓避免了铙钹，而合成器则分配了空间以保持紧张的清晰度。

paras.en: Recording live to tape together in the room also gifts the album a closeness and cleanliness without sacrificing their heaviness or energy.
paras.zh: 在房间里一起现场录音也赋予专辑一种亲密和干净的感觉，同时又不牺牲它们的沉重或能量。

paras.en: For a band historically described as psychedelic cosmonauts, there is a gritty presence to Terrestrials, which — as its title underscores — finds inspiration in very earthly concerns.
paras.zh: 对于一支历史上被描述为迷幻宇航员的乐队来说，Terrescials 有着坚韧的存在，正如其标题所强调的那样，他们从非常现实的问题中寻找灵感。

paras.en: Allbrook has spent most of his career meditating on Australia's national identity. More specifically, chronicling the conflict between Western Australian commerce and culture.
paras.zh: 奥尔布鲁克职业生涯的大部分时间都在思考澳大利亚的民族认同。更具体地说，记录了西澳大利亚商业与文化之间的冲突。

paras.en: Stripping away Pond's trippy signatures for something more sinewy only makes his lyrical plights and political barbs more pointed.
paras.zh: 去掉庞德的迷幻特征，换取更有力的东西，只会让他的抒情困境和政治讽刺更加尖锐。

paras.en: Contemplating Australia Day's history and the titular City of Perth fireworks celebrations that accompany it, angular opener Skyworks comes over like modern-day Midnight Oil.
paras.zh: 考虑到澳大利亚国庆日的历史以及与之相伴的珀斯市烟花庆祝活动，棱角分明的开场白 Skyworks 就像现代的午夜油。

paras.en: Ditto the thumping Casuarina, which critiques the "ongoing institutional neglect and violence" at the titular WA high-security prison that led to the death in custody of 16-year-old Cleveland Dodd at the "inhumane" Unit 18.
paras.zh: 《木麻黄》也是如此，它批评了西澳高度戒备监狱中“持续的机构忽视和暴力”，导致 16 岁的克利夫兰·多德 (Cleveland Dodd) 在“不人道”的 18 号牢房中死亡。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the scrappy, scathing Two Hands laments Rio Tinto's destruction of Juukun Gorge — a 47,000-year-old sacred site for local First Nations communities — with its rallying chorus:
paras.zh: 与此同时，斗志旺盛、尖刻的“两只手”用集结的合唱哀叹力拓对 Juukun 峡谷（当地原住民社区拥有 47,000 年历史的圣地）的破坏：

paras.en: "If your blood pumps and your heart beats / I'll meet you on the corner of my street / And our two hands can make a fist / Red mist."
paras.zh: “如果你的血液泵动，你的心脏跳动/我会在街角遇见你/我们的两只手可以握成拳头/红雾。”

paras.en: "You're inspired to write about the things that loom largest in your mind," notes Allbrook.
paras.zh: “你会受到启发，写下你脑海中最重要的事情，”奥尔布鲁克指出。

paras.en: "I'm not necessarily thinking 'Right, I'm going to build a great body of work about Western Australia and its people.'"
paras.zh: “我不一定会想‘好吧，我要创作一部关于西澳大利亚及其人民的伟大作品。’”

paras.en: But he is fascinated with what he calls "the sunburnt, blistered, debauched freaks" on the fringes of WA culture.
paras.zh: 但他对西澳文化边缘的那些他所谓的“晒伤、起泡、放荡的怪胎”很着迷。

paras.en: "The fear, anxiety, horror, innate goodness, hope — all this stuff that resides within those people … I'm writing about myself really. And my family and my home."
paras.zh: “恐惧、焦虑、恐怖、与生俱来的善良、希望——所有这些存在于这些人内心的东西……我写的是我自己。还有我的家人和我的家。”

paras.en: Born in Fremantle, Allbrook spent his childhood in the remote town of Derby in the Kimberley region before returning to Perth as a high-schooler.
paras.zh: 奥尔布鲁克出生于弗里曼特尔，在金伯利地区的偏远小镇德比度过了童年，然后作为高中生返回珀斯。

paras.en: Part of the city's burgeoning 2000s grassroots scene, Allbrook found local infamy fronting Mink Mussel Creek, one of several bands comprising the same line-up of like-minded muso friends.
paras.zh: 作为这座城市 2000 年代蓬勃发展的草根场景的一部分，奥尔布鲁克发现 Mink Mussel Creek 在当地声名狼藉，该乐队是由志同道合的穆索朋友组成的几个乐队之一。

paras.en: That included drummer Kevin Parker, who would later achieve award-hoovering global acclaim as Tame Impala. Allbrook and Jay "GUM" Watson, who were then Tame touring members, teamed with "Shiny" Joe Ryan to form Pond in 2008.
paras.zh: 其中包括鼓手凯文·帕克（Kevin Parker），他后来因驯服黑斑羚（Tame Impala）而获得全球奖项。 Allbrook 和 Jay "GUM" Watson（当时是 Tame 巡演成员）与 "Shiny" Joe Ryan 于 2008 年组建了 Pond。

paras.en: They went from being a weirder, wilder offshoot to an internationally touring band with breakout 2013 record Beard, Wives, Denim (produced by Parker, who still occasionally joins his mate on tour).
paras.zh: 他们从一个更怪异、更狂野的分支发展成为一支国际巡演乐队，并在 2013 年推出了突破性唱片《Beard, Wives, Denim》（由 Parker 制作，他现在仍然偶尔与他的伴侣一起巡演）。

paras.en: They solidified their line-up over the next decade, with keyboardist Jamie Terry and drummer James Ireland, and their clout for consistently well-received records and live shows.
paras.zh: 在接下来的十年里，他们巩固了自己的阵容，包括键盘手杰米·特里和鼓手詹姆斯·爱尔兰，以及他们一贯广受好评的唱片和现场表演的影响力。

paras.en: Allbrook developed a manic stage presence, but the unhinged goblin persona he cultivated belies the progressive, deep thinker of his poetic lyrics and solo records.
paras.zh: 奥尔布鲁克在舞台上表现得狂躁，但他所培养的精神错乱的妖精形象掩盖了他诗意歌词和独奏唱片中进步、深刻的思想家。

paras.en: He is fascinated with the "brokenness and beauty" of Western Australia, unafraid to interrogate how it has benefited from a history of colonialism, genocide and resource extraction.
paras.zh: 他对西澳大利亚的“破碎与美丽”着迷，不惧质疑它如何从殖民主义、种族灭绝和资源开采的历史中受益。

paras.en: "It's embarrassing," he says. "The state capture by mining oligarchs like Gina Rinehart and Twiggy [Andrew Forrest] guides everything."
paras.zh: “这很尴尬，”他说。 “像吉娜·莱因哈特（Gina Rinehart）和特威吉（安德鲁·福雷斯特）这样的矿业寡头对国家的夺取主导了一切。”

paras.en: Or corporations like Woodside Energy sponsoring WA arts events and "my beloved Freo Dockers," he continues.
paras.zh: 或者像 Woodside Energy 这样的公司赞助西澳艺术活动和“我心爱的 Freo Dockers”，他继续说道。

paras.en: "Grubby fingers are in everything we do. Even the most well-meaning people, like our Premier Roger Cook; no-one's immune from the glittering prizes they offer."
paras.zh: “我们所做的一切都是肮脏的手指。即使是最善意的人，比如我们的总理罗杰库克；没有人能免受他们提供的闪闪发光的奖品的影响。”

paras.en: Terrestrials reckons with humanity's greed and hell-bent instinct for destroying our landscapes.
paras.zh: 地球人考虑到人类的贪婪和破坏我们景观的顽固本能。

paras.en: Named for a stretch of wetland east of Broome, the jangling Roebuck Plains is sung from the perspective of a miner questioning his livelihood.
paras.zh: 《罗巴克平原》以布鲁姆以东的一片湿地命名，歌曲从一名质疑自己生计的矿工的角度出发。

paras.en: "When it gets dry, I feel like I'm dying in Tom Price," Allbrook sings, name-checking the iron ore mining town owned and operated by Rio Tinto.
paras.zh: “当天气变干时，我感觉自己快要死在汤姆·普莱斯了，”奥尔布鲁克唱道，他列举了力拓拥有和经营的铁矿石开采小镇的名字。

paras.en: The driving title track confronts anxieties around "unborn tomorrows and dead yesterdays" with a quintessential Australian refrain: "She'll be alright."
paras.zh: 这首极具震撼力的同名歌曲用典型的澳大利亚歌曲“她会没事的”来面对人们对“未出生的明天和已死去的昨天”的焦虑。

paras.en: It speaks to the optimism that hums beneath these kinetic, rust-coloured songs concerning ecological collapse, state corruption and humanity's tendency for self-destruction.
paras.zh: 它讲述了这些关于生态崩溃、国家腐败和人类自我毁灭倾向的充满活力、铁锈色的歌曲背后所蕴含的乐观情绪。

paras.en: So how does Allbrook combat that existential dread?
paras.zh: 那么奥尔布鲁克如何对抗这种存在主义的恐惧呢？

paras.en: "I recently realised that when I'm really strung out, stressed, sad … the most immediate antidote to that is rockin' out!
paras.zh: “我最近意识到，当我真的感到紧张、压力、悲伤时……最直接的解药就是摇滚！

paras.en: "Releasing all that energy, it's just crazy how quickly you feel better. It's faster than any antidepressant or drink or whatever."
paras.zh: “释放所有能量，你感觉好转的速度之快真是太疯狂了。它比任何抗抑郁药或饮料或其他任何东西都快。”

paras.en: After touring Terrestrials in the US, next month, Pond kick off a homecoming run of theatre shows, bringing a little energy and empathy to folks with their artful racket.
paras.zh: 下个月在美国巡演《地球人》后，庞德将开始一系列返校戏剧表演，用他们巧妙的表演为人们带来一点能量和同理心。

paras.en: As Allbrook poetically surmises, "we're an ugly bunch, but we've got great wells of love and hope in us."
paras.zh: 正如奥尔布鲁克诗意地推测的那样，“我们是一群丑陋的人，但我们内心充满了爱和希望。”

paras.en: Pond kicks off their headline tour in Fremantle on December 5, before playing Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney.
paras.zh: Pond 将于 12 月 5 日在弗里曼特尔开始他们的头条巡演，然后前往布里斯班、墨尔本和悉尼。

articles.title: Tsunami response window shorter after staff pulled from remote island
articles.author: Jano Gibson

paras.en: Australia's decision to remove personnel from Macquarie Island in the Southern Ocean means an important seismic station in the region is currently not operational.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚决定从南大洋麦格理岛撤离人员，这意味着该地区的一个重要地震台目前无法运行。

paras.en: Documents obtained by the ABC show authorities will now have less time to respond if a tsunami is heading towards Australia's south-eastern coastline.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司获得的文件显示，如果海啸袭击澳大利亚东南部海岸线，当局现在做出反应的时间将会减少。

paras.en: Geoscience Australia says it hopes solar panels can be installed early next year so that the seismic station can be automated.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局表示，希望明年初安装太阳能电池板，以便地震台实现自动化。

paras.en: Emergency services in Australia will have less time to respond to tsunamis from the Southern Ocean because the Macquarie Island seismic station is currently not operating, internal government documents reveal.
paras.zh: 政府内部文件显示，由于麦觉理岛地震台目前尚未运行，澳大利亚紧急服务部门应对南大洋海啸的时间将会减少。

paras.en: In late August, the federal environment department made the unprecedented decision to withdraw personnel from the island, 1,500 kilometres south-east of Tasmania, because of concerns about a potential H5 bird flu outbreak.
paras.zh: 8月下旬，出于对可能爆发H5禽流感的担忧，联邦环境部做出了史无前例的决定，从塔斯马尼亚州东南1500公里处的岛上撤出人员。

paras.en: "This decision is a sensitive one that is likely to attract criticism — including because it would be taken ahead of a mortality event," a briefing prepared by the Australian Antarctic Division (AAD) said at the time.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚南极分部（AAD）当时准备的一份简报称：“这一决定是一项敏感决定，可能会招致批评，因为它是在死亡事件发生之前做出的。”

paras.en: The briefing, released to the ABC under freedom of information laws, warned that unless expeditioners were extracted, they could be exposed to "psycho-social hazards" from living and working amongst dying and dead baby elephant seals for several months.
paras.zh: 这份根据信息自由法向美国广播公司发布的简报警告说，除非探险者被撤离，否则他们可能会因在垂死和死亡的小象海豹中生活和工作几个月而面临“心理社会危害”。

paras.en: But the briefing also noted the decision would have "significant implications" on critical monitoring programs conducted by the AAD and other government agencies.
paras.zh: 但简报还指出，这一决定将对 AAD 和其他政府机构实施的关键监测计划产生“重大影响”。

paras.en: One of them is Geoscience Australia, which has a seismic observatory on the island.
paras.zh: 其中之一是澳大利亚地球科学公司，该公司在岛上设有地震观测站。

paras.en: The observatory monitors earthquakes in the highly volatile region, which is on the boundary of the Pacific and Australian tectonic plates.
paras.zh: 该天文台监测位于太平洋和澳大利亚板块边界的高度不稳定地区的地震。

paras.en: But since the removal of expeditioners in early October, the island has been without power, meaning the seismic observatory has not been able to operate.
paras.zh: 但自10月初探险队撤走以来，该岛一直断电，这意味着地震观测站无法运行。

paras.en: An email obtained by the ABC shows an official from Geoscience Australia outlined the "impacts of loss of real-time data" several weeks before the team was extracted.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司获得的一封电子邮件显示，澳大利亚地球科学局的一名官员在团队撤离前几周概述了“实时数据丢失的影响”。

paras.en: "[There will be] reduced overall coverage in the region that modelling shows will impact in the timeliness and sensitivity of earthquake detection in the region,"
paras.zh: “该地区的总体覆盖范围将会减少，模型显示这将影响该地区地震检测的及时性和灵敏度，”

paras.en: When the seismic observatory was operational, it would take eight minutes to detect an earthquake in the region.
paras.zh: 当地震观测站投入运行时，需要八分钟才能检测到该地区的地震。

paras.en: But now that it is offline, it takes an estimated 10 minutes — delaying alerts for potential tsunamis by an additional two minutes.
paras.zh: 但现在它已离线，估计需要 10 分钟，潜在海啸警报又延迟了两分钟。

paras.en: "A reduction in the ability of the seismograph network to support these alerting timelines in this region would directly result in less response time for emergency services in preparation for tsunami reaching Australia's south-eastern coasts," the email said.
paras.zh: 电子邮件称：“地震仪网络支持该地区警报时间表的能力下降，将直接导致为应对海啸袭击澳大利亚东南海岸而准备的紧急服务响应时间缩短。”

paras.en: Offline seismic station is a 'major gap', expert says
paras.zh: 专家称离线地震台是一个“重大差距”

paras.en: There have been at least nine earthquakes in the region larger than magnitude 7.5 since 1900, according to the US Geological Survey.
paras.zh: 根据美国地质调查局的数据，自 1900 年以来，该地区至少发生过 9 次 7.5 级以上的地震。

paras.en: One of them was an 8.2-magnitude quake in 1989, and another was an 8.1-magnitude quake in 2004.
paras.zh: 其中一次是1989年的8.2级地震，另一次是2004年的8.1级地震。

paras.en: Both reportedly triggered minor tsunamis of between 15 and 30 centimetres by the time they reached Tasmania and parts of the south-eastern mainland.
paras.zh: 据报道，当它们到达塔斯马尼亚和东南大陆部分地区时，都引发了 15 至 30 厘米的小海啸。

paras.en: But Professor Hrvoje Tkalčić, a seismology and geophysics expert at the Australian National University, said much bigger tsunamis were known to have occurred many years before.
paras.zh: 但澳大利亚国立大学地震学和地球物理学专家赫尔沃耶·特卡尔西奇教授表示，据了解，多年前曾发生过规模更大的海啸。

paras.en: "Historically, we have evidence from paleo tsunami deposits that in the last several thousand years, there are some devastating tsunamis coming from that area," he said.
paras.zh: “从历史上看，我们从古海啸沉积物中得到的证据表明，在过去的几千年里，该地区曾发生过一些毁灭性的海啸，”他说。

paras.en: The Macquarie Island seismic observatory is one of more than 100 stations that form part of the Australian National Seismograph Network.
paras.zh: 麦觉理岛地震观测站是澳大利亚国家地震仪网络 100 多个观测站之一。
