paras.en: But Professor Tkalčić said it was significant that it was not operating.
paras.zh: 但特卡尔西奇教授表示，重要的是它没有运行。

paras.en: "It leaves a major gap on that plate boundary, with the closest station more than 1,000 kilometres away."
paras.zh: “它在板块边界上留下了一个很大的缺口，最近的站点距离有1000多公里。”

paras.en: Alerts will still be issued within 'required timeframes'
paras.zh: 警报仍将在“规定的时间范围”内发出

paras.en: Geoscience Australia told the ABC the situation was expected to result in "slower and less sensitive" detection of earthquakes that occur to the south of Australia and New Zealand.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局告诉澳大利亚广播公司，这种情况预计将导致澳大利亚和新西兰南部发生的地震检测“速度变慢且灵敏度降低”。

paras.en: "However, it is expected that alerts will continue to be issued with the required timeframes to support tsunami warning," it said.
paras.zh: 报告称：“不过，预计将继续在规定的时间内发布警报，以支持海啸预警。”

paras.en: That required timeframe is within 10 minutes of an earthquake occurring.
paras.zh: 所需的时间范围是地震发生后 10 分钟内。

paras.en: Geoscience Australia said it had attempted to automate its seismic observatory on Macquarie Island during the October drawdown, but was unable to do so because of bad weather.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局表示，在 10 月份缩减规模期间，曾试图实现麦格理岛地震观测站的自动化，但由于天气恶劣而未能实现。

paras.en: "Due to strong winds during the drawdown period, the installation of solar panels on the roof, which are required to power the observatory, was not able to be undertaken safely,"
paras.zh: “由于水位下降期间的强风，天文台所需的屋顶太阳能电池板安装无法安全进行。”

paras.en: It is now working with the AAD to return to Macquarie Island early next year to complete the automation plans.
paras.zh: 目前它正在与 AAD 合作，计划于明年初返回麦格理岛完成自动化计划。

paras.en: The island withdrawal has also impacted other monitoring services, including weather and wildlife observations, plus a system that detects nuclear explosions in other parts of the world.
paras.zh: 撤岛还影响了其他监测服务，包括天气和野生动物观测，以及检测世界其他地区核爆炸的系统。

paras.en: Environmental concerns flagged in documents
paras.zh: 文件中标记的环境问题

paras.en: The internal documents also show another agency — the Tasmania Parks and Wildlife Service (PWS) — raised potential issues regarding the island's aging infrastructure.
paras.zh: 内部文件还显示，另一个机构——塔斯马尼亚公园和野生动物管理局（PWS）——提出了有关该岛基础设施老化的潜在问题。

paras.en: "One item potentially overlooked to date is the legislative obligations of the AAD," a PWS official said in an email sent a fortnight after the withdrawal decision was made.
paras.zh: “迄今为止，AAD 的立法义务可能被忽视，”PWS 的一名官员在撤回决定两周后发送的一封电子邮件中表示。

paras.en: They noted that if the station's deteriorating infrastructure caused habitat destruction, pollution to breeding colonies or disturbance to threatened species, it could breach conservation rules.
paras.zh: 他们指出，如果该站日益恶化的基础设施造成栖息地破坏、繁殖群体污染或受威胁物种的干扰，它可能会违反保护规则。

paras.en: "I would consider if the AAD knew the station presented environment risks, removed the capacity to manage those risks, and failed to implement sufficient mitigation measures beforehand [a range of legislative acts] could be potentially engaged," they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“我会考虑，如果 AAD 知道该站存在环境风险，取消了管理这些风险的能力，并且未能事先实施足够的缓解措施（一系列立法行为），则可能会采取行动。”

paras.en: An AAD spokesperson told the ABC it had worked with PWS to identify and mitigate any potential environment hazards prior to the withdrawal.
paras.zh: AAD 发言人告诉 ABC，在撤回之前，它已与 PWS 合作识别并减轻任何潜在的环境危害。

paras.en: This included boarding up windows and barricading doors on all buildings and draining fuel and oils from engines and plants.
paras.zh: 这包括将所有建筑物的窗户钉上木板，将门封锁起来，并从发动机和设备中排出燃料和油。

paras.en: "These efforts have done much to reduce the environmental risks associated with the temporary withdrawal," the AAD spokesperson said.
paras.zh: AAD 发言人表示：“这些努力在很大程度上减少了与临时撤军相关的环境风险。”

paras.en: They said preparations were underway to send the RSV Nuyina to Macquarie Island in March next year to retrieve 185,000 litres of diesel from the station's bulk fuel farm.
paras.zh: 他们表示，目前正在进行准备工作，计划于明年3月将“RSV努伊娜”号科考船派往麦夸里岛，从该站的散装燃料库中取回18.5万升柴油。

paras.en: The decision to withdraw from the island was opposed by multiple expeditioners, who said they were prepared to remain there regardless of the AAD's concerns about psychosocial risks.
paras.zh: 撤离该岛的决定遭到了多名探险者的反对，他们表示，尽管 AAD 对心理社会风险的担忧，他们仍准备留在那里。

paras.en: But the internal documents show the AAD considered the risks were impossible to mitigate to an "acceptable level".
paras.zh: 但内部文件显示，AAD 认为风险不可能降低到“可接受的水平”。

paras.en: "In these circumstances, we consider it highly likely that expeditioners would seek unscheduled earlier retrievals from the island," the briefing said.
paras.zh: 简报称：“在这种情况下，我们认为探险者很可能会寻求在岛上进行计划外的早期回收。”

paras.en: If an evacuation was required during the summer months, it said it would have compromised the Nuyina's scheduled resupply voyages to Antarctica, as well as some science projects.
paras.zh: 据称，如果在夏季需要撤离，努伊纳号前往南极洲的补给航行以及一些科学项目将会受到影响。

paras.en: "Diverting RSV Nuyina from the approved season plan would likely result in the majority of the season objectives not being achieved and could have flow-on effects on funded science activities for up to three years."
paras.zh: “将RSV Nuyina从批准的季节计划中转移可能会导致大部分季节目标无法实现，并可能对资助的科学活动产生长达三年的连带影响。”

paras.en: The briefing said cost of chartering a different vessel to retrieve the expeditioners would have been about $4 million and taken at least 10 weeks to mobilise.
paras.zh: 简报称，租用另一艘船接回探险队的费用约为 400 万美元，并且至少需要 10 周的时间进行动员。

paras.en: It said that given the "significant uncertainties involved" expeditioners were not expected to return to live on Macquarie Island before April or May 2028.
paras.zh: 声明称，鉴于“涉及重大不确定性”，预计探险者不会在 2028 年 4 月或 5 月之前返回麦觉理岛居住。

articles.title: Live: Struggling Wallabies face resurgent Wales
articles.author: Luke Pentony

paras.en: Wallabies vs Wales Nations Championship Test in Cardiff — live updates, scores and stats
paras.zh: 卡迪夫小袋鼠队 vs 威尔士国家锦标赛测试赛 — 实时更新、比分和统计数据

paras.en: The Wallabies are on a four-match losing streak as they meet Wales in Cardiff, a week after the hosts snapped a 73-year hoodoo against the All Blacks.
paras.zh: 袋鼠队在卡迪夫迎战威尔士队，遭遇四连败，一周前，东道主队与全黑队终结了 73 年来的不祥之兆。

paras.en: Here's how the Wallabies shape up against Wales:
paras.zh: 以下是袋鼠队对阵威尔士队的情况：

paras.en: I'm Luke Pentony and thanks for joining ABC Sport's coverage of the Wallabies' Nations Championship Test against Wales in Cardiff.
paras.zh: 我是卢克·彭托尼，感谢您参加 ABC 体育频道对在卡迪夫对阵威尔士的小袋鼠国家锦标赛测试赛的报道。

paras.en: Pride is on the line for the Wallabies this morning (AEDT) as they attempt to halt a four-match losing streak.
paras.zh: 今天早上袋鼠队（AEDT）的骄傲即将来临，他们试图阻止四连败。

paras.en: So far on their British swing in the Nations Championship, the Wallabies have recorded defeats against England (42-22) and Scotland (15-12).
paras.zh: 到目前为止，袋鼠队在英国国家锦标赛上已经输给了英格兰队（42-22）和苏格兰队（15-12）。

paras.en: Wales is full of confidence after posting its first victory over the All Blacks since 1953.
paras.zh: 威尔士自1953年以来首次战胜全黑队，信心十足。

paras.en: We hope you can stick with us throughout the morning!
paras.zh: 我们希望您整个早上都能和我们在一起！

articles.title: Russian strike on Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine kills 2, wounds 60

paras.en: Russian strike on Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine kills 2, wounds 60
paras.zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰中部泽伦斯基家乡的袭击造成2人死亡、60人受伤

paras.en: Missile attack in Kryvyi Rih came hours after 2 Russian missiles came down in Poland
paras.zh: 两枚俄罗斯导弹击落波兰几小时后，克里沃罗格发生导弹袭击

paras.en: A Russian strike on the centre of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown, Kryvyi Rih, killed two people and wounded 60 others, local officials said Saturday.
paras.zh: 当地官员周六表示，俄罗斯对乌克兰总统泽连斯基家乡克利沃罗市中心发动的袭击造成两人死亡、60 人受伤。

paras.en: A seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman were killed in the attack Friday night on the city in central Ukraine, the head of the city administration, Oleksandr Vilkul, wrote on the Telegram messaging service.
paras.zh: 乌克兰中部城市的市政府负责人 Oleksandr Vilkul 在 Telegram 消息服务上写道，一名 7 岁男孩和一名 20 岁妇女在周五晚上发生的袭击中丧生。

paras.en: Oleksandr Hanzha, head of the regional military administration, said 60 people were wounded, including six children.
paras.zh: 地区军事管理局局长亚历山大·汉扎 (Oleksandr Hanzha) 表示，有 60 人受伤，其中包括 6 名儿童。

paras.en: The strike caused four fires and damaged about 25 apartment buildings, a hospital, schools and an industrial facility, as well as businesses and vehicles, Vilkul said.
paras.zh: Vilkul 说，这次罢工引发了四起火灾，并损坏了约 25 栋公寓楼、一家医院、学校和一处工业设施，以及企业和车辆。

paras.en: The attack fits the pattern of Moscow's heavy responses to eye-catching Ukrainian attacks, such as the ones this week on the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to illegally annexed Crimea.
paras.zh: 这次袭击符合莫斯科对引人注目的乌克兰袭击事件做出的强烈反应，例如本周在连接俄罗斯和非法吞并的克里米亚的刻赤大桥上发生的袭击。

paras.en: The site of a Russian drone and missile attack on Friday night in central Kryvyi Rih, Zelenskyy's hometown. (Press service of the National Police of Ukraine/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周五晚上，俄罗斯无人机和导弹袭击了泽伦斯基家乡克利沃罗市中心。 （乌克兰国家警察新闻处/路透社）

paras.en: The missile attack came hours after two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland, in what its prime minister said was likely a provocation timed to coincide with European military exercises in his country for a possible postwar mission in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这次导弹袭击发生在两枚俄罗斯导弹和一架疑似无人机在波兰坠落数小时后，波兰总理表示，这可能是一次挑衅，恰逢欧洲在波兰进行军事演习，以执行可能在乌克兰执行的战后任务。

paras.en: European troops were taking part on Friday in an unprecedented two-week military exercise that began Nov. 9 in southeastern Poland.
paras.zh: 周五，欧洲军队参加了一场史无前例的为期两周的军事演习，演习于 11 月 9 日在波兰东南部开始。

paras.en: Forces are preparing for a possible postwar mission in Ukraine aimed at helping to stabilize the country and rebuild its military.
paras.zh: 部队正在为可能在乌克兰执行的战后任务做准备，旨在帮助稳定该国并重建其军队。

paras.en: European countries previously have expressed alarm at what they deem to be Russia's attempts to destabilize the continent.
paras.zh: 欧洲国家此前曾对俄罗斯企图破坏非洲大陆稳定的行为表示震惊。

paras.en: The aftermath of Friday night's Russian drone and missile attack in central Kryvyi Rih. The attack killed two people, including a child. (Press service of the National Police of Ukraine/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周五晚上，俄罗斯无人机和导弹袭击克里沃罗格中部地区。这次袭击造成两人死亡，其中包括一名儿童。 （乌克兰国家警察新闻处/路透社）

paras.en: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said in Warsaw on Saturday that the alliance is commited to defending "every inch of Polish territory."
paras.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特周六在华沙表示，该联盟致力于保卫“每一寸波兰领土”。

paras.en: The development stoked tensions between Europe and Moscow as the U.S. tried to build momentum for talks on ending the war, which began with Russia's invasion on Feb. 24, 2022.
paras.zh: 这一事态发展加剧了欧洲和莫斯科之间的紧张关系，因为美国试图为结束战争的谈判创造动力，这场战争始于俄罗斯于 2022 年 2 月 24 日入侵。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump discussed the war with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese leader Xi Jinping at a summit in China on Thursday, according to his envoy, Steve Witkoff. Trump called Putin his "friend" during the meeting and continued to tout their relationship at a White House news conference on Friday.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫表示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四在中国举行的峰会上与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国领导人习近平讨论了这场战争。特朗普在会见期间称普京为他的“朋友”，并在周五的白宫新闻发布会上继续宣传他们的关系。

paras.en: Asked about Trump's remarks in an interview with CNN, Zelenskyy called Putin "a killer."
paras.zh: 在接受美国有线电视新闻网采访时被问及特朗普的言论时，泽伦斯基称普京是“杀手”。

paras.en: "For us, he is an enemy. And of course, for us, he is a killer," Zelenskyy said Friday. He warned that describing the Russian leader in friendly terms could mean "he doesn't feel enough pressure."
paras.zh: “对我们来说，他是敌人。当然，对我们来说，他是杀手，”泽连斯基周五说道。他警告说，用友好的语言描述这位俄罗斯领导人可能意味着“他没有感受到足够的压力”。

paras.en: Elsewhere in Ukraine, 11 people, including two children, were wounded when a Russian drone attacked a five-storey apartment building in the Kharkiv region, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said Saturday. One person was wounded in a Russian attack on the capital, Kyiv, according to the service.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家紧急服务部门周六表示，在乌克兰其他地方，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了哈尔科夫地区一栋五层公寓楼，造成 11 人受伤，其中包括两名儿童。据该部门称，俄罗斯在首都基辅发动的袭击中造成一人受伤。

paras.en: In Russia, local officials said Saturday that Ukrainian drone attacks wounded three people in the Bryansk and Belgorod border regions.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯，当地官员周六表示，乌克兰无人机袭击在布良斯克和别尔哥罗德边境地区造成三人受伤。

paras.en: A firefighter works at the site of a Russian missile strike in Kyiv, during Russia's attack on Ukraine on Friday night into Saturday. (Press service of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine/Reuters)
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯周五晚至周六袭击乌克兰期间，一名消防员在基辅的俄罗斯导弹袭击现场工作。 （乌克兰国家紧急服务局新闻处/路透社）

paras.en: Russian cargo vessel on fire in Finnish waters
paras.zh: 俄罗斯货船在芬兰水域起火

paras.en: Meanwhile, Russian officials said on Saturday that a cargo vessel bound for Kaliningrad was attacked by two drones in neutral waters.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯官员周六表示，一艘开往加里宁格勒的货船在中立水域遭到两架无人机袭击。

paras.en: The crew was being evacuated and the extent of the damage was being assessed, said Aleksandr Drozdenko, the Leningrad regional governor, shortly after the attack was first reported.
paras.zh: 列宁格勒地区州长亚历山大·德罗兹登科在首次报道袭击事件后不久表示，正在疏散船员，并评估受损程度。

paras.en: The ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea and later drifted into Finnish waters, prompting Helsinki to impose temporary air and maritime restrictions. It said Ukraine was probably behind the attack.
paras.zh: 该船在波罗的海被无人机击中后起火，随后漂入芬兰水域，促使赫尔辛基实施临时空中和海上限制。据称乌克兰可能是此次袭击的幕后黑手。

paras.en: The Russian cargo ship Sparta II is seen damaged in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday. (Finnish Border Guard/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，俄罗斯货船斯巴达二号在芬兰湾受损。 （芬兰边防卫队/路透社）

paras.en: Finland's Border Guard said there was no danger to people or maritime traffic, that rescue units were at the scene, and that it was co-ordinating operations with neighbouring countries.
paras.zh: 芬兰边防卫队表示，人员或海上交通没有危险，救援部队已在现场，并正在与邻国协调行动。

paras.en: The Sparta II vessel is known to have links to Russia's armed forces, Finnish Border Guard Cmdr. Ilja Iljin told Reuters.
paras.zh: 芬兰边防部队中校称，斯巴达 II 号船只与俄罗斯武装部队有联系。伊利亚·伊尔金 (Ilja Iljin) 告诉路透社。

paras.en: "At the moment, there is no confirmed information about what cargo is on board, but it cannot be ruled out that there is military material on board," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“目前还没有关于船上载有什么货物的确认信息，但不能排除船上有军用物资。”

paras.en: "The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas. Finnish authorities are handling the situation in the Gulf of Finland, where a drone strike has hit a Russian merchant vessel. Ukraine has the right to fight against the aggressor," Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said on X.
paras.zh: 芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波 (Petteri Orpo) 在 X 台上表示：“战争正在蔓延到我们的邻近地区。芬兰当局正在处理芬兰湾的局势，一艘无人机袭击了那里的一艘俄罗斯商船。乌克兰有权打击侵略者。”

paras.en: Ukraine's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Russia's embassy in Helsinki did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯驻赫尔辛基大使馆没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: The vessel is subject to U.S. sanctions and is linked to Russian shipping company Oboronlogistika, according to the U.S. Treasury Department.
paras.zh: 据美国财政部称，该船受到美国制裁，并与俄罗斯航运公司 Oboronlogisticika 有关。

paras.en: Oboronlogistika provides logistics services for the Russian defence ministry, according to the company's website.
paras.zh: 据该公司网站称，Oboronlogisticika 为俄罗斯国防部提供后勤服务。

paras.en: Kaliningrad Gov. Alexei Besprozvannykh said the incident posed no threat to supplies to the region. Kaliningrad, a Russian exclave on the Baltic Sea that borders Poland and Lithuania, has occasionally been a flashpoint between Russia, the European Union and NATO.
paras.zh: 加里宁格勒州长阿列克谢·贝斯普罗兹万内赫表示，这一事件对该地区的供应没有构成威胁。加里宁格勒是波罗的海的俄罗斯飞地，与波兰和立陶宛接壤，偶尔会成为俄罗斯、欧盟和北约之间的冲突点。

articles.title: Israeli strike kills 3 in vehicle distributing aid in Gaza, witnesses say

paras.en: Israeli strike kills 3 in vehicle distributing aid in Gaza, witnesses say
paras.zh: 目击者称，以色列空袭在加沙分发援助物资的车辆中造成 3 人死亡

paras.en: A witness said the vehicle appeared to be carrying food and papers
paras.zh: 一名目击者称，该车似乎载有食物和文件

paras.en: Israeli forces on Saturday hit a truck in Gaza, which witnesses said was carrying food and papers bearing the logo of the World Central Kitchen charity, but the organization said the vehicle was not affiliated with it.
paras.zh: 以色列军队周六在加沙袭击了一辆卡车，目击者称这辆卡车载有食品和带有世界中央厨房慈善机构标志的文件，但该组织表示该车辆与其无关。

paras.en: The Gaza Health Ministry said three people were killed in the incident in Gaza City.
paras.zh: 加沙卫生部表示，加沙城事件造成三人死亡。

paras.en: The Israeli military said several militant operatives were targeted in the area, without providing further details. It did not immediately respond to questions on why it had hit a vehicle that appeared to be distributing aid.
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，该地区有几名武装分子成为袭击目标，但没有提供更多细节。它没有立即回答有关为何撞上一辆似乎正在分发援助物资的车辆的问题。

paras.en: World Central Kitchen said in a statement that the truck was unaffiliated with the charity, which distributes food in Gaza. It said a driver of the vehicle had previously worked for the charity and that the two others in the car were not WCK workers.
paras.zh: 世界中央厨房在一份声明中表示，这辆卡车与该在加沙分发食品的慈善机构无关。据称，该车的一名司机此前曾为该慈善机构工作过，车上的另外两人并非 WCK 工作人员。

paras.en: The vehicle appeared to be carrying packaged foodstuffs, and papers inside carried the logo of World Central Kitchen, an aid organization that distributes food in Gaza, according to a Reuters witness.
paras.zh: 据路透社目击者称，这辆车似乎载有包装食品，里面的文件上有世界中央厨房的标志，这是一个在加沙分发食品的援助组织。

paras.en: "It was just about to stop to distribute the food and drink to children when it was hit by a missile," said Abu Zein Al-Daya, who also witnessed the strike.
paras.zh: “当它正要停下来给孩子们分发食物和饮料时，它被导弹击中了，”同样目睹了这次袭击的阿布·泽因·达亚(Abu Zein Al-Daya)说。

paras.en: Afterward, meals of cooked rice were scattered around the vehicle, which was partially covered in the blood of the victims of the attack.
paras.zh: 随后，熟米饭散落在车周围，车上部分沾满了袭击受害者的血迹。

paras.en: The Israeli military previously killed seven World Central Kitchen workers in a 2024 strike, including citizens of Australia, Britain and Poland.
paras.zh: 以色列军方此前在 2024 年的一次罢工中杀害了 7 名世界中央厨房工人，其中包括澳大利亚、英国和波兰的公民。

paras.en: At the time, the military said there had been "serious errors and breaches of procedure," but earlier this year it said it had found no basis upon which to open criminal investigations into the incident.
paras.zh: 当时，军方表示存在“严重错误和违反程序”，但今年早些时候，军方表示没有找到对此事件展开刑事调查的依据。

paras.en: Palestinian children inspect the site of the Israeli airstrike on a vehicle on Saturday. (Dawoud Abu Alkas/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，巴勒斯坦儿童乘车检查以色列空袭现场。 （达乌德·阿布·阿尔卡斯/路透社）

paras.en: Israel briefly launched a ground operation in Gaza earlier this week and killed six people in a strike on a hospital that it said was targeting a Hamas commander.
paras.zh: 以色列本周早些时候在加沙短暂发动了一次地面行动，并在对一家医院的袭击中造成六人死亡，据称此次袭击的目标是一名哈马斯指挥官。

paras.en: An October 2025 U.S.-backed ceasefire halted major fighting in the shattered territory but has not stopped Israeli attacks on Gaza or secured the disarmament of Hamas.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月美国支持的停火制止了这片破碎地区的重大战斗，但并没有阻止以色列对加沙的袭击，也没有确保哈马斯解除武装。

paras.en: At least 1,600 Palestinians and five Israeli soldiers have been killed in the time since, according to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies.
paras.zh: 根据巴勒斯坦和以色列各自的统计，此后至少有 1,600 名巴勒斯坦人和 5 名以色列士兵被杀。

paras.en: - Video Camps destroyed in 2 Israeli military strikes on Gaza City
paras.zh: - 视频营地在以色列对加沙城的两次军事打击中被摧毁

paras.en: - Video ‘Hospitals should not be targeted’: UN expert reacts to strike in Gaza
paras.zh: - 视频“医院不应成为攻击目标”：联合国专家对加沙袭击的反应

paras.en: Israeli troops now control about two-thirds of Gaza, up from more than half at the time of the ceasefire, with Hamas controlling a sliver of territory along Gaza's coast.
paras.zh: 以色列军队现在控制着加沙约三分之二的地区，高于停火时的一半以上，哈马斯控制着加沙沿岸的一小片领土。

paras.en: Israel's three-year-long assault on Gaza has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians, health officials say. The attacks have also caused a hunger crisis, internally displaced Gaza's entire population and led to assessments of genocide from scholars and a United Nations inquiry.
paras.zh: 卫生官员称，以色列对加沙地带长达三年的袭击已造成超过 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人死亡。这些袭击还引发了饥饿危机，使加沙全体人民在国内流离失所，并导致学者和联合国调查对种族灭绝进行了评估。

paras.en: Israel calls its actions self-defence after an attack by Hamas-led militants on Oct. 7, 2023, killed 1,200 people and took 251 hostages, according to Israeli tallies.
paras.zh: 根据以色列统计，哈马斯领导的武装分子于 2023 年 10 月 7 日发动袭击，造成 1,200 人死亡并劫持 251 名人质，之后以色列称其行动是自卫。

articles.title: Mexico detains top cartel boss El Chapo Isidro, setting off burst of violence in Sinaloa

paras.en: Mexico detains top cartel boss El Chapo Isidro, setting off burst of violence in Sinaloa
paras.zh: 墨西哥拘留贩毒集团头号矮子伊西德罗，引发锡那罗亚州爆发暴力事件

paras.en: Key ally for Los Mayos faction of Sinaloa Cartel was one of FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives
paras.zh: 锡那罗亚贩毒集团洛斯梅约斯派系的主要盟友是联邦调查局十大通缉逃犯之一

paras.en: Gunfire rang out, trucks burned and Mexican forces clashed with cartel gunmen in the state of Sinaloa overnight as authorities captured top cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro.
paras.zh: 枪声响起，卡车被烧毁，墨西哥军队与锡那罗亚州的贩毒集团枪手发生冲突，当局抓获了贩毒集团头目福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯（Fausto Isidro Meza Flores），绰号“矮子伊西德罗”（El Chapo Isidro）。

paras.en: Meza Flores was one of the FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives and a top cartel leader from the Beltrán Leyva criminal organization wanted for trafficking drugs to the United States and illegally carrying firearms.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 是联邦调查局 (FBI) 十大通缉犯之一，也是贝尔特兰·雷瓦 (Beltrán Leyva) 犯罪组织的一名卡特尔头目，因向美国贩运毒品和非法携带枪支而被通缉。

paras.en: Mexico's government said in a report early Saturday that intelligence from the U.S. helped with the capture of Meza Flores, but provided few details about how authorities in Mexico and the U.S. co-ordinated to detain him.
paras.zh: 墨西哥政府在周六早些时候的一份报告中表示，来自美国的情报帮助抓获了梅萨·弗洛雷斯，但没有提供有关墨西哥和美国当局如何协调拘留他的细节。

paras.en: The capo was also a key ally to Los Mayos, a faction of the Sinaloa Cartel, which was designated as a foreign terrorist organization by the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump last year. His capture represents a blow to the cartel as it fights with another faction for control of the northern Mexican state.
paras.zh: 该变调夹还是洛斯梅约斯（Los Mayos）的重要盟友，洛斯梅约斯是锡那罗亚贩毒集团的一个派系，该组织去年被美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府指定为外国恐怖组织。他的被捕对卡特尔来说是一个打击，因为该卡特尔正在与另一个派别争夺墨西哥北部州的控制权。

paras.en: The Trump administration and Mexican authorities both celebrated the arrest as a security win, but experts warn it could set off another wave of violence in a region already ravaged by cartels.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府和墨西哥当局都庆祝这次逮捕，认为这是一次安全胜利，但专家警告称，这可能会在一个已经被卡特尔蹂躏的地区引发另一波暴力浪潮。

paras.en: Night of terror after forces moved against cartel
paras.zh: 军队打击卡特尔后的恐怖之夜

paras.en: The capture of Meza Flores and his No. 2 in the city of Guasave set off a wave of violence overnight, terrorizing civilians. Calm appeared to set in Saturday morning.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯和他的二号人物在瓜萨韦市被捕，一夜之间引发了暴力浪潮，使平民陷入恐慌。周六早上似乎平静下来。

paras.en: Videos show screaming civilians fleeing gunfire at a baseball game, burning cars and businesses, and circling helicopters shooting at homes below. Such shows of force by cartels are common following the capture or killing of leaders.
paras.zh: 视频显示，棒球比赛中，尖叫着的平民逃离枪林弹雨，焚烧汽车和企业，直升机盘旋向下方的房屋开枪。在捕获或杀害领导人后，卡特尔展​​示武力的情况很常见。

paras.en: Vehicles on fire on a highway near Los Mochis, Sinaloa, on Friday following the announcement of El Chapo Isidro's arrest. (Yohari Leon/Facebook/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周五，在宣布逮捕“矮子”伊西德罗后，锡那罗亚州洛斯莫奇斯附近的高速公路上车辆着火。 （Yohari Leon/Facebook/路透社）

paras.en: Guasave resident and firefighter Paola Sánchez said thousands of people were terrorized late Friday night as they took shelter from intense gunfire in grocery stores and other locations.
paras.zh: 瓜萨韦居民兼消防员保拉·桑切斯 (Paola Sánchez) 表示，周五深夜，数千人在杂货店和其他地点躲避猛烈枪火时受到惊吓。

paras.en: "Last night, many businesses were burned, including Oxxo [convenience] stores, kiosks and pharmacies, along with cars and trucks," Sánchez told The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 桑切斯告诉美联社：“昨晚，许多企业被烧毁，包括 Oxxo（便利店）、售货亭和药店，以及汽车和卡车。”

paras.en: The city's firefighters had to take shelter at their station and wait until Saturday morning for orders from their superiors to dispatch the first crews to check whether any businesses or vehicles were still burning, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，该市的消防队员必须在他们的车站避难，直到周六早上接到上级的命令，派出第一批消防人员检查是否还有任何企业或车辆仍在燃烧。

paras.en: "Everything looks calm today," she said.
paras.zh: “今天一切看起来都很平静，”她说。

paras.en: Mexican Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch wrote on X Saturday morning that armed forces would remain deployed in Sinaloa state to protect civilians.
paras.zh: 墨西哥安全部长奥马尔·加西亚·哈富奇于周六上午写道，武装部队将继续部署在锡那罗亚州以保护平民。

paras.en: U.S. pressure on Mexico to crack down on cartels
paras.zh: 美国向墨西哥施压，要求其打击卡特尔

paras.en: Meza Flores's detention marks another high-profile capture of a cartel leader as Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum faces pressure from U.S. President Donald Trump to crack down on cartels.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯的被捕标志着墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆面临美国总统唐纳德·特朗普打击卡特尔的压力，卡特尔头目再次被高调抓获。

paras.en: Sheinbaum has gone after illegal groups more aggressively than her predecessors, and homicides have dipped significantly in her two years in office.
paras.zh: 希因鲍姆比她的前任更积极地打击非法团体，在她执政的两年里，凶杀案大幅下降。

paras.en: Both the U.S. and Mexican governments celebrated the capture on Saturday, with the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) commending Mexican authorities.
paras.zh: 美国和墨西哥政府周六都庆祝了此次抓获，美国缉毒局 (DEA) 对墨西哥当局表示赞扬。

paras.en: "The capture of El Chapo Isidro delivers a significant blow to a ruthless criminal organization that has used extreme violence to traffic deadly drugs, including fentanyl, a designated weapon of mass destruction, into American communities," the DEA said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国缉毒局在一份声明中表示：“矮子伊西德罗的被捕对一个残酷的犯罪组织造成了重大打击，该组织利用极端暴力向美国社区贩运致命毒品，其中包括指定的大规模杀伤性武器芬太尼。”

paras.en: "This operation underscores the critical importance of intelligence sharing in targeting dangerous cartel leaders."
paras.zh: “这次行动强调了情报共享对于打击危险的卡特尔领导人的至关重要性。”

paras.en: Garcia Harfuch called the detention "an important step in pacifying Sinaloa."
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇称这次拘留是“平息锡那罗亚的重要一步”。

paras.en: Mexican authorities said they used "stealth and surprise" to capture Meza Flores, establishing a security perimeter around the building where he was located. After coming under attack with guns and explosives from suspected cartel operatives, armed forces personnel entered a home and detained him, they said.
paras.zh: 墨西哥当局表示，他们采用“秘密和出其不意”的方式抓获了梅萨·弗洛雷斯，并在他所在的建筑物周围建立了安全边界。他们说，在遭到卡特尔嫌疑人的枪支和爆炸物袭击后，武装部队人员进入一所房屋并拘留了他。

paras.en: Video shared by authorities shows heavily armed men in camouflage escorting a man who appears to be Meza Flores through a dimly lit house and putting him in the back of a truck.
paras.zh: 当局分享的视频显示，身着迷彩服的全副武装的男子护送一名疑似梅萨·弗洛雷斯的男子穿过一间灯光昏暗的房子，并将他放到一辆卡车的后座上。

paras.en: 'Kingpin strategy' causes more violence, experts say
paras.zh: 专家称“主脑策略”导致更多暴力

paras.en: Sheinbaum's government has immobilized a number of cartel kingpins. Chief among them was Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, known as El Mencho, who was killed in Guadalajara state in February. Similar to the aftermath of the capture of Meza Flores, that dramatic operation resulted in a burst of violence and burning cars.
paras.zh: 谢因鲍姆政府已经冻结了一些贩毒集团的头目。其中最主要的是内梅西奥·奥塞格拉·塞万提斯（Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes），人称“El Mencho”，他于二月份在瓜达拉哈拉州被杀。与占领梅萨弗洛雷斯的后果类似，这次戏剧性的行动导致了一系列暴力事件和焚烧汽车。

paras.en: Mexican security analyst David Saucedo said the capture of Meza Flores marked another instance of the governments of Mexico and the U.S. increasingly falling back on a longstanding security strategy, which critics warn could fuel more violence in the long run.
paras.zh: 墨西哥安全分析师大卫·索塞多表示，梅萨弗洛雷斯的占领标志着墨西哥和美国政府日益依赖长期安全战略的又一实例，批评者警告称，从长远来看，这可能会助长更多暴力事件。

paras.en: The so-called "kingpin strategy" relies on taking out top capos as a way to combat cartels. But experts say it often triggers violent power disputes among groups, like the one underway in Sinaloa.
paras.zh: 所谓的“头目战略”依赖于消灭顶级变调师作为打击卡特尔的一种方式。但专家表示，这经常引发群体之间的暴力权力纠纷，就像锡那罗亚州正在发生的那样。

paras.en: "What is evident is this is a product of pressure from the United States," Saucedo said. "What they do is capture high-profile kingpins — the leaders — but they don't dismantle the entire organization.
paras.zh: 索塞多说：“显而易见的是，这是美国压力的产物。” “他们所做的是抓获备受瞩目的主要人物——领导者——但他们并没有瓦解整个组织。

paras.en: "They arrested the No. 1 and No. 2, but the entire network of hit men, street-level drug dealers, businesses and political and police connections remains intact."
paras.zh: “他们逮捕了一号和二号，但整个杀手网络、街头毒贩、企业以及政治和警察关系仍然完好无损。”

articles.title: New EU budget proposal aims at tax gobal tech giants

paras.en: European Council President Antonio Costa has proposed a new draft for the next EU budget.
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔提出了下一个欧盟预算的新草案。

paras.en: Among other things, he is suggesting a tax on big tech firms to ease the contributions of member states, some of which strongly criticised earlier proposals.
paras.zh: 除其他外，他建议对大型科技公司征税，以减轻成员国的缴款，其中一些成员国强烈批评了先前的提议。

paras.en: The EU budget is theEuropean Union’s shared budget and it is used for things ranging from agricultural subsidies, infrastructure projects to border control and defence.
paras.zh: 欧盟预算是欧盟的共享预算，用于农业补贴、基础设施项目、边境管制和国防等领域。

paras.en: A first draft for the 2028 to 2034 budget was proposed by the EU Commission in 2025 but was criticised, especially by a group of northern European members including Germany who wanted the budget to be much smaller.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会于 2025 年提出了 2028 年至 2034 年预算的初稿，但遭到批评，尤其是包括德国在内的一群希望预算大幅减少的北欧成员国。

paras.en: Following that criticism, the European Council President has now suggested a new draft, which is smaller by €204 billion.
paras.zh: 继批评之后，欧洲理事会主席现在提出了一份新草案，金额减少了 2040 亿欧元。

paras.en: But divisions among member states appear to remain, with France immediately coming out against Costa’s new draft, saying it was "deeply disappointing."
paras.zh: 但成员国之间的分歧似乎依然存在，法国立即站出来反对科斯塔的新草案，称其“非常令人失望”。

paras.en: The proposal includes a string of new "revenue channels," explicitly intended to "to keep national contributions at a reasonable level," so that member state will have to contribute less than otherwise would be the case.
paras.zh: 该提案包括一系列新的“收入渠道”，明确旨在“将国家捐款保持在合理水平”，以便成员国的捐款必须少于其他情况。

paras.en: The biggest splash would likely come from a tax on companies with an annual turnover from digital activities of at least 50 million euros in the EU and 750 million euros worldwide.
paras.zh: 最大的影响可能来自于对欧盟数字活动年营业额至少 5000 万欧元、全球数字活动年营业额至少 7.5 亿欧元的公司征税。

paras.en: Those firms would be subject to "an annual contribution corresponding to 3% of the annual net turnover from online advertising, digital intermediation services and user-generated data," according to Costa.
paras.zh: Costa 表示，这些公司将需要“每年从在线广告、数字中介服务和用户生成的数据中缴纳相当于年度净营业额 3% 的贡献”。

paras.en: Aside from the tech tax, the "balanced basket of new own resources" also includes taxes on tobacco products and electronic waste.
paras.zh: 除了科技税外，“平衡的新自有资源篮子”还包括对烟草产品和电子废物征税。

paras.en: Neither the EU Commission nor European Council President Costa will have the final word on the budget. Costa's plan will now be at the centre of hours of talks when EU leaders meet in Brussels next week.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会和欧洲理事会主席科斯塔都不会就预算拥有最终决定权。欧盟领导人下周在布鲁塞尔举行会议时，科斯塔的计划将成为会谈的核心。

paras.en: "This is a realistic budget that addresses our new priorities while preserving our established policies," Costa wrote about his proposal. "I am confident that this proposal is a good basis for moving towards a final agreement."
paras.zh: 科斯塔在谈到他的提议时写道：“这是一个现实的预算，它解决了我们新的优先事项，同时保留了我们既定的政策。” “我相信这项提议是达成最终协议的良好基础。”

paras.en: But an initial reaction from France suggests that any final agreement might still be some way off.
paras.zh: 但法国的初步反应表明，距离达成最终协议可能还有一段路要走。

paras.en: The French presidency said the budget "falls well short of what is needed, particularly on the Common Agricultural Policy, notably to guarantee income support for farmers."
paras.zh: 法国总统表示，预算“远远低于所需的水平，特别是在共同农业政策方面，特别是保证农民收入支持方面。”

paras.en: "As it stands, this proposal from the President of the European Council does not provide a basis for an agreement."
paras.zh: “就目前情况而言，欧洲理事会主席的这项提议并没有为达成协议提供基础。”

paras.en: The EU was hoping to reach a general agreement on the budget by the end of 2026 with its formal adoption planned for 2027.
paras.zh: 欧盟希望在 2026 年底前就预算达成总体协议，并计划于 2027 年正式通过。

articles.title: EU and Indonesia sign trade deal

paras.en: The European Union and Indonesia signed a free trade deal on Saturday, describing it as a new chapter in economic relations between the two sides.
paras.zh: 欧盟和印度尼西亚周六签署了一项自由贸易协定，称其为双方经济关系的新篇章。

paras.en: "This is one of the most ambitious deals the European Union has concluded in Asia," Ursula von der Leyen, president of the European Commission, said at the signing ceremony on Saturday.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在周六的签字仪式上表示：“这是欧盟在亚洲达成的最雄心勃勃的协议之一。”

paras.en: "Together, we represent a market of 730 million people," she added.
paras.zh: “我们共同代表着 7.3 亿人口的市场，”她补充道。

paras.en: The Indonesia-European Union Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) and the additional Investment Protection Agreement (IPA) are designed to reduce trade barriers and attract investment in strategic sectors such as electric vehicles, electronics, and pharmaceuticals.
paras.zh: 印尼-欧盟全面经济伙伴关系协定（CEPA）和附加投资保护协定（IPA）旨在减少贸易壁垒，吸引电动汽车、电子和制药等战略领域的投资。

paras.en: The agreement comes after almost 10 years of negotiations and is part of a wider series of trade deals by the EU.
paras.zh: 该协议经过近十年的谈判达成，是欧盟更广泛的一系列贸易协议的一部分。

paras.en: 'Keeping the doors open when others are closing theirs'
paras.zh: “当其他人关门时，保持大门敞开”

paras.en: The bloc hopes to reduce its reliance on individual economic partners as trade with both China and the US has become more difficult in recent years.
paras.zh: 由于近年来与中国和美国的贸易变得更加困难，欧盟希望减少对个别经济伙伴的依赖。

paras.en: Von der Leyen also stressed the importance of international cooperation, saying that "in a time when others are closing their doors, we keep ours open."
paras.zh: 冯德莱恩还强调了国际合作的重要性，他说，“当其他人关上大门的时候，我们却敞开大门。”

paras.en: The deal sees tariffs on about 98% of EU exports to Indonesia to be done away with. The EU estimates that European companies could save more than €600 million (around €658 million) per year.
paras.zh: 该协议预计将取消欧盟对印度尼西亚约 98% 的出口产品的关税。欧盟估计欧洲企业每年可节省超过 6 亿欧元（约 6.58 亿欧元）。

paras.en: "The benefits for our exporters are concrete and measurable," Indonesian Minister of Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto said, hailing a "new chapter" in economic relations with the EU. He said the deal would benefit his country’s main exports to Europe, including palm oil, footwear and textiles.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚经济事务部长艾尔朗加·哈塔托表示：“我们出口商的利益是具体且可衡量的。”他称赞与欧盟的经济关系翻开了“新篇章”。他表示，该协议将有利于该国对欧洲的主要出口，包括棕榈油、鞋类和纺织品。

paras.en: Palm oil and deforestation had been major stumbling blocks during the negotiations, and the agreement includes mechanisms for cooperation on regulatory and sustainability issues as well as a dedicated protocol on palm oil to address environmental concerns.
paras.zh: 棕榈油和森林砍伐一直是谈判期间的主要障碍，该协议包括监管和可持续发展问题上的合作机制以及解决环境问题的棕榈油专门协议。

paras.en: The EU parliament is now expected to greenlight the deal while Indonesian authorities will also complete the ratification process so it can enter into force in 2027.
paras.zh: 目前预计欧盟议会将批准该协议，而印度尼西亚当局也将完成批准程序，以便该协议于 2027 年生效。

articles.title: Russian helicopter suspected of violating Finnish airspace

paras.en: A Russian helicopter is suspected of violating Finnish airspace, the Nordic country's Ministry of Defense said Saturday.
paras.zh: 北欧国家国防部周六表示，一架俄罗斯直升机涉嫌侵犯芬兰领空。

paras.en: The incident happened a few hours after a drone attack left a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland, the easternmost part of the Baltic Sea.
paras.zh: 事件发生几个小时前，一艘俄罗斯货船在波罗的海最东端的芬兰湾遭遇无人机袭击，起火燃烧。

paras.en: According to Finland's Defense Ministry, the incursion happened at 12:34 p.m. local time (10:34 UTC/GMT) off the town of Loviisa, on the southern coast.
paras.zh: 据芬兰国防部称，入侵发生在中午 12 点 34 分。当地时间（10:34 UTC/GMT）位于南部海岸洛维萨镇附近。

paras.en: "This alleged airspace violation may be linked to rescue or surveillance operations carried out by Finland following damage sustained by a cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland," public broadcaster YLE cited Defense Minister Antti Hakkanen as saying.
paras.zh: 公共广播公司 YLE 援引国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁的话说：“这起涉嫌侵犯领空的事件可能与芬兰在一艘货船在芬兰湾遭受损坏后进行的救援或监视行动有关。”

paras.en: The ministry added the helicopter could have penetrated up to 4.1 kilometers (2.5 miles) into Finnish territory.
paras.zh: 该部补充说，这架直升机可能已深入芬兰领土 4.1 公里（2.5 英里）。

paras.en: What do we know about the cargo ship attack?
paras.zh: 我们对货船袭击了解多少？

paras.en: Earlier Saturday, Finland — one of NATO's newest members — said a Russian cargo ship heading for Russia's Baltic exclave of Kaliningrad caught fire after being struck by drones in the Gulf of Finland.
paras.zh: 周六早些时候，北约最新成员国之一芬兰表示，一艘前往俄罗斯波罗的海飞地加里宁格勒的俄罗斯货船在芬兰湾被无人机击中后起火。

paras.en: The Finnish military said the Sparta II was damaged west of Russia's Gogland island, about 40 kilometers (25 miles) from Finland's coast, and later drifted into Finnish territorial waters.
paras.zh: 芬兰军方表示，斯巴达二号在距离芬兰海岸约40公里（25英里）的俄罗斯戈格兰岛以西受损，随后漂入芬兰领海。

paras.en: Finnish Border Guard Commander Ilja Iljin later told YLE that the vessel, which is known to have links to the Russian military, was struck by Ukrainian drones while in Russian waters.
paras.zh: 芬兰边境警卫队指挥官伊尔贾·伊尔金 (Ilja Iljin) 后来告诉《YLE》，这艘已知与俄罗斯军方有联系的船只在俄罗斯水域时被乌克兰无人机击中。

paras.en: "At the moment, there is no confirmed information about what cargo is on board, but it cannot be ruled out that there is military materiel on board," Iljin said.
paras.zh: 伊尔金说：“目前还没有关于船上载有什么货物的确认信息，但不能排除船上有军用物资。”

paras.en: The ship is on a US sanctions list, according to a search of the Open Sanctions website.
paras.zh: 根据公开制裁网站的搜索结果，该船已被列入美国制裁名单。

paras.en: The Border Guard later said the crew of the Sparta II was evacuating into a life raft and rescue boat.
paras.zh: 边防卫队后来说，斯巴达二号的船员正在撤离到救生筏和救援船上。

paras.en: "The [Ukraine] war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas," wrote Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo on X.
paras.zh: “（乌克兰）战争正在蔓延到我们的邻近地区，”芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波 (Petteri Orpo) 在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Ukraine has the right to fight against the aggressor," he added.
paras.zh: 乌克兰有权打击侵略者。”

paras.en: The Finnish government has put temporary curbs on aviation and maritime traffic in the eastern Gulf of Finland.
paras.zh: 芬兰政府对芬兰湾东部的航空和海上交通实施了临时限制。

paras.en: The Defense Ministry said Finland had informed its allies about the incident.
paras.zh: 国防部表示，芬兰已将此事件通知其盟友。

articles.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United: Premier League – teams, prediction, lineups

paras.en: When: Sunday, November 22 , at 4:30pm (16:30 GMT)
paras.zh: 时间：11 月 22 日星期日下午 4:30（16:30 GMT）

paras.en: Where: Anfield in Liverpool, United Kingdom
paras.zh: 地点：英国利物浦安菲尔德球场

paras.en: How to follow: Al Jazeera will have full text commentary coverage of the game with build-up from 13:30 GMT
paras.zh: 关注方式：半岛电视台将从 13:30 GMT 开始对比赛进行全文评论报道

paras.en: The latest rebuild of Manchester United begins at Liverpool on Sunday with Mauricio Pochettino in the hot seat – a position that some see as the impossible job.
paras.zh: 曼联最新的重建工作将于周日在利物浦开始，毛里西奥·波切蒂诺处于热门位置——一些人认为这是一项不可能完成的任务。

paras.en: The match at Anfield comes four days after the arrival of the Argentinian, who only oversaw his final game as United States coach on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 这场在安菲尔德举行的比赛是阿根廷人抵达安菲尔德的四天后进行的，他在周三才观看了他作为美国队主教练的最后一场比赛。

paras.en: The 54-year-old is tasked with ending a 13-year wait for a 21st Premier League title – only Liverpool have won the competition as many times as the Red Devils.
paras.zh: 这位 54 岁的球员肩负着结束 13 年等待第 21 个英超冠军的重任——只有利物浦和红魔一样赢得过如此多的英超冠军。

paras.en: United sacked Michael Carrick last week with the team third from bottom in the league and suffering their worst league start for 40 years.
paras.zh: 曼联上周解雇了迈克尔·卡里克，球队在联赛中排名倒数第三，并遭遇了 40 年来最糟糕的联赛开局。

paras.en: Pochettino is the ninth permanent manager since Sir Alex Ferguson retired with the club’s last league title in 2014 and he is the fourth in the last three years.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺是自弗格森爵士于2014年夺得俱乐部最后一个联赛冠军后退休以来的第九位常任主帅，也是过去三年中的第四位主教练。

paras.en: United’s recent pain is made worse by Liverpool’s revival in the last decade, with the Reds sitting fourth in the table and hoping to mount a challenge this season to move clear as the team with the most English top-flight titles.
paras.zh: 利物浦在过去十年中的复兴让曼联最近的痛苦变得更加严重，红军在积分榜上排名第四，希望在本赛季发起挑战，成为获得英格兰顶级联赛冠军最多的球队。

paras.en: What were the key takeaways from Pochettino’s Man United media conference?
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺在曼联媒体发布会上的主要收获是什么？

paras.en: Given the swift turnaround from his previous role to his new one, Pochettino’s unveiling as United manager was combined with the pre-game media briefing ahead of the Anfield trip.
paras.zh: 鉴于他从之前的角色迅速转变为新的角色，波切蒂诺就任曼联主帅的揭幕仪式与安菲尔德之行前的赛前媒体吹风会结合在一起。

paras.en: Understandably, most of the questions centred on how United’s form can be reversed in the short and long-term.
paras.zh: 可以理解的是，大多数问题都集中在曼联如何在短期和长期内扭转局面。

paras.en: “It is about building our own way here,” Pochettino said when asked what he can do differently to the other managers who have taken on the role since Ferguson’s farewell. “The past is not going to help, to think about yesterday.”
paras.zh: 当被问及与弗格森告别后接任这一职位的其他主教练相比，波切蒂诺能做些什么不同的事情时，波切蒂诺说道：“这是为了在这里建立我们自己的方式。” “回想昨天，过去是没有帮助的。”

paras.en: “We feel the support and we are going to work really hard to help the players to perform. That is the priority.
paras.zh: “我们感受到了支持，我们将非常努力地帮助球员表现。这是首要任务。

paras.en: “It is normal when you don’t win games that the confidence starts to go down,” he said. “I think the players need to feel from us that we believe and trust in them.
paras.zh: “当你没有赢得比赛时，信心开始下降，这是正常的，”他说。 “我认为球员需要从我们身上感受到我们信任他们。

paras.en: “With the schedule we have ahead we have to settle on our principles. The players are intelligent, they have quality. Sometimes it is unlocking some things that didn’t appear for different reasons.”
paras.zh: “根据我们前面的赛程安排，我们必须确定我们的原则。球员们很聪明，他们有能力。有时它会解锁一些由于不同原因而没有出现的东西。”

paras.en: A key figure in any rebuilding effort will be captain Bruno Fernandes, whose future has been the subject of speculation as he has yet to agree a new deal.
paras.zh: 任何重建工作中的关键人物将是队长布鲁诺·费尔南德斯，由于他尚未同意新合同，他的未来一直是人们猜测的话题。

paras.en: Pochettino revealed he had already held extensive talks with the Portugal midfielder and indicated he remained central to his plans.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺透露，他已经与葡萄牙中场进行了广泛的会谈，并表示他仍然是他计划的核心。

paras.en: “Bruno is our captain and a very important player but other players have to feel they are important from the bottom to the top,” he said.
paras.zh: “布鲁诺是我们的队长，也是一位非常重要的球员，但其他球员必须从下到上感受到他们的重要性，”他说。

paras.en: “We spoke, I spent three hours chatting with all the players individually. It was very nice contact.”
paras.zh: “我们进行了交谈，我花了三个小时与所有球员单独聊天。这是非常好的接触。”

paras.en: Questions about the squad’s fitness levels have swirled around Old Trafford, but Pochettino refused to criticise what he had inherited.
paras.zh: 关于球队健康水平的问题一直围绕着老特拉福德，但波切蒂诺拒绝批评他所继承的东西。

paras.en: “It is about proposing that idea to be brave and take it to the field,” he said.
paras.zh: “这是关于勇敢地提出这个想法并将其付诸实践，”他说。

paras.en: “We cannot talk about data without context. It is easy to manipulate data but we need to be honest, sometimes they don’t show something that you can see on the field.
paras.zh: “我们不能在没有背景的情况下谈论数据。操纵数据很容易，但我们需要诚实，有时它们不会显示你在现场可以看到的东西。

paras.en: “We are here not to denounce things. We are here to build something with our players.”
paras.zh: “我们来这里不是为了谴责事情。我们来这里是为了与我们的球员一起创造一些东西。”

paras.en: What have Liverpool said ahead of Manchester United’s visit?
paras.zh: 利物浦在曼联来访之前说了些什么？

paras.en: Liverpool had lost consecutive games before their 3-1 win against bottom-of-the-table Crystal Palace in their last match.
paras.zh: 利物浦上一场比赛3-1战胜积分榜垫底的水晶宫，此前已经连续输球。

paras.en: The run summed up the mixed start to life at Anfield for Andoni Iraola, who replaced Arne Slot in the summer – the former Bournemouth manager admits an epic encounter awaits.
paras.zh: 这场比赛总结了安多尼·伊劳拉在安菲尔德的喜忧参半的开局，他在夏天取代了阿恩·斯洛特——这位前伯恩茅斯主帅承认，一场史诗般的遭遇正在等待着。

paras.en: “You don’t find bigger games than this, honestly. I feel lucky to be here and privileged to be part of these games,” Iraola said.
paras.zh: “老实说，你找不到比这更大的游戏了。我很幸运能够来到这里，并很荣幸能够成为这些游戏的一部分，”伊劳拉说。

paras.en: “We have to acknowledge the importance of the game, and also a lot of ingredients, such as their new manager.
paras.zh: “我们必须承认比赛的重要性，以及很多因素，比如他们的新教练。

paras.en: “It is important for us in lots of different ways because we want to improve our form at home and the first chance we have to do that is on Sunday.”
paras.zh: “这对我们来说在很多方面都很重要，因为我们想改善主场的状态，而我们要做的第一个机会就是周日。”

paras.en: Iraola also admitted he fears Pochettino, whose Premier League experience was gained at Tottenham and Chelsea, will have an advantage because he does not know the Argentinian’s preferred tactics with his new club.
paras.zh: 伊劳拉还承认，他担心波切蒂诺会占据优势，因为波切蒂诺在托特纳姆热刺和切尔西获得了英超联赛经验，因为他不知道阿根廷人在新俱乐部的首选战术。

paras.en: “We’ve faced each other. Obviously he has a lot of Premier League games that we can look at and we can look at games in the US, but they still have this small advantage,” Iraola said.
paras.zh: “我们已经交锋过。显然他有很多英超比赛我们可以看，我们也可以看美国的比赛，但他们仍然有这个小小的优势，”伊劳拉说。

paras.en: “We don’t have references to prepare because they can go different ways that we don’t actually know.
paras.zh: “我们没有可供准备的参考资料，因为它们可能会采取我们实际上不知道的不同方式。

paras.en: “The staff have been working with them, so they are going to arrive well prepared. We don’t have the references that we have against other teams.”
paras.zh: “工作人员一直在与他们合作，所以他们会做好充分准备。我们没有针对其他球队的参考资料。”

paras.en: Iraola will have to adapt on the fly and the Spaniard plans to switch up his game plan if he is caught out by Pochettino’s tactics.
paras.zh: 伊劳拉必须随时适应，西班牙人计划如果被波切蒂诺的战术抓住，就改变他的比赛计划。

paras.en: “Especially the beginning of the game will be important as we have to adapt to certain things and manage the situation as quick as possible,” he said.
paras.zh: “尤其是比赛的开始非常重要，因为我们必须尽快适应某些事情并控制局势，”他说。

paras.en: “Every time there is a new manager you want to impress. It happens everywhere. But we have been focusing more on us, how we can improve.”
paras.zh: “每当有一位新主帅出现时，你都想给他留下深刻的印象。这种事随处可见。但我们更关注的是我们自己，以及我们如何改进。”

paras.en: What happened the last time Liverpool played Man United?
paras.zh: 上次利物浦对阵曼联时发生了什么？

paras.en: United were 3-2 winners when the sides met in the Premier League at Old Trafford last season.
paras.zh: 上赛季双方在老特拉福德进行的英超联赛中，曼联以3-2获胜。

paras.en: Liverpool fought back from two goals down in May, only for Kobbie Mainoo to net the late winner from the edge of the box.
paras.zh: 5月份，利物浦在两球落后的情况下奋起反击，只有科比·迈努在禁区边缘攻入制胜球。

paras.en: What happened in the corresponding fixture last season?
paras.zh: 上赛季相应的比赛发生了什么？

paras.en: United were 2-1 winners at Anfield in October last year, with Bryan Mbeumo and Harry Maguire scoring either side of Cody Gakpo’s strike.
paras.zh: 去年10月，曼联在安菲尔德以2-1获胜，布莱恩·姆博莫和哈里·马奎尔在科迪·加克波的进球中分别进球。

paras.en: When did Liverpool last beat Manchester United?
paras.zh: 利物浦上次击败曼联是什么时候？

paras.en: Liverpool last beat United with a 3-0 win at Old Trafford in the Premier League in September 2024.
paras.zh: 利物浦上一次在英超联赛中以3-0战胜曼联是在2024年9月。

paras.en: Luis Diaz scored twice and Mohamed Salah netted the other in the win for Arne Slot’s side.
paras.zh: 路易斯·迪亚兹梅开二度，穆罕默德·萨拉赫又攻入一球，帮助阿内·斯洛特的球队获胜。

paras.en: When did Liverpool last beat Manchester United at Anfield?
paras.zh: 利物浦上次在安菲尔德击败曼联是什么时候？

paras.en: Remarkably, the Reds haven’t beaten their fierce rivals at home since Jurgen Klopp’s side emerged victorious in March 2023.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，自尤尔根·克洛普的球队于 2023 年 3 月取得胜利以来，红军还没有在主场击败过他们的劲敌。

paras.en: The result on that occasion was, however, an emphatic 7-0 win for Cody Gakpo, Darwin Nunez and Mohamed Salah all scoring twice, before Roberto Firmino added the seventh.
paras.zh: 然而，那次比赛的结果是，科迪·加克波、达尔文·努涅斯和穆罕默德·萨拉赫均梅开二度，最终以 7-0 获胜，而罗伯托·菲尔米诺则攻入第七球。

paras.en: The two following seasons in the matchup at Anfield resulted in draws.
paras.zh: 接下来的两个赛季在安菲尔德的对决都以平局告终。

paras.en: Liverpool have been given a 57.3 percent chance of winning the game by Opta’s supercomputer, while United have only been given a 29.5 percent chance of claiming the spoils.
paras.zh: Opta的超级计算机给出的利物浦获胜机会为57.3%，而曼联获胜的机会只有29.5%。

paras.en: This will be their 219th meeting, with United winning 85 of the encounters and Liverpool 72.
paras.zh: 这将是两队第 219 次交锋，其中曼联赢了 85 场，利物浦赢了 72 场。

paras.en: The fixture dates back to a 2-1 win for Liverpool in April 1894.
paras.zh: 这场比赛可以追溯到 1894 年 4 月利物浦 2-1 获胜的比赛。

paras.en: Liverpool are boosted by the return of injured trio Jeremie Frimpong, Ryan Gravenberch and Virgil van Dijk, while Dominik Szoboszlai has also been cleared to play.
paras.zh: 受伤三人组杰里米·弗林蓬、瑞安·格拉文伯奇和维吉尔·范迪克的回归给利物浦带来了提振，而多米尼克·索博斯莱也已获准参加比赛。

paras.en: Giovanni Leoni and Conor Bradley have returned to training but are not yet available. Hugo Ekitike is still sidelined.
paras.zh: 乔瓦尼·莱奥尼和康纳·布拉德利已经恢复训练，但尚未上场。雨果·埃基蒂克仍然缺阵。

paras.en: Alisson; Araujo, Van Dijk, Jacquet, Kerkez; Mac Allister, Szoboszlai; Gakpo, Wirtz, Barcola; Isak
paras.zh: 阿利森；阿劳霍、范迪克、雅凯、科尔克兹；麦克·阿利斯特，索博斯莱；加克波、维尔茨、巴克拉；伊萨克

paras.en: Patrick Dorgu and Harry Maguire are back in training after knocks, while Lisandro Martinez returns from suspension.
paras.zh: 帕特里克·多尔古和哈里·马奎尔在受伤后恢复训练，而利桑德罗·马丁内斯则从停赛中恢复。

paras.en: Luke Shaw and Marcus Rashford are closing in on comebacks from knocks, but it is thought that the Liverpool match will come too soon.
paras.zh: 卢克·肖和马库斯·拉什福德即将从伤病中复出，但人们认为与利物浦的比赛来得太早了。

paras.en: Carlos Baleba, Manuel Ugarte and Benjamin Sesko remain out.
paras.zh: 卡洛斯·巴莱巴、曼努埃尔·乌加特和本杰明·塞斯科仍缺席。

paras.en: Predicted Manchester United starting lineup
paras.zh: 预测曼联首发阵容

paras.en: Lammens; Yoro, Martinez, Maguire, Dalot; Tielemans, Mainoo; Diallo, Fernandes, Cunha; Mbeumo
paras.zh: 拉门斯；约罗、马丁内斯、马奎尔、达洛特；蒂勒曼斯，迈努；迪亚洛、费尔南德斯、库尼亚；姆博莫

articles.title: Could Brexit be reversed?

paras.en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham hopes his country will rejoin the EU in his lifetime. But what are the chances?
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆希望他的国家在他有生之年重新加入欧盟。但机会有多大呢？

paras.en: The United Kingdom and European Union have struck new deals in Brussels for closer cooperation, more than a decade after Britain voted to leave the bloc.
paras.zh: 英国公投脱欧十多年后，英国和欧盟在布鲁塞尔达成了新协议，以加强合作。

paras.en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham hopes his country will rejoin the EU in his lifetime.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆希望他的国家在他有生之年重新加入欧盟。

paras.en: Bobby McDonagh – Former Irish ambassador to the UK and former permanent representative to the EU
paras.zh: 鲍比·麦克唐纳 (Bobby McDonagh) – 前爱尔兰驻英国大使和前常驻欧盟代表

paras.en: Steven Wright – Cofounder of Britain Unbound, a group focused on advocating for the UK to remain outside the EU
paras.zh: Steven Wright – Britain Unbound 联合创始人，该组织致力于倡导英国留在欧盟之外

paras.en: Lionel Barber – Former editor-in-chief of the Financial Times.
paras.zh: 莱昂内尔·巴伯（Lionel Barber）——英国《金融时报》前主编。

articles.title: FBI national crime database suffers suspected breach: Reports

paras.en: The FBI’s national criminal database has suffered a suspected breach, according to multiple US media reports.
paras.zh: 据多家美国媒体报道，联邦调查局的国家犯罪数据库疑似遭到泄露。

paras.en: President Donald Trump, who has repeatedly downplayed breaches affecting departments within his administration, appeared to confirm the FBI hacking during a television interview on Saturday.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统一再淡化影响其政府内各部门的违规行为，他在周六的电视采访中似乎证实了联邦调查局的黑客行为。

paras.en: “Well, we just heard about it, and I will say that it’s not good. I don’t like that,” Trump told Fox News.
paras.zh: “好吧，我们刚刚听说这件事，我会说这不好。我不喜欢这样，”特朗普告诉福克斯新闻。

paras.en: On Friday, CNN and NBC reported that the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which is used by law enforcement agencies across the United States to share information on criminal warrants and background checks, was compromised, citing two people who had been briefed on the matter.
paras.zh: 周五，美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 和全国广播公司 (NBC) 援引两名知情人士的话报道称，美国各地执法机构利用该中心共享刑事搜查令和背景调查信息的国家犯罪信息中心 (NCIC) 遭到入侵。

paras.en: The reported hacking, which would be the second to hit the bureau this year, is the latest in a string of US government breaches and outages that have alarmed officials over the past week.
paras.zh: 据报道，这将是该局今年遭受的第二起黑客攻击，也是过去一周美国政府发生的一系列违规和服务中断事件中的最新一起，这些违规和服务中断事件令官员们感到震惊。

paras.en: In a separate incident, NBC reported an apparent cyberattack against the US Department of Agriculture.
paras.zh: 在另一起事件中，美国全国广播公司 (NBC) 报道了一起针对美国农业部的明显网络攻击。

paras.en: The FBI and USDA did not immediately return Al Jazeera’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局和美国农业部没有立即回复半岛电视台的置评请求。

paras.en: In the interview on Saturday, Trump suggested the hack of the FBI’s crucial database could be viewed with “a positive spin”.
paras.zh: 在周六的采访中，特朗普表示可以从“积极的角度”看待联邦调查局关键数据库遭到黑客攻击。

paras.en: “Maybe we’ll learn things that we would have never learned otherwise. You had the Russia, Russia, Russia hoax. You had all these other hoaxes,” he said in an apparent reference to his discontent with the FBI’s investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 US election.
paras.zh: “也许我们会学到一些我们永远不会学到的东西。你有俄罗斯，俄罗斯，俄罗斯骗局。你有所有这些其他骗局，”他说，这显然是指他对联邦调查局(FBI)调查俄罗斯干预2016年美国大选的不满。

paras.en: In September, the FBI said it was investigating an apparent breach by a cyber group that claimed it had stolen sensitive information on the bureau’s 38,000 employees.
paras.zh: 9 月，FBI 表示正在调查一个网络组织的明显违规行为，该组织声称窃取了联邦调查局 38,000 名员工的敏感信息。

paras.en: Additionally, in March, the agency said it had been investigating “suspicious activities” on some of its internal systems, The Associated Press news agency reported.
paras.zh: 此外，据美联社报道，该机构今年 3 月表示正在调查其部分内部系统的“可疑活动”。

paras.en: FBI Director Kash Patel, who has not publicly commented on the most recent hacking, was not present for a Wednesday hearing at the US Capitol to examine threats against the US. Patel’s deputy, Christopher Raia, attended in his place, joining US Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin and US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔没有对最近的黑客攻击公开发表评论，也没有出席周三在美国国会大厦举行的听证会，以审查针对美国的威胁。帕特尔的副手克里斯托弗·拉亚（Christopher Raia）代替他出席，与美国国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林（Markwayne Mullin）和美国国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿（Jay Clayton）一起出席。

articles.title: Military analyst Phillips O'Brien on Ukraine and Europe being left out of Trump's talks
articles.author: Scott Simon

paras.en: Military analyst Phillips O'Brien on Ukraine and Europe being left out of Trump's talks
paras.zh: 军事分析家菲利普斯·奥布莱恩认为乌克兰和欧洲被排除在特朗普的会谈之外

paras.en: As President Trump met with Russian and Chinese counterparts, Ukraine and its European allies were left out of the talks. NPR's Scott Simon talks with Phillips O'Brien of St. Andrew's University.
paras.zh: 当特朗普总统会见俄罗斯和中国同行时，乌克兰及其欧洲盟友被排除在谈判之外。 NPR 的斯科特·西蒙 (Scott Simon) 与圣安德鲁大学的菲利普斯·奥布莱恩 (Phillips O'Brien) 进行了交谈。

paras.en: Two summits this week on two sides of the world. President Trump was in China with leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, as European leaders gathered in Berlin with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to show their support for Ukraine. We're joined now by Phillips O'Brien, professor of strategic studies at University of St. Andrews in Scotland. Professor, thanks for being back with us.
paras.zh: 本周在世界两侧举行两场峰会。特朗普总统与中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京一起访问中国，欧洲领导人与弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基总统齐聚柏林，表达对乌克兰的支持。现在苏格兰圣安德鲁斯大学战略研究教授菲利普斯·奥布莱恩也加入了我们的行列。教授，感谢您回到我们身边。

paras.en: PHILLIPS O'BRIEN: I'm (ph) glad to be here.
paras.zh: 菲利普斯·奥布莱恩： 我很高兴来到这里。

paras.en: SIMON: What do you think we learned from the two summits this week?
paras.zh: 西蒙：您认为我们从本周的两次峰会中学到了什么？

paras.en: O'BRIEN: Well, we've learned that the United States is now officially much closer to Russia than it is to Ukraine or its European partners and that the United States' goal is to now bully Ukraine into giving up territory and people to Russia so that Putin gets a very good deal. The other thing we've learned is that Ukraine's support now is going to come from Europe and Europe alone, that the United States - oh, and Canada. But that, you know, it is up to Europe now to work with Ukraine to fight Russia off. And that's the reality. It's been the reality for a while, but that's what we actually had confirmed this week. And that was a useful thing.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩：嗯，我们了解到，美国现在与俄罗斯的官方关系比与乌克兰或其欧洲伙伴的关系要密切得多，而且美国现在的目标是胁迫乌克兰向俄罗斯放弃领土和人民，以便普京得到一个非常好的协议。我们了解到的另一件事是，乌克兰现在的支持将来自欧洲，而且仅来自欧洲，即美国 - 哦，还有加拿大。但你知道，现在欧洲有责任与乌克兰合作击退俄罗斯。这就是现实。这已经成为现实一段时间了，但这就是我们本周实际证实的。这是一件有用的事情。

paras.en: O'BRIEN: It is, certainly. I mean, Europe is - you would say, if you stepped back, Europe's more than capable of helping Ukraine. It has the money. It has the technology. It has the people. It has the brainpower. It has the engineering. What it doesn't have is the ability to think strategically on its own. It's become, in some ways, infantilized by the United States over the past 80 years. The United States did so much of its strategic thinking. And Europeans are panicked, really, when faced with the reality of having to do it without the USA. They are slowly adjusting, but the real issue's not material. It's mental.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩：当然是这样。我的意思是，欧洲——你会说，如果你退后一步，欧洲完全有能力帮助乌克兰。它有钱。它有技术。它有人民。它有脑力。它有工程。它所缺乏的是自己进行战略思考的能力。在过去的80年里，它在某种程度上被美国幼稚化了。美国做了很多战略思考。当欧洲人不得不在没有美国参与的情况下做到这一点时，欧洲人确实感到恐慌。他们正在慢慢调整，但真正的问题并不重要。这是精神上的。

paras.en: SIMON: Ukraine carried out a major attack this week on Russia. They hit a bridge linking Russia with the occupied Crimea Peninsula. And Russia retaliated with deadly missile strikes in Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown yesterday. What does this tell us about the military capabilities of both countries?
paras.zh: 西蒙：乌克兰本周对俄罗斯发动了一次重大袭击。他们撞上了一座连接俄罗斯和被占领的克里米亚半岛的桥梁。昨天，俄罗斯对弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的家乡进行了致命的导弹袭击进行报复。这对我们两国的军事能力有何启示？

paras.en: O'BRIEN: Well, what we know - Russia's plan is to try and break Ukrainian civilian will this winter by committing war crimes on a daily basis. And that's been the - what they've been doing for a while. So they're going to try to kill civilians. They're trying to freeze civilians. They're trying to cut power. They are going to try and make Ukraine as unlivable as possible. And they have been helped a great deal by the United States because the United States has deprived Ukraine of air defense. And right now, by the way, the United States and - through Starlink and Starshield is actually hampering Ukraine's ability to defend itself by shooting down drones. So the Russian strategy's quite straightforward in - when we see it in action.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩：嗯，据我们所知，俄罗斯的计划是在今年冬天通过每天犯下战争罪行来试图摧毁乌克兰平民的意志。这就是他们一段时间以来一直在做的事情。所以他们会试图杀害平民。他们正试图冻结平民。他们正试图切断电源。他们将尽力让乌克兰变得尽可能不适宜居住。而且他们得到了美国的很大帮助，因为美国剥夺了乌克兰的防空能力。顺便说一句，美国现在通过星链和星盾实际上正在阻碍乌克兰通过击落无人机来保卫自己的能力。因此，当我们看到俄罗斯的战略付诸实施时，它是相当简单的。

paras.en: What the Ukrainians are trying to do is, in some ways, something far more ambitious and actually, by the way, legal. And that is they're trying to cut the flow of supplies to occupied western Ukraine. It's very hard for the Russians to get supplies into Crimea and then occupied parts of Kherson and Zaporizhzhia. And so what the Ukrainians seem to be trying to do is to isolate those regions and make it very difficult for the Russians to supply them.
paras.zh: 在某些方面，乌克兰人试图做的事情更加雄心勃勃，而且实际上是合法的。那就是他们正试图切断被占领的乌克兰西部的供应。俄罗斯人很难将物资输送到克里米亚，然后占领赫尔松和扎波罗热的部分地区。因此，乌克兰人似乎试图孤立这些地区，让俄罗斯人很难向这些地区供应物资。

paras.en: SIMON: The U.S. envoy Jared Kushner said he believes that Russia - his phrase was comfortable - is comfortable with...
paras.zh: 西蒙：美国特使贾里德·库什纳表示，他相信俄罗斯——他的措辞很舒服——对……感到满意。

paras.en: SIMON: ...NATO-like - well, you anticipate the question...
paras.zh: 西蒙：……就像北约——嗯，你预料到了这个问题……

paras.en: SIMON: ...NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine...
paras.zh: 西蒙：……为乌克兰提供类似北约的安全保障……

paras.en: SIMON: ...As a way to end the war. Does this strike you as a plausible proposal for negotiations?
paras.zh: 西蒙：……作为结束战争的一种方式。您认为这是一个看似合理的谈判建议吗？

paras.en: O'BRIEN: Well, there's two things to say. NATO-like is nothing. Yeah, there's either NATO or not NATO. And, you know, NATO-like can be whatever they want it to be. But the key thing is Kushner's desperate to get a deal because they understand what's coming down the pike with the new Congress. And by the way, this was - they're saying it, oddly, to the Ukrainians and Europeans, who are then reporting it to the press, that what's going on is they - that, you know, Kushner and Witkoff and the Americans are saying, we need a deal by January 3 because we're going to have less power when the Democrats take over Congress. But this is simply posing. It's arguments, you know, that Putin is not going to accept anything like a real security guarantee for Ukraine. But it's the Trump administration's desperation to get something for Putin before the Democrats take over Congress.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩：嗯，有两件事要说。像北约那样没什么。是的，要么有北约，要么没有北约。而且，你知道，北约可以是他们想要的任何东西。但关键是库什纳迫切希望达成协议，因为他们了解新国会将会发生什么。顺便说一句，奇怪的是，他们对乌克兰人和欧洲人这么说，然后乌克兰人和欧洲人向媒体报道了这件事，他们说，库什纳、维特科夫和美国人说，我们需要在 1 月 3 日之前达成协议，因为当民主党接管国会时，我们的权力将会减少。但这只是摆拍而已。你知道，有人认为普京不会接受乌克兰的真正安全保证之类的东西。但特朗普政府迫切希望在民主党接管国会之前为普京谋取一些利益。

paras.en: SIMON: It's been almost five years since Russia launched the full-scale invasion of Ukraine. It's a long time for Ukraine to hold out, isn't it? What's your sense of where the war might be heading?
paras.zh: 西蒙：俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵已经快五年了。乌克兰已经坚持了很长时间了，不是吗？您对战争的走向有何看法？

paras.en: O'BRIEN: Well, it certainly is a long time, and they've done a remarkable job. And from the Ukrainian perspective, when you talk to them, their view is, we have no option. I mean, if we're - if we so - don't hold out, we'll be dead. I mean, it's quite clear that the Russians don't care about their lives, don't care about their cultures or societies. So resisting isn't really an option to them. They have to resist, or they will be wiped out.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩：嗯，这确实是一段很长的时间，而且他们做得非常出色。从乌克兰人的角度来看，当你与他们交谈时，他们的观点是，我们别无选择。我的意思是，如果我们——如果我们这样的话——不坚持下去，我们就会死掉。我的意思是，很明显俄罗斯人不关心他们的生活，不关心他们的文化或社会。因此，抵抗对他们来说并不是一个真正的选择。他们必须反抗，否则就会被消灭。

paras.en: The thing that is very frustrating, and I got this from when I was last in Ukraine and talking to them, is they feel, in many ways, the war is heading in their favor. They're more adaptable. They're doing better on the front line. They were doing a very successful strike campaign against Russian oil refineries and logistics. But then the United States has, you know, come out and switched sides. And so the United States is providing a huge lifeline to Putin, which is really helping the Russians by leaving Ukrainian cities defenseless. And that's the reality of that - what they face.
paras.zh: 令人非常沮丧的是，我上次在乌克兰与他们交谈时了解到，他们觉得，在很多方面，战争正在朝着对他们有利的方向发展。他们的适应能力更强。他们在前线做得更好。他们对俄罗斯炼油厂和后勤设施进行了一次非常成功的打击行动。但后来，你知道，美国站出来改变了立场。因此，美国正在为普京提供巨大的生命线，这实际上是在帮助俄罗斯人，让乌克兰城市变得毫无防御能力。这就是现实——他们所面临的。

paras.en: SIMON: Phillips O'Brien, professor at University of St. Andrews in Scotland. Thank you so much for being with us.
paras.zh: 西蒙：菲利普斯·奥布莱恩，苏格兰圣安德鲁斯大学教授。非常感谢您与我们在一起。

articles.title: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
articles.author: Imogen Foulkes

paras.en: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
paras.zh: 杀手机器人：联合国谈判未能达成具有法律约束力的规则

paras.en: GENEVA — Diplomats meeting at the United Nations in Geneva have agreed to start discussing options to regulate lethal autonomous weapons, often called "killer robots."
paras.zh: 日内瓦——在日内瓦举行的联合国会议上，外交官们同意开始讨论监管致命性自主武器（通常被称为“杀手机器人”）的方案。

paras.en: After a week of negotiations that dragged on until the small hours of Saturday morning, a compromise emerged: countries would have two years to suggest regulations that could be legally binding, but could also be optional.
paras.zh: 经过一周的谈判一直拖到周六凌晨，最终达成了妥协：各国将有两年的时间来提出可能具有法律约束力但也可以是可选的法规。

paras.en: Bleary-eyed negotiators insisted the agreement was better than nothing and showed the U.N.'s disarmament process could still function. But for many humanitarian organizations and many countries, the deal falls far short of what they had hoped for.
paras.zh: 睡眼惺忪的谈判代表坚称该协议总比没有好，并表明联合国的裁军进程仍然可以发挥作用。但对于许多人道主义组织和许多国家来说，该协议远远没有达到他们的期望。

paras.en: Before the negotiations got underway, the International Committee of the Red Cross, the guardian of the Geneva Conventions, said it was urgent for legally binding rules to be drafted within a year. That call was backed by the U.N. secretary-general and by Pope Leo.
paras.zh: 在谈判开始之前，《日内瓦公约》的守护者红十字国际委员会表示，迫切需要在一年内起草具有法律约束力的规则。这一呼吁得到了联合国秘书长和教皇利奥的支持。

paras.en: Their concerns stem from the kind of warfare we are now seeing. In Ukraine, Sudan and Gaza, civilians are being killed by semi-autonomous drones. This year in Sudan, 80% of civilian deaths were caused by drones according to the U.N.
paras.zh: 他们的担忧源于我们现在看到的那种战争。在乌克兰、苏丹和加沙，半自主无人机正在造成平民死亡。据联合国统计，今年苏丹 80% 的平民死亡是由无人机造成的。

paras.en: Humans remain, albeit very remotely, in control for now, but humanitarian organizations fear we are on the verge of seeing artificial intelligence-assisted weapons make the decision to kill entirely on their own.
paras.zh: 尽管距离很远，但人类目前仍处于控制之中，但人道主义组织担心我们即将看到人工智能辅助武器完全自行做出杀戮决定。

paras.en: Algorithms making life-and-death decisions
paras.zh: 做出生死决定的算法

paras.en: "There is a fundamental ethical concern with having what are essentially these life-and-death decisions determined by programming, determined by an algorithm," said ICRC legal adviser Georgia Hinds. "That's not something that you can fix with better technology. That is a moral red line that we cannot cross."
paras.zh: 红十字国际委员会法律顾问乔治亚·海因兹 (Georgia Hinds) 表示：“这些生死攸关的决定本质上是由编程和算法决定的，这是一个基本的道德问题。” “这不是用更好的技术就能解决的问题。这是我们无法跨越的道德红线。”

paras.en: No one went into the negotiations thinking they would be easy; some of the world's most powerful countries, among them the U.S., Russia and Israel, had already indicated their reluctance to agree to binding regulations.
paras.zh: 没有人在谈判时认为谈判会很容易；世界上一些最强大的国家，其中包括美国、俄罗斯和以色列，已经表示不愿同意具有约束力的法规。

paras.en: On day one, Russia delayed proceedings by objecting to the meeting's agenda. Then the United States proposed a five-year window to discuss nonbinding, optional guidelines for autonomous weapons.
paras.zh: 第一天，俄罗斯因反对会议议程而推迟了会议进程。随后，美国提议用五年时间来讨论自主武器的非约束性、可选准则。

paras.en: "They're just kicking the can down the road," said one frustrated delegate. As the clock ticked on and the weekend approached, diplomats scrambled to get some kind of result from negotiations that had been billed as a last chance to regulate weapons whose technology and decision-making capabilities we may not even fully understand.
paras.zh: 一位沮丧的代表表示：“他们只是把罐头踢到路边。”随着时间的流逝和周末的临近，外交官们争先恐后地从谈判中获得某种结果，这场谈判被宣传为监管武器的最后机会，而我们甚至可能不完全了解这些武器的技术和决策能力。

paras.en: Finally, at 4:30 a.m. on Saturday morning, they emerged from the negotiating room to announce their compromise: no to a deal within a year, maybe to legally binding rules, or maybe not.
paras.zh: 最后，周六凌晨 4 点 30 分，他们从谈判室出来宣布妥协：一年内不达成协议，也许遵守具有法律约束力的规则，也可能不同意。

paras.en: The ICRC immediately said it regretted the move and renewed its appeal for a binding treaty. Other campaigners were less polite, calling the deal "a real disappointment" and a "nothing burger." "I am concerned people will die because of this," added another.
paras.zh: 红十字国际委员会立即表示对此举感到遗憾，并再次呼吁制定具有约束力的条约。其他活动人士则不那么礼貌，称这笔交易“真正令人失望”，而且“没什么汉堡”。另一位补充道：“我担心人们会因此而死亡。”

paras.en: A key worry is that, with two years to talk about possible rules that might only be optional, the technology will race ahead, uncontrolled.
paras.zh: 一个主要的担忧是，用两年的时间来讨论可能只是可选的规则，这项技术将不受控制地向前发展。

paras.en: "We're likely to see the systems proliferate," said Anna Hehir, an expert in military AI governance at the Future of Life Institute. "They're not like nuclear weapons in that they're inaccessible. There are autonomous weapons that are easy to purchase or even to create for all kinds of actors: individuals, nonstate actors, criminal groups."
paras.zh: “我们可能会看到这些系统激增，”未来生命研究所军事人工智能治理专家安娜·赫希尔 (Anna Hehir) 说。 “它们不像核武器那样难以接近。自主武器很容易为各种行为者购买甚至制造：个人、非国家行为者、犯罪集团。”

paras.en: There are also big questions about how our existing rules of war – the Geneva Conventions – can be upheld if those doing the killing are not humans, but machines.
paras.zh: 还有一个大问题是，如果杀人者不是人类而是机器，我们现有的战争规则——《日内瓦公约》——如何才能得到维护。

paras.en: "These rules are the bare minimum that militaries and states have developed and agreed to adhere to," said the ICRC's Hinds. "The commander remains responsible for making sure that the use of force is lawful. The commander remains accountable. You cannot hold a machine accountable for a violation of the law."
paras.zh: 红十字国际委员会的海因兹表示：“这些规则是军队和国家制定并同意遵守的最低限度规则。” “指挥官仍然有责任确保使用武力的合法性。指挥官仍然要承担责任。你不能让机器对违法行为负责。”

paras.en: But in the race to develop new weapons, no country wants to come second. Although most U.N. member states do agree there should be some controls over autonomous weapons, the compromise in Geneva means that, for the next two years at least, weapons that can use artificial intelligence to make life-and-death decisions will remain unregulated.
paras.zh: 但在开发新武器的竞赛中，没有一个国家愿意成为第二。尽管大多数联合国成员国确实同意应对自主武器进行一些控制，但日内瓦的妥协意味着，至少在未来两年内，能够利用人工智能做出生死决定的武器将继续不受监管。

paras.en: Meanwhile, weapons technology is developing at pace, while diplomacy is struggling to keep up.
paras.zh: 与此同时，武器技术正在快速发展，而外交却在努力跟上。

articles.title: Mexico detains top cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro,' setting off violence
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Mexico detains top cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro,' setting off violence
paras.zh: 墨西哥拘留贩毒集团头号“矮子伊西德罗”，引发暴力

paras.en: MEXICO CITY — Gunfire rang out, trucks burned and Mexican forces clashed with cartel gunmen in the state of Sinaloa overnight as Mexican authorities captured cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as "El Chapo Isidro."
paras.zh: 墨西哥城——枪声响起，卡车被烧毁，墨西哥军队与锡那罗亚州贩毒集团枪手发生冲突，墨西哥当局抓获了贩毒集团头目福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯（Fausto Isidro Meza Flores），人称“矮子伊西德罗”。

paras.en: Meza Flores was one of the FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives and a top cartel leader from the Beltrán Leyva criminal organization wanted for trafficking drugs to the United States and illegally carrying firearms.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 是联邦调查局 (FBI) 十大通缉犯之一，也是贝尔特兰·雷瓦 (Beltrán Leyva) 犯罪组织的一名卡特尔头目，因向美国贩运毒品和非法携带枪支而被通缉。

paras.en: Mexico's government said in a report early Saturday that intelligence from the Trump administration helped authorities capture him, but provided few details about how authorities in Mexico and the United States coordinated to detain Meza Flores.
paras.zh: 墨西哥政府在周六早些时候的一份报告中表示，特朗普政府的情报帮助当局抓获了他，但没有提供有关墨西哥和美国当局如何协调拘留梅萨·弗洛雷斯的细节。

paras.en: He was also a key ally to "Los Mayos," a faction of the Sinaloa Cartel, which was designated as a foreign terrorist organization by the Trump administration last year. His capture represents a blow to the cartel as it fights with another faction for control of the northern Mexican state.
paras.zh: 他还是锡那罗亚贩毒集团的一个派系“洛斯梅奥斯”的重要盟友，该组织去年被特朗普政府认定为外国恐怖组织。他的被捕对卡特尔来说是一个打击，因为该卡特尔正在与另一个派别争夺墨西哥北部州的控制权。

paras.en: Authorities in the United States and Mexico celebrated the arrest as a security win. U.S. President Donald Trump has pressured Mexico's government to go after criminal groups.
paras.zh: 美国和墨西哥当局庆祝此次逮捕，称其为安全方面的胜利。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向墨西哥政府施压，要求其追捕犯罪集团。

paras.en: But experts warn that it could set off another wave of violence in a region already caught up in a power struggle between warring cartel factions.
paras.zh: 但专家警告说，这可能会在一个已经陷入卡特尔交战派别之间权力斗争的地区引发另一波暴力浪潮。

paras.en: Mexican forces' move against cartel fuels violence
paras.zh: 墨西哥军队打击卡特尔的行动助长暴力

paras.en: Mexican authorities said they used "stealth and surprise" to capture Meza Flores, establishing a security perimeter around the building where he was located. After coming under attack with guns and explosives from suspected cartel operatives, armed forces personnel entered a home and detained him. He was later taken by aircraft to Mexico City to appear before prosecutors.
paras.zh: 墨西哥当局表示，他们采用“秘密和出其不意”的方式抓获了梅萨·弗洛雷斯，并在他所在的建筑物周围建立了安全边界。在遭到卡特尔嫌疑人的枪支和爆炸物袭击后，武装部队人员进入一所房屋并拘留了他。后来他被飞机带到墨西哥城接受检察官的审讯。

paras.en: Video shared by authorities shows heavily armed men in camouflage escorting a man through a dimly lit house and putting him in the back of a truck. No casualties have been reported so far as a result of the operation.
paras.zh: 当局分享的视频显示，身穿迷彩服的全副武装的男子护送一名男子穿过一间光线昏暗的房子，并将他放到一辆卡车的后座上。截至目前，此次行动尚未造成人员伤亡。

paras.en: The capture of Meza Flores and his No. 2 in the city of Guasave, Sinaloa, set off a wave of violence overnight with calm setting in Saturday morning.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯和他的二号人物在锡那罗亚州瓜萨维市被捕，一夜之间掀起了一波暴力浪潮，周六早上气氛平静。

paras.en: Videos show screaming civilians fleeing gunfire at a baseball game, burning cars and businesses, and circling helicopters shooting at people below. Such shows of force by cartels are common following the capture or killing of leaders.
paras.zh: 视频显示，棒球比赛中，尖叫着的平民逃离枪林弹雨，焚烧汽车和企业，盘旋的直升机向下面的人开枪。在捕获或杀害领导人后，卡特尔展​​示武力的情况很常见。

paras.en: As a result, the Mexican army and National Guard special forces were unable to extract Meza Flores from Guasave until 4 a.m. on Saturday, said a federal official who spoke on condition of anonymity because he wasn't authorized to discuss the case.
paras.zh: 一名因无权讨论此案而要求匿名的联邦官员表示，因此，墨西哥军队和国民警卫队特种部队直到周六凌晨 4 点才将梅萨·弗洛雷斯从瓜萨韦救出。

paras.en: "Getting him (Meza Flores) out was extraordinary," the official said, describing an intense response by members of the criminal group who maintained at least "10 roadblocks" with burning vehicles on Guasave's streets.
paras.zh: 这位官员说：“把他（梅萨·弗洛雷斯）救出来是非同寻常的。”他描述了犯罪团伙成员的强烈反应，他们在瓜萨韦的街道上用燃烧的车辆设置了至少“10个路障”。

paras.en: Guasave resident and firefighter Paola Sánchez said that thousands of people were terrorized late Friday as they took shelter from intense gunfire in grocery stores and other locations.
paras.zh: 瓜萨韦居民兼消防员保拉·桑切斯 (Paola Sánchez) 表示，周五晚间，数千人在杂货店和其他地点躲避猛烈枪火时受到惊吓。

paras.en: "Last night, many businesses were burned ... along with cars and trucks," Sánchez told The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 桑切斯告诉美联社：“昨晚，许多企业被烧毁……还有汽车和卡车。”

paras.en: She said that the city's firefighters had to take shelter at their station and wait until Saturday morning for orders from their superiors to dispatch the first crews to check whether any businesses or vehicles were still burning.
paras.zh: 她说，该市的消防队员必须在他们的车站避难，直到周六早上接到上级的命令，派出第一批消防人员去检查是否有任何企业或车辆仍在燃烧。

paras.en: "Everything looks calm today," Sánchez said.
paras.zh: “今天一切看起来都很平静，”桑切斯说。

paras.en: Mexican Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch wrote on X on Saturday morning that armed forces would remain deployed in Sinaloa state to protect civilians.
paras.zh: 墨西哥安全部长奥马尔·加西亚·哈富奇 (Omar García Harfuch) 周六上午在 X 上写道，武装部队将继续部署在锡那罗亚州以保护平民。

paras.en: Capture prompts celebration and warnings
paras.zh: 捕获提示庆祝和警告

paras.en: Meza Flores' detention marks another high-profile capture of a cartel leader as Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum faces pressure from Trump to crack down on cartels. Sheinbaum has gone after illegal groups more aggressively than her predecessors, and homicides have dipped significantly in her two years in office.
paras.zh: 梅萨·弗洛雷斯的拘留标志着墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆面临特朗普打击卡特尔的压力，又一起高调抓获卡特尔头目。希因鲍姆比她的前任更积极地打击非法团体，在她执政的两年里，凶杀案大幅下降。

paras.en: The U.S. and Mexican governments celebrated the capture on Saturday, with the DEA commending Mexican authorities.
paras.zh: 美国和墨西哥政府周六庆祝了此次抓获，美国缉毒局对墨西哥当局表示赞扬。

paras.en: "The capture of El Chapo Isidro delivers a significant blow to a ruthless criminal organization that has used extreme violence to traffic deadly drugs, including fentanyl, a designated weapon of mass destruction, into American communities," the DEA said in a statement. "This operation underscores the critical importance of intelligence sharing in targeting dangerous cartel leaders."
paras.zh: 美国缉毒局在一份声明中表示：“矮子伊西德罗的被捕对一个残酷的犯罪组织造成了重大打击，该组织利用极端暴力向美国社区贩运致命毒品，其中包括指定的大规模杀伤性武器芬太尼。” “这次行动强调了情报共享对于打击危险的卡特尔领导人的至关重要性。”

paras.en: García Harfuch called the detention "an important step in pacifying Sinaloa."
paras.zh: 加西亚·哈富奇称这次拘留是“平息锡那罗亚的重要一步”。

paras.en: Sheinbaum's government has targeted a number of cartel kingpins, including Jalisco New Generation Cartel leader Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, known as " El Mencho," who was killed by the military in February.
paras.zh: 谢因鲍姆政府已将目标锁定为多名贩毒集团头目，其中包括哈利斯科州新一代贩毒集团领导人内梅西奥·奥塞格拉·塞万提斯（Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes），人称“El Mencho”，他于二月份被军方击毙。

paras.en: Mexican security analyst David Saucedo said that the capture of Meza Flores marked another case of the governments of Mexico and the U.S. increasingly falling back on a longstanding security strategy, which critics warn could fuel more violence in the long run.
paras.zh: 墨西哥安全分析师戴维·索塞多表示，梅萨弗洛雷斯的抓获标志着墨西哥和美国政府日益依赖长期安全战略的又一案例，批评者警告称，从长远来看，这可能会助长更多暴力事件。

paras.en: The so-called kingpin strategy relies on zeroing in on capos like Meza Flores as a way to combat cartels. But experts say that it often triggers violent power disputes among groups, like the one underway in Sinaloa.
paras.zh: 所谓的主脑战略依赖于像梅萨·弗洛雷斯这样的变调夹，以此作为打击贩毒集团的一种方式。但专家表示，这经常引发群体之间的暴力权力纠纷，就像锡那罗亚州正在发生的那样。

paras.en: "What is evident is this is a product of pressure from the United States," Saucedo said. "What they do is capture high-profile kingpins — the leaders — but they don't dismantle the entire organization. They arrested the No. 1 and No. 2, but the entire network of hit men, street-level drug dealers, businesses and political and police connections remains intact."
paras.zh: 索塞多说：“显而易见的是，这是美国压力的产物。” “他们所做的是抓捕高调的头目——领导人——但他们并没有瓦解整个组织。他们逮捕了一号和二号人物，但整个杀手网络、街头毒贩、企业以及政治和警察关系仍然完好无损。”
