articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时机，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的美妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Voters want to 'move on' from the president, former Trump official claims as reason for GOP's midterm defeat

paras.en: Former Kansas Republican Sen. Sam Brownback, who served as an ambassador during Donald Trump's first term, blamed the president's personal leadership style for Republicans' midterm losses.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普第一任期内担任大使的前堪萨斯州共和党参议员萨姆·布朗巴克将共和党中期失败归咎于总统的个人领导风格。

paras.en: He claims the outcome of the 2026 elections — where Democrats' sweeping victories in traditional red strongholds helped them reclaim majorities in the House and Senate — was a sign of voters rejecting Trump more than rebuking his policies.
paras.zh: 他声称 2026 年选举的结果——民主党在传统红色据点的压倒性胜利帮助他们重新获得了众议院和参议院的多数席位——表明选民更多的是拒绝特朗普，而不是谴责他的政策。

paras.en: "I think the thing we're missing is that it was really targeted at President Trump. I don't think it was targeted at the policies so much," Brownback told Fox News Digital in an interview. "Pride comes before a fall and a haughty spirit before a stumble."
paras.zh: “我认为我们忽略的是，它确实是针对特朗普总统的。我不认为它是针对政策的，”布朗巴克在接受福克斯新闻数字采访时说道。 “骄傲在跌倒之前出现，傲慢的精神在跌倒之前出现。”

paras.en: The former Kansas governor argued that Republicans should not write off the midterm results as the typical losses suffered by a president’s party through history during their second term.
paras.zh: 这位前堪萨斯州州长认为，共和党人不应将中期选举结果视为历史上总统所在政党在第二任期内遭受的典型损失。

paras.en: Brownback, who represented Kansas in the U.S. Senate from 1996 to 2011 before serving as governor from 2011 to 2018, said economic concerns, including inflation and gas prices, played a role in the election results.
paras.zh: 布朗巴克曾于 1996 年至 2011 年代表堪萨斯州参议院，随后于 2011 年至 2018 年担任州长。他表示，包括通货膨胀和汽油价格在内的经济担忧在选举结果中发挥了作用。

paras.en: He suggested voters' frustrations extended beyond the economy to Trump's approach to governing.
paras.zh: 他表示，选民的不满不仅限于经济，还包括特朗普的执政方式。

paras.en: The Fox News Voter Poll found that 89% of voters considered the cost of living a crucial or major factor in their congressional vote, compared with 74% who said the same about the war in Iran. The findings suggest broader economic frustrations were also a major concern among voters, although the two issues may overlap and the polling does not establish which ultimately drove Republican defections.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻选民民意调查发现，89％的选民认为生活成本是他们在国会投票中的关键或主要因素，而74％的选民对伊朗战争也持同样看法。调查结果表明，更广泛的经济挫折也是选民的主要担忧，尽管这两个问题可能重叠，而且民意调查并未确定最终导致共和党倒戈的原因。

paras.en: "People just saying I'm ready to move on past President Trump," Brownback said, adding that voters still appreciated the administration's efforts to secure the border but viewed interior immigration enforcement as too aggressive.
paras.zh: 布朗巴克说：“人们只是说我已经准备好超越特朗普总统。”他补充说，选民仍然赞赏政府为确保边境安全所做的努力，但认为国内移民执法过于激进。

paras.en: The former ambassador-at-large for international religious freedom also urged Republicans to reconsider how they communicate with voters, emphasizing the importance of humility and kindness.
paras.zh: 这位前国际宗教自由无任所大使还敦促共和党人重新考虑如何与选民沟通，强调谦逊和友善的重要性。

paras.en: "You just can't be proud. You've got to come forward humbly," Brownback said. "And I think you have to do that with the American public."
paras.zh: “你不能骄傲。你必须谦虚地挺身而出，”布朗巴克说。 “我认为你必须对美国公众这样做。”

paras.en: Brownback called for a more measured response to voters' concerns ahead of 2028. "We hear you, American public. We're adjusting to the message that we heard," he said.
paras.zh: 布朗巴克呼吁在 2028 年之前对选民的担忧做出更加谨慎的回应。“美国公众，我们听到了你们的声音。我们正在根据我们听到的信息进行调整，”他说。

paras.en: "America is great because it's good. If it ever loses its goodness, it will lose its greatness," he added. "There has to be, as I keep doubling back to, a humility and a kindness about it as well."
paras.zh: “美国之所以伟大，是因为它是好的。如果它失去了它的善良，它就会失去它的伟大，”他补充道。 “正如我不断强调的那样，还必须有一种谦逊和善意。”

paras.en: Both Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio have been floated as potential contenders for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, with Vance saying he plans to decide whether to launch a White House bid in the spring.
paras.zh: 副总统 JD 万斯和国务卿马可·卢比奥都被视为 2028 年共和党总统提名的潜在竞争者，万斯表示，他计划在春季决定是否发起入主白宫竞选。

articles.title: Maher calls out 'spoiled brats' who left US over Trump presidency, says country ‘self-corrected’ in midterms

paras.en: Bill Maher, host of HBO's "Real Time," took a swipe at liberals who fled the country over President Donald Trump’s administration, calling them "spoiled brats" as he celebrated Democrats’ sweep in this month’s midterm elections.
paras.zh: HBO 节目《实时》的主持人比尔·马赫在庆祝民主党在本月的中期选举中大获全胜时，猛烈抨击了因唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府而逃离美国的自由派，称他们为“被宠坏的孩子”。

paras.en: Speaking to the audience during the show’s season finale Friday night, Maher blasted Democrats who moved abroad following Trump’s election victories in 2016 and 2024.
paras.zh: 马赫在周五晚上的节目季终集上向观众发表讲话，谴责特朗普在 2016 年和 2024 年大选获胜后移居国外的民主党人。

paras.en: "But it is also important to remember to mock and ridicule the spoiled brats who fled to England or Ireland because America was so irredeemably ‘Trumpian-Republican,’" Maher said as he flashed a news headline highlighting "21 celebs who fled the U.S. amid Trump’s presidency."
paras.zh: “但同样重要的是，要记住嘲笑和嘲笑那些逃到英国或爱尔兰的被宠坏的孩子，因为美国是如此不可救药的‘特朗普共和党’，”马赫一边说，一边亮出了一个新闻标题，强调“在特朗普担任总统期间逃离美国的 21 名名人”。

paras.en: "Only to come back to America now because America did what America does: self-corrected," he added.
paras.zh: “现在才回到美国，因为美国做了美国所做的事情：自我纠正，”他补充道。

paras.en: Maher went on to question the judgment of those who left their country over election results that they were unhappy with, as he touted Democrats’ historic sweep in the midterm election earlier this month.
paras.zh: 马赫接着质疑那些离开祖国的人对选举结果不满意的判断，他在本月早些时候的中期选举中吹捧了民主党的历史性大胜。

paras.en: "You left the country you're supposed to love forever because you lost an election or two, and now you look like the husband who leaves his wife because she let herself go for a while," Maher added. "Well, guess what? We got hot again."
paras.zh: 马赫补充道：“你离开了你应该永远热爱的国家，因为你输掉了一两次选举，现在你看起来就像一个离开妻子的丈夫，因为她暂时放开了自己。” “嗯，你猜怎么着？我们又热起来了。”

paras.en: Maher began by making fun of conservatives who left blue states: "Let's all allow ourselves a good laugh at the people who uprooted their whole lives in blue states to move to red states that are now blue states."
paras.zh: 马赫首先取笑离开蓝州的保守派：“让我们大家一起嘲笑那些一生都在蓝州搬到红州（现在是蓝州的人）的人。”

paras.en: He praised the results of the midterms, noting, "We should all have a little more faith that democracy can still do its thing. And it's a beautiful thing. The sound of a country turning the page, catching up with its own ideals."
paras.zh: 他赞扬了中期选举的结果，并指出，“我们都应该多一点信心，相信民主仍然可以发挥作用。这是一件美丽的事情。一个国家翻过新页，追赶自己的理想的声音。”

paras.en: The HBO host's comments come after several high-profile celebrities — including comedians Rosie O’Donnell and Ellen DeGeneres — cited Trump’s election victory as their driving force for moving abroad.
paras.zh: 在这位 HBO 主持人发表上述言论之前，包括喜剧演员罗西·奥唐纳 (Rosie O’Donnell) 和艾伦·德杰尼勒斯 (Ellen DeGeneres) 在内的几位知名名人都表示，特朗普的选举胜利是他们移居海外的动力。

paras.en: "We got here the day before the election and woke up to lots of texts from our friends with crying emojis, and I was like, 'He got in,'" DeGeneres told broadcaster Richard Bacon after she and her wife, Portia de Rossi, decided to relocate to the United Kingdom, according to the BBC in 2025. "And we're like, 'We're staying here.'"
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 报道，在德杰尼勒斯和她的妻子波西亚·德·罗西 (Portia de Rossi) 决定于 2025 年搬到英国后，德杰尼勒斯对广播公司理查德·培根 (Richard Bacon) 表示：“我们在大选前一天到达这里，醒来时收到了很多朋友发来的带有哭泣表情符号的短信，我当时想，‘他进来了’。”“而我们的反应是，‘我们要留在这里。’”

paras.en: O’Donnell referred to Trump as "Mango Mussolini" on the Aug. 17 episode of "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" during a week-long guest-hosting stint that brought the 64-year-old comic back to the United States from her new home in Ireland.
paras.zh: 奥唐纳在 8 月 17 日的“吉米·金梅尔现场直播！”节目中称特朗普为“芒果墨索里尼”。在为期一周的客座主持期间，这位 64 岁的喜剧演员从爱尔兰的新家回到了美国。

paras.en: "I read that Project 2025 and said, ‘Got to get myself out of here, you know,’ and I decided to go to Ireland, a place where people are driven to drink regardless of who's running their country," O’Donnell said.
paras.zh: 奥唐纳说：“我读到《2025 计划》后说，‘你知道，我必须离开这里’，然后我决定去爱尔兰，在这个地方，无论谁统治这个国家，人们都被迫喝酒。”

paras.en: Musician Art Garfunkel also weighed the possibility of leaving the United States over Trump’s presidency, telling The Guardian earlier this year that he is unhappy with the administration’s handling of climate change, international affairs and other political issues.
paras.zh: 音乐家阿特·加芬克尔也考虑过因特朗普担任总统而离开美国的可能性，他今年早些时候告诉《卫报》，他对政府处理气候变化、国际事务和其他政治问题的方式感到不满。

paras.en: "I don’t like America’s position at all," he told the outlet. "I’m not on board, and I’m thinking of leaving the country, frankly."
paras.zh: “我根本不喜欢美国的立场，”他告诉媒体。 “我不在船上，坦白说，我正在考虑离开这个国家。”

paras.en: Maher's comments were noticed by Democratic strategist Kaivan Shroff, who suggested to Fox News Digital that the comedian could be acting a bit hypocritical in his final monologue of the season.
paras.zh: 民主党策略师凯万·史洛夫注意到了马赫的言论，他向福克斯新闻数字频道表示，这位喜剧演员在本季最后的独白中可能表现得有点虚伪。

paras.en: "This Ireland shot is obviously a Rosie O’Donnell dig, and Maher is flattening 20 years of context to make it work," Shroff said. "Trump has singled her out since 2006 and, after she left, publicly threatened to take away her citizenship."
paras.zh: “这个爱尔兰镜头显然是罗西·奥唐纳 (Rosie O’Donnell) 的挖苦，马赫正在扁平化 20 年的背景以使其发挥作用，”史洛夫说。 “特朗普自 2006 年以来一直针对她，并在她离开后公开威胁要剥夺她的公民身份。”

paras.en: "You can call her decision dramatic, but it was not some celebrity tantrum over losing an election," he added. "And Maher, who can barely tolerate criticism directed at himself, is an especially funny person to lecture somebody else about having thicker skin."
paras.zh: “你可以说她的决定是戏剧性的，但这并不是一些名人因选举失败而发脾气，”他补充道。 “马赫几乎不能容忍针对自己的批评，他是一个特别有趣的人，他会教导别人脸皮厚。”

paras.en: NewsBusters managing editor Curtis Houck told Fox News Digital: "Bill Maher will sadly be on an island when it comes to calling out people on his own team who fled the country."
paras.zh: NewsBusters 总编辑柯蒂斯·霍克 (Curtis Houck) 告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“比尔·马赫 (Bill Maher) 在呼吁他自己的团队中逃离该国的人时，可悲的是，他将陷入孤岛。”

paras.en: "Anyone returning to America as though their tantrums never happened shouldn’t be taken seriously," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“任何回到美国的人，就好像他们的脾气从未发生过一样，不应该被认真对待。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to representatives of DeGeneres and O’Donnell for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字联系了德杰尼勒斯和奥唐纳的代表请其置评。

articles.title: Zelenskyy says Russia strikes hometown, criticizes Putin-Trump meeting

paras.en: A Russian strike on Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown, Kryvyi Rih, killed two people and wounded 58 others, the Ukrainian leader said Saturday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰领导人周六表示，俄罗斯对泽伦斯基家乡克里沃罗格的袭击造成两人死亡、58 人受伤。

paras.en: A 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman were killed in the attack Friday night in the central Ukraine town, according to Oleksandr Vilkul, the head of the city administration.
paras.zh: 乌克兰中部城镇奥列克桑德·维尔库尔 (Oleksandr Vilkul) 表示，周五晚上，一名 7 岁男孩和一名 20 岁妇女在乌克兰中部城镇的袭击中丧生。

paras.en: Zelenkskyy said in a social media post the woman was an emergency medical worker and the boy was named Tykhon.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在社交媒体帖子中表示，这名妇女是一名紧急医疗工作者，男孩名叫蒂洪。

paras.en: "He was born in 2019, and, sadly, most of his life was lived during a war like this. And the Russians took his life with their strike. My condolences to their families and loved ones," Zelenkskyy said.
paras.zh: “他出生于 2019 年，可悲的是，他一生的大部分时间都是在这样的战争中度过的。俄罗斯人的罢工夺走了他的生命。我向他们的家人和亲人表示哀悼，”泽伦斯基说。

paras.en: On top of the civilian deaths and injuries, the strike sparked four fires and damaged roughly 25 apartment buildings, along with a hospital, schools, an industrial facility, businesses and vehicles.
paras.zh: 除了造成平民伤亡外，罢工还引发了四起火灾，并损坏了大约 25 栋公寓楼、一家医院、学校、工业设施、企业和车辆。

paras.en: Zelenkskyy claimed that the Russian strike hit an area of the city with no military targets.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基声称，俄罗斯的袭击袭击了该市没有军事目标的地区。

paras.en: "The strike hit an ordinary civilian area of the city – there are no military facilities nearby, and there never have been," he wrote, adding, "Russia is waging war against life, and there can be NO justification for this."
paras.zh: “这次袭击袭击了该市的一个普通平民区——附近没有军事设施，而且从来没有军事设施，”他写道，并补充道，“俄罗斯正在对生命发动战争，这是没有道理的。”

paras.en: The Ukrainian leader later commented on President Donald Trump's recent trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 这位乌克兰领导人后来评论了唐纳德·特朗普总统最近与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的三边会晤。

paras.en: "Putin didn't get his 'Yalta 2,'" Zelenskyy wrote, referring to the famed 1945 Yalta Conference between former U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill, and Soviet Premier Joseph Stalin.
paras.zh: “普京没有得到他的‘雅尔塔2’，”泽连斯基写道，指的是著名的1945年美国前总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联总理约瑟夫·斯大林之间举行的雅尔塔会议。

paras.en: "As far as I understand, he recently commented: 'What's wrong with Yalta? Those were the victories over Nazism, over fascism, and so on, that were sealed there.' First of all, indeed, this was no Yalta. Did Putin want a real Yalta? Yes. In the sense of carving up the world and changing borders. China didn't let itself be drawn into it. I don't know what happened between the United States and Russia in their bilateral, but Ukraine wasn't discussed. Nothing came out publicly. So the redrawing of borders didn't happen," Zelenskyy wrote.
paras.zh: “据我了解，他最近评论道：‘雅尔塔出了什么问题？那些战胜纳粹主义、战胜法西斯主义等等的胜利就在那里。’”首先，确实，这不是雅尔塔。普京想要一个真正的雅尔塔吗？是的。从瓜分世界和改变边界的意义上来说。中国没有让自己卷入其中。我不知道美国和俄罗斯在双边会谈中发生了什么，但没有讨论乌克兰问题。一切都没有公开。因此，边界的重新划分并没有发生，”泽连斯基写道。

paras.en: "If there really was an intention to reaffirm the victory over fascism now, then the participants at this summit would have to be the United States, Europe, and Ukraine. Definitely not Russia. I think this trilateral summit turned out very badly for Russia. Not only did Putin fail to get the results he wanted, but we also saw his reaction.
paras.zh: “如果现在真的有意重申战胜法西斯，那么这次峰会的参与者就必须是美国、欧洲和乌克兰。绝对不是俄罗斯。我认为这次三方峰会对俄罗斯来说非常糟糕。普京不仅没有得到他想要的结果，我们也看到了他的反应。

paras.en: "And, unfortunately, we saw that reaction in Ukraine. There was a massive attack that night – 111 missiles. If Putin wanted to remind the world once again who he is, there was no need – we haven't forgotten that he's a terrorist and a killer," his X post continued.
paras.zh: “不幸的是，我们在乌克兰看到了这种反应。那天晚上发生了大规模袭击——111枚导弹。如果普京想再次提醒世界他是谁，没有必要——我们没有忘记他是恐怖分子和杀手，”他的X帖子继续说道。

paras.en: The strike on Zelenskyy's hometown is far from uncommon, with periodic Russian attacks targeting the industrial steel town dozens of times since the start of the war in 2022.
paras.zh: 对泽连斯基家乡的袭击并不罕见，自 2022 年战争爆发以来，俄罗斯定期对这座工业钢铁小镇发动数十次袭击。

paras.en: The incident also occurred as a Russian ship was struck by drones on Saturday, causing it to catch fire in the Gulf of Finland.
paras.zh: 周六，一艘俄罗斯船只在芬兰湾被无人机击中，导致起火。

paras.en: The Russian-flagged Sparta II was struck by a drone shortly before 9 a.m. local time, according to Finnish Coast Guard Commander Mikko Simola.
paras.zh: 芬兰海岸警卫队指挥官米科·西莫拉 (Mikko Simola) 表示，当地时间上午 9 点前不久，悬挂俄罗斯国旗的 Sparta II 号被一架无人机击中。

paras.en: "Generally it should be noted that it is known that this Sparta II vessel has been used for transports for the Russian state, including the armed forces," Simola said.
paras.zh: 西莫拉说：“总的来说，应该指出的是，众所周知，这艘斯巴达二号船已被用于俄罗斯国家的运输，包括武装部队。”

paras.en: As a result of its damage, the craft entered Finnish territorial waters. Simola also noted that Finland believed a Russian helicopter crossed Finland's sovereign borders as well.
paras.zh: 由于损坏，该船进入了芬兰领海。西莫拉还指出，芬兰相信一架俄罗斯直升机也越过了芬兰的主权边界。

paras.en: Finnish officials believe that Ukraine was behind the attack.
paras.zh: 芬兰官员认为乌克兰是此次袭击的幕后黑手。

paras.en: "It is likely that Ukraine ... is behind (the attack)," Finnish armed forces spokesperson Aki-Mauri Huhtinen said.
paras.zh: 芬兰武装部队发言人阿基-毛里·胡赫蒂宁说：“乌克兰……很可能是这次袭击的幕后黑手。”

articles.title: Australian neo-Nazis among far-right groups raising hundreds of thousands via global crowdfunding platform
articles.author: Tory Shepherd

paras.en: Australian neo-Nazis have raised hundreds of thousands of dollars on the global crowdfunding platform GiveSendGo, which has been accused of facilitating the financing of hate and extremism.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚新纳粹分子在全球众筹平台 GiveSendGo 上筹集了数十万美元，该平台被指控为仇恨和极端主义融资提供便利。

paras.en: Of the 68 Australian fundraisers on the site, the White Australia party has raised the fourth-highest amount of money with $200,000 for its high court battle to overturn its ban as a designated hate group.
paras.zh: 在该网站上的 68 场澳大利亚筹款活动中，白澳大利亚党筹集了第四高的资金，达到 20 万澳元，用于向高等法院推翻其作为指定仇恨团体的禁令。

paras.en: Neo-Nazi Thomas Sewell’s legal defence fund is sixth at almost $110,000. Sewell pleaded guilty to violent disorder in October. He and others allegedly stormed Camp Sovereignty in 2025 after taking part in an anti-immigration march. Five people were injured.
paras.zh: 新纳粹分子托马斯·休厄尔 (Thomas Sewell) 的法律辩护基金排名第六，接近 11 万美元。十月，休厄尔承认犯有暴力骚乱罪。据称，他和其他人在参加反移民游行后于 2025 年袭击了主权营。五人受伤。

paras.en: GiveSendGo was set up after GoFundMe started cracking down on hate groups. It says its aims are to “share the Hope of Jesus through crowdfunding” and to “stand for freedom”.
paras.zh: GiveSendGo 是在 GoFundMe 开始打击仇恨团体后成立的。它表示其目标是“通过众筹分享耶稣的希望”和“支持自由”。

paras.en: Most crowdfunding on the site is for uncontroversial causes – medical procedures, funerals for relatives, saving endangered species or creative projects.
paras.zh: 该网站上的大多数众筹都是为了没有争议的原因——医疗程序、亲属葬礼、拯救濒危物种或创意项目。

paras.en: Other asks are overtly political – the top Australian fundraisers are from anti-trans and anti-abortion activists.
paras.zh: 其他要求则具有明显的政治性——澳大利亚最大的筹款活动来自反跨性别者和反堕胎活动人士。

paras.en: Last year a Minnesota woman who admitted calling a child the N-word raised more than US$750,000 on the site to “protect [her] family”.
paras.zh: 去年，一名明尼苏达州妇女承认用 N 字眼称呼自己的孩子，并在该网站上筹集了超过 75 万美元以“保护她的家人”。

paras.en: The co-founder of GiveSendGo, Jacob Wells, defended hosting that fundraiser, saying he believed in “freedom of speech, freedom of association” and that those were foundational tenets of society.
paras.zh: GiveSendGo 的联合创始人雅各布·威尔斯 (Jacob Wells) 为主办这次筹款活动进行了辩护，称他相信“言论自由、结社自由”，而这些是社会的基本原则。

paras.en: In 2022 the US Anti-Defamation League (ADL) Centre on Extremism found GiveSendGo hosted 230 campaigns “operated by or for extremists and their causes”. The centre found crowdfunding platforms had raised more than US$6m for extremist campaigns, and GiveSendGo was responsible for collecting more than 86.5% of that money from 2016 to 2022.
paras.zh: 2022 年，美国反诽谤联盟 (ADL) 极端主义中心发现，GiveSendGo 举办了 230 场“由极端分子及其事业运作或为极端分子及其事业运作”的活动。该中心发现，众筹平台已为极端主义活动筹集了超过 600 万美元，而 GiveSendGo 在 2016 年至 2022 年期间筹集了其中 86.5% 以上的资金。

paras.en: “Extremist campaigns found on these platforms espouse hateful rhetoric including antisemitism, white supremacy, QAnon conspiracies and anti-LGBTQ+ extremism, as well as rhetoric from antisemitic sects of Black Hebrew Israelites,” it found.
paras.zh: 报告发现：“这些平台上发现的极端主义活动宣扬仇恨言论，包括反犹太主义、白人至上、QAnon 阴谋和反 LGBTQ+ 极端主义，以及希伯来以色列黑人反犹太教派的言论。”

paras.en: In 2023, the Australia/Israel & Jewish Affairs Council (Aijac) called on the Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) Australia – which that year featured the Coalition senator Jacinta Nampijinpa Price and former prime minister Tony Abbott – to dump GiveSendGo as its gold sponsor because of its use by neo-Nazis and other extremist groups.
paras.zh: 2023 年，澳大利亚/以色列和犹太事务委员会 (Aijac) 呼吁澳大利亚保守党政治行动会议 (CPAC)（当年的参会者包括联盟党参议员 Jacinta Nampijinpa Price 和前总理托尼·阿博特）放弃 GiveSendGo 作为其黄金赞助商，因为它被新纳粹和其他极端主义团体利用。

paras.en: A spokesperson for GiveSendGo said it did not “condone racism, discrimination, hate speech, or violence of any kind”.
paras.zh: GiveSendGo 的发言人表示，它不“纵容种族主义、歧视、仇恨言论或任何形式的暴力”。

paras.en: “Fundraisers that violate those rules are subject to moderation or removal.”
paras.zh: “违反这些规则的筹款活动将受到限制或删除。”

paras.en: Dr Matt Wade, a senior lecturer in social inquiry at LaTrobe University, has studied the interaction between crowdfunding platforms and extremist movements.
paras.zh: 马特·韦德博士是拉筹伯大学社会调查高级讲师，他研究了众筹平台与极端主义运动之间的相互作用。

paras.en: Speaking broadly about GiveSendGo, not specifically about Australia, he said platform’s policies and how they are enforced had “gravely serious implications” and that GiveSendGo’s claim to be a free speech defender made it a “safe haven for white supremacist and neo-Nazi causes”.
paras.zh: 他广泛谈论了 GiveSendGo，而不是具体谈论澳大利亚，他表示平台的政策及其执行方式具有“严重影响”，而 GiveSendGo 自称是言论自由捍卫者，使其成为“白人至上主义和新纳粹事业的避风港”。

paras.en: Hosting a fundraising campaign tacitly lent any cause legitimacy, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，举办筹款活动默认了任何事业的合法性。

paras.en: “Crucially, in key cases that are harbingers of growing far-right influence, these donations are not simply expressions of sympathy or support, but outright endorsements of the actions that the beneficiaries took,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“至关重要的是，在预示着极右势力影响力不断增强的关键案件中，这些捐款不仅仅是表达同情或支持，而是对受益人所采取行动的直接认可。”

paras.en: It expects donors to give only to those they know and trust, and does not confirm that every statement in a fundraiser is true.
paras.zh: 它希望捐助者只向他们认识和信任的人捐款，并且不确认筹款活动中的每项陈述都是真实的。

paras.en: It bans any fundraisers for abortion, gender reassignment for minors and anything illegal.
paras.zh: 它禁止任何为堕胎、未成年人变性以及任何非法行为筹款的活动。

paras.en: The spokesperson said people had a right to ask for help, others had the right to decide whether to give, and that GiveSendGo was “not a place of judgment but a place of generosity”.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，人们有权寻求帮助，其他人有权决定是否给予帮助，GiveSendGo“不是一个判断的地方，而是一个慷慨的地方”。

paras.en: Wade said GiveSendGo’s claim to ban the promotion of racism was questionable.
paras.zh: 韦德表示，GiveSendGo 声称禁止宣扬种族主义的说法值得怀疑。

paras.en: “Many would argue that, at best, the qualifier of ‘stated or demonstrable purpose’ is wilfully naive and far too narrowly construed, given the ultimate aspirations and raison d’être of some of the figures they host on their platform,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“许多人会认为，考虑到他们在平台上托管的一些人物的最终愿望和存在的理由，‘陈述或可证明的目的’这一限定词充其量是故意天真的，而且解释得太狭隘了。”

paras.en: The top Australian fundraiser currently on the site is for Sall Grover, founder of the Giggle for Girls app, with almost $2m raised. Grover is fighting the federal court finding that her app discriminated against trans woman Roxanne Tickle.
paras.zh: 目前该网站上澳大利亚筹款最多的是 Giggle for Girls 应用程序的创始人 Sall Grover，筹集了近 200 万美元。格罗弗正在对抗联邦法院的裁决，因为她的应用程序歧视跨性别女性罗克珊·蒂克尔(Roxanne Tickle)。

paras.en: Next is the anti-abortion activist Joanna Howe, who has raised almost $400,000 to pursue legal action under the Fair Work Act against her employer, Adelaide University, because of its investigations into almost 200 allegations against her.
paras.zh: 接下来是反堕胎活动人士乔安娜·豪 (Joanna Howe)，她已筹集近 40 万澳元，根据《公平工作法》对她的雇主阿德莱德大学采取法律行动，因为阿德莱德大学对近 200 项针对她的指控进行了调查。

paras.en: Her husband, James Howe, has raised another $180,000 for a potential defamation case.
paras.zh: 她的丈夫詹姆斯·豪 (James Howe) 又为潜在的诽谤案筹集了 18 万美元。

paras.en: Both Howes say on the site they would use any money left over to “transition” their careers.
paras.zh: 豪夫妇在网站上表示，他们将用剩下的钱来“过渡”他们的职业生涯。

paras.en: The Sedra family has raised about $340,000 for help to “move to a safe home”. Andrew and Noleen Sedra, a married couple who are both pastors at the Pentecostal Echo church in Sydney, claim they were threatened at their home by “LGBTQ left-wing activists”. Other reports have cast doubt on that claim.
paras.zh: Sedra 一家已筹集了约 34 万美元，用于帮助“搬到安全的家”。安德鲁·塞德拉 (Andrew Sedra) 和诺琳·塞德拉 (Noleen Sedra) 是一对已婚夫妇，都是悉尼五旬节回声教堂的牧师，他们声称他们在家中受到“LGBTQ 左翼活动人士”的威胁。其他报道对这一说法提出了质疑。

articles.title: Cigarettes on silver platters at Bondi ‘clean’ beauty business lip gloss launch referred for investigation
articles.author: Melissa Davey Medical editor

paras.en: An Australian beauty company that promotes “clean” ingredients “free from skin irritants” has been referred to state health regulators after appearing to offer cigarettes to guests at a beachside lip gloss launch.
paras.zh: 一家澳大利亚美容公司宣传“不含皮肤刺激物”的“清洁”成分，因在海滨唇彩发布会上向客人提供香烟而被移交州卫生监管机构。

paras.en: Photos from an event held earlier in November at a venue in Bondi, Sydney show what appears to be loose cigarettes without health warnings on a tiered silver platter alongside a bowl of lip glosses.
paras.zh: 11 月初在悉尼邦迪 (Bondi) 的一个场所举行的一次活动的照片显示，分层银盘上放着似乎是没有健康警告的散装香烟，旁边放着一碗唇彩。

paras.en: “Celebrating the launch of our soft gloss with our community,” one post from the event shared by the Copini Beauty account on Instagram read, with an accompanying carousel of images showing what appeared to be cigarettes on display with Copini-branded match boxes, lipglosses and glasses of wine.
paras.zh: Copini Beauty 帐户在 Instagram 上分享的一篇活动帖子写道：“与我们的社区一起庆祝我们推出的柔光唇彩”，并附有一张图片轮播图，其中展示的似乎是香烟，旁边还有 Copini 品牌的火柴盒、唇彩和酒杯。

paras.en: The images are also featured in a highlight reel from the event on the official Instagram page for the brand.
paras.zh: 这些图片还出现在该品牌官方 Instagram 页面上的活动精彩片段中。

paras.en: Copini is co-founded by influencer Casey James and product developer Carla McGraw.
paras.zh: Copini 由影响者 Casey James 和产品开发人员 Carla McGraw 共同创立。

paras.en: Under the Public Health (Tobacco and Other Products) Act 2023, advertising or promoting smoking or the use of tobacco products is prohibited. Both state and federal laws prohibit businesses offering, giving or distributing a free tobacco product.
paras.zh: 根据《2023 年公共卫生（烟草和其他产品）法》，禁止广告或宣传吸烟或使用烟草产品。州和联邦法律均禁止企业提供、赠送或分发免费烟草产品。

paras.en: Any tobacco supplied must also meet strict product standards, such as displaying mandatory graphic health warnings. The cigarettes at the Copini launch do not appear to carry any health warnings on the filter as required, indicating they are illicit products. Buying or supplying illicit tobacco is illegal in Australia, regardless of the quantity.
paras.zh: 提供的任何烟草还必须符合严格的产品标准，例如显示强制性图形健康警语。 Copini 发布会上的香烟似乎没有按照要求在过滤嘴上贴有任何健康警告，表明它们是非法产品。在澳大利亚，购买或供应非法烟草都是非法的，无论数量如何。

paras.en: Cigarettes in Australia cannot legally carry brand logos. The cigarettes appear to carry the Manchester “sapphire blue” branding, one of the most common illicit tobacco products in Australia. They are considered unlabelled under Australian law because they do not carry official government health warnings and compliant packaging.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的香烟不能合法地带有品牌标志。这些香烟似乎带有曼彻斯特“宝石蓝”品牌，这是澳大利亚最常见的非法烟草产品之一。根据澳大利亚法律，它们被视为无标签，因为它们没有政府官方健康警告和合规包装。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the NSW health minister, Ryan Park, said of the event and images: “This has been referred to NSW health’s centre for regulation and enforcement.”
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州卫生部长瑞安·帕克(Ryan Park)的发言人谈到这一事件和图片时表示：“这已被提交给新南威尔士州卫生监管和执法中心。”

paras.en: The centre works with state and federal authorities to regulate smoking products and has powers to inspect premises, seize illicit stock, issue fines and prosecute offenders.
paras.zh: 该中心与州和联邦当局合作监管吸烟产品，并有权检查场所、扣押非法库存、处以罚款和起诉违法者。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the federal health department said the government is “deeply concerned about advertising or promotion that glamorises smoking or the use of tobacco products, or helps normalise tobacco use, particularly where it might reach young people”.
paras.zh: 联邦卫生部门发言人表示，政府“对美化吸烟或烟草制品使用或帮助烟草使用正常化的广告或促销深感担忧，特别是在年轻人可能受到影响的情况下”。

paras.en: “There is no appropriate place for tobacco products to be used as a promotional prop or to make smoking appear fashionable or appealing,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“烟草产品没有适当的地方可以用作促销道具或使吸烟显得时尚或有吸引力。”

paras.en: “The government strengthened Australia’s tobacco laws to reduce the visibility and normalisation of tobacco products and protect Australians from the harms of smoking.”
paras.zh: “政府加强了澳大利亚的烟草法，以降低烟草产品的可见度和正常化，并保护澳大利亚人免受吸烟的危害。”

paras.en: The spokesperson said allegations of non-compliance with laws are taken seriously, saying the maximum penalty for criminal advertising or sponsorship of tobacco under federal laws is $728,000 for an individual, or $7.2m for a company.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，不遵守法律的指控将得到严肃处理，并表示根据联邦法律，对烟草广告或赞助的犯罪行为的最高处罚为个人 728,000 美元，或公司 720 万美元。

paras.en: Smoking accelerates ageing and causes more than 16,000 cases of cancer in Australia each year. The display of cigarettes at the launch appears to contradict Copini’s philosophy: “We’re 100% vegan, cruelty-free, and free from skin irritants and endocrine disruptors,” the website says, stating that “clean ingredients” are used in all products.
paras.zh: 在澳大利亚，吸烟会加速衰老并导致超过 16,000 例癌症病例。发布会上展示的香烟似乎与 Copini 的理念相矛盾：“我们是 100% 纯素食、零残忍、不含皮肤刺激物和内分泌干扰物，”该网站称，并声明所有产品均使用“清洁成分”。

paras.en: The company did not respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 该公司没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: It comes amid growing concerns about the use of cigarettes by brands, and in images of celebrities, especially online, with health experts warning it risks normalising and glamourising smoking.
paras.zh: 此举正值人们对品牌和名人形象（尤其是在网上）使用香烟的担忧日益增加之际，健康专家警告称，这有可能使吸烟正常化和美化。

paras.en: Becky Freeman, a professor of tobacco control with the University of Sydney, said it was “shocking to see the resurgence” of smoking in pop culture and on red carpets.
paras.zh: 悉尼大学烟草控制教授贝基·弗里曼表示，吸烟在流行文化和红地毯上重新流行“令人震惊”。

paras.en: “But to see this really local example, in Bondi, shows this is not an international phenomena – it’s happening in a country like Australia where we have low smoking rates through strong regulations and health policies,” she said.
paras.zh: “但看看邦迪这个真正的本地例子，就表明这不是一个国际现象——它发生在像澳大利亚这样的国家，我们通过严格的法规和卫生政策实现了低吸烟率，”她说。

articles.title: ‘Six, seven, maybe more preventable deaths’: Queensland’s LNP faces reckoning over broken health system
articles.author: Andrew Messenger

paras.en: At the beginning of another Queensland parliamentary sitting week, anonymous sources were out in force, this time background briefing against the state’s Labor leader, Steven Miles.
paras.zh: 在昆士兰州议会开会的另一周开始时，匿名消息人士蜂拥而出，这次是针对该州工党领袖史蒂文·迈尔斯的背景简报。

paras.en: It is no great revelation to observers of Queensland politics that Miles, still seemingly bruised from his election loss two years ago, has struggled to find his feet as opposition leader. Many wondered why he wanted to stay on after the party’s drubbing in 2024. Some of Labor’s factional whisperers were telling anyone who would listen that the former premier’s leadership would come to an end in the weeks before Christmas.
paras.zh: 对于昆士兰政治观察家来说，迈尔斯似乎仍然因两年前的选举失败而受到重创，一直在努力寻找自己作为反对党领袖的地位，这并不是什么重大启示。许多人想知道为什么他在 2024 年工党惨败后仍想继续留任。工党的一些派系传言者告诉任何愿意倾听的人，这位前总理的领导地位将在圣诞节前几周结束。

paras.en: However, the week in parliament has ended with a revitalised opposition and a wounded LNP government. A government that has for so long seemed untouchable. A government that has now been left battling the perception that it is overseeing a broken health system.
paras.zh: 然而，本周的议会以反对派重新焕发活力和自由国家党政府受伤而告终。长期以来，这个政府似乎是不可动摇的。现在政府一直在与人们认为它正在监督一个支离破碎的卫生系统的看法作斗争。

paras.en: And a government – now in office for more than two years – finally forced to take responsibility for systems it had promised to repair; seemingly no longer able to legitimately blame the former Labor government for the litany of mistakes that led to the deaths of seven people in the care of Queensland’s health system.
paras.zh: 执政已两年多的政府最终被迫对其承诺修复的系统承担责任；似乎不再能够合理地将导致昆士兰州卫生系统七人死亡的一连串错误归咎于前工党政府。

paras.en: By the end of the week, parliament heard six people had died waiting for an ambulance in the last three weeks. One man had waited seven hours, another three. All were triaged as urgently in need of attention.
paras.zh: 到本周末，议会听说过去三周内有六人在等待救护车时死亡。一名男子等了七个小时，另一名男子等了三个小时。所有人都被分类为急需关注。

paras.en: Another man had taken his own life in the emergency department of the Prince Charles hospital after self-admitting for mental health treatment. It took staff three hours to find him.
paras.zh: 另一名男子自认接受精神健康治疗后，在查尔斯王子医院急诊室结束了自己的生命。工作人员花了三个小时才找到他。

paras.en: The health minister, Tim Nicholls, is a professional, a 20-year veteran, with the bearing of a well-paid barrister, who led the LNP to an election in 2017.
paras.zh: 卫生部长蒂姆·尼科尔斯 (Tim Nicholls) 是一名专业人士，拥有 20 年的经验，具有高薪律师的气质，曾带领自由国家党赢得 2017 年大选。

paras.en: But he struggled to cope with the parliamentary barrage.
paras.zh: 但他难以应对议会的猛烈攻击。

paras.en: In response to a question from Labor’s Joe Kelly, a former nurse, about how many ambulances had been ramped on 3 November, the night a man died while waiting for one in Townsville, Nicholls first criticised the question’s “pettiness”.
paras.zh: 在回答工党前护士乔·凯利 (Joe Kelly) 关于 11 月 3 日有多少辆救护车出动的问题时，尼科尔斯首先批评了这个问题的“琐碎”。

paras.en: “What next? Are they going to ask me what the level of fuel was in the back of the ambulances?” he responded.
paras.zh: “接下来怎么办？他们会问我救护车后面​​的燃油水平是多少吗？”他回答道。

paras.en: “There was no ramping overnight at the Townsville University hospital that night,” he finished.
paras.zh: “那天晚上汤斯维尔大学医院没有过夜，”他总结道。

paras.en: “I am very pleased to be able to correct the record for the purposes of the house,” he said, two questions later.
paras.zh: “我很高兴能够为了房子的目的而更正记录，”他在问了两个问题后说道。

paras.en: “There were at that time four ambulances, as I understand it, on the ramp waiting to off-load. That was the situation there.”
paras.zh: “据我了解，当时有四辆救护车在坡道上等待卸货。当时的情况就是这样。”

paras.en: Nicholls threw the blame at the federal government, at the former Labor state government and its “decade of decline”, a phrase repeated endlessly by government MPs, at overwhelmed hospitals full of “forgotten Australians”, a term used to refer to retirees warehoused in public hospitals for lack of a federally funded retirement home to put them in.
paras.zh: 尼科尔斯将责任归咎于联邦政府、前工党州政府及其“十年的衰落”（这句话被政府议员们不断重复），归咎于挤满了“被遗忘的澳大利亚人”的医院不堪重负，“被遗忘的澳大利亚人”是指因缺乏联邦政府资助的养老院而被安置在公立医院的退休人员。

paras.en: Endlessly, Labor hounded him: would he meet the families of the dead?
paras.zh: 工党无休止地追捕他：他会见死者家属吗？

paras.en: The answer was not quite no, but never yes either.
paras.zh: 答案并非完全否定，但也绝非肯定。

paras.en: For a government built on a small-target strategy based on responding to the grief of victims of crime – predicated on the fact that any indecisive response to a tragedy would be an inherently unconvincing one – this was a completely different emotional battle.
paras.zh: 对于一个以应对犯罪受害者的悲伤为基础的小目标战略的政府来说——基于这样一个事实，即对悲剧的任何优柔寡断的反应本质上都是不令人信服的——这是一场完全不同的情感斗争。

paras.en: By Wednesday, Nicholls was attending an emergency meeting with the premier, David Crisafulli, the health department director general, David Rosengren, and the ambulance service commissioner, Craig Emery.
paras.zh: 周三，尼科尔斯正在参加与州长戴维·克里萨富利、卫生部门局长戴维·罗森格伦和救护车服务专员克雷格·埃默里举行的紧急会议。

paras.en: The next day, after another bruising question time, he called a press conference.
paras.zh: 第二天，在又一次令人痛苦的提问之后，他召开了新闻发布会。

paras.en: Bearing his well-worn years-old folder labelled “LABOR’S HOSPITAL FAILURES”, he insisted that he was taking responsibility – for making sure his subordinates were doing their jobs.
paras.zh: 他拿着他已经用了好几年的文件夹，上面贴着“工党医院失败”的标签，坚称他正在承担责任——确保他的下属做好他们的工作。

paras.en: “I think people would expect that, as the minister, I hold the DG and the commissioner responsible for the services that they deliver, and I seek answers to questions,” he said.
paras.zh: “我认为人们会期望，作为部长，我让总干事和专员对他们提供的服务负责，并寻求问题的答案，”他说。

paras.en: “So I sought advice from the commissioner about the steps that they were taking, what was being done to address the need, what was the root cause of the problem.”
paras.zh: “因此，我向专员寻求建议，了解他们正在采取的步骤、正在采取哪些措施来满足需求以及问题的根本原因是什么。”

paras.en: Nicholls said the community could have confidence in the triple-zero system and paramedics, promising to reinvest whatever it was he needed to, on advice from his department.
paras.zh: 尼科尔斯表示，社区可以对“三零”系统和护理人员充满信心，并承诺根据他所在部门的建议，对他需要的一切进行再投资。

paras.en: “Like all Queenslanders, I do have questions regarding the delivery of services because one death that’s unexpected in the community is one too many,” he said.
paras.zh: “像所有昆士兰人一样，我确实对服务的提供有疑问，因为社区中意外的死亡人数太多了，”他说。

paras.en: “Every available vehicle is on the road. But the issue is there are simply not enough beds.”
paras.zh: “所有可用的车辆都在路上。但问题是根本没有足够的床位。”

paras.en: After 10 minutes, with many more questions unasked, he abruptly walked off, looking more like a traditional Queensland health minister than any in the LNP cabinet have this term.
paras.zh: 10 分钟后，在还有更多问题没有问完的情况下，他突然走开了，看上去比自由国家党内阁中任何一位部长都更像传统的昆士兰卫生部长。

paras.en: Then Miles stepped up to the microphone. After days of leadership speculation in newspapers – which has been deliberately and mischievously fanned by the government – the former health minister was on much more solid ground.
paras.zh: 然后迈尔斯走到麦克风前。经过几天报纸上对领导层的猜测——政府故意恶作剧地煽动——这位前卫生部长的立场更加坚实。

paras.en: “I have never before seen so many preventable deaths of Queenslanders left waiting hours for an ambulance to arrive, only to die before it does,” Miles said.
paras.zh: 迈尔斯说：“我以前从未见过如此多的昆士兰人本可以避免的死亡，他们等待救护车到达几个小时，结果却在救护车到来之前死去。”

paras.en: “Six, seven, maybe more preventable deaths.
paras.zh: “六、七，也许是更多可以预防的死亡。

paras.en: “It is only getting worse and worse. The worst that it’s ever been.”
paras.zh: “情况只会变得越来越糟。这是有史以来最糟糕的。”

paras.en: Miles retains significant goodwill from most Labor MPs, but the polls have become hard for most to ignore. Some think he’s simply failed to land enough punches. Others that he hasn’t thrown nearly enough.
paras.zh: 迈尔斯在大多数工党议员中保留着巨大的善意，但民意调查已经让大多数人难以忽视。有些人认为他只是没有打出足够的拳头。其他的他还没有扔得足够多。

paras.en: It remains to be seen whether Miles’s decision to come out swinging was the act of an opposition leader with nothing to lose, deciding to fight at five minutes to midnight in his political career.
paras.zh: 迈尔斯决定出来摇摆是否是一个没有什么可失去的反对派领导人的行为，决定在他的政治生涯中在距离午夜五分钟时战斗还有待观察。

paras.en: One thing is certain. After two years in which the opposition has rarely felt relevant, this week Queensland politics finally felt like a fair fight.
paras.zh: 有一点是确定的。两年来，反对派很少感到相关，本周昆士兰政治终于感觉像是一场公平的战斗。

articles.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database

paras.en: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its criminal information database, US media reports, citing two people briefed on the issue.
paras.zh: 美国媒体援引两名知情人士的话报道称，联邦调查局正在调查其犯罪信息数据库明显遭到破坏的事件。

paras.en: The National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information on warrants and background checks.
paras.zh: 联邦和地方执法部门使用国家犯罪信息中心 (NCIC) 数据库来共享有关逮捕令和背景调查的信息。

paras.en: It would not be the first time hackers have targeted the FBI, the domestic intelligence and security service of the US. The agency did not immediately respond to the BBC's request for comment.
paras.zh: 这并不是黑客第一次针对美国国内情报和安全部门联邦调查局 (FBI)。该机构没有立即回应 BBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: When asked about the breach in a Fox News interview on Saturday, President Donald Trump said he had "just heard" about the hack. "I will say that it's not good. I don't like that," he said.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在周六接受福克斯新闻采访时被问及此次黑客攻击事件时表示，他“刚刚听说”了此次黑客攻击。 “我会说这不好。我不喜欢这样，”他说。

paras.en: "But maybe we'll learn things that we would've never learned otherwise," the president added.
paras.zh: “但也许我们会学到一些我们永远不会学到的东西，”总统补充道。

paras.en: This apparent breach of FBI database comes after a string of tech outages which hit banking, air traffic control and other sectors in the US last week. Officials have said they were not caused by cyberattacks, but the blackouts have sparked scrutiny from lawmakers.
paras.zh: 上周，美国银行业、空中交通管制和其他部门发生一系列技术中断事件，导致联邦调查局数据库明显遭到破坏。官员们表示，这不是由网络攻击引起的，但停电事件引发了立法者的审查。

paras.en: White House National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross was fired this week, with US President Donald Trump saying he was not good enough.
paras.zh: 白宫国家网络主管肖恩·凯恩克罗斯 (Sean Cairncross) 本周被解雇，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 表示他不够好。

paras.en: In September, the FBI said it was investigating an apparent breach by a cyber-crime group ShinyHunters, which claimed it had stolen sensitive information on all bureau staff - around 38,000 people.
paras.zh: 9 月，FBI 表示正在调查网络犯罪组织 ShinyHunters 的一起明显违规行为，该组织声称窃取了联邦调查局所有工作人员（约 38,000 人）的敏感信息。

paras.en: After that hack, one former FBI agent told the BBC he feared for the safety of current employees, whose personal information could soon become available online to criminals and hostile nation-state hackers.
paras.zh: 在那次黑客攻击之后，一名前联邦调查局特工告诉英国广播公司，他担心现任员工的安全，他们的个人信息很快就会被犯罪分子和敌对的民族国家黑客在网上获取。

paras.en: In a separate development, NBC reported an apparent cyberattack against the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) .
paras.zh: 在另一项进展中，NBC 报道了针对美国农业部 (USDA) 的明显网络攻击。

paras.en: Employees were informed on Thursday that its farm payment system had been targeted, NBC said.
paras.zh: NBC 称，员工周四获悉其农场支付系统已成为攻击目标。

paras.en: The USDA has not publicly commented on the issue.
paras.zh: 美国农业部尚未对此问题公开发表评论。

articles.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland

paras.en: A Russian cargo vessel bound for the country's Baltic exclave Kaliningrad has been hit by a drone attack in the eastern Gulf of Finland, Russian and Finnish authorities say.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和芬兰当局称，一艘开往该国波罗的海飞地加里宁格勒的俄罗斯货船在芬兰湾东部遭到无人机袭击。

paras.en: The ship - the Sparta II - caught on fire after the strike on Saturday morning, before drifting into Finnish waters. Finnish defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind the attack. Kyiv has yet to comment.
paras.zh: 这艘名为“斯巴达二号”的船在周六早上的袭击后起火，随后漂入芬兰水域。芬兰国防军表示，乌克兰很可能是此次袭击的幕后黑手。基辅尚未发表评论。

paras.en: "War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity," Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said. "Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor."
paras.zh: 芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波表示：“战争正在蔓延到我们附近。” “乌克兰有权反击侵略者。”

paras.en: Kaliningrad Governor Alexei Besprozvannykh said two drones had been used, based on preliminary information, and there was "no threat" to the territory's supplies.
paras.zh: 加里宁格勒州长阿列克谢·贝斯普罗兹万内赫表示，根据初步信息，使用了两架无人机，该地区的供应“没有受到威胁”。

paras.en: The Sparta II was sanctioned by the US in 2022 and Ukraine earlier this year, and is run by a Russian company, according to the Ukrainian and US governments.
paras.zh: 据乌克兰和美国政府称，Sparta II 于 2022 年受到美国和今年早些时候乌克兰的制裁，由一家俄罗斯公司运营。

paras.en: The company says on its website that it was established within the structure of Russia's defence ministry in 2011 and since 2015 has been operating within the military construction complex.
paras.zh: 该公司在其网站上表示，它于 2011 年在俄罗斯国防部的框架内成立，自 2015 年以来一直在军事建筑群内运营。

paras.en: Finland's coast guard said it had been alerted to the attack at around 08:50 local time (06:50 GMT) on Saturday and that the cargo vessel had been located approximately 50km west of the island of Suursaari in the Gulf of Finland.
paras.zh: 芬兰海岸警卫队表示，已于周六当地时间 08:50（格林威治标准时间 06:50）左右接到袭击警报，该货船位于芬兰湾 Suursaari 岛以西约 50 公里处。

paras.en: This prompted "temporary aviation and maritime restrictions" around the area, Finnish border officials said.
paras.zh: 芬兰边境官员表示，这促使该地区周围出现“临时航空和海上限制”。

paras.en: Shortly after the incident, Finland's defence ministry said a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating the country's airspace, potentially linked to "rescue or tracking operations".
paras.zh: 事件发生后不久，芬兰国防部表示，一架俄罗斯直升机涉嫌侵犯该国领空，可能与“救援或追踪行动”有关。

paras.en: A Russian rescue vessel approached the ship and was told by the crew that they did not need to be evacuated, Kaliningrad's governor wrote on Telegram, adding: "The crew is currently carrying out the necessary work and plans to continue on its way."
paras.zh: 加里宁格勒州长在 Telegram 上写道，一艘俄罗斯救援船接近该船，船员告诉他们不需要撤离，并补充道：“船员目前正在进行必要的工作，并计划继续航行。”

paras.en: The Finnish Border Guard later said the crew had been evacuated to another Russian vessel that was now already en route to Russia. The Russian rescue vessel had remained at the location of the stricken ship.
paras.zh: 芬兰边防卫队后来表示，船员已被疏散到另一艘俄罗斯船只上，该船只目前已在前往俄罗斯的途中。俄罗斯救援船仍留在失事船只所在地。

paras.en: It added that no environmental damage had been detected and that there was no danger to maritime traffic or people.
paras.zh: 它补充说，没有发现环境破坏，海上交通或人员没有危险。

paras.en: Kaliningrad is a Russian exclave that sits between Poland and Lithuania.
paras.zh: 加里宁格勒是位于波兰和立陶宛之间的俄罗斯飞地。

paras.en: Defence Minister Antti HÃ¤kkÃ¤nen said that the Finnish Border Guard were responsible for the investigation into the attack and were co-operating with other relevant authorities.
paras.zh: 国防部长安蒂·哈克宁表示，芬兰边防卫队负责对此次袭击事件进行调查，并正在与其他有关当局合作。

paras.en: Nato has also been informed, the defence ministry said.
paras.zh: 国防部表示，北约也已获悉此事。

paras.en: The Baltic Sea has become a flashpoint in the Russia-Ukraine war, triggered when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Ukraine has recently ramped up its long-range attacks against Russia beyond the front lines.
paras.zh: 波罗的海已成为俄乌战争的爆发点，起因是俄罗斯于2022年对乌克兰发动全面入侵。乌克兰最近加大了对俄罗斯前线以外地区的远程攻击力度。

paras.en: Earlier this month, a Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，乌克兰无人机袭击了芬兰湾的一艘俄罗斯军舰。

articles.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock

paras.en: Negotiations at the COP31 UN climate summit in Turkey are in deadlock after running more than 36 hours into overtime with countries unable to agree on a new global climate deal.
paras.zh: 在土耳其举行的 COP31 联合国气候峰会上，谈判陷入僵局，经过 36 个多小时的加班，各国未能就新的全球气候协议达成一致。

paras.en: The EU and Pacific island nations are amongst a group pushing back against the latest draft agreement which included no reference to reducing the world's demand for fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 欧盟和太平洋岛国是反对最新协议草案的群体之一，该协议草案没有提到减少世界对化石燃料的需求。

paras.en: A second sticking point involves a push from the Africa Group to get commitments on more money for adaptation - but the EU has previously said it would not support this.
paras.zh: 第二个症结在于非洲集团推动获得更多资金用于适应的承诺，但欧盟此前曾表示不会支持这一点。

paras.en: Negotiating teams due to fly out on Sunday morning are now moving their flights to Monday in a sign that a deal is not yet in sight.
paras.zh: 原定于周日早上出发的谈判团队现在将航班改至周一，这表明协议尚未达成。

paras.en: If countries cannot reach consensus - which is required by the UN's climate talks process - the negotiations could be suspended.
paras.zh: 如果各国无法达成共识——这是联合国气候谈判进程所要求的——谈判可能会暂停。

paras.en: In that case the summit would end with no deal and be reconvened next year. This has only happened once before since countries started holding COP climate meetings in 1995.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，峰会将在没有达成任何协议的情况下结束，并于明年重新召开。自 1995 年各国开始召开 COP 气候会议以来，这种情况只发生过一次。

paras.en: On Saturday, EU Commissioner for Climate Wopke Hoekstra said if the bloc could not get "what is needed in terms of climate action... then there's no deal."
paras.zh: 周六，欧盟气候专员沃普克·霍克斯特拉(Wopke Hoekstra)表示，如果欧盟无法获得“气候行动所需的东西……那么就不会达成协议。”

paras.en: The UK's chief negotiator, Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh, remained more hopeful and said her team was still working to get an agreement.
paras.zh: 英国首席谈判代表、能源大臣米亚塔·法恩布拉(Miatta Fahnbulleh)仍然充满希望，并表示她的团队仍在努力达成协议。

paras.en: "These are difficult negotiations, but discussions remain productive and there is a deal to be done. The UK is pushing hard for an outcome and we will keep working in the coming hours to bring countries together."
paras.zh: “这些谈判很艰难，但讨论仍然富有成效，并且有一项协议需要完成。英国正在努力推动取得成果，我们将在未来几个小时内继续努力，让各国走到一起。”

paras.en: Another risk is that negotiating teams have to start journeys homw, and the meeting could lose the critical number of nations needed to pass any global agreement.
paras.zh: 另一个风险是谈判团队必须开始旅程，而会议可能会失去通过任何全球协议所需的关键数量的国家。

paras.en: Ministers from Panama, Solomon Islands, Cote d'Ivoire and the EU are fighting to get a commitment to move away from oil, gas and coal back into the final agreement after fossil fuel producers led by Saudi Arabia pushed for its removal.
paras.zh: 在以沙特阿拉伯为首的化石燃料生产国推动取消石油、天然气和煤炭承诺后，巴拿马、所罗门群岛、科特迪瓦和欧盟的部长们正在努力争取将石油、天然气和煤炭的承诺重新纳入最终协议中。

paras.en: "It is not acceptable to have a COP or a cover decision that does not even mention fossil fuels and we simply will not put up with it," said Juan Carlos Navarro, Panama's minister for the environment.
paras.zh: 巴拿马环境部长胡安·卡洛斯·纳瓦罗表示：“缔约方大会或封面决定甚至不提及化石燃料，这是不可接受的，我们根本不会容忍。”

paras.en: His words were echoed by France's Minister of Ecological Transition, Monique Barbut.
paras.zh: 他的话得到了法国生态转型部长莫尼克·巴布的回应。

paras.en: She took aim at several references in the text to carbon capture, use and storage - the technology that takes emissions when they are released and stores them underground - as a licence for other countries to keep burning oil and gas.
paras.zh: 她瞄准了文中多次提到的碳捕获、使用和储存——这种技术在释放排放物时将其储存在地下——作为其他国家继续燃烧石油和天然气的许可证。

paras.en: "We cannot be announcing to the world that we are now getting to 1.5 increase in the temperature and do business like nothing was happening," Barbut said.
paras.zh: 巴布特说：“我们不能向世界宣布气温已上升 1.5 度，却又像什么都没发生一样开展业务。”

paras.en: For the first time at a COP the agreement - known officially as the Antalya Accords - could acknowledge that the goal of keeping global temperature rise below 1.5C has been missed.
paras.zh: 该协议（正式名称为《安塔利亚协议》）首次在缔约方大会上承认，将全球气温升幅控制在 1.5 摄氏度以下的目标已经实现。

paras.en: The world is entering a period called "overshoot".
paras.zh: 世界正在进入一个被称为“超调”的时期。

paras.en: Beyond this point scientists warn, external that millions more people will be exposed to sea level rise and extreme heat.
paras.zh: 超过这一点，科学家对外警告说，数百万人将面临海平面上升和极端高温的影响。

paras.en: But Chris Bowen, Australia's climate change and energy minister who is leading negotiations, pushed back on the need to include language on fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 但领导谈判的澳大利亚气候变化和能源部长克里斯·鲍文(Chris Bowen)反对纳入有关化石燃料的措辞的必要性。

paras.en: He argued that this summit was about implementation, and should focus on the move towards clean energy sources.
paras.zh: 他认为，这次峰会是关于落实的，应该重点关注向清洁能源的发展。

paras.en: Away from COP, renewable energy is growing at unprecedented rates. For the first time this year a modern renewable source - solar panels - was the biggest contributor to meeting new global energy demand, outstripping oil and gas, external.
paras.zh: 除了 COP 之外，可再生能源正以前所未有的速度增长。今年，现代可再生能源——太阳能电池板——首次成为满足全球新能源需求的最大贡献者，超过了石油和天然气。

paras.en: The International Energy Agency also warned this week that the longer disruption to fuel supplies through the Strait of Hormuz due to the Iran War, the stronger the incentive to switch to electricity powered by renewables.
paras.zh: 国际能源署本周还警告称，伊朗战争导致霍尔木兹海峡燃料供应中断的时间越长，改用可再生能源电力的动力就越强。

paras.en: Although, this week US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed at a meeting in Shenzhen to increase oil production in the face of fuel supply disruption.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，本周美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在深圳举行的一次会议上同意在面临燃料供应中断的情况下增加石油产量。

paras.en: It is understood that one proposal is to keep fossil fuels off the table in exchange for Saudi Arabia and other petro-states signing up to a pledge for 35% of their energy consumption to come from electricity by 2035.
paras.zh: 据了解，其中一项提议是不考虑化石燃料，以换取沙特阿拉伯和其他石油国家签署承诺，到 2035 年其能源消耗的 35% 来自电力。

paras.en: This does not solve one of the other key issues raised by developing nations - the lack of money.
paras.zh: 这并没有解决发展中国家提出的其他关键问题之一——缺乏资金。

paras.en: Earlier versions of the text included an agreement to ramp up money for adaptation to $120bn (Â£91bn) by 2035 - that figure has now been removed.
paras.zh: 该文本的早期版本包括一项到 2035 年将适应资金增加到 1200 亿美元（910 亿英镑）的协议，但该数字现已被删除。

paras.en: "We did not come here to beg, we came here to claim what is rightfully ours for our people who are suffering the brunt of anthropogenic activities of developed countries," said Zanetor Agyeman Rawlings, Ghana's Environment Minister and chair of the African Group of negotiators.
paras.zh: 加纳环境部长兼非洲谈判小组主席扎内托·阿吉曼·罗林斯表示：“我们不是来这里乞讨的，我们来这里是为了为我们的人民索取应有的东西，这些人民正遭受发达国家人为活动的冲击。”

paras.en: Climate activists and environmental groups, who are observers to these talks, have slammed negotiations.
paras.zh: 作为这些谈判观察员的气候活动人士和环保组织对谈判进行了猛烈抨击。

paras.en: "I can tell you without any doubt that this has been the worst COP ever," said Mohamed Adow of Powershift Africa.
paras.zh: Powershift Africa 的穆罕默德·阿多 (Mohamed Adow) 表示：“我可以毫无疑问地告诉你，这是有史以来最糟糕的一次缔约方大会。”

paras.en: These groups are normally highly critical of the process for not moving fast enough. But it seems that Turkey have been particularly unpopular as hosts after their lead negotiator walked out of some crucial negotiations leaving many countries feeling "disrespected", said one observer.
paras.zh: 这些团体通常对这一进程的进展速度不够快表示高度批评。但一位观察家表示，土耳其作为东道主似乎特别不受欢迎，因为他们的首席谈判代表退出了一些关键谈判，让许多国家感到“不受尊重”。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用运输卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: Carlisle 的 EL121 系列盘式刹车片现已通过 Carlisle 授权经销商和分销商发售。要了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的卡莱尔授权经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表 https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle 发布 Ag 视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了提高可视化效果，该视频采用 3D 动画和标准拖拉机模型中的产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com
