articles.title: SEMA Names Ryan Mascoli Chief Operations Officer
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Specialty Equipment Market Association (SEMA) has named Ryan Mascoli chief operations officer. Mascoli joins SEMA effective Nov. 16.
paras.zh: 特种设备市场协会 (SEMA) 任命 Ryan Mascoli 为首席运营官。 Mascoli 于 11 月 16 日加入 SEMA。

paras.en: Mascoli brings more than 15 years of experience in operational strategy, business transformation and growth within manufacturing and supply-chain organizations. Reporting to SEMA CEO Mike Spagnola, he will oversee day-to-day operations, advance strategic initiatives, and align teams and resources with the association’s long-term priorities.
paras.zh: Mascoli 在制造和供应链组织的运营战略、业务转型和增长方面拥有超过 15 年的经验。他向 SEMA 首席执行官 Mike Spagnola 汇报，将监督日常运营、推进战略计划，并使团队和资源与协会的长期优先事项保持一致。

paras.en: “Ryan is a proven operational leader who understands how to translate strategy into measurable results,” said Spagnola. “His experience will strengthen our executive team and help SEMA operate with greater alignment, accountability and effectiveness. By improving how we work across the organization, we will be better positioned to deliver meaningful value to our members and foster the success of the automotive aftermarket.”
paras.zh: “瑞安是一位久经考验的运营领导者，他了解如何将战略转化为可衡量的结果，”斯帕尼奥拉说。 “他的经验将增强我们的管理团队，并帮助 SEMA 以更好的协调性、责任感和效率来运作。通过改进我们整个组织的工作方式，我们将能够更好地为我们的会员提供有意义的价值，并促进汽车售后市场的成功。”

paras.en: Mascoli most recently served as vice president of operations for Advanced Charging Technologies, leading enterprise operations across manufacturing, supply chain and production. During his tenure, the company grew revenue from $25 million to $60 million while maintaining a 99.6% on-time-delivery rate. He also increased daily production output 25%, reduced order dwell time from 21 days to two and led a companywide enterprise resource planning implementation completed in three months.
paras.zh: 马斯科利最近担任先进充电技术公司的运营副总裁，领导制造、供应链和生产领域的企业运营。在他任职期间，该公司的收入从 2500 万美元增长到 6000 万美元，同时保持了 99.6% 的准时交货率。他还将日产量提高了 25%，将订单停留时间从 21 天减少到 2 天，并领导在三个月内完成了全公司范围的企业资源规划实施。

paras.en: Previously, Mascoli served as general manager and COO at ICE Cable Systems, overseeing finance, sales, supply chain, marketing, information technology and human resources. From 2019 to 2021, the company grew revenue from $10 million to $22 million and increased profit from $200,000 to $3.7 million. Earlier in his career, he held supply chain and inventory leadership positions at ICE Cable Systems and Toshiba.
paras.zh: 此前，Mascoli 曾担任 ICE Cable Systems 的总经理兼首席运营官，负责监督财务、销售、供应链、营销、信息技术和人力资源。从2019年到2021年，该公司的收入从1000万美元增加到2200万美元，利润从20万美元增加到370万美元。在其职业生涯早期，他曾在 ICE Cable Systems 和东芝担任供应链和库存领导职务。

paras.en: “SEMA plays a vital role in creating the conditions for aftermarket businesses and professionals to succeed,” said Mascoli. “I look forward to working with SEMA’s leadership, staff, board and members to strengthen operations, execute strategic priorities and deliver greater value to the industry.”
paras.zh: Mascoli 表示：“SEMA 在为售后市场企业和专业人士的成功创造条件方面发挥着至关重要的作用。” “我期待与 SEMA 的领导层、员工、董事会和成员合作，加强运营、执行战略重点并为行业创造更大价值。”

paras.en: As COO, Mascoli will establish performance measures, support annual planning and budgeting, improve organizational processes and help manage operational risks. He also will work with department leaders to support employee development and align organizational priorities with SEMA’s mission to foster the success of the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 作为首席运营官，Mascoli 将制定绩效衡量标准、支持年度规划和预算、改进组织流程并帮助管理运营风险。他还将与部门领导合作，支持员工发展，并使组织优先事项与 SEMA 促进汽车售后市场成功的使命保持一致。

paras.en: Mascoli studied business administration with an emphasis in management at California State University, Fullerton.
paras.zh: 马斯科利在加州州立大学富勒顿分校学习工商管理，主修管理学。

paras.en: For more information on SEMA, visit sema.org.
paras.zh: 有关 SEMA 的更多信息，请访问 sema.org。

articles.title: ALI Names Janelle Storey VP of Operations and Legal Affairs
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Automotive Lift Institute (ALI) has appointed Janelle Storey vice president, business operations and legal affairs. Since joining the lift safety organization, Storey has cultivated deep institutional knowledge and built a reputation for consistently driving alignment and supporting operational execution.
paras.zh: 汽车举升机构 (ALI) 任命 Janelle Storey 为副总裁，负责业务运营和法律事务。自加入电梯安全组织以来，斯托里积累了深厚的机构知识，并在持续推动协调和支持运营执行方面建立了声誉。

paras.en: In this executive role, Storey will help guide ALI’s long-term vision and support its next phase of growth and outreach while expanding her work overseeing ALI’s intellectual property, participation agreements and contracts.
paras.zh: 在担任这一行政职务期间，斯托里将帮助指导 ALI 的长期愿景，支持其下一阶段的发展和外展，同时扩大其监督 ALI 知识产权、参与协议和合同的工作。

paras.en: “Janelle brings a unique combination of insight, initiative and experience from her years of working across all areas of ALI,” said R.W. “Bob” O’Gorman, president of ALI. “By applying her leadership expertise across business operations and emerging developments, we will strengthen organizational efficiency and enhance member support. This role will also enable us to further deepen industry relationships and broaden our educational outreach. Ultimately, this move supports our commitment to advancing automotive lift safety.”
paras.zh: ALI 总裁 R.W.“Bob”O’Gorman 表示：“Janelle 凭借她在 ALI 各个领域多年的工作经验，将洞察力、主动性和经验融为一体，带来了独特的结合。” “通过运用她在业务运营和新兴发展领域的领导专业知识，我们将提高组织效率并增强会员支持。这一角色还将使我们能够进一步深化行业关系并扩大我们的教育范围。最终，这一举措支持了我们对推进汽车举升机安全的承诺。”

paras.en: Storey was named coordinator for the new ALI Lift Inspector Certification Program in 2013. She later assumed responsibility for key aspects of ALI’s flagship Lift Certification Program. Her role has since evolved to include oversight of business operations, contracts, legal affairs, marketing, training, technology and other organizational functions.
paras.zh: Storey 于 2013 年被任命为新 ALI 电梯检验员认证计划的协调员。后来，她负责 ALI 旗舰电梯认证计划的关键方面。此后，她的职责演变为包括监督业务运营、合同、法律事务、营销、培训、技术和其他组织职能。

paras.en: In this capacity, she works directly with President O’Gorman, ALI legal counsel and the board of directors. As vice president, she will lead team members and administrative personnel across these areas while spearheading cross-functional initiatives and managing intellectual property protection, compliance and enforcement.
paras.zh: 在此职位上，她直接与总裁奥戈尔曼、ALI 法律顾问和董事会合作。作为副总裁，她将领导这些领域的团队成员和管理人员，同时带头跨职能举措并管理知识产权保护、合规和执法。

paras.en: “I am honored to step into this new role to help lead ALI into its next chapter of growth,” said Storey. “As new vehicle technologies continue to reshape the service bay, I look forward to expanding our educational reach and further increasing access to automotive lift safety training across North America. I want ALI to be more than an authority; I want it to remain the trusted resource people rely on for guidance, education and confidence in lift safety.”
paras.zh: Storey 表示：“我很荣幸能够担任这一新职务，帮助带领 ALI 进入新的增长篇章。” “随着新技术不断重塑服务区，我期待着扩大我们的教育范围，并进一步增加整个北美地区汽车升降机安全培训的机会。我希望 ALI 不仅仅是一个权威；我希望它仍然是人们在升降机安全方面提供指导、教育和信心的值得信赖的资源。”

paras.en: Storey earned a bachelor’s degree from the State University of New York at Cortland in 2013 and is pursuing a master of business administration. She also serves as an elected trustee on the Homer Central School District Board of Education. She and her husband live in the district with their two children.
paras.zh: Storey 于 2013 年在纽约州立大学科特兰分校获得学士学位，目前正在攻读工商管理硕士学位。她还担任荷马中心学区教育委员会的当选受托人。她和她的丈夫带着两个孩子住在该地区。

paras.en: For more information on ALI, visit autolift.org.
paras.zh: 有关 ALI 的更多信息，请访问 autolift.org。

articles.title: Toyota issues voluntary Takata airbag recall on 314,000 vehicles
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Toyota is conducting a voluntary safety recall involving 314,000 Toyota and Lexus vehicles in the U.S. equipped with Takata front passenger airbags.
paras.zh: 丰田正在美国进行自愿安全召回，涉及 314,000 辆配备高田前排乘客安全气囊的丰田和雷克萨斯汽车。

paras.en: Takata, a bankrupt parts supplier, was responsible for manufacturing airbag canisters in defective airbag inflators that can explode and spray sharp metal fragments toward the driver and passengers, comparable to shrapnel from an exploding grenade, which has caused severe injuries and deaths.
paras.zh: 高田是一家破产的零部件供应商，负责在有缺陷的安全气囊充气机中生产安全气囊罐，这种充气机可能会爆炸，并向驾驶员和乘客喷射锋利的金属碎片，类似于爆炸手榴弹的弹片，导致严重受伤和死亡。

paras.en: The Takata airbag inflator recall is the largest safety recall in automotive history and spans worldwide. Issues first came to light in 2008. Vehicles across more than 30 brands are equipped with the airbags, according to NHTSA.
paras.zh: 高田安全气囊充气机召回是汽车史上规模最大的安全召回，涉及全球。问题于 2008 年首次曝光。据 NHTSA 称，有 30 多个品牌的车辆配备了安全气囊。

paras.en: NHTSA says the airbags have killed 28 people and caused at least 400 injuries in the U.S. It linked the 28th death to an incident that occurred in Alabama involving a Honda vehicle.
paras.zh: NHTSA 表示，安全气囊已在美国造成 28 人死亡、至少 400 人受伤。该安全局将第 28 起死亡事件与发生在阿拉巴马州的本田汽车事故联系起来。

paras.en: Toyota says it will replace the front passenger airbag inflator or airbag assembly, depending on the model, for all involved vehicles, free of charge.
paras.zh: 丰田表示，将根据车型，为所有涉及的车辆免费更换前排乘客安全气囊充气机或安全气囊总成。

paras.en: A Nov. 12 Toyota press release about the recall doesn’t list the specific vehicle models involved. Instead, it directs owners to visit Toyota.com/recall or NHTSA.gov/recalls and enter their VIN or license plate information to check for recalls.
paras.zh: 11 月 12 日，丰田关于此次召回的新闻稿并未列出涉及的具体车型。相反，它指示车主访问 Toyota.com/recall 或 NHTSA.gov/recalls 并输入其 VIN 或车牌信息以检查召回情况。

paras.en: Toyota’s Takata recall page lists several vehicle models; however, it isn’t clear which, if any, are involved in the newest recall. The page states, “If you own a Toyota, Scion, or Lexus manufactured between 2002 and 2017, your vehicle may be subject to a Safety Recall for the Takata Front Passenger Airbag Inflator or Takata Driver’s Airbag Inflator.”
paras.zh: 丰田高田召回页面列出了多种车型；然而，目前尚不清楚最新的召回涉及哪些产品（如果有的话）。该页面指出，“如果您拥有 2002 年至 2017 年间生产的丰田、Scion 或雷克萨斯汽车，您的车辆可能会因高田前排乘客安全气囊充气器或高田驾驶员安全气囊充气器而受到安全召回。”

paras.en: Toyota doesn’t provide a National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) campaign number for the newest recall, which is necessary to look up the full affected vehicle population on NHTSA’s site. NHTSA’s Takata recall page doesn’t show when it was last updated, so it’s unclear if the vehicle lists include the new recall population.
paras.zh: 丰田没有提供最新召回的国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 活动编号，这是在 NHTSA 网站上查找全部受影响车辆数量所必需的。 NHTSA 的高田召回页面没有显示上次更新时间，因此尚不清楚车辆列表是否包括新的召回人群。

paras.en: In October, NHTSA said it “cannot confirm the status” of the remaining 9% of more than 67 million recalled Takata airbags, or whether they remain on U.S. roads.
paras.zh: 10 月份，NHTSA 表示，它“无法确认超过 6700 万个被召回的高田安全气囊中剩余 9% 的状态”，也无法确认它们是否仍在美国道路上行驶。

paras.en: NHTSA categorizes each U.S. state and territory into one of three recall zones based on temperature and humidity. Toyota’s Takata page states that vehicles in Zone A, areas with high temperature cycling and humidity, could experience significant propellant degradation after six to nine years of service. Some models listed on the page date back to model year 2002.
paras.zh: NHTSA 根据温度和湿度将美国每个州和地区划分为三个召回区域之一。丰田的高田页面指出，A区（高温循环和潮湿的区域）的车辆在使用六到九年后可能会经历明显的推进剂退化。页面上列出的某些型号可以追溯到 2002 年型号。

paras.en: Toyota’s Takata page lists Zone B vehicles, areas with moderate temperature cycling and humidity, as being in service for an estimated 10-15 years before degradation occurs. It states that Zone C vehicles, areas with lower temperature cycling and humidity, could be in service for an estimated 15-20 years before degradation occurs.
paras.zh: 丰田的高田页面列出了 B 区车辆，即温度循环和湿度适中的区域，预计在退化发生前可使用 10-15 年。它指出，C 区车辆（温度循环和湿度较低的区域）预计可使用 15 至 20 年，然后才会发生性能退化。

articles.title: Mercedes-Benz to expand hands-free and point-to-point driving in 2027
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Mercedes-Benz recently announced it is expanding its MB.DRIVE portfolio to the U.S. in 2027, bringing advanced point-to-point driver assistance and hands-free highway driving.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰最近宣布将于 2027 年将 MB.DRIVE 产品组合扩展到美国，带来先进的点对点驾驶员辅助和免提高速公路驾驶。

paras.en: “With our hands-free and point-to-point assisted driving systems, we’re bringing software, sensing and computing together to offer the highest benefit to our customers,” said Jörg Burzer, Mercedes-Benz Group board of management member and chief technology officer of development and procurement, in the release. “With the touch of a button, customers’ lives become easier as the car makes point-to-point journeys almost effortless. And thanks to MB.OS, we will continue to deliver new and improved functions through regular over-the-air updates.”
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰集团管理委员会成员兼开发和采购首席技术官 Jörg Burzer 在新闻稿中表示：“通过我们的免提和点对点辅助驾驶系统，我们将软件、传感和计算结合在一起，为我们的客户提供最高的利益。” “只需按一下按钮，客户的生活就会变得更加轻松，因为汽车几乎可以毫不费力地进行点对点旅程。借助 MB.OS，我们将继续通过定期的无线更新来提供新的和改进的功能。”

paras.en: Hands-free driving on highways will become available on eligible U.S. roads in spring 2027, the release states. It doesn’t give details about when in 2027 point-to-point (MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO) assisted driving will roll out.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，高速公路上的免提驾驶将于 2027 年春季在符合条件的美国道路上实现。它没有详细说明 2027 年何时推出点对点 (MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO) 辅助驾驶。

paras.en: An early access program (EAP) will provide select eligible customers in California with access to both MB.DRIVE ASSIST Pro and hands-free highway assist starting in December.
paras.zh: 从 12 月开始，抢先体验计划 (EAP) 将为加州部分符合条件的客户提供 MB.DRIVE ASSIST Pro 和免提高速公路辅助服务。

paras.en: “MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO supports drivers along the navigation route, including in complex urban traffic, while Hands-Free Highway Assist allows drivers to take their hands off the steering wheel on eligible controlled-access highways at speeds up to 85 mph,” the release states. “Both systems are designed to reduce routine workload behind the wheel and bring the Mercedes-Benz ‘Welcome home’ feeling to the journey.”
paras.zh: “MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO 为驾驶员提供导航路线支持，包括在复杂的城市交通中，而免提高速公路辅助系统则允许驾驶员在符合条件的受控高速公路上以高达 85 英里/小时的速度将双手从方向盘上移开，”该新闻稿称。 “这两个系统的设计目的都是为了减少驾驶时的日常工作量，并为旅途带来梅赛德斯-奔驰‘欢迎回家’的感觉。”

paras.en: MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO can assist drivers with exiting the highway, changing lanes, merging into the correct lane, turning at intersections, and braking or pulling away at traffic lights, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO 可以帮助驾驶员退出高速公路、变道、并入正确车道、在十字路口转弯以及在红绿灯处制动或驶离。

paras.en: The technology uses 27 sensing components that includes 10 cameras, five radar sensors, and 12 ultrasonic sensors.
paras.zh: 该技术使用 27 个传感组件，其中包括 10 个摄像头、5 个雷达传感器和 12 个超声波传感器。

paras.en: “The sensor data is processed by a high-performance computer delivering up to 254 TOPS (Tera Operations Per Second),” the release states. “The required hardware is already installed in certain eligible 2027 vehicles, including CLA Electric, GLE, GLS and S-Class. Beginning with model year 2028, more vehicles across the Mercedes-Benz passenger car portfolio in the U.S. will be equipped to support the feature.”
paras.zh: “传感器数据由高性能计算机处理，速度高达 254 TOPS（每秒万亿次运算），”该新闻稿称。 “所需的硬件已安装在某些符合条件的 2027 年车辆中，包括 CLA Electric、GLE、GLS 和 S 级。从 2028 年车型开始，美国梅赛德斯-奔驰乘用车产品组合中的更多车辆将配备支持该功能。”

paras.en: The feature will be eligible on select Mercedes-Benz models and will offer flexible purchase options depending on the model year, the release states. The feature can be purchased digitally on eligible vehicles with the required hardware. It would be delivered via an over-the-air update.
paras.zh: 发布声明称，该功能将适用于部分梅赛德斯-奔驰车型，并将根据车型年份提供灵活的购买选项。可以在具有所需硬件的合格车辆上以数字方式购买该功能。它将通过无线更新来交付。

paras.en: “For Mercedes-Benz, leadership in driver assistance is not about a single feature,” said Jason Hoff, Mercedes-Benz North America CEO, in the release. “It’s about intelligent assistance across the entire journey. By bringing hands-free highway driving together with point-to-point assistance and expanding these technologies across our portfolio, we’re making them available to more customers across the U.S. That’s where sophisticated technology becomes meaningful: when it makes everyday driving more comfortable and convenient.”
paras.zh: “对于梅赛德斯-奔驰来说，驾驶员辅助领域的领先地位不仅仅是单一功能，”梅赛德斯-奔驰北美首席执行官杰森·霍夫(Jason Hoff)在新闻稿中表示。 “这是关于整个旅程的智能辅助。通过将免提高速公路驾驶与点对点辅助结合起来，并将这些技术扩展到我们的产品组合中，我们正在将它们提供给美国各地的更多客户。这就是复杂技术变得有意义的地方：当它让日常驾驶变得更加舒适和方便时。”

paras.en: The feature was first rolled out in 2025 in China, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，该功能将于 2025 年在中国首次推出。

paras.en: GM also announced in recent months plans to expand its “eyes-off” autonomous highway driving beyond its EV lineup to its gas-powered vehicles, including full-size SUVs and light-duty pickups, in upcoming years, according to a press release.
paras.zh: 据一份新闻稿称，通用汽车近几个月还宣布，计划在未来几年将其“无眼”自动高速公路驾驶业务从电动汽车产品线扩展到汽油动力汽车，包括全尺寸 SUV 和轻型皮卡。

paras.en: The automaker announced last year that it would launch “eyes-off” autonomous highway driving on its Cadillac ESCALADE IQ in 2028. It plans to expand the technology to its highest-volume and best-selling vehicle lineups following the Cadillac ESCALADE IQ.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商去年宣布，将于 2028 年在凯迪拉克 ESCALADE IQ 上推出“闭眼”自动高速公路驾驶。该公司计划将该技术扩展到继凯迪拉克 ESCALADE IQ 之后销量最高、最畅销的车型系列中。

paras.en: Reuters reports that, currently, GM’s Super Cruise and Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (Supervised) control steering and speed in certain settings. It adds the systems can sometimes be hands-free but require the driver to remain attentive.
paras.zh: 路透社报道称，目前，通用汽车的超级巡航和特斯拉的全自动驾驶（监督）在某些设置下控制转向和速度。它补充说，系统有时可以免提，但要求驾驶员保持注意力集中。

paras.en: Only a few automakers have introduced eyes-off systems, including Mercedes-Benz. However, service typically is limited to small geographic areas at low speeds, according to the article.
paras.zh: 只有少数汽车制造商引入了视线转移系统，包括梅赛德斯-奔驰。然而，据文章称，服务通常仅限于低速的小地理区域。

paras.en: In October, some Rivian drivers started receiving invites to the automaker’s Autonomy Early Access Program, according to the company’s website.
paras.zh: 据该公司网站称，10 月份，一些 Rivian 司机开始收到该汽车制造商 Autonomy Early Access 计划的邀请。

paras.en: The program is designed to test and refine pre-released driver assistance features before they roll out to the broader fleet. The features include “point-to-point” autonomy features.
paras.zh: 该计划旨在测试和完善预先发布的驾驶员辅助功能，然后再将其推广到更广泛的车队。这些功能包括“点对点”自治功能。

paras.en: The invitation rollout follows comments made by Rivian founder and CEO RJ Scaringe regarding the company’s plans for autonomous vehicle software during a TechCrunch Disrupt event.
paras.zh: 在此次邀请发布之前，Rivian 创始人兼首席执行官 RJ Scaringe 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 活动期间就该公司的自动驾驶汽车软件计划发表了评论。

paras.en: TechCrunch reports Scaringe said he’s willing to delay profitability to develop autonomous vehicle software for EVs. Rivian could be venturing into a different type of vehicle from its outdoorsy SUVs in the future, he said.
paras.zh: TechCrunch 报道称，斯卡林奇表示，他愿意推迟盈利时间来开发电动汽车自动驾驶软件。他表示，Rivian 未来可能会尝试推出与户外 SUV 不同类型的汽车。

articles.title: Oklahoma examination identifies unfair claims settlement violations by State Farm
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A market examination report filed last week by the Oklahoma Insurance Department (OID) shows State Farm violated the state’s Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act dozens of times and failed to timely produce records examiners requested.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州保险部 (OID) 上周提交的一份市场审查报告显示，State Farm 数十次违反了该州的《不公平索赔解决实践法》，并且未能及时提供审查员要求的记录。

paras.en: State Farm agreed to a settlement of more than $45 million after receiving the results of the OID’s examination into the company’s handling of homeowners’ claims for wind and hail damage to roofs. Within 30 days of receiving the order, State Farm must develop a Corrective Action Plan that includes the detailed steps it will take to come into full compliance with the Oklahoma Insurance Code.
paras.zh: State Farm 在收到 OID 对该公司处理房主因风和冰雹屋顶损坏索赔的处理情况进行调查的结果后，同意达成超过 4500 万美元的和解协议。 State Farm 必须在收到订单后 30 天内制定纠正行动计划，其中包括为完全遵守俄克拉荷马州保险法而将采取的详细步骤。

paras.en: The market examination period was Jan. 1, 2019 through Dec. 21, 2024, and included subsequent events through Sept. 30, 2026, when the report was filed. State Farm rebutted the report on Oct. 21.
paras.zh: 市场审查期为2019年1月1日至2024年12月21日，包括截至2026年9月30日提交报告的后续事件。 State Farm 于 10 月 21 日反驳了该报道。

paras.en: According to the report, 58 claimants out of a sample of 181 permitted engineers to inspect their roofs for potential storm damage. The report notes that examiners only reviewed the claim files of those who permitted the inspections.
paras.zh: 报告称，在 181 名索赔人样本中，有 58 名索赔人允许工程师检查他们的屋顶是否有潜在的风暴损坏。报告指出，审查员只审查了那些允许检查的人的索赔档案。

paras.en: In 27 instances, the engineers determined that storm-related roof damage was sufficient to warrant repair or replacement.
paras.zh: 在 27 个实例中，工程师确定风暴造成的屋顶损坏足以需要维修或更换。

paras.en: “The examiners requested the engineering firm calculate estimates of roof repair or replacement costs based upon prevailing costs at the time of the company’s claims determination,” the report states. “The examiners reviewed the estimates of cost to repair the roofs provided by the engineering firm and determined that in twenty-two (22) of the twenty-seven (27) instances the engineering firm’s estimates of repair or replacement exceeded the insured’s policy deductible, contrary to State Farm’s determinations on those claims.”
paras.zh: 报告指出：“审查人员要求工程公司根据公司索赔确定时的现行成本来计算屋顶维修或更换成本的估算。” “审查人员审查了工程公司提供的屋顶维修成本估算，并确定在二十七 (27) 起案例中，有二十二 (22) 起工程公司估算的维修或更换费用超过了被保险人的保单免赔额，这与 State Farm 对这些索赔的决定相反。”

paras.en: According to the market examination report, State Farm:
paras.zh: 根据市场检验报告，State Farm：

paras.en: - Violated the Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act, specifically 36 O.S. § | 250.7(A), in three instances, or 1.66% of 181 files in the sample. The report states that in each instance, State Farm “failed to notify the claimant in writing that the claim was being denied or failed to retain a copy of such denial in writing in the CWOP [closed without payment] claim file.”
paras.zh: - 违反了《不公平索赔解决实践法》，特别是 36 O.S. §| 250.7(A)，在三个实例中，占样本中 181 个文件的 1.66%。报告指出，在每种情况下，State Farm“均未能以书​​面形式通知索赔人索赔被拒绝，或未能在 CWOP [未付款结案]索赔文件中保留书面拒绝的副本。”

paras.en: - Failed to comply with the Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act, specifically 36 O.S. § 1250.5(4), in at least 22 instances from Nov. 1, 2023 through Dec. 31, 2024 “by failing to make a good-faith effort to promptly, fairly, and equitably settle roofing claims for which liability had become reasonably clear.” Twenty-two errors out of 181 files provide a sample proportion of 12.15% errors.
paras.zh: - 未能遵守《不公平索赔解决实践法》，特别是 36 O.S. § 1250.5(4)，从2023年11月1日到2024年12月31日，至少有22个案例“未能做出善意的努力，及时、公平和公正地解决责任已经相当明确的屋顶索赔。” 181 个文件中有 22 个错误提供了 12.15% 错误的样本比例。

paras.en: - Failed to comply with 36 O.S. § 309.3, which requires timely production of records responsive to reasonable written requests of the examiners.
paras.zh: - 未能遵守 36 O.S. § 309.3，要求根据审查员的合理书面要求及时提供记录。

paras.en: The report states that examiners relied on records provided by State Farm to conduct the market examination, as well as claimant storm damage inspection reports provided by the independent third-party engineer, and public court documents from litigation involving State Farm in Oklahoma.
paras.zh: 报告指出，审查人员依赖 State Farm 提供的记录进行市场审查，以及独立第三方工程师提供的索赔人风暴损害检查报告，以及涉及俄克拉荷马州 State Farm 诉讼的公开法庭文件。

paras.en: During the examination period, A.M. Best Co. gave State Farm its highest rating of A++ (superior), according to the report. The report shows that State Farm homeowners policies in force grew by nearly 2.1 million nationally and nearly 48,000 in Oklahoma between Dec. 31, 2019 and Dec. 31, 2025. And its homeowners written premium nearly doubled in Oklahoma and nationally during the same period.
paras.zh: 考试期间，A.M.据报道，Best Co. 给予 State Farm 最高评级 A++（高级）。报告显示，2019 年 12 月 31 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日期间，State Farm 的房主保单在全国范围内增加了近 210 万份，在俄克拉荷马州增加了近 48,000 份。同期，其房主在俄克拉荷马州和全国范围内的承保保费几乎翻了一番。

paras.en: The report includes, as an attachment, State Farm documents and email correspondence related to an Oklahoma home insurance claim lawsuit that were unsealed in August. At the time, the plaintiffs’ attorneys said the documents and emails prove the insurer is profiting by denying claims.
paras.zh: 该报告的附件包括与 8 月份启封的俄克拉荷马州家庭保险索赔诉讼相关的 State Farm 文件和电子邮件通信。当时，原告律师表示，这些文件和电子邮件证明保险公司通过拒绝索赔而获利。

paras.en: The report notes that the unsealed internal documents span from April 2020 through January 2024, and fulfill some of what examiners requested under the market examination but weren’t “timely produced” by State Farm.
paras.zh: 该报告指出，未密封的内部文件时间跨度为 2020 年 4 月至 2024 年 1 月，满足了审查人员在市场审查中要求的部分内容，但 State Farm 并未“及时提供”。

paras.en: Oklahoma Watch reported Monday that Mulready’s successor, Bob Sullivan, newly elected earlier this month, isn’t happy with how the state will be able to deal with State Farm moving forward under the terms of the settlement.
paras.zh: 《俄克拉荷马观察报》周一报道称，本月早些时候新当选的马尔雷迪的继任者鲍勃·沙利文对该州将如何根据和解条款处理国营农场的事宜并不满意。

paras.en: “Sullivan, in a phone interview Friday afternoon, said the settlement appeared to be good news for policyholders who have had their State Farm roof claims denied and haven’t filed their own lawsuits against the company,” the article states. “Still, he said the settlement agreement takes some regulatory flexibility off the table when it comes to dealing with State Farm.”
paras.zh: 文章称，“沙利文在周五下午的电话采访中表示，对于那些州立农场屋顶索赔被拒绝且尚未对该公司提起诉讼的投保人来说，和解似乎是个好消息。” “不过，他表示，在与 State Farm 打交道时，和解协议取消了一些监管灵活性。”

paras.en: Sullivan told Oklahoma Watch: “There’s a 12-month period where we’re not going to be opening market conduct examinations against State Farm as a result of this settlement agreement. I’m not in love with it.”
paras.zh: 沙利文告诉《俄克拉荷马观察》：“由于这项和解协议，我们将在 12 个月的时间内不会对 State Farm 进行市场行为检查。我不喜欢这样。”

paras.en: The article also states that, in a written statement, State Farm “disagreed with the conclusions in the market conduct exam.”
paras.zh: 文章还指出，State Farm 在一份书面声明中“不同意市场行为检查的结论”。

paras.en: “The company said it recorded $178.5 million in net underwriting losses in Oklahoma from 2021 to 2025,” the article states.
paras.zh: 文章称：“该公司表示，2021 年至 2025 年，其在俄克拉荷马州的净承保损失为 1.785 亿美元。”

paras.en: “‘Over the past five years, State Farm has responded to more than 100,000 claims in Oklahoma,'” the statement said, according to Oklahoma Watch. “‘A limited review of individual claims should not be mistaken for a complete picture of our overall claims-handling practices.'”
paras.zh: 据《俄克拉荷马观察报》报道，声明称，“过去五年，State Farm 已对俄克拉荷马州超过 10 万起索赔请求做出了回应”。 “‘对个人索赔的有限审查不应被误认为是对我们整体索赔处理实践的全面了解。’”

paras.en: The article adds that State Farm said, “the financial commitments in the settlement were part of a negotiated resolution, not a punitive fine imposed after State Farm accepted the report’s conclusions.”
paras.zh: 文章补充说，State Farm 表示，“和解中的财务承诺是谈判解决方案的一部分，而不是 State Farm 接受报告结论后施加的惩罚性罚款。”

paras.en: On Monday, a Cleveland County, Oklahoma judge sanctioned State Farm executives to answer questions on the stand in a pending lawsuit by two of its policyholders over a roof claim for hail damage, according to a report from Oklahoma’s News 4. The sanction comes after nearly a year of State Farm failing to produce documents for executive depositions, according to the news report.
paras.zh: 据《俄克拉荷马州新闻 4》报道，周一，俄克拉荷马州克利夫兰县的一名法官制裁 State Farm 高管，让他们在两名保单持有人就屋顶冰雹损坏索赔提起的未决诉讼中回答出庭提问。据新闻报道，该制裁是在 State Farm 近一年未能提供高管证词文件之后做出的。

paras.en: One of the plaintiffs’ attorneys said he hasn’t seen State Farm sanctioned since 2006. News 4 reports the insurer will take the stand in January.
paras.zh: 一位原告律师表示，自 2006 年以来，他从未见过 State Farm 受到制裁。News 4 报道称，该保险公司将于 1 月份出庭作证。

paras.en: This year’s CRASH Network Insurer Report Card survey is open, which asks collision repairers to grade each company from A+ to F based on how well insurers’ claims practices ensure quality repairs and customer service.
paras.zh: 今年的 CRASH Network 保险公司报告卡调查已开放，要求碰撞维修商根据保险公司的索赔实践确保维修质量和客户服务的情况，对每家公司进行从 A+ 到 F 的评级。

paras.en: In October, John Yoswick filled Repairer Driven News in on how the three-minute survey garners important information for the collision repair industry and consumers.
paras.zh: 10 月，约翰·约斯威克 (John Yoswick) 在《维修驱动新闻》(Repairer Driven News) 中介绍了这项三分钟的调查如何为碰撞维修行业和消费者获取重要信息。

paras.en: “The key reason that we believe shops should participate is the Insurer Report Card can then help educate consumers,” said Yoswick, CRASH Network’s editor. “We get 1,000 shops participating, and the result is a free report that anyone can download, including consumers, showing grades for 90-plus insurers.”
paras.zh: CRASH Network 编辑 Yoswick 表示：“我们认为商店应该参与的关键原因是保险公司报告卡可以帮助教育消费者。” “我们有 1,000 家商店参与，结果是一份任何人都可以免费下载的报告，包括消费者，其中显示了 90 多家保险公司的评级。”

paras.en: He added that the survey isn’t just on the top 10 national insurers; it includes smaller, regional carriers, depending on where carriers do business. Depending on location, repairers oftentimes grade 20 or 30 carriers in their respective state.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这项调查不仅针对全国排名前 10 的保险公司，还针对全国排名前 10 的保险公司。它包括较小的区域性运营商，具体取决于运营商开展业务的地点。根据地点的不同，维修人员通常会在各自的州对 20 或 30 个运营商进行评级。

paras.en: To request a link to the Insurer Report Card survey, visit crashnetwork.com/irc/signup.php.
paras.zh: 要请求保险公司报告卡调查的链接，请访问 crashnetwork.com/irc/signup.php。

articles.title: Power Window Problems: Is It A Bad Motor or Regulator?
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: A customer brings a vehicle into the shop because the driver’s window won’t roll up. Pressing the switch produces a clicking sound, but the glass doesn’t move. Is the motor bad, or is something inside the door preventing the window from operating?
paras.zh: 一名顾客将车辆开进商店，因为驾驶员车窗无法摇起。按下开关会发出咔嗒声，但玻璃不会移动。电机是否损坏，或者门内有什么东西阻止车窗操作？

paras.en: For a new technician, knowing how to answer that question can save time and prevent unnecessary repairs.
paras.zh: 对于新手技术人员来说，知道如何回答该问题可以节省时间并防止不必要的维修。

paras.en: Power window systems combine electrical and mechanical components. Understanding how these parts work together is the first step toward diagnosing a problem correctly.
paras.zh: 电动车窗系统结合了电气和机械部件。了解这些部分如何协同工作是正确诊断问题的第一步。

paras.en: Most power window systems use two main components: an electric motor and a window regulator.
paras.zh: 大多数电动车窗系统使用两个主要部件：电动机和车窗调节器。

paras.en: The window motor provides the power needed to move the glass. The window regulator converts that motor’s rotation into the up-and-down movement of the window.
paras.zh: 车窗电机提供移动玻璃所需的动力。车窗升降器将电机的旋转转换为车窗的上下运动。

paras.en: Depending on the vehicle, the regulator may use cables, gears, arms or a toothed plastic strip to raise and lower the glass.
paras.zh: 根据车辆的不同，调节器可以使用电缆、齿轮、臂或带齿塑料条来升高和降低玻璃。

paras.en: When the driver presses the window switch, the electrical system commands the motor to operate. On many basic systems, reversing the polarity at the motor changes its direction.
paras.zh: 当驾驶员按下车窗开关时，电气系统命令电机运转。在许多基本系统中，反转电机的极性会改变其方向。

paras.en: More advanced systems use electronic control modules to manage window movement, one-touch operation and safety features.
paras.zh: 更先进的系统使用电子控制模块来管理车窗移动、一键式操作和安全功能。

paras.en: If any part of this system fails, the window may stop moving, operate slowly or become stuck in one position.
paras.zh: 如果该系统的任何部分出现故障，车窗可能会停止移动、运行缓慢或卡在一个位置。

paras.en: Recognizing Common Power Window Problems
paras.zh: 认识电动车窗的常见问题

paras.en: Before removing a door panel, pay attention to how the window behaves. Different symptoms can help narrow down the cause.
paras.zh: 拆卸门板之前，请注意窗户的性能。不同的症状可以帮助缩小病因范围。

paras.en: • The window doesn’t move or make any noise.
paras.zh: • 窗户不会移动或发出任何噪音。

paras.en: Possible causes include a blown fuse, damaged wiring, faulty switch, control module issue or failed motor.
paras.zh: 可能的原因包括保险丝熔断、接线损坏、开关故障、控制模块问题或电机故障。

paras.en: • The motor makes noise, but the glass doesn’t move.
paras.zh: • 电机发出噪音，但玻璃不动。

paras.en: This can indicate a broken regulator cable, damaged gear or failed connection between the regulator and glass.
paras.zh: 这可能表明调节器电缆损坏、齿轮损坏或调节器与玻璃之间的连接失败。

paras.en: Worn regulator components, binding tracks or excessive friction in the window channels may be responsible. Electrical problems, including low voltage, can also affect motor performance.
paras.zh: 调节器部件磨损、固定轨道或窗户通道中的过度摩擦可能是造成这种情况的原因。电气问题（包括低电压）也会影响电机性能。

paras.en: • The window moves crooked or drops into the door.
paras.zh: • 窗户移动弯曲或掉落到门上。

paras.en: This often points to a broken regulator, damaged mounting hardware or a problem with the glass attachment.
paras.zh: 这通常表明调节器损坏、安装硬件损坏或玻璃附件有问题。

paras.en: These symptoms are useful clues, but they don’t confirm the cause. A technician still needs to test the system.
paras.zh: 这些症状是有用的线索，但它们并不能证实原因。技术人员仍需要测试系统。

paras.en: Start by operating the window and observing what happens.
paras.zh: 首先操作窗口并观察会发生什么。

paras.en: Does the window respond from either switch? Does the motor make noise? Does the glass move partway before stopping?
paras.zh: 窗口是否对任一开关做出响应？电机有噪音吗？玻璃在停止前是否移动了一半？

paras.en: If the vehicle has multiple window switches, test the affected window using both the driver’s master switch and the individual door switch, when equipped.
paras.zh: 如果车辆有多个车窗开关，请使用驾驶员的主开关和单独的车门开关（如果配备）测试受影响的车窗。

paras.en: Check whether other windows operate normally. If several windows have stopped working, the problem may involve a shared power supply, fuse or control system.
paras.zh: 检查其他窗口是否正常运行。如果多个窗户停止工作，问题可能涉及共用电源、保险丝或控制系统。

paras.en: Also inspect the glass and visible window channels for damage or obstructions.
paras.zh: 还要检查玻璃和可见的窗户通道是否有损坏或障碍物。

paras.en: Shop tip: Write down the symptoms before beginning repairs. Good diagnostic notes help you identify patterns and explain your findings to another technician or service advisor.
paras.zh: 商店提示：开始维修之前记下症状。良好的诊断记录可以帮助您识别模式并向其他技术人员或服务顾问解释您的发现。

paras.en: If the window doesn’t respond, begin with the electrical system.
paras.zh: 如果车窗没有反应，请从电气系统开始。

paras.en: Use the vehicle’s wiring diagram to identify the fuse, switch, motor, control module and related connections.
paras.zh: 使用车辆接线图识别保险丝、开关、电机、控制模块和相关连接。

paras.en: Inspect the appropriate fuse and confirm that power is reaching the circuit under the conditions specified by the manufacturer.
paras.zh: 检查适当的保险丝并确认电源在制造商指定的条件下到达电路。

paras.en: Next, check the switch and motor circuit.
paras.zh: 接下来，检查开关和电机电路。

paras.en: Depending on the system, you may need a digital multimeter to measure voltage and ground at the motor connector while commanding the window to move.
paras.zh: 根据系统的不同，您可能需要数字万用表来测量电机连接器上的电压和接地，同时命令车窗移动。

paras.en: On a conventional reversible motor circuit, the polarity across the motor terminals changes to reverse direction. On module-controlled systems, the control module may determine when and how the motor receives power.
paras.zh: 在传统的可逆电机电路中，电机端子的极性变为相反方向。在模块控制系统上，控制模块可以确定电机何时以及如何接收电力。

paras.en: If the motor receives the correct voltage and ground under load but doesn’t operate, the motor or a jammed regulator may be at fault.
paras.zh: 如果电机在负载下接收到正确的电压和接地但不运行，则电机或卡住的调节器可能出现故障。

paras.en: If the motor isn’t receiving the proper electrical supply, continue checking the wiring, switches and control components.
paras.zh: 如果电机未获得适当的电源，请继续检查接线、开关和控制组件。

paras.en: Remember: Finding battery voltage at a connector doesn’t always prove the circuit can carry enough current. Voltage-drop testing can help identify excessive resistance in wiring or connections.
paras.zh: 请记住：在连接器上查找电池电压并不总能证明电路可以承载足够的电流。压降测试可以帮助识别接线或连接中的过大电阻。

paras.en: Some modern vehicles also allow technicians to use a scan tool to check window-switch inputs, diagnostic trouble codes and control module commands.
paras.zh: 一些现代车辆还允许技术人员使用扫描工具检查车窗开关输入、诊断故障代码和控制模块命令。

paras.en: Once you’ve evaluated the electrical system, inspect the mechanical components.
paras.zh: 评估电气系统后，请检查机械部件。

paras.en: Window regulators operate every time the glass moves. Over time, cables can fray, plastic components can crack and sliding parts can wear out.
paras.zh: 每次玻璃移动时，车窗升降器都会工作。随着时间的推移，电缆可能会磨损，塑料部件可能会破裂，滑动部件可能会磨损。

paras.en: These failures may prevent the regulator from lifting the glass even when the motor operates correctly.
paras.zh: 即使电机正常运行，这些故障也可能会阻止调节器升起玻璃。

paras.en: - Loose or damaged glass mounting points
paras.zh: - 玻璃安装点松动或损坏

paras.en: A damaged regulator can also cause the glass to tilt as it moves. This may keep the window from sealing properly and lead to wind noise or water leaks.
paras.zh: 损坏的调节器也会导致玻璃在移动时倾斜。这可能会导致窗户无法正常密封并导致风噪或漏水。

paras.en: When inspecting the regulator, look for the reason it failed. Replacing a broken component without correcting a binding track or damaged guide could lead to another repair.
paras.zh: 检查调节器时，查找其失效的原因。在不纠正绑定轨道或损坏的导轨的情况下更换损坏的组件可能会导致另一次维修。

paras.en: Step 4: Remove and Replace Damaged Components Safely
paras.zh: 第 4 步：安全地拆卸和更换损坏的组件

paras.en: Replacing a window motor or regulator usually requires removing the interior door panel.
paras.zh: 更换车窗电机或调节器通常需要拆下车门内板。

paras.en: Before beginning, review the vehicle manufacturer’s service information. Door panels may contain electrical connectors, side-impact airbag components and other parts that require special handling.
paras.zh: 开始之前，请查看车辆制造商的服务信息。门板可能包含电气连接器、侧面碰撞安全气囊组件和其他需要特殊处理的部件。

paras.en: Use the recommended safety procedures, including battery disconnection when specified.
paras.zh: 使用建议的安全程序，包括在指定时断开电池连接。

paras.en: Once the panel is removed, carefully detach or move the moisture barrier to access the regulator assembly.
paras.zh: 卸下面板后，小心地拆下或移动防潮层以接近调节器组件。

paras.en: Support the window glass before disconnecting it from the regulator. Glass can drop suddenly when its mounting hardware is released.
paras.zh: 在将车窗玻璃与调节器断开连接之前，支撑住车窗玻璃。当安装硬件松开时，玻璃可能会突然掉落。

paras.en: Use the manufacturer’s recommended glass-holding equipment or an approved support method.
paras.zh: 使用制造商推荐的玻璃固定设备或经批准的支撑方法。

paras.en: Disconnect the appropriate electrical connectors and remove the regulator mounting hardware following the service procedure.
paras.zh: 按照维修程序断开相应的电气连接器并拆下调节器安装硬件。

paras.en: Some vehicles allow the motor and regulator to be replaced separately. Others use a combined assembly.
paras.zh: 有些车辆允许单独更换电机和调节器。其他人则使用组合组件。

paras.en: After installing the replacement parts, tighten all fasteners to the specified torque and check that the glass is positioned correctly in its tracks.
paras.zh: 安装更换部件后，将所有紧固件拧紧至指定扭矩，并检查玻璃是否正确放置在轨道中。

paras.en: Never place your hands in the path of moving regulator components during testing.
paras.zh: 测试期间切勿将手放在移动调节器组件的路径上。

paras.en: Step 5: Check Window Alignment and Operation
paras.zh: 第 5 步：检查窗口对齐和操作

paras.en: Installing a new regulator isn’t always the final step.
paras.zh: 安装新的调节器并不总是最后一步。

paras.en: Before reinstalling the door panel, inspect the window tracks, guides and weatherstripping.
paras.zh: 重新安装门板之前，检查窗轨、导轨和挡风雨条。

paras.en: Dirt, debris and damaged seals can create friction that makes the motor work harder. Clean and lubricate components only as directed by the manufacturer, using products compatible with the materials.
paras.zh: 污垢、碎片和损坏的密封件会产生摩擦，使电机工作更加困难。仅按照制造商的指示使用与材料兼容的产品清洁和润滑部件。

paras.en: Operate the window through its full range of travel, keeping hands and tools clear of the mechanism.
paras.zh: 在整个行程范围内操作车窗，保持手和工具远离机械装置。

paras.en: Watch for uneven movement, binding or unusual noises.
paras.zh: 注意不均匀的运动、束缚或异常噪音。

paras.en: Some vehicles require a window initialization or relearn procedure after replacing the motor or regulator or disconnecting power.
paras.zh: 有些车辆在更换电机或调节器或断开电源后需要进行车窗初始化或重新学习程序。

paras.en: This procedure allows the window control system to recognize the glass’s travel limits and operate features such as express-up and express-down correctly.
paras.zh: 此过程允许车窗控制系统识别玻璃的行程限制并正确操作快速上升和快速下降等功能。

paras.en: Follow the manufacturer’s instructions rather than assuming every vehicle uses the same reset process.
paras.zh: 请遵循制造商的说明，而不是假设每辆车都使用相同的重置过程。

paras.en: On vehicles equipped with anti-pinch protection, verify the safety feature using the approved service procedure.
paras.zh: 对于配备防夹保护的车辆，请使用批准的维修程序验证安全功能。

paras.en: Finally, reinstall the moisture barrier and door panel. Make sure the barrier seals correctly to help prevent water intrusion.
paras.zh: 最后，重新安装防潮层和门板。确保屏障正确密封，以防止水侵入。

paras.en: Imagine a vehicle comes into your shop with a front passenger window that won’t close.
paras.zh: 想象一下，一辆汽车驶入您的商店，前排乘客的车窗无法关闭。

paras.en: The customer says the motor makes noise when the switch is pressed, but the glass stays in place.
paras.zh: 客户表示，按下开关时电机会发出噪音，但玻璃仍保持在原位。

paras.en: You remove the door panel after performing the appropriate preliminary checks and discover that the regulator cable has broken.
paras.zh: 执行适当的初步检查后，您拆下门板，发现调节器电缆已损坏。

paras.en: The motor still operates, but it can no longer transfer movement to the glass.
paras.zh: 电机仍在运行，但无法再将运动传递到玻璃上。

paras.en: In this situation, replacing only the motor wouldn’t solve the problem. You need to repair or replace the damaged regulator assembly.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，仅更换电机并不能解决问题。您需要修理或更换损坏的调节器组件。

paras.en: Now consider a different vehicle where the window doesn’t move and the motor makes no noise. Electrical testing shows that the motor isn’t receiving its required power supply.
paras.zh: 现在考虑另一种车辆，车窗不移动且电机不发出噪音。电气测试表明电机未收到所需的电源。

paras.en: That result points you toward further electrical diagnosis rather than immediately replacing mechanical parts.
paras.zh: 该结果表明您需要进一步进行电气诊断，而不是立即更换机械部件。

paras.en: Both examples demonstrate why understanding the system is more valuable than guessing which component has failed.
paras.zh: 这两个例子都说明了为什么理解系统比猜测哪个组件发生故障更有价值。

paras.en: Power window problems can involve electrical circuits, motors, mechanical regulators or electronic controls.
paras.zh: 电动车窗问题可能涉及电路、电机、机械调节器或电子控制装置。

paras.en: The most effective repair starts with verifying the complaint, testing the circuit and inspecting the mechanism before replacing parts.
paras.zh: 最有效的维修从验证投诉、测试电路和检查机构开始，然后再更换零件。

paras.en: For technicians just entering the industry, this is an opportunity to practice electrical diagnosis, component inspection and safe service procedures.
paras.zh: 对于刚刚进入该行业的技术人员来说，这是一个练习电气诊断、部件检查和安全服务程序的机会。

paras.en: The next time a power window stops working, don’t start with the parts catalog. Start with the symptoms and let your test results guide the repair.
paras.zh: 下次电动车窗停止工作时，不要从零件目录开始。从症状开始，让测试结果指导修复。

articles.title: How Regenerative Braking Changes Repair and Inspection
articles.author: Joe Keene

paras.en: Regenerative braking allows electric vehicles to recover energy during deceleration. Instead of converting all vehicle momentum into heat at the brake rotors, the electric motor acts as a generator. This slows the vehicle while returning some energy to the battery.
paras.zh: 再生制动允许电动汽车在减速过程中回收能量。电动机不是将所有车辆动量转化为制动转子的热量，而是充当发电机。这会减慢车辆的速度，同时将一些能量返回给电池。

paras.en: The process can significantly reduce the use of conventional friction brakes. However, reduced brake usage can also create maintenance challenges involving corrosion and component operation.
paras.zh: 该过程可以显着减少传统摩擦制动器的使用。然而，减少制动器的使用也会带来涉及腐蚀和部件操作的维护挑战。

paras.en: On conventional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles, brake pads regularly contact the rotors during braking. This friction helps remove light surface corrosion from the rotor faces.
paras.zh: 在传统的内燃机 (ICE) 车辆上，刹车片在制动过程中会定期接触转子。这种摩擦有助于消除转子表面的轻微表面腐蚀。

paras.en: EVs with aggressive regenerative braking may use their friction brakes less frequently. Exposure to moisture, road salt and humidity can then allow corrosion to develop on the rotor surfaces.
paras.zh: 具有积极再生制动功能的电动汽车可能会减少使用摩擦制动器的频率。暴露在湿气、道路盐分和湿气中会导致转子表面发生腐蚀。

paras.en: EV Regenerative Braking and Rotor Corrosion
paras.zh: 电动汽车再生制动和转子腐蚀

paras.en: Light surface rust is not necessarily a problem because normal brake applications can remove it. However, corrosion can progress when friction brakes are not used regularly.
paras.zh: 轻微的表面锈迹不一定是问题，因为正常的制动应用可以将其去除。然而，如果不定期使用摩擦制动器，腐蚀就会加剧。

paras.en: Over time, heavier rust, pitting and scaling can develop on the rotors. Once the rotor surfaces deteriorate significantly, normal brake applications may not restore their condition.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，转子上会出现更严重的锈迹、点蚀和氧化皮。一旦转子表面明显恶化，正常的制动应用可能无法恢复其状态。

paras.en: Reduced friction brake usage can also extend brake pad life. However, brake components can develop problems unrelated to friction material wear.
paras.zh: 减少摩擦制动器的使用也可以延长刹车片的使用寿命。然而，制动部件可能会出现与摩擦材料磨损无关的问题。

paras.en: Corrosion may form around brake pad hardware, caliper brackets, slide pins and other components. Pads can become restricted in their brackets, while caliper components may develop problems from limited movement.
paras.zh: 刹车片硬件、卡钳支架、滑销和其他部件周围可能会出现腐蚀。刹车片可能会受到支架的限制，而卡钳部件可能会因运动受限而出现问题。

paras.en: As a result, brake components may require replacement because of corrosion or restricted movement rather than normal wear.
paras.zh: 因此，制动部件可能因腐蚀或运动受限而不是正常磨损而需要更换。

paras.en: How Regenerative and Friction Braking Work Together
paras.zh: 再生制动和摩擦制动如何协同工作

paras.en: Electric vehicles still require conventional hydraulic friction brakes to maintain stopping performance.
paras.zh: 电动汽车仍然需要传统的液压摩擦制动器来保持制动性能。

paras.en: Regenerative braking may become reduced or unavailable under certain operating conditions. These include a fully charged battery, very cold battery temperatures, vehicle stability control intervention or certain system faults.
paras.zh: 在某些操作条件下，再生制动可能会减弱或不可用。这些包括充满电的电池、极低的电池温度、车辆稳定性控制干预或某些系统故障。

paras.en: EV braking systems blend regenerative braking with conventional hydraulic friction braking to provide the stopping performance drivers expect.
paras.zh: 电动汽车制动系统将再生制动与传统的液压摩擦制动相结合，以提供驾驶员期望的制动性能。

paras.en: This makes conventional brake system condition an important consideration, even when regenerative braking reduces normal friction brake usage.
paras.zh: 这使得传统制动系统状况成为一个重要的考虑因素，即使再生制动减少了正常的摩擦制动使用。

paras.en: EV Brake Inspection and Maintenance Considerations
paras.zh: 电动汽车制动器检查和维护注意事项

paras.en: Technicians should account for reduced friction brake usage when inspecting electric vehicle braking systems.
paras.zh: 技术人员在检查电动汽车制动系统时应考虑减少摩擦制动器的使用。

paras.en: Measuring brake pad thickness alone may not provide a complete picture of component condition.
paras.zh: 仅测量刹车片厚度可能无法提供部件状况的完整信息。

paras.en: EV regenerative braking improves efficiency by recovering energy and can substantially extend brake pad life. However, reduced friction brake usage can also increase the potential for corrosion and restricted component movement.
paras.zh: 电动汽车再生制动通过回收能量来提高效率，并可以大大延长刹车片的使用寿命。然而，减少摩擦制动器的使用也会增加腐蚀和限制部件运动的可能性。

paras.en: Brake condition assessments should account for both friction material wear and the effects of limited brake usage.
paras.zh: 制动状况评估应考虑摩擦材料磨损和限制制动使用的影响。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Auto Value 和 Bumper to Bumper 赞助。

articles.title: Inspection and Replacement of Active Motor Mounts
articles.author: Jerry Renshaw

paras.en: Motor mounts aren’t glamorous or impressive or a high-performance item, but they’re a critical part of any vehicle’s drivetrain and its entire noise/vibration/harshness package. Motor mounts (and transmission mounts) help keep several hundred pounds of engine and drivetrain aligned at a precise angle, attaching the engine and transmission to the chassis or subframe. These rubberized mounts help isolate the vibrations from the engine and dampen the tendency for the engine to twist to one side due to torque on acceleration. They’re part of a system that keeps the drivetrain situated properly and ensures a quiet and smooth experience for the driver.
paras.zh: 电机支架并不迷人或令人印象深刻，也不是高性能产品，但它们是任何车辆传动系统及其整个噪声/振动/粗糙度包的关键部分。电机支架（和变速箱支架）有助于使数百磅的发动机和传动系统以精确的角度对齐，将发动机和变速箱连接到底盘或副车架上。这些橡胶支架有助于隔离发动机的振动，并抑制发动机由于加速扭矩而向一侧扭转的趋势。它们是保持动力传动系统正确定位并确保驾驶员安静平稳体验的系统的一部分。

paras.en: For decades, motor mounts were just a sandwich of vulcanized rubber inside inner and outer metal sleeves; while this is a simple and dependable design, rubberized motor mounts tend to dry out and shrink after time and many heat/cool cycles, meaning they’ll transmit more vibration or may fail completely and need to be replaced. Some European models use a hydraulic mount, a gel-filled donut with sealed chambers and passages. This more advanced design is tuned to respond to certain vibration frequencies and amplitudes that go along with RPM and load.
paras.zh: 几十年来，电机支架只是内部和外部金属套筒内的硫化橡胶的三明治；虽然这是一种简单可靠的设计，但经过一段时间和多次热/冷循环后，橡胶电机支架往往会变干和收缩，这意味着它们会传递更多振动，或者可能完全失效并需要更换。一些欧洲型号使用液压安装座，这是一个带有密封室和通道的凝胶填充甜甜圈。这种更先进的设计经过调整，可以响应与转速和负载相关的某些振动频率和振幅。

paras.en: Active motor mounts, on the other hand, are designed with electronic or vacuum controls that can alter stiffness on demand and are featured on a number of performance brands. In design and function, they’re not too dissimilar from the solenoids and controls for active suspensions, including the magnetorheological fluid used in active shock absorbers.
paras.zh: 另一方面，主动电机安装座采用电子或真空控制装置设计，可以根据需要改变刚度，并且是许多高性能品牌的特色。在设计和功能上，它们与主动悬架的螺线管和控制器没有太大不同，包括主动减震器中使用的磁流变液。

paras.en: On some Jaguar models, the active mounts are part of the driving mode package and can be adjusted to provide more feedback for the driver in Sport mode. They’re designed to be dynamic and can even change stiffness slightly during gear changes or while cornering. The problems with active mounts usually stem from the vacuum or electronic side, not the mount itself.
paras.zh: 在某些捷豹车型上，主动支架是驾驶模式包的一部分，可以进行调整，以便在运动模式下为驾驶员提供更多反馈。它们被设计为动态的，甚至可以在换档或转弯时轻微改变刚度。有源安装座的问题通常源于真空或电子侧，而不是安装座本身。

paras.en: Earlier designs of active motor mounts relied on engine vacuum to regulate their damping behavior. An engine pulls more vacuum at idle, and the mounts would be softer and more compliant to easily soak up NVH. Acceleration and load means less vacuum, and mounts were designed to limit excessive engine movement as they firmed up. That, of course, means a vacuum line and port that could be prone to wear and failure.
paras.zh: 主动电机支架的早期设计依靠发动机真空来调节其阻尼行为。发动机在怠速时会产生更多的真空，并且支架会更柔软、更柔顺，可以轻松吸收 NVH。加速和负载意味着真空度降低，支架的设计旨在限制发动机在固定时的过度运动。当然，这意味着真空管线和端口可能容易磨损和失效。

paras.en: Later designs worked much the same way, but rely on an electronic actuator that’s controlled by the vehicle’s ECU, based on input from sensors and programming. This design is more precise and doesn’t have the lag time that goes along with vacuum actuation, adjusting the firmness of the mounts on the fly. Some active mounts can even generate a counter-vibration that’s tuned to neutralize the vibration frequencies from the engine’s rotating assembly, not unlike a balance shaft design. These mounts are common on models from Audi, BMW, Jaguar, Lexus, Toyota, Honda and other makes. Active motor mounts are commonplace on any vehicle that has a cylinder deactivation system, helping to soak up vibrations as the engine’s cylinders shut down.
paras.zh: 后来的设计工作原理大致相同，但依赖于由车辆 ECU 根据传感器输入和编程控制的电子执行器。这种设计更加精确，并且没有真空驱动带来的滞后时间，可以动态调整安装座的牢固度。一些主动安装座甚至可以产生反振动，该反振动经过调整以中和发动机旋转组件的振动频率，这与平衡轴设计没有什么不同。这些安装座常见于奥迪、宝马、捷豹、雷克萨斯、丰田、本田和其他品牌的车型。主动电机支架在任何配备停缸系统的车辆上都很常见，有助于吸收发动机气缸关闭时的振动。

paras.en: There are usually some pretty clear signs of failing motor mounts. These include:
paras.zh: 通常有一些非常明显的迹象表明电机安装座出现故障。这些包括：

paras.en: - Excessive vibration that can be felt through the steering wheel or floorboards, during certain RPM or load ranges, while idling in gear or using the AC.
paras.zh: - 在某些转速或负载范围内，在挂档或使用空调时，可以通过方向盘或地板感觉到过度振动。

paras.en: - Noticeable clunk or bang when putting the vehicle in gear, accelerating or decelerating (this can easily be mistaken for bad U-joints or CV joints).
paras.zh: - 当车辆挂档、加速或减速时，会发出明显的沉闷声或撞击声（这很容易被误认为是损坏的 U 形万向节或等速万向节）。

paras.en: - Noticeable torque steer on a FWD vehicle.
paras.zh: - 前轮驱动车辆上的明显扭矩转向。

paras.en: - The engine moves in its motor mount cradle when an assistant revs the engine, in gear and foot on the brake.
paras.zh: - 当助手挂档并踩下制动器转动发动机时，发动机会在电机安装支架中移动。

paras.en: One failed mount puts extra stress on the other mounts and will usually lead to their failure as well. When the engine is wobbling and torquing around underhood, it stretches wiring and puts strain on vacuum lines, radiator hoses, belts, throttle and shift linkages. In extreme cases, a misaligned engine and transmission can change driveline geometry and wear out CV joints, or the engine can even come in contact with the radiator fan and shroud.
paras.zh: 一个失败的安装座会给其他安装座带来额外的压力，并且通常也会导致它们的失败。当发动机在引擎盖下晃动和扭转时，它会拉伸接线并对真空管路、散热器软管、皮带、油门和换档连杆施加压力。在极端情况下，未对准的发动机和变速箱可能会改变传动系统的几何形状并磨损等速万向节，或者发动机甚至可能与散热器风扇和护罩接触。

paras.en: It’s also worth noting here that oil or transmission fluid leaks can degrade the rubber of a motor mount, softening it and hastening its failure. In instances like this, the leak will need to be addressed as well. Also, an active misfire code like P0300 or P0304 can cause vibrations that are harsh enough to destroy engine mounts within weeks.
paras.zh: 这里还值得注意的是，油或变速箱油泄漏会降低电机支架的橡胶性能，使其软化并加速其故障。在这种情况下，也需要解决泄漏问题。此外，像 P0300 或 P0304 这样的主动失火代码可能会导致剧烈的振动，足以在几周内损坏发动机支架。

paras.en: The ECU might store codes as well, but these can be misleading: for instance, P0171 or P0400 codes indicate a failed EGR or clogged PCV that will produce an idle so rough that it can mimic a failed motor mount. Codes like P1586 can confirm a failed solenoid and internal electronics.
paras.zh: ECU 也可能存储代码，但这些代码可能会产生误导：例如，P0171 或 P0400 代码表示 EGR 故障或 PCV 堵塞，会产生非常粗糙的怠速，以至于可以模仿故障的电机安装。 P1586 等代码可以确认电磁阀和内部电子设备出现故障。

paras.en: Your best bet, though, is still a visual inspection: does the engine torque to one side when an assistant “power-brakes” it with the transmission in gear? Can you see a sooty appearance to the body of the engine mount? Does the rubber look dry-rotted, degraded or is it starting to separate from the metal body?
paras.zh: 不过，最好的选择仍然是目视检查：当助手在变速箱挂档的情况下“动力制动”发动机时，发动机是否会向一侧扭转？您能看到发动机支架主体有黑黑的外观吗？橡胶是否看起来干腐、退化或者开始与金属体分离？

paras.en: Inspect other components like wiring harnesses, throttle linkage, transmission linkage, heat shields, hoses, vacuum lines, intake ducts, drive axles, etc., to ensure that they haven’t been damaged by excessive engine movement. When servicing, make sure the oil pan, transmission and other parts are properly supported to avoid damage and be aware that other components might need to be removed in order to access the motor mounts.
paras.zh: 检查其他部件，如线束、油门连杆、传动连杆、隔热罩、软管、真空管路、进气管、驱动轴等，以确保它们没有因发动机过度运动而损坏。维修时，确保油底壳、变速箱和其他部件得到适当支撑，以避免损坏，并注意可能需要拆下其他部件才能接触电机安装座。

paras.en: Mounts should be replaced in pairs or sets, not one at a time; a single mushed-out motor mount can put undue stress on the other mounts. After installing the mounts, check and verify the clearance around exhaust and cooling components to make sure the engine’s position is correct. Active systems might require calibration or functional testing; be sure of the right process for your year/make/model.
paras.zh: 安装座应成对或成套更换，而不是一次更换一个；单个松散的电机安装座可能会给其他安装座带来过度的压力。安装支架后，检查并验证排气和冷却部件周围的间隙，以确保发动机的位置正确。主动系统可能需要校准或功能测试；确保您的年份/品牌/型号采用正确的流程。

paras.en: After installation, always road test the vehicle at different speeds to be sure the vibration problem’s been eliminated. Inspection of the motor mounts should go along with other routine maintenance, such as changing a timing belt, and motor and transmission mount inspection should be part of any collision repair work.
paras.zh: 安装后，始终以不同的速度对车辆进行道路测试，以确保振动问题已消除。电机安装座的检查应与其他日常维护一起进行，例如更换正时皮带，并且电机和变速箱安装座的检查应成为任何碰撞维修工作的一部分。

paras.en: Depending on the design of active engine mounts, a technician should look for DTCs, module commands, wiring (power and ground) and the mount’s response to any commands or switching of modes. Be mindful that the details of repair and replacement can vary a lot from one year/make/model to another.
paras.zh: 根据主动发动机支架的设计，技术人员应查找 DTC、模块命令、接线（电源和接地）以及支架对任何命令或模式切换的响应。请注意，维修和更换的细节可能因年份/品牌/型号而异。

articles.title: National Signing Day Welcomes Young Technicians Into the Industry with Fanfare
articles.author: NAPA

paras.en: National Signing Day: held in the spring, it features young soon-to-be professionals signing letters of intent affirming their path of choice and receiving a scholarship in turn.
paras.zh: 全国签约日：在春季举行，年轻的未来专业人士签署意向书，确认他们选择的道路，并依次获得奖学金。

paras.en: College football? No, better: the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 大学橄榄球？不，更好的是：汽车售后市场。

paras.en: That’s right: NAPA and Skills USA held their own National Signing Day on May 6, marking the day as a nationwide celebration recognizing students choosing careers in the automotive, diesel and motorsports industries.
paras.zh: 没错：NAPA 和 Skills USA 于 5 月 6 日举办了自己的全国签名日，将这一天作为全国性的庆祝活动，表彰在汽车、柴油机和赛车运动行业选择职业的学生。

paras.en: As with football, the automotive technical industry needs plenty of young people coming into the profession, and like a college that recruits a player to play for them, we need to make them feel at home in the industry.
paras.zh: 与足球一样，汽车技术行业需要大量年轻人进入这个行业，就像大学招募球员为他们效力一样，我们需要让他们在这个行业有宾至如归的感觉。

paras.en: On May 6, NAPA and Skills USA welcomed six students from Georgia to Truist Park, home of the Atlanta Braves, to sign letters of intent and officially commit to careers as automotive technicians.
paras.zh: 5 月 6 日，NAPA 和 Skills USA 迎来了六名来自佐治亚州的学生来到亚特兰大勇士队的主场 Truist Park，签署意向书并正式致力于汽车技术员的职业生涯。

paras.en: Each student received a Carlyle toolbox kit packed with the necessary tools to get their careers going. They knew that was going to happen, but what they didn’t know was that Cassie Bell, chief people officer at NAPA, was going to surprise them with $2,500 scholarships to support their post-secondary education in the industry.
paras.zh: 每个学生都收到了凯雷工具箱，其中包含推动他们职业发展所需的工具。他们知道这将会发生，但他们不知道的是 NAPA 首席人力官 Cassie Bell 将为他们提供 2,500 美元的奖学金，以支持他们在该行业的高等教育。

paras.en: “This is one of my favorite nights of the year,” said Bell. “National Signing Day is a moment the whole country pauses to recognize students stepping into their futures, and we wanted to make sure the students choosing the skilled trades felt that same energy and excitement. We talk a lot about investing in our people, and tonight that means making sure these students know how thrilled the industry is to welcome them.”
paras.zh: “这是我一年中最喜欢的夜晚之一，”贝尔说。 “全国签约日是整个国家停下来认可学生踏入未来的时刻，我们希望确保选择技术行业的学生感受到同样的活力和兴奋。我们谈论了很多关于投资于我们的员工，今晚这意味着确保这些学生知道整个行业是多么高兴地欢迎他们。”

paras.en: - School: Cobb Innovation and Technology Academy
paras.zh: - 学校：科布创新科技学院

paras.en: - Post-secondary plans: High Performance Motorsports Technology at University of Northwestern Ohio
paras.zh: - 高等教育计划：西北俄亥俄大学高性能赛车技术

paras.zh: - 高等教育计划：环球技术学院汽车技术

paras.zh: - 高等教育计划：拉尼尔技术学院赛车技术

paras.zh: - 学校：金岛学院和职业学院
