articles.title: UARX Space Marks a Milestone for Spain’s Space Industry with the Maiden Flight of OSSIE-D, Featuring a Complete Power Subsystem Supplied by DHV Technology
articles.author: UARX Space

paras.en: Nigrán, Spain | November 12 2026 – UARX Space has achieved a major milestone for Spain’s space industry with the deployment of OSSIE-D, an Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV) designed and manufactured entirely in Spain, with 75% of its components developed in-house by the company. Launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, OSSIE-D was deployed using SAU&RON 24, UARX Space’s proprietary separation system. The achievement marks a world first, bringing together an orbital transfer vehicle and a separation system developed by the same company in a single mission.
paras.zh: 西班牙尼格兰| 2026 年 11 月 12 日 – UARX Space 部署了 OSSIE-D，实现了西班牙航天工业的一个重要里程碑。OSSIE-D 是一种完全在西班牙设计和制造的轨道传输飞行器 (OTV)，其 75% 的组件由该公司内部开发。 OSSIE-D 由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射，并使用 UARX Space 的专有分离系统 SAU&RON 24 进行部署。这一成就标志着世界首创，将同一家公司开发的轨道传输飞行器和分离系统结合在一次任务中。

paras.en: The mission represents a significant advance in Spain’s space technology capabilities, demonstrating the ability to develop and integrate key technologies for in-space transportation and orbital operations. By combining its OTV with its own SAU&RON 24 separation system, UARX Space reinforces its integrated approach to spacecraft development, spanning the vehicle itself and the technology required for its deployment into orbit.
paras.zh: 该任务代表了西班牙空间技术能力的重大进步，展示了开发和集成空间运输和轨道运行关键技术的能力。通过将其 OTV 与其自己的 SAU&RON 24 分离系统相结合，UARX Space 强化了其航天器开发的集成方法，涵盖航天器本身及其部署到轨道所需的技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D also highlights the importance of collaboration between specialized companies across the European space industry. For this mission, DHV Technology designed, qualified and manufactured the vehicle’s complete electrical power subsystem, including the solar arrays, Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU), main battery modules, SADA (Solar Array Drive Assembly) and additional supporting subsystems required to meet the mission’s power requirements.
paras.zh: OSSIE-D 还强调了欧洲航天工业专业公司之间合作的重要性。对于此次任务，DHV Technology 设计、鉴定和制造了车辆的完整电力子系统，包括太阳能电池阵列、功率调节和配电单元 (PCDU)、主电池模块、SADA（太阳能阵列驱动组件）以及满足任务电力要求所需的其他支持子系统。

paras.en: “OSSIE-D represents a milestone for the Spanish aerospace industry and shows how collaboration between companies with complementary capabilities can turn ambitious missions into reality. DHV Technology has been a key partner, with its expertise, highly reliable solutions and team commitment making a significant contribution to the mission’s energy capabilities. This partnership also highlights the potential of the Spanish space sector to innovate and compete at both European and global level,” said Dr. Andrés Villa, CTO and Co-Founder of UARX Space.
paras.zh: UARX Space 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrés Villa 博士表示：“OSSIE-D 代表了西班牙航空航天业的一个里程碑，展示了具有互补能力的公司之间的合作如何能够将雄心勃勃的任务变为现实。DHV Technology 一直是关键合作伙伴，其专业知识、高度可靠的解决方案和团队承诺为任务的能源能力做出了重大贡献。这种合作伙伴关系还凸显了西班牙航天部门在欧洲和全球层面的创新和竞争潜力。”

paras.en: Following launch, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem is operating nominally in orbit, starting from the generation of the power with the solar arrays, control and distribution with the PCDU and storage with the battery, including initial telemetry which confirms that the system is performing as expected. This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.
paras.zh: 发射后，DHV Technology 的电力子系统名义上在轨道上运行，从太阳能电池阵列发电、PCDU 控制和分配以及电池存储开始，包括确认系统按预期运行的初始遥测。这对于 DHV Technology 的工程团队和整个 OSSIE-D 任务来说是一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: “Seeing the full electrical power subsystem fully developed by DHV for OSSIE-D operating as expected in orbit is an important milestone for our team and for our collaboration with UARX Space,” said Dr. Vicente Díaz, Managing Director and Co-Founder of DHV Technology. “This achievement reflects the close cooperation between both engineering teams and the work invested throughout the design, manufacturing, testing and integration phases. We are proud to contribute to this mission and look forward to OSSIE-D continuing to deliver positive results for UARX Space and all the partners involved.”
paras.zh: DHV Technology 董事总经理兼联合创始人 Vicente Díaz 博士表示：“看到 DHV 完全开发的用于 OSSIE-D 的完整电力子系统在轨道上按预期运行，对于我们的团队以及我们与 UARX Space 的合作来说是一个重要的里程碑。” “这一成就反映了两个工程团队之间的密切合作以及在整个设计、制造、测试和集成阶段所投入的工作。我们很自豪能为这一任务做出贡献，并期待 OSSIE-D 继续为 UARX Space 和所有相关合作伙伴带来积极的成果。”

paras.en: Beyond supplying the electrical power subsystem, DHV Technology is using OSSIE-D as a platform to test innovative technological concepts in orbit. The results obtained during the mission will help increase the technological maturity of several of the company’s solutions, extending the value of the mission beyond its immediate operational objectives. These developments include novel electrical interconnection methods, improved solar panel deployment and hinge mechanisms, as well as advanced photovoltaic technologies.
paras.zh: 除了提供电力子系统之外，DHV Technology 还使用 OSSIE-D 作为在轨测试创新技术概念的平台。任务期间获得的结果将有助于提高公司多个解决方案的技术成熟度，使任务的价值超出其直接运营目标。这些发展包括新颖的电气互连方法、改进的太阳能电池板部署和铰链机构以及先进的光伏技术。

paras.en: The collaboration between UARX Space and DHV Technology underscores the importance of combining specialized engineering capabilities to deliver increasingly advanced space missions. While UARX Space leads the development of the OTV and its deployment architecture, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem provides a critical element for the vehicle’s operation while enabling the evaluation of new technologies under real space operating conditions.
paras.zh: UARX Space 和 DHV Technology 之间的合作强调了结合专业工程能力来交付日益先进的太空任务的重要性。虽然 UARX Space 引领 OTV 及其部署架构的开发，但 DHV Technology 的电力子系统为车辆的运行提供了关键要素，同时能够在真实的空间运行条件下评估新技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D therefore represents progress on two fronts: it strengthens UARX Space’s capabilities and position in the in-space transportation sector, while providing an opportunity to validate technologies that could support future missions. The combination of an OTV developed in Spain, a proprietary separation system and a complete electrical power subsystem supplied by DHV Technology demonstrates the potential of Spain’s space industry to deliver increasingly complex technological projects.
paras.zh: 因此，OSSIE-D 代表了两个方面的进展：它增强了 UARX Space 在太空运输领域的能力和地位，同时提供了验证可支持未来任务的技术的机会。西班牙开发的 OTV、专有的分离系统和 DHV Technology 提供的完整电力子系统的结合展示了西班牙航天工业交付日益复杂的技术项目的潜力。

paras.en: About DHV Technology https://dhvtechnology.com/
paras.zh: 关于 DHV 技术 https://dhvtechnology.com/

articles.title: Cosmo Bee to flight-test Honeybee Hall thruster with D-Orbit in 2027
articles.author: Cosmo Bee

paras.en: Daejeon, Republic of Korea – October 14, 2026: South Korean space electric propulsion startup Cosmo Bee plans to conduct an in-orbit flight test of its 10 mN-class Honeybee Hall thruster system in October 2027 through a service agreement with D-Orbit.
paras.zh: 韩国大田 – 2026 年 10 月 14 日：韩国太空电力推进初创公司 Cosmo Bee 计划通过与 D-Orbit 签订的服务协议，于 2027 年 10 月对其 10 mN 级 Honeybee Hall 推进器系统进行在轨飞行测试。

paras.en: Honeybee is a 10 mN-class Hall thruster system under development by Cosmo Bee for small satellites operating in LEO constellations.
paras.zh: Honeybee 是 Cosmo Bee 正在为在 LEO 星座运行的小型卫星开发的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器系统。

paras.en: “In-orbit validation is an essential step as we prepare to bring Honeybee to the commercial market,” said Dongha Park, co-founder and CEO of Cosmo Bee. “D-Orbit is an ideal partner to help us achieve that goal.”
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Dongha Park 表示：“在轨验证是我们准备将 Honeybee 推向商业市场的重要一步。” “D-Orbit 是帮助我们实现这一目标的理想合作伙伴。”

paras.en: “Hosting in-orbit demonstrations is one of the core services we offer aboard ION,” said Matteo Lorenzoni, Director of the Orbital Access Business Unit at D-Orbit. “Honeybee will operate in the real space environment, with our mission operations team supporting the test throughout, so Cosmo Bee comes away with the performance data it needs to take the thruster to market.” This test will evaluate Honeybee’s key performance parameters, including thrust and specific impulse, under various operating conditions.
paras.zh: “举办在轨演示是我们在 ION 上提供的核心服务之一，”D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部总监 Matteo Lorenzoni 说道。 “Honeybee 将在真实的太空环境中运行，我们的任务运营团队全程支持测试，因此 Cosmo Bee 可以获得将推进器推向市场所需的性能数据。”该测试将评估 Honeybee 在各种操作条件下的关键性能参数，包括推力和比冲量。

paras.en: “For satellite operators choosing a propulsion system, flight heritage is often what decides the purchase”, commented Matteo Zeni, Head of Sales of D-Orbit’s Orbital Access Business Unit. “Our in-orbit demonstration service gives technology developers like Cosmo Bee a direct route to space and the data they need to move from qualification to a commercial product. We look forward to flying Honeybee next year.”
paras.zh: “对于选择推进系统的卫星运营商来说，飞行传统往往是决定购买的因素”，D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部销售主管 Matteo Zeni 评论道。 “我们的在轨演示服务为 Cosmo Bee 等技术开发人员提供了直接进入太空的途径，以及他们从资格认证转向商业产品所需的数据。我们期待明年让 Honeybee 飞行。”

paras.en: Through the partnership, Cosmo Bee plans to establish flight heritage for Honeybee while preparing for the system’s commercial introduction in 2027. The company intends to make Honeybee available to satellite operators and mission developers seeking electric propulsion systems for small spacecraft.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Cosmo Bee 计划为 Honeybee 建立飞行遗产，同时为 2027 年该系统的商业推出做准备。该公司打算将 Honeybee 提供给卫星运营商和寻求小型航天器电力推进系统的任务开发商。

paras.en: Cosmo Bee was founded in July 2023 as a spin-off from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), building on electric propulsion research conducted by Professor Wonho Choe’s team since 2003.
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 成立于 2023 年 7 月，是韩国科学技术院 (KAIST) 的一个衍生公司，其基础是 Wonho Choe 教授团队自 2003 年以来进行的电力推进研究。

paras.en: In November 2025, the company launched its first space mission, K-HERO, a 3U CubeSat designed to demonstrate the operation of a 150 W-class Hall thruster in orbit. The spacecraft was launched aboard South Korea’s KSLV-2 launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，该公司发射了其首次太空任务 K-HERO，这是一颗 3U 立方体卫星，旨在演示 150 W 级霍尔推进器在轨道上的运行。该航天器是由韩国的 KSLV-2 运载火箭发射升空的。

paras.en: In June 2026, the Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) designated Cosmo Bee’s 10 mN-class Hall thruster and hollow cathode technologies as “New Space Technologies.” The company also raised $5 million in a Series A funding round that month.
paras.zh: 2026 年 6 月，韩国宇宙航空管理局 (KASA) 将 Cosmo Bee 的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器和空心阴极技术指定为“新空间技术”。该公司还在当月的 A 轮融资中筹集了 500 万美元。

paras.en: “Cosmo Bee is growing alongside the rapidly expanding demand for LEO satellite constellations in South Korea,” Park said. “We hope Honeybee can support customers developing the next generation of small satellite constellations.”
paras.zh: Park 表示：“随着韩国对 LEO 卫星星座需求的快速增长，Cosmo Bee 也在不断发展。” “我们希望 Honeybee 能够支持客户开发下一代小型卫星星座。”

articles.title: Flexell Space and ALATYR Sign MoU to Explore Solar Power Solutions for Orbital Data Centers
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Collaboration to assess next-generation ultralight solar cells for space-based computing infrastructure
paras.zh: – 合作评估用于天基计算基础设施的下一代超轻太阳能电池

paras.en: – Partnership brings together Korean space energy technology and French orbital infrastructure expertise
paras.zh: – 合作伙伴关系汇集了韩国空间能源技术和法国轨道基础设施专业知识

paras.en: Bremen, Germany – Flexell Space, a space energy company, announced that it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with ALATYR, a French company developing orbital data centers, to explore solar power solutions for space-based computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 德国不来梅 – 空间能源公司 Flexell Space 宣布与开发轨道数据中心的法国公司 ALATYR 签署了一份谅解备忘录 (MoU)，共同探索用于天基计算基础设施的太阳能解决方案。

paras.en: The collaboration will assess the potential application of Flexell Space’s next-generation solar cell technology to orbital infrastructure designed for large-scale computing and data storage. The companies intend to exchange technical requirements relating to power demand and operating conditions and explore opportunities for future joint development and validation.
paras.zh: 此次合作将评估 Flexell Space 的下一代太阳能电池技术在专为大规模计算和数据存储而设计的轨道基础设施中的潜在应用。两家公司打算交换有关电力需求和运行条件的技术要求，并探索未来联合开发和验证的机会。

paras.en: ALATYR develops orbital data centers designed to support artificial intelligence (AI) computing and mission-critical workloads. Its CITADEL modular infrastructure architecture and BYLD robotic system are designed to enable assembly, maintenance, and upgrades in orbit. The architecture separates the service life of the supporting infrastructure from the replacement cycle of computing hardware, enabling computing modules to be renewed in orbit while retaining the infrastructure that powers, cools, and supports them.
paras.zh: ALATYR 开发轨道数据中心，旨在支持人工智能 (AI) 计算和关键任务工作负载。其 CITADEL 模块化基础设施架构和 BYLD 机器人系统旨在实现在轨组装、维护和升级。该架构将支持基础设施的使用寿命与计算硬件的更换周期分开，使计算模块能够在轨道上更新，同时保留为其供电、冷却和支持的基础设施。

paras.en: Reliable power generation is essential to making orbital data centers viable. As these facilities grow, solar power systems must address not only electrical performance but also mass, launch and deployment efficiency, manufacturing costs, and long-term reliability.
paras.zh: 可靠的发电对于轨道数据中心的可行性至关重要。随着这些设施的发展，太阳能系统不仅必须解决电气性能问题，还必须解决质量、发射和部署效率、制造成本和长期可靠性问题。

paras.en: Flexell Space is developing next-generation space solar cells based on CIGS (copper indium gallium selenide) and perovskite technologies. With a focus on lightweight, flexible designs and large-area manufacturing, the company aims to provide power solutions for satellites and larger space infrastructure. Through the collaboration, Flexell Space intends to gain a clearer understanding of orbital data center requirements and assess how its technology could support this emerging application.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 正在开发基于 CIGS（铜铟镓硒）和钙钛矿技术的下一代太空太阳能电池。该公司专注于轻量化、灵活设计和大面积制造，旨在为卫星和更大的空间基础设施提供电源解决方案。通过此次合作，Flexell Space 打算更清楚地了解轨道数据中心的要求，并评估其技术如何支持这一新兴应用。

paras.en: “This MoU marks an important milestone in strengthening cooperation between Korea and Europe, particularly France, in space energy and infrastructure,” said Kyumin Lee, Business Development Manager at Flexell Space. “By combining our next-generation solar cell technology with ALATYR’s orbital infrastructure expertise, we aim to build a lasting partnership and lay the groundwork for joint development and validation of power solutions for future orbital data centers.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 业务开发经理 Kyumin Lee 表示：“这份谅解备忘录标志着韩国与欧洲（特别是法国）在空间能源和基础设施领域加强合作的一个重要里程碑。” “通过将我们的下一代太阳能电池技术与 ALATYR 的轨道基础设施专业知识相结合，我们的目标是建立持久的合作伙伴关系，并为未来轨道数据中心电力解决方案的联合开发和验证奠定基础。”

paras.en: He added, “By bringing together our complementary capabilities, we aim to establish a practical foundation for future development and validation.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“通过整合我们的互补能力，我们的目标是为未来的开发和验证奠定实用的基础。”

paras.en: “Our orbital infrastructure is designed to serve successive generations of computing hardware,” said Emeric Lhomme, Chief Executive Officer of ALATYR. “That makes solar cell efficiency and longevity central to our approach: our power systems must continue to deliver reliable performance as computing modules are replaced and upgraded. With Flexell Space, we will explore how next-generation lightweight solar technologies could meet the demands of that extended service life.”
paras.zh: ALATYR 首席执行官埃默里克·洛姆 (Emeric Lhomme) 表示：“我们的轨道基础设施旨在为连续几代的计算硬件提供服务。” “这使得太阳能电池的效率和寿命成为我们方法的核心：随着计算模块的更换和升级，我们的电力系统必须继续提供可靠的性能。通过 Flexell Space，我们将探索下一代轻型太阳能技术如何满足延长使用寿命的需求。”

paras.en: The companies plan to begin by exchanging information on their technologies and development priorities, followed by a phased assessment of solar cell and power system compatibility. Specific development activities and validation approaches will be discussed through subsequent technical consultations.
paras.zh: 两家公司计划首先交换有关技术和开发优先事项的信息，然后对太阳能电池和电力系统的兼容性进行分阶段评估。具体的开发活动和验证方法将通过后续技术磋商进行讨论。

paras.en: Flexell Space is a space energy company that originated as an internal venture at Hanwha Systems. The company develops next-generation space solar cells and power solutions based on CIGS and perovskite technologies, with a focus on low-cost, large-area, ultralight products. Through collaboration with global partners, Flexell Space is advancing the commercialization of solar cell technologies for satellites and a broad range of space infrastructure.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 是一家空间能源公司，最初是韩华系统公司的内部合资企业。该公司开发基于CIGS和钙钛矿技术的下一代空间太阳能电池和电源解决方案，重点是低成本、大面积、超轻产品。通过与全球合作伙伴的合作，Flexell Space 正在推进卫星太阳能电池技术和广泛的空间基础设施的商业化。

paras.en: ALATYR is a French company developing a new layer of critical digital infrastructure in space. The company designs orbital data centers that evolve with computing technology, rather than being replaced with each hardware generation. Its infrastructure is designed to remain productive over the long term and expand with demand, creating a lasting extension of the cloud in orbit to increase computing capacity and strengthen the resilience of essential digital services worldwide.
paras.zh: ALATYR 是一家法国公司，正在开发太空关键数字基础设施的新层。该公司设计的轨道数据中心随着计算技术的发展而发展，而不是随着每一代硬件的发展而更换。其基础设施旨在长期保持生产力并根据需求进行扩展，在轨道上创建云的持久扩展，以提高计算能力并增强全球基本数字服务的弹性。

articles.title: New NASA Seed Funding Primes Small Businesses for Innovation
articles.author: Abby Tabor

paras.en: Awards to small businesses around the country are addressing some of NASA’s most crucial technology needs for exploration of the Moon and Mars while fueling the U.S. space economy.
paras.zh: 向全国各地小企业颁发的奖项正在解决美国宇航局探索月球和火星的一些最关键的技术需求，同时推动美国太空经济。

paras.en: NASA’s Small Business Innovation Research/Small Business Technology Transfer (SBIR/STTR) program recently selected 302 innovative projects, for a total investment of up to $171 million in seed funding.
paras.zh: NASA 的小型企业创新研究/小型企业技术转让 (SBIR/STTR) 计划最近选出了 302 个创新项目，种子资金总投资高达 1.71 亿美元。

paras.en: This early-stage research and development work will tackle an array of topics, including those related to Artemis and the establishment of a U.S. Moon Base. Selected projects include next-generation battery solutions, robotic systems with sensing capabilities for the extreme lunar environment, and tools to prepare for construction of critical infrastructure, such as lunar landing pads.
paras.zh: 这项早期研发工作将解决一系列主题，包括与阿耳忒弥斯和建立美国月球基地相关的主题。选定的项目包括下一代电池解决方案、具有针对极端月球环境的传感能力的机器人系统，以及为建造月球着陆场等关键基础设施做准备的工具。

paras.en: NASA’s SBIR/STTR program provides support for entrepreneurs, startups, and small businesses to advance and commercialize technologies that can advance the agency’s missions. Working with the program, a company’s path toward commercialization or infusion into NASA missions occurs in phases. The latest awards involved two of these phases.
paras.zh: NASA 的 SBIR/STTR 计划为企业家、初创公司和小型企业提供支持，以推进可推进该机构使命的技术并将其商业化。通过该项目，公司的商业化或融入 NASA 任务的道路是分阶段进行的。最新的奖项涉及其中两个阶段。

paras.en: The new Phase I contracts will receive up to $225,000 each to establish the merit and feasibility of their proposed innovation. A portion of the projects selected are STTR awards, provided to small businesses partnered with research institutions.
paras.zh: 新的第一阶段合同每份将获得高达 225,000 美元的资金，以确定其拟议创新的优点和可行性。选定的部分项目是 STTR 奖项，提供给与研究机构合作的小型企业。

paras.en: The Phase II awards, with 98 contracts valued at up to $1.3 million each, will continue work begun in Phase I projects selected in 2025, targeting demonstration and delivery of the innovative technologies.
paras.zh: 第二阶段授予的 98 份合同每份价值高达 130 万美元，将继续在 2025 年选定的第一阶段项目中开始的工作，旨在示范和交付创新技术。

paras.en: Following are a few examples of research supported through these recent awards:
paras.zh: 以下是最近这些奖项支持的一些研究示例：

paras.en: An SBIR Phase II award for Opterus Research and Development Inc. supports a project focused on bringing power to the surface of the Moon and Mars by developing a modular system of rollable solar arrays. The arrays can be handled robotically, are compatible with various support structures, and work even in dusty surface conditions. The technology could be scaled up to 50 kilowatts, and it could provide a reliable power source to help both NASA and commercial space companies develop infrastructure on the Moon.
paras.zh: Opterus Research and Development Inc. 获得的 SBIR 第二阶段奖项支持了一个项目，该项目的重点是通过开发可卷曲太阳能电池阵列的模块化系统为月球和火星表面提供电力。该阵列可以由机器人处理，与各种支撑结构兼容，甚至可以在多尘的表面条件下工作。该技术可以扩展到 50 千瓦，并且可以提供可靠的电源来帮助 NASA 和商业航天公司在月球上开发基础设施。

paras.en: - Rovers With Reach: Vision and Tactile Sensing in Robotic Arm
paras.zh: - Rovers With Reach：机械臂中的视觉和触觉感知

paras.en: This SBIR Phase I award, led by Intelligent Fiber Optic Systems Corporation, aims to help lunar rovers perform complex tasks independently on the Moon. The firm’s 10-foot, extendable robotic arm can both “see” and has a sense of touch, combining a camera with sensors to detect and measure surface textures, contact forces, and temperature. The technology could help automate many lunar surface tasks, such as cleaning solar panels, positioning habitat structures, and collecting scientific samples from hard-to-reach locations. On Earth, the same instrumented robotic arms could be used to inspect and repair power lines, nuclear reactors, or other infrastructure in hazardous environments.
paras.zh: 该 SBIR 第一阶段奖项由智能光纤系统公司牵头，旨在帮助月球车在月球上独立执行复杂的任务。该公司的 10 英尺可伸缩机械臂既可以“看到”又具有触觉，将摄像头与传感器结合起来，检测和测量表面纹理、接触力和温度。该技术可以帮助许多月球表面任务实现自动化，例如清洁太阳能电池板、定位栖息地结构以及从难以到达的地点收集科学样本。在地球上，同样的仪器化机械臂可用于检查和修复危险环境中的电线、核反应堆或其他基础设施。

paras.en: - Cold-Friendly Battery for Long Lunar Night
paras.zh: - 寒冷友好型电池，适合漫长的农历夜晚

paras.en: Elementium Materials Inc., selected for an SBIR Phase I award, is developing an ultra-cold-tolerant battery module for space applications and cold-climate uses on Earth. The technology can operate down to minus 76 degrees Fahrenheit without active heating, reducing the need for heaters and insulating layers to work on the Moon. With the space and mass that’s saved, NASA missions can launch other tools and science experiments, instead. This battery technology could help keep rovers, habitats, and other infrastructure running through the frigid, 14-day lunar night and potentially on Mars.
paras.zh: Elementium Materials Inc. 荣获 SBIR 第一阶段奖，正在开发一种用于太空应用和地球寒冷气候用途的超耐寒电池模块。该技术可以在低至-76华氏度的温度下运行，无需主动加热，从而减少了在月球上工作时对加热器和绝缘层的需求。通过节省的空间和质量，美国宇航局的任务可以发射其他工具和科学实验。这种电池技术可以帮助火星车、栖息地和其他基础设施在寒冷的 14 天月球夜晚以及可能在火星上保持运行。

paras.en: - Prepare for Landing — Repeatedly — on Moon
paras.zh: - 反复准备登陆月球

paras.en: A collaboration between Slate Geotechnical Consultants Inc. and the Colorado School of Mines will evaluate two approaches to preparing lunar regolith for repeated lunar landings, so that routine mission activities can have sturdy, reusable landing pads. Without such pads, the force generated by a rocket can blast out loose, gravel-like regolith from the surface, throw up dust, or create craters, potentially damaging spacecraft and nearby infrastructure. The project, supported by an STTR Phase I award, will also investigate ways to use rovers to repair and maintain future lunar landing pads.
paras.zh: Slate Geotechnical Consultants Inc. 和科罗拉多矿业学院之间的合作将评估两种为重复登月准备月球风化层的方法，以便日常任务活动能够拥有坚固、可重复使用的着陆垫。如果没有这样的垫，火箭产生的力可能会从表面炸出松散的砾石状风化层，扬起灰尘，或形成陨石坑，可能会损坏航天器和附近的基础设施。该项目得到了 STTR 第一阶段奖项的支持，还将研究如何使用漫游车来修复和维护未来的月球着陆场。

paras.en: Complete lists of the selected proposals are available on the SBIR/STTR program’s website:
paras.zh: 所选提案的完整列表可在 SBIR/STTR 计划的网站上找到：

paras.en: NASA’s SBIR/STTR program is part of the agency’s Research and Technology Mission Directorate and is managed by NASA’s Ames Research Center in California’s Silicon Valley.
paras.zh: NASA 的 SBIR/STTR 计划是该机构研究和技术任务理事会的一部分，由位于加州硅谷的 NASA 艾姆斯研究中心管理。

articles.title: Afghanistan restrictions prevent pregnant women from seeking medical help

paras.en: Afghanistan restrictions prevent pregnant women from seeking medical help
paras.zh: 阿富汗的限制措施阻止孕妇寻求医疗帮助

paras.en: Aid and development agencies in Afghanistan warned on Friday of an escalating “assault” on the rights and freedoms of women and girls that is preventing growing numbers from accessing vital medical care.
paras.zh: 阿富汗的援助和发展机构周五警告称，对妇女和女孩权利和自由的“攻击”不断升级，导致越来越多的人无法获得重要的医疗服务。

paras.en: A major cause of the crisis is the more than 100 edicts issued by the de facto authorities since they came to power in 2021. These have drastically restricted women's movement outside the home, their access to education and employment.
paras.zh: 造成这场危机的一个主要原因是事实上的当局自2021年上台以来颁布了100多条法令。这些法令极大地限制了妇女在家庭之外的活动、受教育和就业的机会。

paras.en: Serious cuts to funding for relief work have made the situation even worse, according to gender equality agency UN Women. It reports that needs in Afghanistan are vast and growing.
paras.zh: 性别平等机构联合国妇女署表示，救援工作资金的严重削减使情况变得更加糟糕。报告称，阿富汗的需求巨大且不断增长。

paras.en: The agency’s Chief of Humanitarian Action, Sofia Calltorp, warned that there is a growing risk that Afghanistan’s 22 million women and girls will be denied access to healthcare in the longer-term.
paras.zh: 该机构人道主义行动负责人索菲亚·卡尔托普 (Sofia Calltorp) 警告说，从长远来看，阿富汗 2200 万妇女和女童无法获得医疗保健的风险越来越大。

paras.en: “One woman that I met in Kunar told me that she had suffered multiple miscarriages without access to healthcare. I also met with men who spoke of restrictions preventing them from supporting women,” she said.
paras.zh: “我在库纳尔遇到的一位妇女告诉我，她在无法获得医疗保健的情况下多次流产。我还遇到了一些男性，他们谈到了限制他们支持女性的情况，”她说。

paras.en: “I met women facing their second winter, displaced from their homes after losing everything in an earthquake last year. Many had since been displaced by the hostilities with Pakistan or severe flooding in recent months.”
paras.zh: “我遇到了一些面临第二个冬天的妇女，她们在去年的地震中失去了一切，被迫背井离乡。此后，许多人因与巴基斯坦的敌对行动或近几个月的严重洪水而流离失所。”

paras.en: As a result of aid cuts in Afghanistan, UN Women, the UN aid coordination office, OCHA, and partners report that:
paras.zh: 由于阿富汗援助削减，联合国妇女署、联合国援助协调办公室、人道协调厅和合作伙伴报告称：

paras.en: - Nearly 300 humanitarian health facilities have been closed or suspended, affecting more than one million women and girls;
paras.zh: - 近300个人道主义卫生设施已关闭或暂停，影响超过100万妇女和女童；

paras.en: - More than 193 focal points for survivors of gender-based violence have closed, affecting more than one million and girls;
paras.zh: - 超过 193 个性别暴力幸存者协调中心已关闭，影响了超过 100 万女孩；

paras.en: - Around 3.4 million women and girls in need are now unlikely to have access to water, sanitation, and hygiene services.
paras.zh: - 大约 340 万有需要的妇女和女童现在不太可能获得水、环境卫生和个人卫生服务。

paras.en: UN Women provides emergency cash assistance to those in need, along with counselling and small business training.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署为有需要的人提供紧急现金援助，并提供咨询和小企业培训。

paras.en: These services are critical, but they cannot undo the impact of the Taliban’s edicts which have removed guardrails against violence and abuse in the home, said Ms. Calltorp.
paras.zh: 考尔托普女士说，这些服务至关重要，但它们无法消除塔利班法令的影响，塔利班法令取消了防止家庭暴力和虐待的护栏。

paras.en: Just back from Afghanistan, she described the story of a 24-year-old woman who for 18 months had been detained in her own home by her father: “She was often abused and left without food; in her own words, ‘I feel like life is not meant for me.’ It was only when she and her father participated in a programme designed to prevent and protect women from violence that her life turned around – and her father stopped abusing her.”
paras.zh: 刚从阿富汗回来，她描述了一名 24 岁女性的故事，她被父亲关押在自己家里长达 18 个月：“她经常受到虐待，没有食物；用她自己的话说，‘我觉得生活不适合我。’直到她和父亲参加了一项旨在防止和保护妇女免受暴力侵害的项目后，她的生活才发生了转变，她的父亲也不再虐待她。”

paras.en: The programme is run by a local women’s organization, one of many supported by UN Women across Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 该项目由当地一个妇女组织负责运营，该组织是联合国妇女署在阿富汗各地支持的众多项目之一。

paras.en: Women “continue to find ways to survive, to care for their families, to support one another and to hold on to hope (but) we cannot accept this as normal”, Ms. Calltorp insisted.
paras.zh: 卡尔托普女士坚称，女性“继续寻找生存之道、照顾家人、互相支持并抱有希望（但）我们不能接受这种常态”。

paras.en: Across the country, women are banned from many public spaces and most places of work.
paras.zh: 在全国范围内，女性被禁止进入许多公共场所和大多数工作场所。

paras.en: Some 2.6 million girls have also been barred from secondary education, which is projected to push more girls into child marriage and increase maternal mortality, UN Women warned.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署警告称，约 260 万女孩还被禁止接受中等教育，预计这将导致更多女孩陷入童婚并增加孕产妇死亡率。

paras.en: Describing Afghanistan as the “world’s worst women’s rights crisis”, the agency’s Special Representative in the country, Susan Ferguson, said that Afghan women are now “fighting for their own survival”.
paras.zh: 该机构驻阿富汗特别代表苏珊·弗格森将阿富汗描述为“世界上最严重的妇女权利危机”，并表示阿富汗妇女现在正在“为自己的生存而战”。

paras.en: She explained that funding cuts have forced humanitarians to make impossible decisions about which women and girls can receive support and which must be turned away.
paras.zh: 她解释说，资金削减迫使人道主义者做出不可能的决定，决定哪些妇女和女孩可以得到支持，哪些必须拒绝。

paras.en: “I urge all governments and other international donors to stand with us and with Afghan women and girls. Stay the course and increase, not cut, your support. Back these women,” Ms. Ferguson stressed.
paras.zh: “我敦促所有政府和其他国际捐助者与我们以及阿富汗妇女和女孩站在一起。坚持到底，增加而不是减少你们的支持。支持这些妇女，”弗格森女士强调。

articles.title: West Bank: Record settler attacks mar olive harvest as UN urges Israel to protect farmers

paras.en: West Bank: Record settler attacks mar olive harvest as UN urges Israel to protect farmers
paras.zh: 约旦河西岸：创纪录的定居者袭击橄榄收成，联合国敦促以色列保护农民

paras.en: Israeli settlers have carried out more than 400 attacks causing casualties or property damage during this year’s olive harvest in the occupied West Bank – more than in any previous season, UN agencies and humanitarian NGOs said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国机构和人道主义非政府组织周五表示，今年在被占领的约旦河西岸橄榄收获期间，以色列定居者发动了 400 多次袭击，造成人员伤亡或财产损失，比以往任何一个季节都多。

paras.en: Since September, more than 4,000 trees and saplings have been damaged and over 25,000 kilogrammes of produce vandalised or stolen, according to the Humanitarian Country Team for the Occupied Palestinian Territory, which brings together the heads of UN entities and international and Palestinian NGOs.
paras.zh: 据巴勒斯坦被占领土人道主义国家工作队称，自 9 月以来，已有 4,000 多棵树木和树苗遭到破坏，超过 25,000 公斤农产品被破坏或被盗。该小组汇集了联合国实体以及国际和巴勒斯坦非政府组织的负责人。

paras.en: The violence has also spread into Areas A and B, which the 1995 Oslo II Accords placed under full or partial Palestinian Authority control and where Palestinians had faced fewer such attacks in past years.
paras.zh: 暴力事件还蔓延到 A 区和 B 区，1995 年《奥斯陆第二协议》将这两个地区置于巴勒斯坦权力机构的全部或部分控制之下，过去几年，巴勒斯坦人在这些地区遭遇的此类袭击较少。

paras.en: Solidarity activists, journalists and diplomats have also been targeted.
paras.zh: 声援活动人士、记者和外交官也成为袭击目标。

paras.en: ‘Acquiescence, support and participation’
paras.zh: “默许、支持、参与”

paras.en: Earlier calls on the Israeli authorities to protect Palestinians and ensure they can safely reach their groves have not been acted upon, the group said. “Instead, we’ve seen acquiescence, support and participation.”
paras.zh: 该组织表示，早些时候呼吁以色列当局保护巴勒斯坦人并确保他们能够安全到达他们的树林，但这一呼吁尚未得到落实。 “相反，我们看到了默许、支持和参与。”

paras.en: In the first nine months of 2026, Israeli authorities uprooted or otherwise damaged more than 10,000 Palestinian-owned trees and saplings across the West Bank, most of them olive trees.
paras.zh: 2026 年前 9 个月，以色列当局连根拔起或以其他方式损坏了西岸 10,000 多棵巴勒斯坦人拥有的树木和树苗，其中大部分是橄榄树。

paras.en: Near Israeli settlements and behind the West Bank Barrier, Israeli forces are barring landowners from their groves unless they first obtain Israeli authorisation.
paras.zh: 在以色列定居点附近和西岸屏障后面，以色列军队禁止土地所有者进入他们的树林，除非他们首先获得以色列的授权。

paras.en: Even where access is scheduled, the window has been too small, and is often followed by cancellations, denial of entry, expulsion or attacks, the country team reported.
paras.zh: 国家工作队报告说，即使安排了入境，时间窗口也太小，之后往往会出现取消、拒绝入境、驱逐或袭击的情况。

paras.en: Settlements have spread so widely that few Palestinian communities remain unaffected by such restrictions, which in practice extend beyond the areas shown on the Israeli-issued “coordination” map. With thousands unable to reach their trees, crops are being lost.
paras.zh: 定居点分布范围如此之广，以至于几乎没有巴勒斯坦社区不受此类限制的影响，这些限制实际上超出了以色列发布的“协调”地图上显示的区域。由于数千人无法到达树木，农作物正在损失。

paras.en: An estimated 80,000 to 100,000 Palestinian families in the West Bank rely on olives and olive oil, a sector that contributes around 15 per cent of agricultural GDP. The harvest also holds deep social and cultural significance.
paras.zh: 据估计，西岸有 80,000 至 100,000 个巴勒斯坦家庭依赖橄榄和橄榄油，该部门约占农业 GDP 的 15%。收获还具有深刻的社会和文化意义。

paras.en: Restrictions throughout the year prevent essential work such as pruning, fertilization and pest control, steadily reducing tree productivity and future harvests, and undermining livelihoods and food security.
paras.zh: 全年的限制阻碍了修剪、施肥和病虫害防治等基本工作，稳步降低了树木生产力和未来的收成，并损害了生计和粮食安全。

paras.en: “This year’s harvesting window is closing, but there is still some time to act,” the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“今年的收获窗口即将关闭，但仍有一些时间采取行动。”

paras.en: The group urged the Israeli authorities in the strongest possible terms to end all attacks on Palestinians and their livelihoods, as required by international law, and to ensure farmers have free, safe, sufficient and reliable access to their land, including to bring in supplies and equipment and transport their harvest.
paras.zh: 该组织敦促以色列当局按照国际法的要求，以最强烈的措辞停止对巴勒斯坦人及其生计的所有袭击，并确保农民能够自由、安全、充分和可靠地使用他们的土地，包括运入物资和设备以及运输他们的收成。

paras.en: “Perpetrators must be stopped and held to account,” it said, calling on Member States to use their influence to ensure these measures are implemented promptly and sustained throughout the year.
paras.zh: 声明称，“必须制止肇事者并追究其责任”，并呼吁会员国利用其影响力，确保这些措施在全年得到迅速实施和持续。

articles.title: ‘You will not be alone’: General Assembly President tells Rohingya refugees after genocide ruling

paras.en: ‘You will not be alone’: General Assembly President tells Rohingya refugees after genocide ruling
paras.zh: “你不会孤单”：种族灭绝裁决后大会主席告诉罗兴亚难民

paras.en: A day after the UN’s highest court found that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya, the President of the General Assembly visited the refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, urging the world to turn the landmark judgement into action.
paras.zh: 联合国最高法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人犯下种族灭绝罪的第二天，联合国大会主席访问了孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔的难民营，敦促世界将这一具有里程碑意义的判决付诸行动。

paras.en: “Yesterday in The Hague, the highest court of the United Nations spoke. It spoke your name: Rohingya. Yes, Rohingya. Its decision was clear. What was done to you in 2017 was genocide,” Khalilur Rahman told refugees and reporters.
paras.zh: “昨天在海牙，联合国最高法院发表了讲话。它说出了你们的名字：罗兴亚人。是的，罗兴亚人。它的决定很明确。2017 年对你们所做的就是种族灭绝，”哈利勒·拉赫曼告诉难民和记者。

paras.en: He called for justice for the victims, reparations for the survivors and guarantees that refugees can return home safely and with dignity.
paras.zh: 他呼吁为受害者伸张正义，为幸存者提供赔偿，并保证难民能够安全、有尊严地返回家园。

paras.en: Before becoming Bangladesh’s Foreign Minister and then Assembly President, Mr. Rahman served as his country’s top envoy on the Rohingya and visited the camps many times.
paras.zh: 在成为孟加拉国外交部长和议会议长之前，拉赫曼先生曾担任该国罗兴亚人问题最高特使，并多次访问难民营。

paras.en: “I did not wish to speak to you from New York. I wish to come here to the camps and stand with you at this historic moment,” he said.
paras.zh: “我不想在纽约与你们交谈。我希望来到这里的难民营，在这个历史性的时刻与你们站在一起，”他说。

paras.en: On Thursday, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruled in the case brought by The Gambia. It found that Myanmar’s security forces and other State bodies had committed acts of genocide against the Rohingya, a mainly Muslim minority, in Rakhine state.
paras.zh: 周四，国际法院（ICJ）对冈比亚提起的案件做出了裁决。报告发现，缅甸安全部队和其他国家机构对若开邦的罗兴亚人（主要是穆斯林少数民族）实施了种族灭绝行为。

paras.en: The court found that the 2017 military operations involved mass killings, widespread sexual violence and the destruction of entire villages. At least 10,000 Rohingya were killed. Some 750,000 people fled to Bangladesh, according to the UN refugee agency, UNHCR.
paras.zh: 法院认定，2017 年的军事行动涉及大规模杀戮、广泛的性暴力以及对整个村庄的破坏。至少一万名罗兴亚人被杀害。据联合国难民署称，约有 75 万人逃往孟加拉国。

paras.en: “For years you have asked the world to hear you. Now they have heard you,” Mr. Rahman said.
paras.zh: “多年来，你一直要求世界倾听你的声音。现在他们听到了你的声音，”拉赫曼先生说。

paras.en: The Assembly President set out four priorities to make sure the ruling leads to real change.
paras.zh: 大会主席提出了四个优先事项，以确保裁决带来真正的变革。

paras.en: The first is justice. Myanmar must investigate and, where the evidence supports it, prosecute those suspected of genocide, and reform its laws.
paras.zh: 首先是正义。缅甸必须进行调查，并在有证据支持的情况下起诉涉嫌种族灭绝的人，并改革其法律。

paras.en: The second is a safe return. The court ordered Myanmar to make it possible for the Rohingya to come home voluntarily and with dignity. Mr. Rahman said no one should be sent back into danger. Any return must come with real guarantees of safety, freedom of movement and a voice for the Rohingya in decisions about their future.
paras.zh: 二是安全返航。法院命令缅甸让罗兴亚人能够自愿、有尊严地回家。拉赫曼先生表示，任何人都不应该再次陷入危险之中。任何回归都必须真正保证安全、行动自由以及罗兴亚人在决定其未来时拥有发言权。

paras.en: The third is reparations. The court ordered Myanmar to compensate victims and report back within two years.
paras.zh: 三是赔偿。法院命令缅甸赔偿受害者并在两年内报告。

paras.en: “Money cannot replace life. Money cannot replace loved ones that were lost,” Mr. Rahman said. But meaningful reparations could help survivors regain a sense of safety, hope and dignity, he added.
paras.zh: “金钱无法取代生命。金钱无法取代失去的亲人，”拉赫曼先生说。但他补充说，有意义的赔偿可以帮助幸存者重新获得安全感、希望和尊严。

paras.en: The fourth is prevention, through legal reform, training for the security forces and genuine civilian control over them.
paras.zh: 第四是预防，通过法律改革、对安全部队的培训以及对他们的真正文官控制。

paras.en: Mr. Rahman said the international community must also make sure the judgement is carried out and pledged to work with UN Member States on what comes next.
paras.zh: 拉赫曼先生表示，国际社会还必须确保判决得到执行，并承诺与联合国会员国就下一步行动进行合作。

paras.en: “You will not be alone. I will do my part,” he told the refugees.
paras.zh: “你们不会孤单。我会尽自己的一份力量，”他告诉难民。

articles.title: Hamilton 'devastated', Leclerc 'angry' after Ferrari Las Vegas shocker

paras.en: Las Vegas GP: Lewis Hamilton 'devastated' and Charles Leclerc 'angry' after both Ferrari drivers make shock early exits from qualifying
paras.zh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：两位法拉利车手在排位赛中提前出局后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿“震惊”，查尔斯·勒克莱尔“愤怒”

paras.en: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were both eliminated from Q2 during qualifying in Las Vegas; Leclerc will start the race from 10th, with Hamilton a place behind him; watch Sunday's race at 4am (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
paras.zh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔 (Charles Leclerc) 和刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 在拉斯维加斯排位赛中双双被淘汰出局。勒克莱尔将从第十名开始比赛，汉密尔顿落后于他；观看周日凌晨 4 点的比赛（从凌晨 2.30 开始），天空体育 F1 和主赛事直播

paras.en: Charles Leclerc was left "angry" while Lewis Hamilton said he was "devastated" after both Ferrari drivers suffered shock early exits from Las Vegas Grand Prix Qualifying.
paras.zh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔（Charles Leclerc）感到“愤怒”，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿（Lewis Hamilton）则表示，在两名法拉利车手在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中提前出局后，他感到“震惊”。

paras.en: The Italian team had arrived at the Las Vegas Strip Circuit wary of the challenges the long straights and cold temperatures could pose them, but Friday night's session went far worse than either driver had anticipated.
paras.zh: 意大利车队到达拉斯维加斯大道赛道时，对长直道和寒冷气温可能给他们带来的挑战保持警惕，但周五晚上的比赛比两位车手的预期都要糟糕得多。

paras.en: Both drivers were eliminated in Q2 as Leclerc took 11th with Hamilton a place behind him. They will each move a position forward on the grid due to a penalty for McLaren's Oscar Piastri.
paras.zh: 两位车手都在第二季度被淘汰，勒克莱尔获得第 11 位，汉密尔顿落后于他。由于迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里 (Oscar Piastri) 受到处罚，他们将各自在发车区向前移动一个位置。

paras.en: - Las Vegas GP: UK schedule and how to watch on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Leclerc appeared to have more than enough pace to reach Q3 but made a mistake on his final flying lap. The Monegasque was infuriated by Ferrari not having left him enough time to go for another lap in the event of an error or issue.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔似乎有足够的速度进入第三季度，但在最后一圈中犯了一个错误。摩纳哥人对法拉利没有给他足够的时间在发生错误或问题时再跑一圈感到愤怒。

paras.en: "Yes, for sure (Q3 was on the cards) but we didn't do a good job," Leclerc told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “是的，当然（第三季度是有可能的），但我们做得不好，”勒克莱尔告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "I did a mistake the only lap I was given, basically.
paras.zh: “基本上，我在唯一一圈就犯了一个错误。

paras.en: "And at the same time, the execution has been very poor. I don't know. We'll review.
paras.zh: “与此同时，执行情况非常糟糕。我不知道。我们会进行审查。

paras.en: "I'm very angry now, so I would rather not speak too much. But I think there were plenty of things we could have done much better."
paras.zh: “我现在很生气，所以我宁愿不要说太多。但我认为有很多事情我们可以做得更好。”

paras.en: 'Devastated' Hamilton reveals damage and deployment issues
paras.zh: “被摧毁的”汉密尔顿揭示了损坏和部署问题

paras.en: Hamilton was lacking pace throughout the session, which he suggested was caused by damage he had done to his car in the early stages.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在整个比赛中都缺乏速度，他认为这是由于他在早期阶段对赛车造成的损坏造成的。

paras.en: "I'm devastated," Hamilton told Sky Sports F1. "We work hard to do a good job.
paras.zh: “我很伤心，”汉密尔顿告诉天空体育F1。 “我们努力工作，把工作做好。

paras.en: "I didn't really know where we were going to be today. We knew we would struggle a little bit with these long straights, but I was optimistic going in, I thought the car would be OK.
paras.zh: “我真的不知道今天我们会去哪里。我们知道在这些长直道上我们会有点挣扎，但我很乐观，我认为赛车会没事的。

paras.en: "But on the first or second lap, we took a hit from something on the floor, some debris or something damaged the floor and we lost a bunch of downforce with it, a few tenths."
paras.zh: “但是在第一圈或第二圈，我们受到了地板上的东西的撞击，一些碎片或其他东西损坏了地板，我们失去了一堆下压力，零点几。”

paras.en: Unlike Leclerc, Hamilton was able to get a flying lap in at the end of Q2, but he said a deployment issue all but ended his hopes of advancing.
paras.zh: 与勒克莱尔不同，汉密尔顿在第二季度末跑出了一圈，但他表示，部署问题几乎结束了他晋级的希望。

paras.en: "And then I was giving it everything," he added. "My lap was as good as it could be at the end, but I didn't have anyone ahead of me, and then we had a lack of deployment at the end and I lost like six tenths just on deployment.
paras.zh: “然后我就付出了一切，”他补充道。 “我的单圈在最后时已经达到了最好的水平，但我前面没有人，然后我们在最后缺乏部署，仅在部署时我就损失了十分之六。

paras.en: "When it rains it pours. It was just one of those days.
paras.zh: “下雨的时候倾盆大雨。这只是那些日子之一。

paras.en: "We were scrapping to just get into Q3. I think without the deployment loss, without the downforce loss, I think I could have got into Q3, but it would have still been tough.
paras.zh: “我们正在努力进入第三季度。我认为如果没有部署损失，没有下压力损失，我认为我可以进入第三季度，但这仍然会很艰难。

paras.en: "But it is what is, it's over. It's definitely not a nice feeling for all the team, but we'll try to move forwards tomorrow."
paras.zh: “但事情就是这样，一切都结束了。这对所有球队来说绝对不是一种美好的感觉，但我们明天会努力向前迈进。”

paras.en: Leclerc was downcast over Ferrari's prospects for the race, which is live on Sky Sports F1 at 4am on Sunday morning, insisting their lack of straight-line speed would make it difficult for him to move forward.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔对法拉利的比赛前景感到沮丧，比赛将于周日凌晨 4 点在天空体育 F1 上进行直播，他坚称法拉利缺乏直线速度将使他难以前进。

paras.en: Asked about the prospect of a fightback, he said: "I don't think so because we are losing a second down the straights, so there is literally nowhere we will be able to overtake."
paras.zh: 当被问及反击的前景时，他说：“我不这么认为，因为我们在直道上落后了一秒，所以我们实际上无处可超车。”

paras.en: Sky Sports F1 pundit Jamie Chadwick said she could understand why both drivers would be frustrated by the team's execution during qualifying.
paras.zh: 天空体育F1评论员杰米·查德威克表示，她可以理解为什么两位车手都会对车队在排位赛中的表现感到沮丧。

paras.en: Chadwick said: "The thing that I don't understand, and I think this is where Charles refers to the execution, he had no margin to make a mistake on that last lap. That's frustrating for him.
paras.zh: 查德威克说：“我不明白的是，我认为这就是查尔斯所说的处决，他在最后一圈没有犯错的余地。这让他感到沮丧。”

paras.en: "And then on Lewis' side, he was always on his own. If they're saying that they're losing a second on the straight, at least stack the odds in your favour to have a slipstream and give yourself the best chance."
paras.zh: “然后在刘易斯这边，他总是独自一人。如果他们说他们在直道上失去了第二个，至少增加对你有利的赔率，以获得滑流并给自己最好的机会。”

paras.en: In Saturday's feature race, Blow Your Wad will attempt to gain revenge over old rival Doyen Quest in the 1965 Chase at Ascot; we also have competitive action from Lingfield Park and Newcastle live on Sky Sports Racing from 11am
paras.zh: 在周六的正赛中，Blow Your Wad 将试图向 1965 年阿斯科特追逐赛中的老对手 Doyen Quest 复仇；我们还从上午 11 点开始在天空体育竞速直播林菲尔德公园球场和纽卡斯尔的比赛

paras.en: 12.55 Ascot - Doyen Quest and Blow Your Wad clash
paras.zh: 12.55 Ascot - Doyen Quest 和 Blow Your Wad 冲突

paras.en: Doyen Quest and Blow Your Wad headline a classy field for the Ladbrokes 1965 Chase at Ascot.
paras.zh: Doyen Quest 和 Blow Your Wad 是阿斯科特立博 1965 年追逐赛 (Ladbrokes 1965 Chase) 的优雅赛场的主角。

paras.en: Dan Skelton's Doyen Quest outpointed Blow Your Wad when claiming the Grade Two Oaksey Chase at Sandown on his final start last season but could only manage third of three on his return at Carlisle. With that run behind him he ought to be sharper here.
paras.zh: 丹·斯凯尔顿 (Dan Skelton) 的老将奎斯特 (Doyen Quest) 上赛季在桑当 (Sandown) 的最后一场首发赛中获得二级奥克西蔡斯 (Oaksey Chase) 赛冠军时，他以“Blow Your Wad”的成绩击败了“Blow Your Wad”，但在卡莱尔 (Carlisle) 回归后，他只获得了三场比赛中的第三名。有了他身后的那次奔跑，他在这里应该更加敏锐。

paras.en: Blow Your Wad should handle this quicker ground and, having progressed through the grades last season, warrants respect as he receives weight under Freddie Mitchell.
paras.zh: Blow Your Wad 应该能更快地处理这个问题，并且在上个赛季取得了进步，在弗雷迪·米切尔的带领下获得了体重，值得尊重。

paras.en: - Nicholls breaks record for Jumps wins with Warwick triumph
paras.zh: - 尼科尔斯凭借沃里克的胜利打破了跳跃赛胜利纪录

paras.en: - Sober Glory storms to victory over Old Park Star on chase debut
paras.zh: - Sober Glory 在追逐赛首秀中击败 Old Park Star

paras.en: Sam Thomas fields Steel Ally who is three from four over fences with his sole defeat coming in the Arkle at Cheltenham in March. He goes well fresh and looks to have the most scope to improve.
paras.zh: 山姆·托马斯 (Sam Thomas) 派出钢铁盟友 (Steel Ally)，后者四胜三负越过栅栏，他唯一的失败是三月份在切尔滕纳姆 (Cheltenham) 举行的阿克尔 (Arkle) 比赛。他状态良好，看起来有很大的进步空间。

paras.en: 1.30 Ascot - Classy hurdlers Lucky Place and Kateira head field
paras.zh: 1.30 Ascot - 优雅的跨栏运动员 Lucky Place 和 Kateira 头场

paras.en: Classy hurdlers Lucky Place and Kateira clash in a trappy edition of the Grade Two Ladbrokes Ascot Hurdle.
paras.zh: 优雅的跨栏运动员 Lucky Place 和 Kateira 在二级立博阿斯科特跨栏的陷阱版中发生冲突。

paras.en: Lucky Place took this race in 2024 and, having tried fencing, he reverted to hurdles with a few solid runs including when runner-up in the Grade Two Select Hurdle at Sandown. Third behind Alexei in the Molyneux at Aintree on his reappearance, this extra distance should be more to his liking.
paras.zh: Lucky Place 于 2024 年参加了这场比赛，在尝试击剑后，他以几场稳定的成绩重返跨栏，包括在桑当的二级精选跨栏中获得亚军。重新出现时，他在安特里的莫利纽克斯（Molyneux）比赛中排名第三，落后于阿列克谢（Alexei），这个额外的距离应该更符合他的喜好。

paras.en: The Dan Skelton-trained Kateira looks the obvious danger. She has a bit to find on the figures but produced an excellent effort to beat off La Conquiere at Wetherby and deserves a crack at this valuable prize.
paras.zh: 丹·斯凯尔顿训练的凯特拉看起来是明显的危险。她在数据上还有待挖掘，但在韦瑟比击败了拉康奎尔，表现出色，值得获得这个宝贵的奖项。

paras.en: Harry Fry's Altobelli was last seen finishing runner-up behind Potters Charm at Windsor in January and would have claims on the pick of his form.
paras.zh: 哈利·弗莱 (Harry Fry) 的阿尔托贝利 (Altobelli) 上次亮相是在一月份，在温莎 (Windsor) 球场上，落后于波特斯魅力 (Potters Charm) 获得亚军，他的状态有望成为最佳选择。

paras.en: 12.20 Ascot - The Walk is an exciting prospect for the Tizzard team.
paras.zh: 12.20 Ascot - The Walk 对于 Tizzard 团队来说是一个令人兴奋的前景。

paras.en: 2.05 Ascot - Decent mares handicap hurdle - That's Nice will be popular.
paras.zh: 2.05 Ascot - 体面的母马障碍跨栏 - 那很好将会很受欢迎。

paras.en: 2.40 Ascot - Berkshire National - Last year's winner Rock My Way takes on Our Power.
paras.zh: 2.40 阿斯科特 - 伯克郡国家赛 - 去年的冠军 Rock My Way 对阵 Our Power。

paras.en: 3.18 Ascot - Vanderpoel bids to follow up his recent course success.
paras.zh: 3.18 阿斯科特 - 范德普尔力争延续他最近在球场上取得的成功。

paras.en: 11.30 Lingfield - Excellent Class Three novice - Wootton Bassett gelding El Mutamaken features. Al Lazzaz is a well-bred type for the Richard Hannon team.
paras.zh: 11.30 Lingfield - 优秀的三级新手 - Wootton Bassett 骟马 El Mutamaken 的特点。 Al Lazzaz 是 Richard Hannon 团队中的良种。

paras.zh: 12.00 林菲尔德 - 拜伯里之星的新手，希望能做得更好。

articles.title: 'Somebody’s got to stand up to that guy' - Russell slams Verstappen after clash

paras.en: George Russell hits out at Max Verstappen after Las Vegas GP clash and says 'somebody's got to stand up to that guy'
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛冲突后猛烈抨击马克斯·维斯塔潘，并表示“必须有人站出来对抗那个家伙”

paras.en: Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Mercedes' George Russell to start on front row of Las Vegas grid; Russell hit out at Verstappen after final practice collision; watch Sunday's race at 4am (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
paras.zh: 红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘和梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔将在拉斯维加斯发车前排发车；拉塞尔在最后一次练习冲撞后猛烈抨击维斯塔潘；观看周日凌晨 4 点的比赛（从凌晨 2.30 开始），天空体育 F1 和主赛事直播

paras.en: George Russell launched a scathing criticism of Max Verstappen after a collision between the pair in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of a race they will now start on the front row together.
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔对马克斯·维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛最后一次练习中发生碰撞后对马克斯·维斯塔潘提出了严厉的批评，而现在他们将一起在前排开始比赛。

paras.en: The pair, who have had run-ins in the past on track in recent years, clashed wheels in final practice as they fought over track position.
paras.zh: 两人近年来在赛道上曾发生过争执，在最后的练习中，他们在争夺赛道位置时发生了车轮碰撞。

paras.en: Verstappen first overtook Russell on the run down The Strip to Turn 14 before the Mercedes went back down the inside of the Red Bull in the braking zone, with the two cars brushing wheels.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在沿着拉斯维加斯大道冲向14号弯时首先超越了拉塞尔，然后梅赛德斯在制动区回到了红牛内侧，两辆车擦着车轮。

paras.en: - Las Vegas GP: UK schedule and how to watch on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Stewards investigated the incident and issued a warning to Verstappen, ruling he had been "driving erratically" under braking into the corner once ahead of the Mercedes.
paras.zh: 赛会干事对这一事件进行了调查，并向维斯塔潘发出了警告，裁定他在领先梅赛德斯之前入弯时刹车时“驾驶不稳定”。

paras.en: The pair went on to qualify second and third, which becomes first and second on the grid for Sunday's race at 4am, live on Sky Sports F1, due to Q3 pacesetter Kimi Antonelli's five-place grid penalty.
paras.zh: 由于第三季度领跑者基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 受到罚后五位发车，两人随后获得了排位赛第二名和第三名，并在周日凌晨 4 点天空体育 F1 直播的比赛中成为第一名和第二名。

paras.en: Asked after qualifying about the sanction issued to Verstappen by stewards, Russell said "a warning was fine" before going on to issue a withering rebuke of his Red Bull rival's approach.
paras.zh: 排位赛后被问及赛会干事对维斯塔潘的处罚时，拉塞尔表示“警告就可以了”，然后对他的红牛竞争对手的做法进行了严厉的谴责。

paras.en: Russell told Sky Italy: "There's nothing in the rules to say you cannot overtake someone who is starting a lap but when you do this, you are screwing this person over and he does this week in, week out with many drivers and everybody accepts it.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔告诉意大利天空电视台：“规则中并没有规定你不能超越正在开始一圈的人，但当你这样做时，你就搞砸了这个人，他一周又一周地和许多车手一起这样做，每个人都接受它。

paras.en: "I'm not just going to accept somebody to screw me over like this and walk around like they're bigger and better than everyone else. Somebody's got to stand up to that guy."
paras.zh: “我不会接受有人像这样把我搞砸，然后走来走去，好像他们比其他人都更大、更好。必须有人站起来对抗那个人。”

paras.en: Russell's comments about wanting to "stand up to" Verstappen echoed those he made following an incident in qualifying at the 2024 Qatar Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔关于想要“对抗”维斯塔潘的言论与他在 2024 年卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中发生事故后发表的言论相呼应。

paras.en: The pair traded barbs in person and via interviews after that clash, when Verstappen was given a one-place grid drop for impeding Russell in Q3, with the Mercedes driver then launching an explosive attack on his rival ahead of the following week's race in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 在那次冲突后，两人在面对面和采访中互相争吵，维斯塔潘因在第三季度阻碍拉塞尔而被退到一位发车位，而这位梅赛德斯车手随后在下周阿布扎比比赛之前对他的对手发起了爆炸性攻击。

paras.en: On Saturday, the pair were both asked when sitting next to each other in the post-qualifying press conference about the final practice incident and whether there had any confusion about the 'gentleman's agreement' regarding not disturbing a rival who was about to start a flying lap.
paras.zh: 周六，在排位赛后的新闻发布会上，两人并排坐在一起时，两人都被问及最后一次练习赛的事件，以及对于不打扰即将开始飞圈的对手的“君子协定”是否有任何困惑。

paras.en: Verstappen said "nothing happened", while Russell said there was "no confusion, I think it was pretty clear".
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘表示“什么也没发生”，而拉塞尔则表示“没有混乱，我认为情况很清楚”。

paras.en: What did the pundits make of the clash and Russell's comments?
paras.zh: 专家们对这场冲突和拉塞尔的评论有何看法？

paras.en: Sky Sports F1's Jacques Villeneuve said of the incident itself: "Fun and exciting to watch! But we want to see this in the race, not in free practice. Unnecessary.
paras.zh: 天空体育F1的雅克·维伦纽夫谈到这一事件本身时说道：“观看起来既有趣又令人兴奋！但我们希望在比赛中看到这种情况，而不是在自由练习中。没有必要。”

paras.en: "Once you've lost your track position, too bad for you. If you're George, you got overtaken, it's practice. OK, you don't get it back, you lost your position and move on.
paras.zh: “一旦你失去了赛道位置，对你来说就太糟糕了。如果你是乔治，你被超越了，这就是练习。好吧，你不会再回来了，你失去了位置并继续前进。

paras.en: "That was a completely unnecessary risk. You don't want to make an enemy of Max."
paras.zh: “这是完全不必要的风险。你不想与麦克斯为敌。”

paras.en: Speaking after hearing Russell's post-qualifying comments, Sky Sports F1's Jamie Chadwick said: "George saying he'll stand up to Max, I like that. It's very reminiscent of what we saw in Qatar.
paras.zh: 天空体育F1的杰米·查德威克在听到拉塞尔的排位赛后评论后表示：“乔治说他会勇敢地面对马克斯，我喜欢这一点。这很让人想起我们在卡塔尔看到的情况。

paras.en: "With George we know he's never going to give to Max. I think Max does try his luck with that kind of thing and that is why he is able to find himself in good positions. It comes also from the pit wall, who are telling him to push through the traffic and fight his way to get clear air, and he's aggressive and he does bully people out of the way. Most people do give in to that and then someone like Liam Lawson [at the Mexico City GP] comes along, doesn't, and gets in trouble from the big team.
paras.zh: “对于乔治，我们知道他永远不会屈服于马克斯。我认为马克斯确实会在这种事情上碰碰运气，这就是为什么他能够找到自己处于有利位置的原因。这也来自维修区的墙壁，维修区告诉他要挤过车流，努力争取干净的空气，他很有侵略性，他确实会欺负别人。大多数人都会屈服于这一点，然后像利亚姆·劳森（墨西哥城大奖赛的利亚姆·劳森）这样的人出现了，但他没有这样做，并陷入了麻烦来自大团队。

paras.en: "I quite like the fact that George is standing up to him because Max does it intentionally, he drives like that. There is something good to be said for that, but there's also something that needs to be fought against."
paras.zh: “我很喜欢乔治对抗他的事实，因为马克斯是故意这样做的，他就是那样开车的。对此有一些好说的地方，但也有一些需要反对的地方。”

paras.en: With the pair now starting together on the front row for the short run to Las Vegas' first corner, Villeneuve added: "No love lost there, so that's good before the start for tomorrow! That will make it exciting.
paras.zh: 两人现在一起在前排出发，准备前往拉斯维加斯第一个弯道的短距离比赛，维伦纽夫补充道：“那里没有失去爱，所以在明天开始之前这很好！这会让比赛变得令人兴奋。”

paras.en: "He shouldn't overtake someone who is about to start his lap, true, but how does that person know you're about to start your lap? That's one thing, and maybe you're about to start your own lap yourself.
paras.zh: “他不应该超越即将开始一圈的人，没错，但是那个人怎么知道你即将开始你的一圈？这是一回事，也许你自己也即将开始你自己的一圈。

paras.en: "So that's a difficult one to judge, ultimately."
paras.zh: “所以最终这是一个很难判断的问题。”

articles.title: Iraqi security forces deploy in Iran-backed militia stronghold
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: JURF AL-SAKHAR, Iraq — Iraqi security forces deployed in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataib Hezbollah armed group, on Friday under a deal that seeks to limit the reach of Iran’s most powerful Shi’ite militia ally in the country without provoking a confrontation.
paras.zh: 伊拉克尤尔夫萨哈尔——周五，伊拉克安全部队部署在真主党旅武装组织尤尔夫萨哈尔的据点，该协议旨在限制伊朗最强大的什叶派民兵盟友在该国的影响力，同时又不引发对抗。

paras.en: Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi this week ordered security forces to move against the heavily armed Kataib Hezbollah, which officials accused of running an oil smuggling network siphoning state-owned oil worth hundreds of millions of dollars in Jurf al-Sakhar.
paras.zh: 总理阿里·扎伊迪本周下令安全部队对全副武装的卡塔布真主党采取行动，该组织官员被指控在尤尔夫萨哈尔经营一个石油走私网络，窃取价值数亿美元的国有石油。

paras.en: The hardline Kataib Hezbollah (Battalions of the Party of God), branded a terrorist group by the United States, has rejected the smuggling accusations, which have led to arrests that prompted fears of an armed response. The group is among those that have claimed attacks on US forces in Gulf states since the start of the US-Israeli war on Iran.
paras.zh: 被美国称为恐怖组织的强硬派真主党旅否认了走私指控，这些指控导致了逮捕行动，引发了人们对武装回应的担忧。自美以对伊朗战争爆发以来，该组织是声称对驻海湾国家美军发动袭击的组织之一。

paras.en: A convoy of vehicles flying Iraqi flags headed into Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday and soldiers took up positions in the center after senior security officials told a press conference that government forces would protect the town.
paras.zh: 周五，一支悬挂伊拉克国旗的车队驶入尤尔夫萨哈尔，高级安全官员在新闻发布会上表示，政府部队将保护该城镇，士兵们在中心就位。

paras.en: Members of the Kataib Hezbollah group stood near their group’s flags.
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党组织的成员站在该组织的旗帜附近。

paras.en: “From Jurf al-Sakhar, we begin asserting state authority across all of Iraq, confronting corruption and weapons beyond state control,” Zaidi told government troops who entered the town, speaking from a military operations center in Baghdad.
paras.zh: 扎伊迪在巴格达的军事行动中心对进入该镇的政府军说：“从尤尔夫·萨哈尔开始，我们开始在整个伊拉克维护国家权威，对抗腐败和国家无法控制的武器。”

paras.en: “Our decision is firm: No weapons outside state authority, no weapons but Iraq‘s, no decisions but Iraq‘s, and no flag shall fly higher than the Iraqi flag.”
paras.zh: “我们的决定是坚定的：没有国家权力之外的武器，没有伊拉克以外的武器，没有伊拉克以外的任何决定，没有任何旗帜可以飘扬得比伊拉克国旗更高。”

paras.en: Under the arrangement, brokered by Shi’ite politicians, Kataib members were expected to withdraw to other parts of Iraq, a major oil producer and ally of both the US and Iran.
paras.zh: 根据什叶派政界人士的安排，卡塔布成员预计将撤至伊拉克其他地区。伊拉克是主要石油生产国，也是美国和伊朗的盟友。

paras.en: “God willing, things will be safe and secure with the presence of the security forces,” said resident Mohamed Ali.
paras.zh: 居民穆罕默德·阿里说：“上帝保佑，有安全部队在场，一切都会安全无忧。”

paras.en: Senior Iranian representative visited Baghdad, sources say
paras.zh: 消息人士称，伊朗高级代表访问了巴格达

paras.en: The deal will include the opening of a security headquarters in Jurf al-Sakhar on Saturday to oversee the handover. Iraq‘s energy police have begun securing an oil pipeline in Jurf al-Sakhar, the state news agency reported.
paras.zh: 该协议将包括周六在尤尔夫萨哈尔开设安全总部，以监督移交工作。据国家通讯社报道，伊拉克能源警察已开始保护尤尔夫萨哈尔的一条石油管道。

paras.en: “Today is a historic moment in which the Iraqi Armed Forces prove that they are the nation’s shield, safety valve, and the guardian ensuring security stability for the Iraqi people,” Sabah al-Numan, spokesperson for the commander-in-chief of the Iraqi armed forces, told the press conference.
paras.zh: 伊拉克武装部队总司令发言人萨巴赫·努曼在新闻发布会上表示：“今天是一个历史性时刻，伊拉克武装部队证明了他们是国家的盾牌、安全阀和确保伊拉克人民安全稳定的守护者。”

paras.en: Reflecting the sensitivity of the situation, Iraqi Shi’ite political figures said Esmail Qaani, commander of Iran’s Revolutionary Guards’ Quds Force, arrived in Baghdad on Monday to help defuse tensions with Kataib Hezbollah.
paras.zh: 伊拉克什叶派政治人物表示，伊朗革命卫队圣城旅指挥官埃斯梅尔·卡尼周一抵达巴格达，以帮助缓和与真主党旅的紧张关系，这反映了局势的敏感性。

paras.en: So far, nine senior security and oil officials have been dismissed following an investigation focused on Jurf al-Sakhar in Babil province, about 50 km (30 miles) south of Baghdad.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，在针对巴比伦省（巴格达​​以南约 50 公里（30 英里））的 Jurf al-Sakhar 进行调查后，已有 9 名高级安全和石油官员被解雇。

paras.en: Any direct confrontation with Iran’s heavily armed militia allies in Iraq could be risky.
paras.zh: 与伊朗在伊拉克​​全副武装的民兵盟友的任何直接对抗都可能存在风险。

paras.en: After one of Zaidi’s predecessors ordered a similar crackdown on those armed groups five years ago, the prime minister’s Baghdad home was hit in a drone strike that authorities described at the time as an assassination attempt.
paras.zh: 五年前，扎伊迪的一位前任下令对这些武装团体进行类似的镇压，之后总理的巴格达住所遭到无人机袭击，当局当时称这是一次暗杀企图。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has pressured Zaidi to disarm the militias that have struck US troops and facilities in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates in solidarity with Tehran since the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran in February.
paras.zh: 自美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动袭击以来，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向扎伊迪施压，要求其解除袭击美国驻沙特阿拉伯和阿拉伯联合酋长国军队和设施的民兵武装，以声援德黑兰。

paras.en: Kataib Hezbollah and other militias, all of whom report directly to Iran’s Revolutionary Guards, have refused to hand over their weapons to the state.
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党和其他民兵都直接向伊朗革命卫队报告，但拒绝将武器交给国家。

paras.en: Founded in the aftermath of the 2003 US-led invasion of Iraq, Kataib is among the most influential members of the Islamic Resistance in Iraq, the umbrella group of hardline Shi’ite armed organisations supported by Iran.
paras.zh: 卡塔布成立于 2003 年美国领导的入侵伊拉克之后，是伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗组织最有影响力的成员之一，该组织是伊朗支持的强硬什叶派武装组织的伞形组织。

paras.en: Kataib Hezbollah quickly developed a reputation for deadly attacks against military and diplomatic targets during the US-led counterinsurgency war and sectarian conflict of the 2000s, using snipers, rockets, mortars and roadside bombs.
paras.zh: 在 2000 年代美国领导的平叛战争和教派冲突中，卡塔布真主党使用狙击手、火箭、迫击炮和路边炸弹对军事和外交目标发动致命袭击，从而迅速赢得了声誉。

paras.en: Since the 2003 US-led invasion toppled Iran’s arch-enemy, longtime Sunni leader Saddam Hussein, Tehran has steadily expanded its influence in Iraq through close ties with heavily armed Shi’ite militias and political parties.
paras.zh: 自2003年美国领导的入侵推翻了伊朗的宿敌、逊尼派长期领导人萨达姆·侯赛因以来，德黑兰通过与全副武装的什叶派民兵和政党的密切联系，稳步扩大了其在伊拉克的影响力。

paras.en: Iraqi security officials say the militias’ arsenals include assault rifles, machineguns, anti-tank guided missiles, mortars, precision-guided rockets, armed drones and some short-range ballistic and cruise missile capabilities.
paras.zh: 伊拉克安全官员表示，民兵的武器库包括突击步枪、机枪、反坦克制导导弹、迫击炮、精确制导火箭、武装无人机以及一些短程弹道导弹和巡航导弹能力。

paras.en: Kataib has its own political party, called Huquq, or Rights, with five lawmakers. An Iraqi official report said the group also generates cash through businesses such as construction, housing, trade, tourism and currency exchange, though Kataib denies this and says it is dedicated to security.
paras.zh: 卡塔布有自己的政党，称为“Huquq”或“权利”，有五名议员。伊拉克官方报告称，该组织还通过建筑、住房、贸易、旅游和货币兑换等业务赚取现金，但卡塔布否认这一点，并表示其致力于安全。

paras.en: Pro-Iranian militias, including Kataib, enjoy a semi-official status in Iraq, which critics say encourages them to act with impunity. A shadowy group with no announced leadership structure, Kataib Hezbollah has thousands of hardened fighters.
paras.zh: 包括卡塔布在内的亲伊朗民兵在伊拉克享有半官方地位，批评者称这鼓励他们肆无忌惮地行事。卡塔布真主党是一个没有公布领导结构的神秘组织，拥有数千名顽强的战士。

paras.en: It forms several battalions in Iraq‘s Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF), a grouping of armed factions set up in 2014 to fight Islamic State and subsequently recognized as an official security force.
paras.zh: 它在伊拉克人民动员部队 (PMF) 中组建了多个营，该部队是 2014 年为打击伊斯兰国而成立的武装派别组织，随后被承认为官方安全部队。

paras.en: Fighters receive state salaries and Kataib Hezbollah members, including some designated as terrorists by the US, hold senior positions in the PMF. While it is technically under the command of Iraq‘s prime minister as part of the PMF, the group often operates outside the chain of command.
paras.zh: 战士们领取国家工资，卡塔布真主党成员，包括一些被美国认定为恐怖分子的成员，在 PMF 中担任高级职务。虽然从技术上讲，该组织是伊拉克总理的指挥下，属于人民动员部队的一部分，但该组织经常在指挥系统之外开展活动。

articles.title: Man in hospital after stabbing in Melbourne's CBD

paras.en: A man has been taken to hospital with serious injuries after a stabbing in Melbourne's CBD this afternoon.
paras.zh: 今天下午，墨尔本中央商务区发生刺伤事件，一名男子伤势严重，被送往医院。

paras.en: Police believe the 24-year-old was stabbed by another man on Bourke Street, near the corner of Elizabeth Street, about 2.30pm.
paras.zh: 警方认为，下午 2 点 30 分左右，这名 24 岁的男子在靠近伊丽莎白街拐角处的伯克街被另一名男子刺伤。

paras.en: The men are not believed to know each other, police say.
paras.zh: 警方称，据信这些人并不认识。

paras.en: Police are making extensive inquiries into the whereabouts of the alleged offender, who they say fled along Elizabeth Street towards Little Bourke Street.
paras.zh: 警方正在对嫌疑人的下落进行广泛调查，称嫌疑人沿着伊丽莎白街逃往小伯克街。

paras.en: Paramedics took the injured man to the Royal Melbourne Hospital in a critical condition with upper body injuries.
paras.zh: 医护人员将受伤男子送往皇家墨尔本医院，伤势危急，上半身受伤。

paras.en: Police described the man's injuries as serious.
paras.zh: 警方称该男子伤势严重。

paras.en: Investigators are urging anyone with information or footage to contact Crime Stoppers on 1800 333 000.
paras.zh: 调查人员敦促任何有信息或录像的人联系灭罪热线：1800 333 000。

articles.title: Victoria Point woman waited seven hours for ambulance before death

paras.en: Brisbane woman waited almost seven hours for ambulance before death
paras.zh: 布里斯班女子在死亡前等待救护车近七个小时

paras.en: A 63-year-old Brisbane woman died after waiting seven hours for an ambulance last month.
paras.zh: 上个月，一名 63 岁的布里斯班妇女在等待救护车七个小时后死亡。

paras.en: Her death is one of a number that have been labelled "avoidable".
paras.zh: 她的死亡是被标记为“可以避免”的众多事件之一。

paras.en: The woman's death will be investigated by the Queensland Ambulance Service.
paras.zh: 昆士兰救护车服务中心将对这名妇女的死亡进行调查。

articles.title: Aussie bowlers no longer in control of public perception of legacies
articles.author: Russell Jackson

paras.en: Three days ago — an eon in the context of Australian cricket's most embarrassing and avoidable omnishambles — former Australian wicketkeeper Ian Healy offered a reasonable take on Australia's famed bowling group.
paras.zh: 三天前——在澳大利亚板球史上最尴尬和最可避免的混乱的背景下——前澳大利亚守门员伊恩·希利对澳大利亚著名的保龄球团体提出了合理的看法。

paras.en: "I would say it taints their personal legacies … I don't think it's going to taint their performance legacies," Healy said. "Personally now, they're not as credible as they once were, unless they change something drastically in the next few days."
paras.zh: “我想说这会玷污他们的个人遗产……我不认为这会玷污他们的表演遗产，”希利说。 “就我个人而言，他们现在不像以前那么可信了，除非他们在未来几天内做出重大改变。”

paras.en: Healy's personal stake in this is self-evident: his niece is married to Mitchell Starc. And in a fast-evolving crisis, his qualifiers were understandable, although we will get to Josh Hazlewood's version of drastic intervention later.
paras.zh: 希利的个人利益是不言而喻的：他的侄女嫁给了米切尔·斯塔克。在一场快速演变的危机中，他的预选赛是可以理解的，尽管我们稍后会讨论乔什·黑兹尔伍德的激烈干预版本。

paras.en: Healy was right to differentiate between the professional and personal: one need not disparage all the hard work, all the joy, all the winning they have given Australians, by admitting that Australia's bowlers have, in recent times, irreparably damaged their own and Australia's credibility.
paras.zh: 希利区分职业和个人的观点是正确的：人们不必承认澳大利亚保龄球手最近不可挽回地损害了他们自己和澳大利亚的信誉，从而贬低他们为澳大利亚人带来的所有辛勤工作、所有快乐和所有胜利。

paras.en: The bowlers also surely must concede that the precise and absolute truth of what happened in 2018 no longer matters to most fans. In fact, their carefully-worded prevarications and collective obsession with semantic distinctions project an air of guilt almost comically out of proportion with the original offence.
paras.zh: 保龄球手们也肯定必须承认，2018 年发生的事情的准确和绝对真相对大多数球迷来说已经不再重要。事实上，他们措辞谨慎的搪塞和对语义区别的集体痴迷，投射出一种与最初的罪行几乎不成比例的内疚气氛，几乎可笑地。

paras.en: No matter what they saw or heard, barely anyone believes what they are saying about it.
paras.zh: 无论他们看到或听到什么，几乎没有人相信他们所说的。

paras.en: Even if players have publicly approved of Cricket Australia's "truth forum", the rest of us surely agree it is as likely to establish an agreed and convincing set of facts as it is to locate Jimmy Hoffa.
paras.zh: 即使球员们公开认可澳大利亚板球协会的“真相论坛”，我们其他人肯定也同意，它就像找到吉米·霍法一样，有可能建立一套一致同意且令人信服的事实。

paras.en: So, to extend Healy's thought, what is their legacy, exactly?
paras.zh: 那么，延伸一下希利的思想，他们的遗产到底是什么？

paras.en: They can hardly blame us for pondering it now in unflattering light. Because the obsession with the "legacy" of Australia's bowlers predates Usman Khawaja's book.
paras.zh: 他们很难责怪我们现在以不讨人喜欢的眼光来思考这个问题。因为对澳大利亚保龄球手“遗产”的痴迷早于乌斯曼·卡瓦贾（Usman Khawaja）的书。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, the idea has been fairly rammed down our throats as justification for keeping the gang together for a marathon 12 months of Test engagements against South Africa, New Zealand, India and England. The last hurrah for a golden generation, they said.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月里，这个想法已经被我们强行灌输给我们，作为让大家团结起来，与南非、新西兰、印度和英格兰进行为​​期 12 个月的马拉松式测试的理由。他们说，这是黄金一代的最后一次欢呼。

paras.en: It could be argued that the very concept was rendered pointless weeks ago, before Sandpapergate's flare-up, on Australia's disastrous recent tour of South Africa.
paras.zh: 可以说，几周前，在“沙纸门”事件爆发之前，在澳大利亚最近灾难性的南非之行中，这个概念就变得毫无意义了。

paras.en: It is one of the ironies of the present crisis engulfing the bowlers: it has precluded lengthier analysis of their deep and abject failure in the most recent Cape Town Test.
paras.zh: 这是当前席卷保龄球手的危机的讽刺之一：它阻碍了对他们在最近的开普敦测试中的深刻而悲惨的失败进行更长时间的分析。

paras.en: All the noise coming from within the team, of course, suggested this was a mere setback: South Africa are world champions for a reason, ya know? Geez, I guess we shouldn't have bowled first. Oh well, onward and upward, eh?
paras.zh: 当然，来自球队内部的所有噪音都表明这只是一次挫折：南非成为世界冠军是有原因的，你知道吗？天哪，我想我们不应该先投球。哦，好吧，向前向上，嗯？

paras.en: Actually, it was proof not just of muddled selection priorities and dwindling returns from old stagers, but a deeper crisis of philosophy and proof that the bowlers, in particular, were not operating in a meritocracy.
paras.zh: 事实上，这不仅证明了选择优先顺序混乱和老选手回报率下降，而且证明了更深层次的哲学危机，并证明投球手尤其没有在精英体制中运作。

paras.en: Having played out of his skin in the second Test, Scott Boland was dropped for Nathan Lyon, who was in turn out-bowled by Simon Harmer, an off-spinner most Australians had previously thought of as a glorified clubbie.
paras.zh: 在第二次测试中，斯科特·博兰德（Scott Boland）表现不佳，被内森·里昂（Nathan Lyon）淘汰，而内森·里昂（Nathan Lyon）又被西蒙·哈默（Simon Harmer）击倒，西蒙·哈默（Simon Harmer）是大多数澳大利亚人之前认为是光荣的俱乐部成员的旋转选手。

paras.en: And Harmer didn't merely take wickets. He publicly called out and dismantled the Australian captain in a manner that should have caused far more alarm than whatever Cummins did or didn't see as a 24-year-old.
paras.zh: 哈默不仅仅拿下三柱门。他公开斥责并拆散了这位澳大利亚船长，这种方式应该比康明斯作为一个 24 岁的年轻人所做或没有看到的任何事情引起更多的警惕。

paras.en: To delve into another modern-day obsession — being "aura" — the loss went far deeper than a 2-1 scoreline. Before its present distraction, Australian cricket pretended otherwise, but symbolic damage was done on a scale we will see more clearly in a few years.
paras.zh: 深入探讨现代人的另一种痴迷——“光环”——这场失利比 2-1 的比分要深刻得多。在目前的干扰之前，澳大利亚板球界假装并非如此，但象征性的损害所造成的规模我们将在几年后更清楚地看到。

paras.en: Which brings us to Josh Hazlewood. On a very simple level, his claim yesterday that he would "review" his place in the Australian team if Cummins lost the captaincy was an impassioned if artless expression of loyalty and solidarity with the skipper in times of disloyalty.
paras.zh: 这让我们想到了乔什·黑兹尔伍德。简单地说，他昨天声称，如果康明斯失去队长职务，他将“重新审视”自己在澳大利亚队的位置，这是在不忠诚的情况下对队长的忠诚和声援的热情而朴素的表达。

paras.en: More so, it smacked of the cart being placed a hell of a long way in front of the horse. It was an expression of entitlement that brought to mind another unflattering scene from a year ago, of an "absolutely filthy" Nathan Lyon sulking away to a sideline TV reporter after being omitted from last December's pink-ball Test. There have been others.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，它有一种马车被放在马前面很远的地方的味道。这是一种权利的表达，让人想起一年前的另一个不讨人喜欢的场景，“绝对肮脏”的内森·里昂(Nathan Lyon)在去年12月的粉球测试中被淘汰后，向场边的电视记者生闷气。还有其他人。

paras.en: For a long time now — long before Sandpapergate reared up again — there has been an inescapable sense that Australia's senior players see themselves not as members of a team chosen by an independent selection panel, nor as merely a self-selecting elite within that team, but as the self-appointed bosses of Australian Test cricket.
paras.zh: 很长一段时间以来，早在“沙纸门”事件再次兴起之前，人们就有一种不可避免的感觉，即澳大利亚的资深球员不认为自己是由独立选拔小组选出的球队的成员，也不是球队中自我选拔的精英，而是自封的澳大利亚板球对抗赛的老板。

paras.en: It is hard to escape the feeling that it is this self-absorbed culture of entitlement and the desire to control its own narrative — much more so than anything that happened in 2018 — that now defines what the public thinks of Australia's bowlers.
paras.zh: 很难不让人感觉到，正是这种自我陶醉的权利文化和控制自己叙述的欲望——比 2018 年发生的任何事情都要严重——现在决定了公众对澳大利亚保龄球手的看法。

paras.en: And yes, it is true that those who've thrown their weight around like this are, by most definitions, indisputably Australia's best. And it is also true that they have sometimes needed to exercise their collective power for the benefit of others, too, as in their pay negotiations.
paras.zh: 是的，确实，按照大多数定义，那些像这样努力的人无疑是澳大利亚最优秀的人。确实，他们有时也需要为了他人的利益而行使集体权力，例如在薪酬谈判中。

paras.en: But what is the average fan — who, by the time the Perth Test rolls around in nine days, will have been subjected to weeks of a melodrama which is only a paternity test and a few exploding boats away from a Home and Away plot — to make of a 35-year-old multi-millionaire threatening to take his ball and go home if his mate's not in charge?
paras.zh: 但是，当珀斯测试在九天后开始时，普通球迷将经历数周的情节剧，这只是一场亲子鉴定和远离主客场情节的几艘爆炸船，他们会怎么理解一位 35 岁的千万富翁威胁说，如果他的伴侣不负责，他就要拿走他的球回家？

paras.en: "The cartel". It has always had a faintly sinister ring to it, don't you think? Some of the behaviour is, frankly, gangsterism, albeit in the territory mined by Martin Scorsese and David Chase — the petty spats over matters of honour and respect, the fragile egos and wounded pride.
paras.zh: “卡特尔”。它总是带有一丝险恶的气息，你不觉得吗？坦率地说，其中一些行为是黑帮行为，尽管是在马丁·斯科塞斯和大卫·蔡斯的地盘上——围绕荣誉和尊重、脆弱的自尊和受伤的自尊心等问题发生的小口角。

paras.en: In this light, we now see Cameron Bancroft as the hapless 'Spider', egged on and then assassinated. Perhaps we suddenly respect Steve Smith a little more for silently doing all that time for crimes he didn't commit.
paras.zh: 从这个角度来看，我们现在将卡梅伦·班克罗夫特视为倒霉的“蜘蛛”，在怂恿下被暗杀。也许我们突然对史蒂夫·史密斯多了几分尊重，因为他一直默默地为他没有犯下的罪行做出了贡献。

paras.en: Which leaves us with how Australia proceeds in the short-term. Cricket Australia, more to blame for the mess than any player, confirmed on Saturday that Cummins would be retained as captain. It was the most predictable and probably the most sensible course of action based on a sober appraisal of all relevant facts, but it did also have the unfortunate effect of validating Hazlewood's veiled threat.
paras.zh: 这让我们剩下澳大利亚短期内的进展如何。澳大利亚板球协会周六证实，康明斯将继续担任队长，该协会对这场混乱负有最大的责任。基于对所有相关事实的清醒评估，这是最可预测的，也可能是最明智的行动方针，但它也确实产生了验证黑兹尔伍德隐秘威胁的不幸后果。

paras.en: Even granting the need to extinguish a tabloid bin-fire, and acknowledging the overwhelming good Cummins has done for Australian cricket, there is an irony in this: backing him in as leader guarantees him a higher work and stress load than he would ideally be shouldering at this point of his career. In an ideal world, free of this scandal, honest conversations about succession planning would already be happening.
paras.zh: 即使承认有必要扑灭小报的垃圾箱大火，并承认康明斯为澳大利亚板球运动做出了巨大的贡献，但其中存在着讽刺之处：支持他作为领导者保证了他比他在职业生涯此时理想的情况下承担更高的工作和压力负担。在一个没有丑闻的理想世界中，关于继任计划的诚实对话已经发生。

paras.en: Hazlewood's interjection and the self-conferred gravitas of his Test spot, meanwhile, sit somewhat at odds with the prevailing views of his contemporaries. Only a week ago, players' union boss Paul Marsh admitted there was "decreasing" support among players for the idea of Test cricket as the pinnacle of the sport.
paras.zh: 与此同时，黑兹尔伍德的感叹和他在测试地点所表现出的庄重感，与他同时代人的普遍观点有些不一致。就在一周前，球员工会主席保罗·马什承认，球员们对板球测试赛作为这项运动巅峰的想法的支持“正在下降”。

paras.en: Fans, by extension, are now buffeted by administrators who care too little about Test cricket and a few players who care too much.
paras.zh: 推而广之，球迷们现在受到了对板球测试赛太不关心的管理人员和一些过于关心板球比赛的球员的打击。

paras.en: In the time since Sandpapergate, Cricket Australia has had six chairmen, four CEOs, three men's head coaches and capped 21 new Test players. That a few mainstays attained an over-mighty status is perhaps natural enough, but it is surely time that senior players are reminded that Test selection is not their birthright.
paras.zh: 自 Sandpapergate 事件以来，澳大利亚板球协会已经有 6 名主席、4 名首席执行官、3 名男子主教练以及 21 名新测试球员。一些中流砥柱获得超强地位也许是很自然的事情，但现在确实是时候提醒资深玩家了，测试选择并不是他们与生俱来的权利。

paras.en: Australia's next 15 Tests would have been brutally difficult in any context. Against such a draining and unpleasant backdrop, the degree of difficulty for an aging and now embittered group of old hands has only increased.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚接下来的 15 场测试在任何情况下都将异常艰难。在这样一个令人筋疲力尽、令人不快的背景下，对于一群上了年纪、现在心怀怨恨的老手来说，难度只会增加。

paras.en: And that really is the stuff of "legacy" — not just everything in totality, but the aftertaste left by the final few bites.
paras.zh: 这确实是“遗产”的东西——不仅仅是所有的一切，还有最后几口留下的余味。

articles.title: A Montrealer died in Istanbul. Authorities blame food poisoning but what we found suggests something else
articles.author: Michelle Gagnon, Jacaudrey Charbonneau, Judith Plamondon

paras.en: A Montrealer died in Istanbul. Authorities blame food poisoning but what we found suggests something else
paras.zh: 一名蒙特利尔人在伊斯坦布尔去世。当局归咎于食物中毒，但我们的发现表明了其他原因

paras.en: Illegal use of pesticide in Turkey linked to deaths of other tourists and residents
paras.zh: 土耳其非法使用农药导致其他游客和居民死亡

paras.en: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino, a healthy 24-year-old Montrealer, died suddenly in Istanbul on June 17, 2025.
paras.zh: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino 是一名健康的 24 岁蒙特利尔人，于 2025 年 6 月 17 日在伊斯坦布尔突然去世。

paras.en: A Turkish autopsy report concluded the cause of death was food poisoning.
paras.zh: 土耳其尸检报告得出结论，死因是食物中毒。

paras.en: But for her family, that doesn't add up.
paras.zh: 但对于她的家人来说，这并不算什么。

paras.en: A joint investigation into Deveaux-Cattino's death by Enquête and the fifth estate revealed a different poison at work and 12 similar deaths.
paras.zh: Enquête 和第五庄园对 Deveaux-Cattino 的死亡事件进行了联合调查，发现了不同的中毒行为以及 12 起类似的死亡事件。

paras.en: The recent medical school graduate had decided to celebrate by taking a trip with a few of her closest friends.
paras.zh: 这位刚从医学院毕业的人决定与她的几个最亲密的朋友一起旅行来庆祝。

paras.en: "She'd never been to Turkey," said her sister, Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino. "She thought it was a super beautiful, vibrant country."
paras.zh: “她从未去过土耳其，”她的妹妹埃莱奥诺尔·德沃-卡蒂诺 (Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino) 说。 “她认为这是一个超级美丽、充满活力的国家。”

paras.en: The group hit the tourist trail and its highlights, including the requisite balloon ride in Cappadocia.
paras.zh: 该团队参观了旅游路线及其亮点，包括卡帕多西亚必不可少的热气球之旅。

paras.en: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino had never been to Turkey before her trip in 2025, says her sister, Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino. ‘She thought it was a super beautiful, vibrant country.’ (Radio-Caanda)
paras.zh: Bérengère Deveaux-Cattino 的姐姐 Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino 表示，她在 2025 年旅行之前从未去过土耳其。 “她认为这是一个超级美丽、充满活力的国家。”（Radio-Caanda）

paras.en: With only two days to go, Bérengère and one of her friends headed for Istanbul, a city she'd longed to visit.
paras.zh: 只剩两天了，贝伦盖尔和她的一位朋友前往伊斯坦布尔，这是她一直渴望参观的城市。

paras.en: - Watch the full documentary, "The Invisible Killer," from the fifth estate on YouTube or CBC-TV on Friday at 9 p.m.
paras.zh: - 周五晚上 9 点在 YouTube 或 CBC-TV 上观看来自第五庄园的完整纪录片“隐形杀手”

paras.en: They checked into Room 108 at the Seven Days Hotel and went straight out to explore. They soaked up the sights and street food, then settled down for a proper meal, a chicken casserole followed by Turkish tea and baklava.
paras.zh: 他们住进了7天酒店108房间，直接出去探索。他们欣赏了景点和街头美食，然后坐下来享用一顿美餐，先是砂锅鸡，然后是土耳其茶和果仁蜜饼。

paras.en: The next morning, they woke violently ill.
paras.zh: 第二天早上，他们醒来时病得很重。

paras.en: The details of those final days come from Laurie, the woman who travelled to Istanbul with Bérengère. What happened on that trip left her traumatized and we've agreed to protect her identity and not use her real name.
paras.zh: 最后几天的细节来自与贝伦盖尔一起前往伊斯坦布尔的劳里。那次旅行中发生的事情让她受到了创伤，我们同意保护她的身份，不使用她的真实姓名。

paras.en: She said that within minutes of waking, Bérengère was throwing up.
paras.zh: 她说贝伦盖尔醒来几分钟后就开始呕吐。

paras.en: "Then I started feeling unwell," Laurie said, "and suddenly we were taking turns running to the bathroom to vomit until we realized that whatever it was, it wasn't just going to pass."
paras.zh: “然后我开始感觉不舒服，”劳里说，“突然我们轮流跑到卫生间呕吐，直到我们意识到无论是什么，它都不会消失。”

paras.en: They called the front desk and an ambulance took them to hospital.
paras.zh: 他们打电话给前台，救护车将他们送往医院。

paras.en: ‘My sister is younger than me,’ said Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino, right. ‘I’d never imagined a life without her.’ (Submitted by Deveaux-Cattino family)
paras.zh: “我妹妹比我年轻，”埃莱奥诺尔·德沃-卡蒂诺（右）说道。 “我从未想象过没有她的生活。”（由 Deveaux-Cattino 家族提交）

paras.en: That same day, across the ocean in Montreal, Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino saw her screen light up: Laurie was FaceTiming her.
paras.zh: 同一天，在大洋彼岸的蒙特利尔，埃莱奥诺尔·德沃·卡蒂诺 (Éléonore Deveaux-Cattino) 看到她的屏幕亮了起来：劳里正在与她进行 FaceTime 通话。

paras.en: "I thought: 'This isn't normal. Something's off. This is going to be bad news,'" said Deveaux-Cattino. "She says 'Élo, we're in the hospital in Istanbul, and things aren't going well. I've been told to contact the family.'"
paras.zh: “我想：‘这不正常。有些事情不对劲。这将是个坏消息，’”德沃-卡蒂诺说。 “她说‘埃洛，我们在伊斯坦布尔的医院里，情况不太顺利。我被告知要联系家人。’”
